Description: Telkom SA SOC Ltd operates as an integrated communications and information technology (IT) services provider in South Africa the United States the United Kingdom rest of Europe and internationally. It operates through Openserve Telkom Consumer BCX Gyro and Other segments. The company offers mobile and fixed-line telecommunication services including broadband optical and carrier business-to-business connectivity interconnect-based services broadband data voice content and gaming solutions; and small and medium entity information communication and technology solutions as well as business mobility global telecommunication CPE-related services converged communication managed application-centric data networking managed local area networking unified collaboration as a service and internet and value-added services. It also provides IT advertising digital and social media advertising e-commerce and omni-channel services; and printed directory and international maritime services. In addition the company rents properties masts and towers; and offers insurance products and services. It serves residential business government wholesale and corporate customers. Telkom SA SOC Ltd was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Centurion South Africa.

Name: CELSIA S.A. E.S.P.
Description: CELSIA S.A. E.S.P. engages in the generation transmission distribution and sale of electricity to residential commercial industrial and public sectors in Colombia and Central America. It operates hydroelectric solar wind and thermal power plants; and transmission and distribution substations. It also offers solar panels for homes; chargers for electric vehicles and solar farms; cooling districts and backup energy projects; and solutions to real estate developments such as energy internet and charging stations as well as sewage and sanitation management solutions. The company was formerly known as Compañia Colombiana de Inversiones S.A. E.S.P. CELSIA S.A. E.S.P. was founded in 1919 and is based in Medellín Colombia. CELSIA S.A. E.S.P. operates as a subsidiary of Grupo Argos S.A.

Name: Bradespar S.A.
Description: Bradespar S.A. through its interest in VALE operates as a mining company in the production of iron ore and pellets and nickel in Brazil. The company also produces copper thermal and metallurgical coal manganese platinum group metals gold and silver as well as raw materials for the steel industry with applications in the stainless-steel industry and metal alloys used in the production of various products. Bradespar S.A. was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Iguatemi S.A.
Description: Iguatemi S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the commercial exploration and planning of shopping centers in Brazil. The company is also involved in the purchase and sale of real estate. In addition it provides economic financial advisory and consultancy services. The company was formerly known as Jereissati Participações S.A. and changed its name to Iguatemi S.A. in November 2021. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Saudi Reinsurance Company
Description: Saudi Reinsurance Company provides various reinsurance products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the rest of the Middle East Africa Asia and internationally. The company operates in two segments: Property and Casualty and Life and Health. The Property and Casualty segment offers engineering fire marine general accident specialty insurance blind cargo insurance and other products. The Life and Health segment provides coverage for personal well-being healthcare expenses and life protection. The company offers full account aviation energy agriculture political risk motor term and credit life health and inherent defects products. The company was formerly known as Saudi Re for Cooperative Reinsurance. Saudi Reinsurance Company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Danya Cebus Ltd.
Description: Danya Cebus Ltd. operates as a construction and infrastructure company in Israel and internationally. It undertakes infrastructure projects including road paving building railway infrastructure construction of bridges parking lots tunnel mining and related infrastructure development as well as commercial industrial and residential infrastructures. The company also engages in the planning and execution of integrated electromechanic multi system projects; concrete pumps array lease of tower cranes external elevators services and skyscrapers and building equipment; residential projects for rent or sale; the execution of underground works that include foundation deposition and works related to advanced geotechnics; and production of aluminum elements and windows. In addition it provides pre-construction services including review of plans schedules logistical planning and design; construction services comprising project contract on-site logistics and on-site safety management services as well as equipment and materials; consulting services such as project analysis survey quality control and schedule analysis; and human resource solutions. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Or Yehuda Israel. Danya Cebus Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Africa Israel Investments Ltd.

Name: Türk Traktör ve Ziraat Makineleri A.S.
Description: Türk Traktör ve Ziraat Makineleri A.S. engages in the manufacture and sale of tractor and agricultural equipment worldwide. It also offers construction equipment. The company offers its products under the New Holland Case TürkTraktör New Holland Construction Tarlam cepte Hassas Tarim and Servisim brands. Türk Traktör ve Ziraat Makineleri A.S. was formerly known as Minneapolis Moline Türk Traktör ve Ziraat Makineleri A.S. and changed its name to Türk Traktör ve Ziraat Makineleri A.S. in 1968. Türk Traktör ve Ziraat Makineleri A.S. was founded in 1954 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: EIS Eczacibasi Ilaç Sinai ve Finansal Yatirimlar Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: EIS Eczacibasi Ilaç Sinai ve Finansal Yatirimlar Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. together with subsidiaries engages in health and real estate development businesses in Turkey and internationally. The Health segment is involved in the production marketing and sale of medicines related to human health and veterinary medicines. The Real Estate Development segment develops real estate properties; engages in rental activities for serum facilities; and provides consulting services on land development and project management. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. EIS Eczacibasi Ilaç Sinai ve Finansal Yatirimlar Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Eczacibasi Holding A.S.

Name: Transportadora de Gas del Norte S.A.
Description: Transportadora de Gas del Norte S.A. engages in the natural gas transportation in the north and central west regions of Argentina. The company operates and maintains approximately 11222 km of both own and third party pipelines. It also provides operation maintenance integrity pipeline connection and hot taps engineering pipeline works management consulting training SCADA and communications community damage prevention and special projects services to third-party pipelines in Argentina Chile Mexico Peru and Uruguay. Transportadora de Gas del Norte S.A. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. The company operates as a subsidiary of Gasinvest S.A.

Name: First Citizens Group Financial Holdings Limited
Description: First Citizens Group Financial Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries provides banking services in Trinidad and Tobago. It operates through Retail Banking Corporate Banking Treasury Management and Investment Banking and Asset Management segments. The company offers savings and chequing accounts; electronic statements; vehicle home renovation EZ public servants professionals commercial small business and green energy loans; residential and commercial mortgages; wealth management services such as managed accounts bond trading fixed income paper local brokerage services global investment and managed portfolios mutual funds and liquidity management; and debit and credit cards. It also provides commercial banking products including fixed deposits investment solutions working capital/overdraft facilities electronic cash management foreign exchange and international trade services; corporate and investment banking services consisting of project financing corporate and sovereign debt issuances working capital and structured financing and bonds and guarantees; and brokerage capital market and investment advisory services. In addition the company offers depository services such as custodian fund administration/registrar paying agency repo financial accounting/reporting and leasing services; corporate finance and specialized financial trading; investment products and services; and trustee services for retirement benefit plans mutual funds and bonds and loans as well as pension administration and escrow agent services. Further it provides digital online mobile WhatsApp and telebanking services; point of sale terminals; e-commerce solutions; and ATM services. The company was founded in 1914 and is based in Port of Spain Trinidad & Tobago. First Citizens Group Financial Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of First Citizens Holdings Limited.

Name: LDR Turizm A.S.
Description: LDR Turizm A.S. provides long term car rental services. The company sells used cars; and offers professional and roadside assistance; spare vehicles; maintenance and repair; inspections; tire and penalty management; valet; and insurance services. LDR Turizm A.S. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Rami Levi Chain Stores Hashikma Marketing 2006 Ltd
Description: Rami Levi Chain Stores Hashikma Marketing 2006 Ltd together with its subsidiaries operates a chain of discount format retail stores in Israel. It offers food products; and vegetable and fruit products; cleaning products; toiletries; housewares; cosmetics; clothing and textiles; leisure products; and household goods baked goods and tobacco products as well as textile products. The company also provides franchise services. Rami Levi Chain Stores Hashikma Marketing 2006 Ltd was founded in 1976 and is based in Modi'in-Maccabim-Re'ut Israel.

Name: Barloworld Limited
Description: Barloworld Limited operates as an industrial processing distribution and services company in Southern Africa the United Kingdom Australia Russia and Mongolia. The company operates through Equipment Southern Africa Ingrain Equipment Mongolia Equipment Russia and Other segments. The company offers industrial equipment and services comprising of earthmoving equipment industrial services and power systems that enable various mining construction and power solutions. It also manufactures various products which includes food and beverages paper pharmaceuticals building material and adhesives and others. In addition the company offers starch glucose and other products; and salvage management and disposal services. The company was founded in 1902 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P. through its subsidiaries operates in the financial services food petrochemicals and oil services media real estate and education sectors in Kuwait rest of the GCC rest of the Middle East rest of Asia rest of North Africa Europe and North America. It operates in six segments: Commercial Banking; Asset Management and Investment Banking; Media & Satellite Services; Energy; Industrial and Logistics; and Hospitality and Real Estate. The company offers commercial banking services including retail corporate and private banking; treasury products; and digital satellite services media pay TV services via satellite cable radio channels and music and video online streaming. It is also involved in asset management and investment banking activities such as corporate finance investment advisory and research and wealth management; manufacturing sale supply store export and distribution of various aromatics chemical and petrochemical materials and related derivatives; oil field maintenance and drilling services; setting up projects in the oil and gas and renewable energy sector; and consultancy activities. In addition the company engages in industrial project development food utilities transportation logistics and related supply chain services; hospitality and real estate sector; dairy production; leasing of equipment and vehicles; manufacture of rubber and plastic materials; stevedoring marine brokerage printing photography management management property management marketing facilities and hotel management research and development touristic development cosmetic agricultural medical construction educational live event and advertising services; broadcasting TV and IP streaming; managing and operating systems; and trading in electronic and satellite receiving equipment. Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Brava Energia S.A.
Description: Brava Energia S.A. engages in the exploration and production of oil and natural gas in Brazil. The company was formerly known as 3R Petroleum Óleo e Gás S.A. and changed its name to Brava Energia S.A. in September 2024. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Saudi Automotive Services Company
Description: Saudi Automotive Services Company owns and operates a network of motor vehicle service stations in Saudi Arabia. It operates through Retail and Operations; SASCO Palm; Saudi Club; Transportation Fleet; and Others segments. The company establishes workshops for repairing cars heavy equipment and car service stations; engages in local and international car and motorcycle clubs; issues customs traffic documents and international driving licenses; establishes manages maintains and operates motorsports and motorcycle circuits; organizes races and events related to motorsports and motorcycles; transports and distributes water; and transports refrigerated and frozen goods equipment liquids and gases and cars. It also imports and sells foodstuffs drinks beverages and raw materials; operates rest houses motels and restaurants; washes and lubricates cars and equipment; and imports and sells equipment and tools motor vehicles and spare parts. In addition the company engages in buying selling and zoning lands and real estate off-plan sale activities managing and renting owned and leased residential and non-residential properties management activities of properties against commission and real estate registration services; providing marketing services; and constructing roads and bridges. Further it undertakes contracts for establishment management maintenance and operation of residential and commercial buildings and road works; catering; and retail of food and beverages as well as operates fuel station and related activities hotels and integrated office administrative service activities. Saudi Automotive Services Company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Ali Al-Ghanim Sons Automotive Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Ali Al-Ghanim Sons Automotive Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries operates in the automotive business in Kuwait Iraq Egypt and the United Arab Emirates. The company imports distributes and sells vehicles and spare parts; and provides services related to vehicle inspection repair and maintenance. It also engages in dealership of heavy trucks; car rental and leasing; insurance brokerage; used vehicle sales; and real estate business. In addition the company operates showrooms and service centers; and offers after-sales services car valuation services technical inspection and vehicle registration renewal services. The company was founded in 1960 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Ali Al-Ghanim Sons Automotive Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Ali Alghanim Sons Holding Company K.S.C.C.

Name: Scotiabank Trinidad and Tobago Limited
Description: Scotiabank Trinidad and Tobago Limited together with its subsidiaries provides a range of banking and financial services to personal corporate and commercial and business customers. It operates through Retail Corporate and Commercial; Asset management; and Insurance Services segments. The company offers various savings and foreign currency chequing and business accounts as well as term deposits and saving and professional plans; and car and home builder loans auto financing mortgages credit line and term loans for business SME stimulus loan facilities working capital and term financing trade financing structured finance overdraft protection and credit cards. It also provides mutual funds international trade investment banking credit protection insurance risk management asset management insurance and other financial services as well as cash management services such as account management payable and receivable and merchant services. The company was founded in 1906 and is based in Port of Spain the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago. Scotiabank Trinidad and Tobago Limited is a subsidiary of Scotiabank Caribbean Holdings Ltd.

Name: CRDB Bank Plc
Description: CRDB Bank Plc together with its subsidiaries provides corporate and retail banking services for individuals small and medium enterprises (SME) corporates and high net worth individuals in the United Republic of Tanzania the Republic of Burundi and the Democratic Republic of Congo. It operates through Corporate Banking Retail Banking and Treasury segments. The company offers current malkia savings junior jumbo call fixed deposit salary bidii Hodari teen niamoja pension and scholar accounts; personal and salary advance loans; SME MSE malkia and komboa loans; debit cards; short- and long-term loans; and trade finance overdraft facilities contract financing for construction asset-based financing utility services general business and agricultural based project financing. It also provides foreign exchange financial custodial and registrar-ship services; government securities; securities brokerage services; internet and mobile banking services; and motor credit life assurance personal accident domestic package fire group life fidelity guarantee goods in transit marine money and all risk insurance products. The company operates through a network of multiple branches automated teller machines point of sales terminals and agents. CRDB Bank Plc was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Gen Ilac Ve Saglik Urunleri Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Gen Ilac Ve Saglik Urunleri Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi a pharmaceutical company manufactures and supplies products to treat rare diseases and disorders worldwide. The company offers its products in various areas such as neurology endocrinology nephrology oncology hematology and pediatric. Gen Ilac Ve Saglik Urunleri Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi has collaboration with Sulfateq BV for the development of molecule SUL-238 as a treatment for Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative diseases. In addition it manufactures trades imports and exports of all kinds of human medicines and health products. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Çankaya Turkey.

Name: Bank Dhofar SAOG
Description: Bank Dhofar SAOG provides corporate retail and investment banking products and services to individuals families and businesses in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates in four segments: Retail Banking Corporate Banking Treasury and Investments and Islamic Banking. The company offers savings current ladies youth expatriate children minor escrow overdraft relationship banking and private banking accounts; recurring call fixed and flexi deposit accounts; education and retirement savings plans; housing auto personal and term loans as well as other credit facilities; debit and credit cards; consumer loans and mortgages; wealth management; and project finance services. It also provides accident illness home health travel and motor insurance products; and corporate internet banking and collections point of sale payment gateway remote cheque capture and deposit e-statement and SMS alert services. In addition the company offers trade finance services; bonds and guarantees; trade and transactional banking services; export and import letters of credit; letters of guarantee and documentary collections; commercial and treasury payments; Nostro and Vostro accounts; treasury products; cash management and risk participation services; and fund management investment in debt instruments and advisory services as well as engages in the trading of money markets foreign currencies and derivatives; and arranging/participating in syndicated/club/bilateral loans. Further it provides investment savings products; custody; financial planning and investment services; investment management and institutional finance services; and Islamic and online banking services. Additionally the company operates ATMs and CDMs. Bank Dhofar SAOG was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Jordan Islamic Bank
Description: Jordan Islamic Bank together with its subsidiaries provides financial banking and investment services in Jordan and internationally. The company offers current salary current demand saving call term notice investment by proxy and fund accounts; and house car and furniture financing services. It also provides Murabaha sale installment sale and musawama products; and investment services such as craftsmen financing Musharaka and Mudaraba as well as buys sells and rents real estate properties. In addition the company offers cards electronic and remittance services; online and mobile banking and SMS services; and education and brokerage services as well as safe deposit boxes. It operates through a network of various branches and banking offices. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Amman Jordan. Jordan Islamic Bank operates as a subsidiary of Al Baraka Group B.S.C.

Name: Fras-le S.A.
Description: Fras-le S.A. provides friction materials for braking systems and other products in Brazil England Argentina the United States China India Uruguay Holland Chile Colombia Germany South America and internationally. It operates through Automakers and Replacement segments. The company offers brake linings for commercial vehicles brake pads for commercial vehicles automobiles motorcycles and small aircraft brake linings for automobiles railway shoes brake shoes for commercial vehicles and automobiles clutch linings molded linings and universal plates and industrial products; brake disc drum master cylinder servos wheel cylinder wheel hubs repairs actuators and check valves. The company sells its products under the FRAS-LE Controil FREMAX and NAKATA brands. It also exports its products. Fras-le S.A. was founded in 1954 and is based in Caxias Do Sul Brazil. Fras-le S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Randon S.A. Implementos e Participações.

Name: Specialized Medical Company
Description: Specialized Medical Company owns and operates hospitals clinics and medical centers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates in two segments Medical Services and Pharmacies & Others. The company provides diagnostic and therapeutic services for emergency medicine cardiology internal and family medicine and pediatrics; and ancillary services such as lab histopathology diagnostic radiology and nuclear medicine anesthesiology pharmacy and physiotherapy rehab. It also operates surgical units comprising operating room and recovery delivery unit ophthalmology general surgery obstetrics and gynecology urology orthopedics and ENT; and critical care units such as neonatal intensive care CCU and ICU. In addition the company provides a range of medical and alternative medical services addressing dermatology anti-aging and other aesthetic concerns; and home health care virtual consultation and dentistry services. Further it offers cooked and non-cooked food; hospital and medical facilities maintenance services; and non-medical healthy food and food related services as well as management and operations of restaurants. Specialized Medical Company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Transcorp Hotels Plc
Description: Transcorp Hotels Plc together with its subsidiaries provides hospitality services in Nigeria. The company’s hotel services include accommodation cuisines equipped meeting rooms and leisure facilities to business travelers and tourists. It operates the Transcorp Hilton hotel located in Abuja; and Aura by Transcorp Hotels. The company was formerly known as Transnational Hotels and Tourism Services Limited and changed its name to Transcorp Hotels Plc in 2014. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Abuja Nigeria. Transcorp Hotels Plc is a subsidiary of Transnational Corporation of Nigeria Plc.

Name: Abu Qir Fertilizers and Chemical Industries Co. (S.A.E.)
Description: Abu Qir Fertilizers and Chemical Industries Co. (S.A.E.) manufactures and sells nitrogenous fertilizers chemical and other related materials in Egypt and internationally. The company offers prilled urea prilled urea treated with zinc sulphate granular ammonium nitrate granular urea granular urea treated with magnesium and ammonium sulphate urea ammonium nitrate and liquid ammonia. It also provides maintenance for mechanical electrical instrumentation fire protection and detection and bulk material handling facilities; plant shutdowns/turnaround; turbomachinery vibration diagnosis and balancing; construction and piping; workshop; inspection; lifting; water treatment; electrical maintenance; instrumentation; and laboratory analysis services. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Cerveceria San Juan S.A.
Description: Cerveceria San Juan S.A. engages in the production packaging distribution and sale of beer in Peru. It offers malted beverages soft drinks liquors and waters as well as nutritional drinks. The company was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Pucallpa Peru. Cerveceria San Juan S.A. is a subsidiary of Anheuser-Bush InBev NV/SA.

Name: Stanbic IBTC Holdings PLC
Description: Stanbic IBTC Holdings PLC a financial holding company provides banking and other financial services to individuals businesses institutions and corporations in Nigeria and internationally. The Business and Commercial Banking segment offers residential accommodation financing solutions and fleet management and related services to retail small and medium sized businesses and large commercial enterprises. The Corporate and Investment Banking segment provides transactional and lending products such as cash management international trade finance working capital and investor services solutions; and global markets including foreign exchange money markets interest rates equities credit and commodities. This segment also offers investment banking services including advisory and financing solutions for term lending to structured and specialized products across equity and debt capital markets. The Personal and Private Banking segment provides credit card facilities to individuals and businesses; merchant acquiring services; digital payment through various products and platforms; mobile money; and cross-border businesses. This segment offers retail lending; and transactional savings payment and liquidity management solutions. The Insurance and Asset Management segment provides investment portfolio and trust and fund management services as well as offers life insurance and trusteeship services. It undertakes venture capital projects; acts as an investor and portfolio manager an executor and trustee of wills and trusts and promoter of unit trust and funds; administrates and manages pension fund assets; general corporate finance and debt advisory services; and provides agency stockbroking and insurance brokerage services. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Stanbic IBTC Holdings PLC is a subsidiary of Stanbic Africa Holdings Limited.

Name: Odontoprev S.A.
Description: Odontoprev S.A. provides private dental care plans in Brazil. The company operates through Corporate Small and Medium-Sized Enterprise (SME) Individual and Other segments. The company manages and sells dental care plans to corporations and/or individuals. It is also involved in commercial advisory consulting and business management services; develops and licenses software programs; wholesale and retail trade of products and equipment sanitizers drugs medicines pharmaceutical inputs and related items; provision of storage loading deposit organization tidying custody of goods technical and administrative programming services as well as general management of assets and business. In addition the company engages in integrating technologies to develop dental solutions; and provide specialized services related to accidents and illnesses besides actuarial financial administrative and commercial and risk management services. Odontoprev S.A. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Barueri Brazil. Odontoprev S.A. is a subsidiary of Bradesco Saúde S.A.

Name: Kaleseramik Canakkale Kalebodur Seramik Sanayi A.S.
Description: Kaleseramik Canakkale Kalebodur Seramik Sanayi A.S. operates in the ceramic industry in Turkey. It offers floor and kitchen ceramics; urinals; kitchen countertops faucets and taps; sink; concealed cisterns; shower heads; bathroom models products and accessories; armatures; bathroom cabinets furniture ceramics; and toilet seats under the Canakkale Ceramics Kalebodur T-ONE and Kalekim brands. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Kaleseramik Canakkale Kalebodur Seramik Sanayi A.S.  operates as a subsidiary of Canakkale Seramik Fabrikalari A.S.

Name: Universal Motors Israel Ltd
Description: Universal Motors Israel Ltd imports markets and sells Chevrolet Cadillac AVIS and Isuzu brand motor vehicles in Israel. It imports and markets new vehicles spare parts light and medium trucks and buses; and provides new and used car sales operational fleet sales finance rental insurance auto and repair services. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Lod Israel.

Name: Deyaar Development PJSC
Description: Deyaar Development PJSC together with its subsidiaries provides property investment development leasing and management services in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Property Development Properties and Facilities Management and Hospitality Related Activities. It also provides facility management services; and property management services for residential commercial and mixed-use developments to property owners investors and tenants. In addition the company offers real estate services community management asset management hotel management leasing facilities leisure cooling brokerage and related services and hospitality related services as well as rents hotels and hotel apartments.Deyaar Development PJSC was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Jazeera Airways K.S.C.P.
Description: Jazeera Airways K.S.C.P. engages in providing air transportation and commercial passenger services in Kuwait Middle East Central South Asia and Europe. It operates through Passenger Airline Service and Terminal Operations segments. The company operates a fleet of Airbus A320 and A320neo aircraft. It also owns and operates a terminal at Kuwait International Airport. In addition the company provides park and fly remote check-in services; and air cargo services including express courier unaccompanied bags human remains dangerous goods and general and perishable cargo services. It offers its services through its website and mobile app. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Qassim Cement Company
Description: Qassim Cement Company engages in the manufacture and selling of cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers ordinary Portland Portland pozzolana sulphate resistant and finishing cement products as well as derivatives and supplements of cement. Qassim Cement Company was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Buraydah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Grupo Herdez S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Herdez S.A.B. de C.V. a food company provides processed food in Mexico and internationally. It provides homemade salsas organic products honey ice cream marmalade mayonnaise mole mustard pasta spices tea tomato puree tuna and other products. The company offers its products under Aires de Campo Barilla Blasón Búfalo Cielito Querido Café Del Fuerte Doña María Embasa Helados Nestlé® Herdez McCormick Moyo Nutrisa Wholly Guacamole and Yemina brand names as well as Betty Crocker Fiber One Frank’s French’s Häagen-Dazs Kids Bar Kikkoman Pillsbury and Nature Valley y Reynolds brand names. The company was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico. Grupo Herdez S.A.B. de C.V. is a subsidiary of Hechos Con Amor S.A. de C.V.

Name: The SPAR Group Ltd
Description: The SPAR Group Ltd engages in the wholesale and distribution of goods and services to grocery stores and other group retail outlets in South Africa and internationally. The company offers fresh produce in-store bakery butchery deli ready-to-eat meals home-meal replacements groceries general merchandise baked foods liquor products building and hardware products coffee dispensary and health-related products confectionery health and beauty frozen foods catering products wines and non-food items. The SPAR Group Ltd operates stores under the Bean Tree PHARMACY at SPAR Chikka Chicken SPAR Freshline & SPAR Bakery Good Living McCoy Pies SaveMor SPAR Products SPAR Signature Selection SPAR Butchery SPAR Express and The Food Stall brands. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Pinetown South Africa.

Name: Southern Peru Copper Corporation - Sucursal del Peru
Description: Southern Peru Copper Corporation - Sucursal del Peru engages in the mining milling and floatation of ore to produce copper concentrates. The company also smelts and refines copper concentrate to produce copper anodes and cathodes as well as molybdenum sulfuric acid gold silver and other by-product concentrates. It operates the Toquepala mining unit located in the region of Tacna; the Cuajone mining unit situated in the region of Moquegua; and a foundry and refinery property located in Ilo Peru; and holds interests in the Tia Maria project in Arequipa the Quebrada Honda dam in Tacna the Quaternary Crushing plant in Cuajone the Los Chancas project in Apurimac and the Michiquillay project in Cajamarca. The company also exports its copper products to the United States Europe Asia and South American countries. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Lima Peru. Southern Peru Copper Corporation - Sucursal del Peru operates as a subsidiary of Southern Copper Corporation.

Name: M.Yochananof and Sons (1988) Ltd
Description: M.Yochananof and Sons (1988) Ltd engages in the marketing and retail trade in the food and related products in Israel. It operates through Food Retail and Others segments. The company sells dairy products pharmaceutical and cleaning products fresh and frozen meat fruits and vegetables fish products groceries beverages frozen products delicacies and bakery products. It also imports and retails household and personal care products toiletries and household utensils. The company sells its products to supermarkets and food retailers through its retail stores under the Yohannoff and Cheap Stock brands. M.Yochananof and Sons (1988) Ltd was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Rehovot Israel.

Name: Premier Group Limited
Description: Premier Group Limited operates as a consumer-packaged goods company in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Millbake and Groceries and International segments. The company manufactures distributes and sells bread flour maize meal sugar confectionary and nutritional beverages as well as biscuits pasta rice and wheat products. It also provides animal feeds feminine hygiene and other personal care products that include intimate care menstrual and cotton wool products. In addition the company engages in flour milling; food processing; investment holding; baking; sales and distribution; and management services. The company sells its products under the Fepro Iwisa Mageu Iwisa No.1 PowerUp Mandla Mahewu Nyala Amahewu Super Sun Mageu Cream and Smileez biscuits CIM Dry Biscuits BB Bakeries Blue Ribbon Blue Ribbon Square Mister Bread S.U.B. Star Bakeries Manhattan Champion Mister Sweet Rascals Super C Impala Invicta Ligugu Mega Star Nyala Premier Braaipap Super Sun Top Score Polana Sunblest Dove Cotton Lil-Lets Crown Select Dourado Bakers Pride Favorita Florbela and Snowflake brands. The company was founded in 1824 and is headquartered in Waterfall South Africa.

Name: Crédit du Maroc S.A.
Description: Crédit du Maroc S.A. provides various banking and financial products and services in Morocco. The company offers bank accounts bank cards and online banking services; real estate and car loans and consumer credits; savings insurance and pension and education savings; and accident protection as well as death and disability multi-risk home and payment means insurance for individuals. The company also offers accounts and cards; funding for equipment credit and furniture leasing as well as real loans; financial investments; and life provident and account insurance to professionals. In addition it provides accounts and cards; funding for agricultural campaign material and development; financial investments; and life and account insurance products to farmers. Further the company provides payment methods international activities remote banking and flow management services; project financing such as investment financing funding of the operating cycle and financing of the corporate finance; and investment in UCITS term investments and negotiable debt securities for companies. Additionally it provides private banking products and services. The company formerly known as Credit Lyonnais Maroc and changed its name to Crédit du Maroc S.A. 1966. The company was founded in 1929 and is based in Casablanca Morocco. Crédit du Maroc S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Groupe Holmarcom.

Name: Kuo S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Kuo S.A.B. de C.V. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells consumer products plastics and chemical products and transmissions and auto parts in Mexico the United States Spain Belgium and China. It operates through three segments: Consumption Chemical and Automotive. The company engages in the production sale and marketing of consumer products such as processed food and beverages; plastics and chemical products that includes synthetic rubber and polymers; and transmissions automotive parts and components such as pistons brakes bearings gaskets valves and water pumps. Kuo S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Banco Patagonia S.A.
Description: Banco Patagonia S.A. provides various banking products and services in Argentina. It offers savings retired salary current agro and minor accounts; accounts for SMEs; and foreign trade services. The company also provides Patagonia leasing capital marketing and alternative financing services. In addition it offers loans; safe deposit boxes; credit and debit cards; and home car motorbike mobility ATM robbery protected belongings smartphone pets personal accidents life health burial and rental bond insurance products. Further the company provides financial agency services; mobile banking services; business cards; investments for fixed-term mutual funds and financial trusts; and collection payment inter-banking and AFIP services. It serves individuals businesses professionals SMEs agro-business clients the public sector and institutional clients. The company was incorporated in 1928 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Banco Patagonia S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Banco do Brasil S.A.

Name: Cogna Educação S.A.
Description: Cogna Educação S.A. operates as an educational organization in Brazil and internationally. It operates through three segments: Kroton Vasta and Saber. The company provides in-person and distance learning for higher education and postgraduate courses; and editing marketing and distribution of textbooks paradidactic books and handouts. It also offers basic education pre-university preparatory courses and language courses; and complementary activities such as education technology development for services to complement management and training. In addition the company advises on and/or facilitates direct and indirect financing for students; and develops software for adaptive teaching and academic management optimization. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Belo Horizonte Brazil.

Name: Pick n Pay Stores Limited
Description: Pick n Pay Stores Limited an investment holding company engages in the retail of food health and beauty products general merchandise clothing liquor and additional value-added-services in South Africa and Rest of Africa. The company owns and franchises hypermarkets supermarkets clothing stores liquor stores superstores build stores and express stores. It also offers its products online. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: IFA Hotels and Resorts - KPSC
Description: IFA Hotels and Resorts - KPSC engages in the development management and marketing of hotels and resorts in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates Africa and internationally. It operates through Property Development Hospitality Investments and Others segments. The company offers hotel management serviced homes and vacation rentals services under the Fairmont Hotels & Resorts Kempinski Hotels Mövenpick Hotels & Resorts and Sheraton Hotels & Resorts brands. It also purchases develops manages and sells real estate properties and land; and trades in private residential plots. In addition the company holds purchases and sells shares and bonds of real estate companies; provides studies and consultations on real estate issues. Further it prepares real estate auctions; provides buildings general contracting; holds and manages commercial and residential complexes; establishes building foundations for residential commercial maintenance touristic urban athletic buildings and projects; and operates beach clubs. Additionally the company offers travel and tourism services such as personal travel consultancy and air chartering services as well as provides events meetings corporate incentive arrangements; and offers assess to private jets yachts and tailor-creating travel experiences. The company was formerly known as Offset Consulting and Project Management Company – WLL – Najwa Ahmed Abdelaziz Al-Qatami and Partners and changed its name to IFA Hotels and Resorts - KPSC in May 2005. IFA Hotels and Resorts - KPSC was founded in 1995 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry
Description: East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry provides coating services on pipes provided by the customers. The company provides steel pipes for water oil and gas applications; double jointing solutions; coating solutions including environmental applications; and ancillary services comprising laboratory and technical support services as well as yard management systems. It is also involved in processing and polishing of metals. East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry was formerly known as Welspun Middle East Pipes LLC and changed its name to East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry in January 2021. East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry was founded in 2010 and is based in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Commercial Real Estate Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Commercial Real Estate Company K.P.S.C. engages in the real estate business in the State of Kuwait Gulf countries and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Real Estate Hotel and Investment. Its property portfolio includes office towers malls/restaurant complexes residential properties and ballrooms. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Ampa Ltd
Description: Ampa Ltd. through its subsidiaries develops and manages residential and commercial properties. It develops holds rents and manages office industrial commercial and parking spaces as well as entrepreneurial real estate. The company also engages in the financing for accompanying construction projects capital supplements and surplus extraction for real estate developers; credit services; and leasing of residential apartment as well as operates shared coworking spaces. In addition it is involved in the manufacturing of tubes closures and sheets for the food beverage and other industries; cultivation and trading of agricultural produce such as blueberries raspberries blackberries and strawberries under the Carmel brand; and generation of electricity from a water stream as well as operates hotels. The company was founded in 1933 and is based in Herzliya Pituach Israel.

Name: Truworths International Limited
Description: Truworths International Limited an investment holding and management company engages in the retail of fashion apparel and accessories. It operates through Truworths Africa and Office UK segments. The company offers accessories bags bottoms jackets and coats jewellery and watches shoes sleepwear tops and Gifts for women men and kids. It also provides purses denim dresses lingerie maternity formals and co-ord sets for women; wallets suiting and underwears for men; kids multipacks for kids. In addition the company offers fragrances for men and women and kids; skincare such as cleansing moisturisers bath and body gifting special treatments mens grooming and suncare; and makups for eyes gifting lips face and nails. Further it provides homeware including blankets and throws; duvet covers and inners; sheeting; pillowcases; pillows for bedroom; bathmats; bathroom accessories; home fragrances; towels; and bathroom fragrance for bathroom; and curtains decor rugs scatter cushions dining the flower shop and kitchen accessories for living; and soft toys for kids. The company offers its products under various range of brands through a network of stores concession outlets wholesale partnerships and an ecommerce channel. Truworths International Limited was founded in 1917 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E.)
Description: Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E.) engages in real estate and project development and investment business in Egypt. The company involved in the planning and construction of urban districts and provision of utilities and services. Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E.) was founded in 1997 and is based in Giza Egypt. Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E.) is a subsidiary of Emaar Properties PJSC.

Name: Al Moammar Information Systems Company
Description: Al Moammar Information Systems Company provides information technology solutions and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates in seven segments: Business Service Management Unit Solutions Unit Systems Unit Information Technology Security Unit Networking Unit Operation and Maintenance Unit and Data Center Unit. It offers managed healthcare people and medical services; SLA support; MDR; SOC services; and managed IT consulting professional and project management services. The company also provides various data analytics and artificial intelligence solutions; data-driven applications that include ERP and CRM banking and medical applications anti-money laundering geographic information systems industry applications environmental applications and forecast business process management AI chatbots mobile and web applications; and digital platforms including marketplace and e-commerce search engine payment communication digital retail supply chain smart city and digital banking and health platforms. In addition it offers cyber security solutions; web hosting; software solutions including software-defined networking WAN and access as well as network automation and analytics private 5G Wi-Fi 6/6E application delivery controller and monitoring and management; and collaboration solutions such as unified communications collaboration touchpoints conferencing and messaging workspaces and contact center; and UC applications analytics and cloud solutions. Further the company provides medical devices and laboratory products as well as operates tele-care and telemedicine centers canteens or cafeterias and storage of medical waste. It serves transport logistics entertainment manufacturing sales healthcare education energy and services and telecommunication industries; and governments cities financial resources and banks. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: RAK Properties PJSC
Description: RAK Properties PJSC together with its subsidiaries engages in the investment development and management of real estate properties in the United Arab Emirates. It operates in three segments: Property Sales Hotel Operations and Property Leasing and Others. It is involved in the provision of the marina management and related services; and operates hotels. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Ras al-Khaimah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: United Bank for Africa Plc
Description: United Bank for Africa Plc together with its subsidiaries primarily provides corporate commercial and retail banking services in Nigeria rest of Africa and internationally. The company operates through Corporate Banking Retail/Commercial Banking and Treasury and Financial Markets segments. It offers savings current salary domiciliary diaspora and fixed deposit accounts. The company also provides corporate banking financial solutions to multinationals regional companies state-owned companies non-governmental organizations international and multinational organizations and financial institutions; retail/commercial banking products and services to middle and retail segments; and financing and risk management solutions and advisory services to corporate and institutional customers. In addition it offers energy banking services including treasury products current/dom. services credit facilities credit agency backed financing solutions note issuance facilities FCY lending and hedging products structured/project finance loan syndication E–banking services auto notification services card-based services government payment and collection services and in plant tellering services. Further the company provides mobile Internet and magic banking as well as notification services; SME loans and advances including working capital loans SME asset finance healthcare loans creative industry finance young entrepreneurs loans and school loans as well as SME accounts; business registration support services; international trade services; card solutions; merchant services; strategic advisory and research; and e-payment solutions. Additionally it offers trade remittance treasury management custody/investor and cash management services. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Motus Holdings Limited
Description: Motus Holdings Limited provides automotive mobility solutions in South Africa the United Kingdom Australia and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Import and Distribution; Retail and Rental; Mobility Solutions; Aftermarket Parts; and Head Office and Eliminations. It imports and distributes passenger and light commercial vehicles and parts to serve a network of dealerships vehicle rental companies fleets and government institutions; retails new and pre-owned passenger and commercial vehicles; sells parts and accessories; provides servicing and maintenance of vehicles; and provides treasury management fleet management telemetry and business process outsourcing services. The company also distributes wholesales and retails parts and accessories for out-of-warranty vehicles; and develops manages administers distributes vehicle related financial products and services. Motus Holdings Limited was founded in 1948 and is based in Bedfordview South Africa.

Name: Banco Pichincha C.A.
Description: Banco Pichincha C.A. provides various banking services in Ecuador. It offers basic savings compatriot transactional flexible and young future savings accounts as well as current accounts. The company provides multipurpose and open line credit; used heavy lightweight vehicles and vehicle biocredit; educational credits; and mortgage credit including public and social interest housing consulting rooms office and premise biocredit for green housing construction housing for migrants and new or used housing credit as well as mortgage loan for construction expand and remodel. In addition it offers personal credit such as personal guarantee used vehicles educational open line and mortgage-secured credit; investment-backed credit; vehicle productive and builder biocredit; credit for woman; distributor-supplier business credit; constructor credit; and business credit. Further the company provides financial payment solutions; corporate prepaid and business card; credit card activation; forex trading trust payroll phone recharge online payment money receiving online purchase international transfer and shipments from abroad services; insurance products; cash management; agribusiness products; and web mobile and telephone banking. The company was formerly known as Banco del Pichincha C.A. and changed its name to Banco Pichincha C.A. in September 2006. The company was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Quito Ecuador. Banco Pichincha C.A. operates as a subsidiary of Grupo Financiero Pichincha.

Name: United International Holding Company
Description: United International Holding Company together with its subsidiaries provides consumer finance services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers product personal and credit card finance services to individual customers. It also invests in stocks and other securities; and provides loans guarantees and financing to affiliated companies. In addition the company offers remote processing and support data backup credit card payment and technical services for financial institutions and other companies; and call center application processing and information technology support services. United International Holding Company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Al Khobar Saudi Arabia. United International Holding Company is a subsidiary of United Electronics Company.

Name: Agility Public Warehousing Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Agility Public Warehousing Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries operates as an aviation services company under Agility brand name in the Middle East Europe Asia the United States and Africa. The company provides real estate fuel logistics airplane ground handling and cleaning services cargo and lounge management customs operations and management construction and remote site services customs consulting and waste recycling services. In addition it offers inventory management order fulfilment transportation and warehousing and rental services; and ground handling and airport services which includes ramp passengers into-plane fuelling and other aviation related services. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: O.Y. Nofar Energy Ltd
Description: O.Y. Nofar Energy Ltd develops designs licenses constructs and operates photovoltaic systems on rooftops in Israel. It engages in the initiation financing construction operation and maintenance of solar power generation systems wind power generation systems and battery storage systems in the United States Poland Romania Spain Italy England Serbia and Czech Republic. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Ashdod Israel.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Abu Dhabi National Insurance Company PJSC
Description: Abu Dhabi National Insurance Company PJSC provides various insurance and reinsurance products to individuals and corporates in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. It operates in two segments Underwriting of Commercial Lines of Business and Underwriting of Consumer Line of Business. The company offers various personal insurance products such as motor medical home travel personal watercraft life personal accident and wedding insurance products; and corporate insurance products including aviation engineering and construction energy financial lines group medical and life liabilities marine cargo marine hull motor fleet property and group travel insurance products. It also provides affinity programs to professional societies expat communities and sports and leisure membership schemes. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: RLH Properties S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: RLH Properties S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the acquisition development and management of hotels and resorts. Its properties portfolio includes residential assets and villas golf and polo clubs and private homes. The company’s properties include Andaz Mayakoba Banyan Tree Mayakoba Fairmont Mayakoba Four Seasons Ciudad De México One&Only Mandarina Park Hyatt Los Cabos Rosewood Mandarina and Rosewood Mayakoba; Fairmont Residences Mayakoba One&Only Mandarina Private Homes Rosewood Residences Mandarina and Rosewood Residences Mayakoba; and El Camaleón Mayakoba Mandarina Polo Club and Equestrian Center and Mandarina Golf Club. RLH Properties S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Arzan Financial Group for Financing and Investment - KPSC
Description: Arzan Financial Group for Financing and Investment - KPSC together with its subsidiaries engages in the wealth management credit and assets management debt collections and venture capital investment businesses in Kuwait. It operates through four segments: Instalment credit Investments Financial Brokerage and Real Estate. The company provides asset management and brokerage services such as margin trading non-discretionary and custody portfolios; advises on real estate private equity and development investments; and venture capital services. It provides working capital inventory replenishment and capital assets purchases to small and medium businesses; and debt collector services. In addition the company engages in financing services including financing management and brokerage; trading in real estate activities; general trading and contracting; project management; hospitality activities; credit facilities services; investment activities; financial advisory services; consulting services; fund management; and digital currency services. The company was formerly known as International Finance Company (K.P.S.C) and changed its name to Arzan Financial Group for Financing and Investment - KPSC in November 2013. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Selçuk Ecza Deposu Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S.
Description: Selçuk Ecza Deposu Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. together with its subsidiary operates as a pharmacy depot primarily in Turkey. It also organizes distribution channels between drug manufacturers hospitals and pharmacies. In addition the company is involved in operation of pharmaceutical warehouses; and distributes cosmetics personal care infant food vitamins medical and other products. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Selçuk Ecza Deposu Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. is a subsidiary of Selçuk Ecza Holding A.S.

Name: Magazine Luiza S.A.
Description: Magazine Luiza S.A. engages in the retail sale of consumer goods. It operates through Retail Financial Operations Insurance Operations and Other Services segments. The company also grants credit and provides extended warranties for its products. In addition it is involved in the provision of consortium and management services; and e-commerce of perfumes cosmetics sports and fashion products as well as product delivery management and software development services. Further the company provides integration logistics and technological solutions as well as resale goods and provision of services in the stores electronic and food delivery management platform. It serves through physical stores e-commerce platform and SuperApp. Magazine Luiza S.A. was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Franca Brazil. Magazine Luiza S.A. operates as a subsidiary of LTD Administração e Participação S.A.

Name: Minerva S.A.
Description: Minerva S.A. produces and sells fresh beef livestock and by-products in South America and internationally. The company is also involved in slaughtering deboning and meat processing; selling chilled frozen and processed meat as well as beef pork and poultry products; exporting and selling live cattle; and breeding and selling live cattle lambs pigs and other live animals. In addition it trades in electricity; trades in proteins and food products; sells third parties’ brands primarily Swift products; and prepares products for animals which include meat/bone meal blood and tallow. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Barretos Brazil.

Name: Al-Babtain Power and Telecommunications Company
Description: Al-Babtain Power and Telecommunications Company together with its subsidiaries produces lighting poles power transmission towers accessories and communication towers in the United Arab Emirates Saudi Arabia and Egyptian Arabic Republic. The company operates through Towers and Metal Structures Sector; Poles and Lighting; Design Supply and Installation Sector; and Solar Energy Sector segments. The Towers and Metal Structures Sector segment produces power transmission towers galvanized communication towers and tests and galvanized steel structures. The Poles and Lighting Sector segment engages in the production and galvanization of electricity and lighting poles masts and accessories; and production of street lighting lanterns for playgrounds and gardens as well as electricity distribution panels. The Design Supply and Installation Sector segment supplies installs and maintains communication systems. The Solar Energy Sector segment is involved in the production of mobile metal components for solar photovoltaic energy tracking systems. In addition it designs and produces poles masts and lanterns for lighting and squares; manufactures markets and sells decorative poles and LED lighting; and installs operates and maintains programs for wired and wireless communication systems computer devices and networks as well as mechanical and electrical equipment for factories. The company also installs maintains and repairs wind energy networks and generates electric energy; offers electrical and mechanical works; and engages in designing supplying installing and maintaining communication systems as well as provides oil and gas field services including contracting. Al-Babtain Power and Telecommunications Company was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: EcoRodovias Infraestrutura e Logística S.A.
Description: EcoRodovias Infraestrutura e Logística S.A. operates as an infrastructure company that operates highway concessions in Brazil. It operates Ecopátio Logística Cubatão an intermodal logistics platform which is the regulating site for trucks at the Port of Santos. The company is also involved in the port operations and handling and storage of import and export cargo at the Port of Santos. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in São Paulo Brazil. EcoRodovias Infraestrutura e Logística S.A. operates as a subsidiary of IGLI S.p.A.

Name: Tamar Petroleum Ltd
Description: Tamar Petroleum Ltd engages in the exploration development production marketing and transmission of natural gas and condensate in Israel. It has 16.75% interest rights in the Tamar and Dalit projects. The company sells and supplies natural gas produced from the Tamar reservoir primarily to the Israel Electric Company Ltd. private electricity producers industrial customers and natural gas marketing companies as well as sells condensate to Ashdod refinery Ltd. It also exports natural gas to Jordan and Egypt. The company was formerly known as Karish and Tanin Management Ltd. and changed its name to Tamar Petroleum Ltd in May 2017. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Herzliya Pituach Israel.

Name: Anadolu Anonim Türk Sigorta Sirketi
Description: Anadolu Anonim Türk Sigorta Sirketi engages in the insurance business in Turkey. It offers company accident illness-health land vehicles aircraft water vehicles transportation fire and natural disasters general damages land vehicles liability aircraft liability general liability credit surety and financial losses as well as legal protection insurance products. The company was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Anadolu Anonim Türk Sigorta Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Millî Reasürans Türk Anonim Sirketi.

Name: ADvTECH Limited
Description: ADvTECH Limited provides education training and staff placement services in South Africa and other African countries. It operates through Schools Tertiary and Resourcing divisions. The Schools division offers pre-primary primary and secondary education services through face to face and online learning under the Crawford International Pinnacle Colleges Trinityhouse Abbotts College Junior Colleges the Bridge Assisted Learning School and Evolve Online School brands as well as Gaborone International School Flipper International School and Makini Schools brands. Its Tertiary division provides education services on diploma degree and postgraduate levels through face-to-face online and distance learning under the Independent Institute of Education (IIE) Vega School Varsity College Rosebank College IIE MSA IIE School of Hospitality & Service Management Capsicum Culinary Studio and the Oxbridge Academy brands. The Resourcing division offers placement solutions in the areas of information technology (IT) finance and engineering; and payroll and compliance solutions under the Network Recruitment Communicate Recruitment Network Contracting Solutions the Working Earth Africa HR Solutions and the CA Global Africa Recruitment brands. ADvTECH Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Coronation Fund Managers Limited
Description: Coronation Fund Managers Limited is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm provides its services to pension and provident funds medical schemes unit trusts banks insurers and other fund managers international retirement funds endowments and family offices. It launches and manages equity fixed income and balanced mutual funds. The firm invests in the public equity and fixed income markets across the globe. It employs fundamental analysis with bottom-up stock picking approach. Coronation Fund Managers Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Cape Town South Africa with additional office in London United Kingdom and Dublin Ireland.

Name: CFG Bank SA
Description: CFG Bank SA provides various banking products and services to individual professional corporate and institutional clients in Morocco. The company offers various accounts; savings; term deposits and long-term savings products; certificates of deposits; bank cards; consumer Lombard and real estate credits; lease credits; overdraft and cash facilities; short-term loans; and insurance products. It also provides stock market and investment services and private and online banking services. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Azzas 2154 S.A.
Description: Azzas 2154 S.A. engages in the development and marketing of women's men's and children's footwear handbags accessories and clothing in Brazil and internationally. It offers its products through franchise stores company-operated store and web commerce channel under the Arezzo Schutz Anacapri Alexandre Birman Alme Vans Reserva Reserva Mini Reserva INK Reserva Go Oficina Reserva Brizza Troc Baw Carol Bassi ZZMALL Reversa Simples Reserva Paris Texas Vicenza Animale Farm Farm Global Fabula Foxton Cris Barros Off Premium Maria Filo NV Hering and Dzarm brands. The company was formerly known as Arezzo Indústria e Comércio S.A. and changed its name to Azzas 2154 S.A. in July 2024. Azzas 2154 S.A. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Belo Horizonte Brazil.

Name: Zad Holding Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Zad Holding Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacture and distribution of fast-moving-consumer-goods in Qatar and internationally. It operates through Investment and Managed Services; Trading Manufacturing Distribution & Services; and Contracting Real Estate & Others segments. The company manufactures various flour and wheat based products under the QFM brand; and refines and packs various types of edible oils such as sunflower corn and canola oil. It also produces and markets bakery products including traditional Arabic breads pita breads slice bread buns and rolls cakes and muffins and pastries; and frozen meat products comprising chicken nuggets burgers and kofta under the Al Arabia and International brands. In addition the company provides property management; constructs roads water supply and sewerage projects industrial structures and buildings; sells and rents transport and heavy equipment; provides logistics solutions; and transports construction materials such as asphalt sand and aggregates. Further it manufactures and supplies ready mix concrete and asphalt; offers crushing services; and invests in commodities. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Orascom Construction PLC
Description: Orascom Construction PLC together with its subsidiaries operates as an engineering and construction contractor for infrastructure complex industrial and high-end commercial projects in the United States the Middle East Africa and Central Asia. The company constructs water transportation monorail and metro highways and roads and power infrastructure; data center fertilizer cement and petrochemicals projects; and commercial healthcare museum student housing and senior living new cities and buildings. It also offers steel structures steel collector elements plate works pressure vessels boilers heat recovery steam generators heat exchangers piping tanks and packaged skids; aluminum doors windows stick curtain walls unitized curtain walls skylights handrails standing seam roofs and laminated stone products as well as various architectural metal works; pre-cast and pre-stressed concrete pipes; and decorative paints and industrial coatings. In addition the company provides waterproofing lining and geomembranes thermal insulation concrete repair injection and fire proofing and joints sealants; cleaning security and repair services for commercial buildings; and hard services including engineering fit-outs civil and architectural repair and maintenance services; and soft services such as housekeeping janitorial services and deep cleaning services with specialties in façade cleaning landscaping pest control waste management and recycling. Further it manages industrial zones. Orascom Construction PLC was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Fawry for Banking Technology and Electronic Payments S.A.E.
Description: Fawry for Banking Technology and Electronic Payments S.A.E. provides electronic -payments and digital finance solutions in Egypt. The company offers digital and bill payment investment and cash deposit and withdrawal services. It also offers rewards and loyalty programs; commerce enablement services such as online checkout point of sale and payment link services; e-ordering marketplace; payment and collection pay-out and ticketing services; micro finance and insurance brokerage services; and operates TicketsMall and Super app. In addition the company provides HR solutions; and payout portal payroll card employee insurance acceptance cash management cash-in and cash-out cash collection and remittance services; and acts as a banking agent that offers various banking and financial services. Further it offers business loans and daily interest accounts; digital platforms; consumer finance services; fast moving consumer goods (FMCG) platform solutions for consumer goods companies and merchants; and commercial technology solutions. Additionally the company provides systems and communication equipment management and maintenance and computer network services; advanced solutions and strategic software services that supports digital transformation in business organization; and operates free zone. It serves individuals enterprises small and medium size enterprises (SMEs) and financial institutions. Fawry for Banking Technology and Electronic Payments S.A.E. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Middle East Healthcare Company
Description: Middle East Healthcare Company a healthcare provider owns and operates a network of hospitals under the Saudi German Hospital name in the Middle East and North Africa. It also operates manages and maintains hospitals clinics educational centers and institutes health rehabilitation and physiotherapy centers analysis and radiology laboratories and pharmacies. The company also buys land to construct medical projects as well as to establish manage construct and organize exhibitions. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Middle East Healthcare Company operates as a subsidiary of Bait Al Batterjee Medical Co. Ltd.

Name: Mineros S.A.
Description: Mineros S.A. engages in the exploration development and production of gold in Central and South America. It explores for gold and silver deposits. The company holds interest in the Nechí Alluvial Property covering an area of 473 square kilometers located in Lower Cauca Region of Antioquia in northwestern Colombia; Hemco Property that covers an area of 2270 hectares located in Bonanza Nicaragua; and La Pepa Project located in the Maricunga Gold Belt of the Atacama Region Chile. It also engages in the hydroelectric power generation activities. The company was formerly known as Mineros de Antioquia S.A. and changed its name to Mineros S.A. in May 2004. Mineros S.A. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Medellín Colombia. As of March 25 2025 Mineros S.A. is a subsidiary of Sun Valley Investments AG.

Name: ANSA McAL Limited
Description: ANSA McAL Limited engages in trading and distribution construction manufacturing packaging and brewing banking and insurance media retail and service businesses in Trinidad and Tobago the United States of America and internationally. The company operates through Construction Manufacturing Packaging & Brewing Automotive Trading & Distribution Banking and Insurance and Media Retail and Services segments. The company offers industrial & agricultural equipment used vehicles long-term leasing of motor vehicles short-term rentals & chauffeur services; carib & stag lager beers stouts & ciders shandy soft drinks manufacturing and distribution of alcoholic beverages and brewery products and ales lagers and cider; clay steel aluminium PVC building products air conditioning solutions automotive industrial marine & decorative paints furniture finishes concrete roof tiles and construction services. It also provides food consumer household wine spirit health and wellness generic drugs wholesale of food consumer products; investment & merchant bank hire-purchase finance fixed deposits lease rental banking reinsurance car home personal and commercial insurance emergency roadside assistance and defensive driving course life and group health insurance pensions mortgages critical illness motor property accident & health and marine; and distribution hub for liquid chlorine caustic soda hydrochloric acid bleach and other products plastic packaging & plastic crates production of sodium hypochlorite sodium hydroxide and hydrochloric acid glass bottles monte plata solar park wind farm. In addition the company offers newspaper publishing cable radio broadcasting and digital billboards; purchase logistics and travel including shipping air cargo freight stevedoring & inspection services and warehousing services; and stationery & office supplies and furniture & equipment. The company was founded in 1881 and is based in Port of Spain Trinidad & Tobago.

Name: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones Sociedad Anónima
Description: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones Sociedad Anónima together with its subsidiaries engages in the diversified real estate activities in Argentina. It operates through five segments: Shopping Malls Offices Sales and Developments Hotels and Others. The company is involved in the acquisition development and operation of shopping malls office buildings and other non-shopping mall properties primarily for rental purposes; and lease and service related to rental of commercial space and other spaces. It also acquires and operates luxury hotels and resorts under the Intercontinental Libertador and Llao Llao names; develops constructs and sells residential properties including apartment tower complexes; and acquires undeveloped land reserves for future development or sale. In addition the company engages in the development and operation of stadium; and provision of ¡appa! a digital customer loyalty system platform for consumption in shopping malls use of parking spaces and redemption of corporate benefits. Further it is involved in development maintenance and sales of undeveloped parcels of land and/or trading properties; room catering and restaurant services. The company was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires Argentina. IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones Sociedad Anónima operates as a subsidiary of Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A.

Name: Capital Bank of Jordan
Description: Capital Bank of Jordan together with its subsidiaries provides various commercial and investment banking services to individuals and corporate clients in Jordan Iraq rest of the Middle East Europe Asia the United States and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Retail Banking Corporate Banking Corporate Finance and Treasury. It offers current and savings accounts fixed deposit accounts and certificates of deposit; personal car and home loans; corporate loans; trade finance; commercial loans; overdraft and revolving products letters of guarantee letters of credit bills for collection and discounted promissory notes; working capital loans; and structured finance services. The company also provides brokerage services; asset management services such as portfolio management investment advisory external asset manager model structured deposits investment funds and Sharia compliant products; treasury management and remittance and bill payment services; correspondent banking services for financial institutions; debit and credit cards; online and mobile banking services; and ATM facilities and SMS banking services.
