The company offers drive systems and power electronics for electric powertrains; piston systems cylinder components valve trains air conditioning engine cooling air management engine cooling oil management; and power electronics for traction drives for passenger cars as well as electric drive and mechatronic systems for industrial applications agricultural and construction machinery commercial vehicles industrial vehicles electric transport vehicles and the automotive industry. It provides climatic wind tunnels engine testing engineering module testing thermal management and transmission services. In addition the company offers pistons piston rings valves connecting rods bearings bushings thrust washers cylinder liners piston rings camshafts piston pins ring carriers and mechanical compressors products as well as fuelfilters airfilters oil filters air conditioning filters activated carbon filters oil separators caps diesel pre-filters and intake manifolds air conditioning and radiators and condensers. MAHLE Metal Leve S.A. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Mogi Guaçu Brazil.

Name: Organización Terpel S.A.
Description: Organización Terpel S.A. operates fuel service stations in Colombia Panama Ecuador Peru and the Dominican Republic. The company engages in the purchase distribution and supply of hydrocarbons and their derivatives; and refining supply storage and transportation of natural or propane gas and other products. It also manufactures lubricants; and constructs improves conserves maintains and modernizes port and related activities. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Bogotá Colombia. Organización Terpel S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Empresas Copec S.A.

Name: EZTEC Empreendimentos e Participações S.A.
Description: EZTEC Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. engages in engineering construction and real estate development activities in Brazil and internationally. The company develops and sells real estate properties; manages and leases properties; constructs condominiums; and subdivides land. It also engages in the provision of services related to construction supervision studies and projects; and execution of civil engineering works and services. EZTEC Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: DINE S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: DINE S.A.B. de C.V. through its subsidiaries develops real estate projects in Mexico. The company is also involved in the acquisition development and disposal of residential tourist and commercial properties. In addition it provides administrative and advisory services. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Riyadh Cement Company
Description: Riyadh Cement Company produces and sells cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the Kingdom of Bahrain the State of Iraq State of Yemen the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan and the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers white and grey cement; and white portland portland limestone sulphate resisting portland and ordinary portland cement. The company was formerly known as Saudi White Cement Company and changed its name to Riyadh Cement Company in February 2021. Riyadh Cement Company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Controladora Vuela Compañía de Aviación S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Controladora Vuela Compañía de Aviación S.A.B. de C.V. through its subsidiary Concesionaria Vuela Compañía de Aviación S.A.P.I. de C.V. provides air transportation services for passengers cargo and mail in Mexico and internationally. The company operates approximately 550 daily flights on routes connecting 44 cities in Mexico 23 cities in the United States 4 cities in Central America and 2 cities in South America. It also offers merchandising travel agency share administration trust pre-delivery payments financing aircraft administration trust and loyalty program as well as specialized and aeronautical technical services. As of December 31 2024 the company leases 141 aircrafts and 18 spare engines. Controladora Vuela Compañía de Aviación S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Isras Holdings Ltd
Description: Isras Holdings Ltd engages in the real estate business in Israel. It also develops residential properties. The company is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Oman Arab Bank SAOG
Description: Oman Arab Bank SAOG engages in the commercial and investment banking activities in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through Retail Banking Corporate Banking Treasury Others and Islamic Banking segments. The company offers deposit products including current minor savings growth fixed deposit youth and upfront deposit interest accounts; and loan products such as home car and personal loans. It also provides credit debit prepaid corporate and reward cards as well as merchant services and card promotions; ATM and internet and mobile banking services; and bancassurance products comprising motor travel health home contents and comprehensive personal insurances. In addition the company offers treasury services that include foreign exchange and money market and hedging services; trade and project finance; and cash management services. Further it provides Sharia’ compliant Islamic banking products and services such as Ijarah Murabaha Mudarbah and Diminishing Musharakah. Oman Arab Bank SAOG was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Capex S.A.
Description: Capex S.A. an integrated energy company engages in the exploration and exploitation of hydrocarbons in Argentina. The company is involved in the exploration and exploitation of oil and gas; construction and development of a combined-cycle thermal power plant with an installed capacity of 672 MW and an LPG plant; production of hydrogen and oxygen; and production and sale of propane butane and gasoline as well as generation of energy from wind farms and hydrogen/oxygen. It also processes and separates liquid gases derived from gas. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Vicente López Argentina. Capex S.A. is a subsidiary of Companias Asociadas Petroleras S.A.

Name: Naphtha Israel Petroleum Corp. Ltd.
Description: Naphtha Israel Petroleum Corp. Ltd. engages in the exploration production and sale of oil and gas in Israel the Middle East the United States and Europe. The company is also involved in the rental of real estate properties; operation of hotels; and provision of management services. In addition it provides operator services for oil and gas assets; and ancillary services. The company serves private electricity producers industrial customers and natural gas marketing companies. The company was incorporated in 1956 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel. Naphtha Israel Petroleum Corp. Ltd. is a subsidiary of J.O.E.L. Jerusalem Oil Exploration Ltd.

Name: Sustained Infrastructure Holding Company
Description: Sustained Infrastructure Holding Company an investment holding company engages in ports and logistics and water solutions businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company is involved in the operation of container terminal; logistics park developer; bonded re-export zone operator; investment management and operations of bonded and non-bonded logistics parks and zones; and provision of logistics solutions including warehousing transportation and value-added services. It also provides unbundling labeling repacking and consolidation solutions; freight solutions and value-added capabilities including bonded overland freight versatile multi-port clearance facilities specialized services and advanced courier solutions; and water and wastewater solutions. In addition the company offers water solutions comprising desalination distribution and management as well as water supply services. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Mavi Giyim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Mavi Giyim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the wholesale and retail sale of ready-to-wear denim apparel in Turkey and internationally. The company offers knit and woven shirts t-shirts sweaters jackets skirts dresses accessories and denim bottoms for men women and children. It operates retail stores franchise stores and wholesale doors as well as e-commerce platforms. Mavi Giyim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Ataa Educational Company
Description: Ataa Educational Company engages in the establishment of private and international kindergarten primary intermediate and secondary schools for boys and girls in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Education and Employment segments. The company establishes and manages private international and French and Indian schools; establishes colleges and universities; and engages in mediating in employing and online recruitment agencies. It is also involved in owning establishment management operation and maintenance of vocational and other training centers private educational schools and educational and training institutes; purchasing existing schools and educational and training facilities; and construction of non-residential buildings such as schools hospitals and hotels and educational transportation. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Reysas Tasimacilik ve Lojistik Ticaret A.S.
Description: Reysas Tasimacilik ve Lojistik Ticaret A.S. provides logistics solutions in Turkey and internationally. The company offers local transportation and distribution automotive logistics warehousing railway transportation international services fuel logistics and bonded warehousing. It also provides technology solutions such as software services and vehicle tracking systems. In addition the company distributes and markets tobacco products and operates vehicle inspection station as well as involved in the real estate investments. Reysas Tasimacilik ve Lojistik Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Besalco S.A.
Description: Besalco S.A. through its subsidiaries operates as a construction company in Chile. It designs constructs and sells houses and apartments; develops constructs maintains and operates hydroelectric plants; and manages concessions in public and private infrastructure ports airports and other sectors. The company also engages in the construction of roads reservoirs tunnels tailings dams bridges viaducts gas pipelines irrigation works hydroelectric plants sanitary works mining works hospitals stadiums residential and commercial buildings airports and seaports as well as works for the Santiago subway and State Railways; engineering and construction of industrial plants; and design and construction of electrical energy transmission systems including high medium and low voltage lines and substations. In addition it provides mining earthworks crushing sorting processing materials loading and transporting salt harvesting tailings dam operation equipment spot leasing harvesting forest debarking and ready-mixed concrete transportation services as well as chips chipping and transportation services. The company was formerly known as Sanz Bezanilla y Salinas Limitada and changed its name to Besalco S.A. in January 1995. Besalco S.A. was incorporated in 1944 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Perfect Presentation for Commercial Services Company
Description: Perfect Presentation for Commercial Services Company operates as an ICT services and technology solutions company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers operations and maintenance services; call center services; computer software licensing and development services; SMS and subscriptions and internet services; specialized training services in call centers customer service and customer care; and advisory services specialized in establishing of call centers customer service and taking care of subscribers. The company is also involved in the management and operation of call centers customer service and subscribers' care activities; and provision of human resources to work in call centers and customer service. In addition it offers programs and systems for call centers customer service and subscribers care such as open-source call center systems comprising contact center systems; IVR interactive response systems through sound and image; call recording systems; customer relationship management systems; and reporting systems for call center performance and real time monitoring screens. Perfect Presentation for Commercial Services Company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia

Name: delta holding S.A.
Description: delta holding S.A. operates in the infrastructure metallurgy water and environmental and parachemistry activities worldwide. It manufactures road security advertising billboards and spots public area equipment bitumen/asphalt and its derivatives construction materials and signaling equipment; installs toll booths; and provides sports surfacing coating solutions and construction materials. The company also constructs and maintains roads highways city road networks port platforms and aeronautical runways; installs and maintains horizontal and vertical signages and safety equipment on traffic lanes; and develops social housings. In addition it offers metal and mechanical engineering boiler making hydro-mechanical equipment piping masts and public lighting columns; iron parts for the hydraulic industrial and public work sectors; and aluminum profiles and construction accessories. Further the company engages in machining of mechanical parts; hot-dip galvanizing and surface treatment business; foundry and extrusion of aluminum and stainless and special steels business; assembly and maintenance of electromechanical equipment; pumping plant set-up; port and hydraulic equipment installation; fabrication and erection of reconstituted welded profiles; and implementing industrial projects. Additionally it pipes and canals in centrifuged and pre-stressed reinforced concrete and special pipes. The company also offers paints thinners and horizontal signage related products; industrial medical and laboratory gases; mechanical construction materials; supplies ethanol and liquid carbon dioxide gas; and exploits for gem salt. delta holding S.A. was founded in 1974 and is based in Skhirat Morocco.

Name: Grupo Posadas S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Posadas S.A.B. de C.V. owns and operates hotels primarily in Mexico. The company operates hotels primarily under the Live Aqua Grand Fiesta Americana Curamoria Fiesta Americana IOH The Explorean Fiesta Inn One and Gamma brand names. It also operates Fiesta Americana Vacation Club; Kívac a point system that offers access to hotels and experiences in Mexico; and Live Aqua Residence Club a club with a portfolio of residential and hotel vacation properties. Grupo Posadas S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: UNACEM Corp S.A.A.
Description: UNACEM Corp S.A.A. produces markets and sells various types of cement clinker and concrete products in Peru the United States Ecuador Colombia and Chile. The company operates through three segments: Production and Marketing of Cement; Production and Marketing of Concrete; and Generation and Marketing of Electrical Energy Using Hydraulic Resources. It provides consulting and technology assistance storage and surveillance services. The company also engages in the real estate business; extraction of non-ferrous metal ores; thermal plant operation; production and sale prefabricated concrete; sale of energy and power; and manufacturing of quicklime and calcium carbonates. The company was formerly known as Unión Andina de Cementos S.A.A. and changed its name to UNACEM Corp S.A.A. UNACEM Corp S.A.A. was founded in 1967 and is based in La Victoria Peru.

Name: The Okomu Oil Palm Company Plc
Description: The Okomu Oil Palm Company Plc engages in the cultivation and plantation of oil palm and rubber in Nigeria. The company operates Palm Plantation Rubber Plantation and Palm and Rubber Processing segments. It is also involved in the processing of fresh fruit bunches into crude palm oil and kernel for resale; and processing of rubber lumps to rubber cake. In addition the company offers palm oil products such as crude palm oil palm kernel palm kernel oil and palm kernel cake. Further it provides natural and synthetic rubber products. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Benin City Nigeria. The Okomu Oil Palm Company Plc operates as a subsidiary of Socfinaf S.A.

Name: Intelbras S.A. - Indústria de Telecomunicação Eletrônica Brasileira
Description: Intelbras S.A. - Indústria de Telecomunicação Eletrônica Brasileira engages in the manufacturing developing and sale of electronic security equipment and electronic surveillance and monitoring services in Brazil. The company operates through Security Communication and Energy segments. It offers electronic safety products and solutions including automation devices alarms storage cameras condominium communication corporate access control locks digital video recorders fire and intercom products vehicle monitoring sensors emergency signaling video walls software and application products and accessories; and networks products and solutions comprise racks routers 5G and corporate Wi-Fi products outdoor radios optical fiber and passive products switches PoE injectors signal repeaters USB adapters software and apps and cables. The company also provides communication related products and solutions such as webcams projectors wireless mouse and keyboards cloud solutions antennas and converters phone centrals appliance and conference products gateways headsets radio communicators smart boxes and controls smart speakers software and applications and phones; and energy related products and solutions that includes electric vehicle chargers fonts batteries UPS electronic protectors surge protectors USB accessories and illumination presence sensors. In addition it offers on grid solutions which includes attachment structures on grid generators and inverters solar panels and string box; and off grid solutions such as illumination products mounting structures outdoor cabinets solar drive and panels solar bomb and off grid generators and inverters. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in São José Brazil.

Name: Cresud Sociedad Anónima Comercial Inmobiliaria Financiera y Agropecuaria
Description: Cresud Sociedad Anónima Comercial Inmobiliaria Financiera y Agropecuaria an agricultural company engages in the production of agricultural commodities in Brazil and other Latin American countries. The company operates through Agricultural Business and Business Urban Properties and Investments segments. It is also involved in the management development and ownership of shopping malls office buildings and hotels; sale of grain derivatives such as flour and oil; production and sale of crops such as soybean sugarcane wheat corn oilseed and sunflower as well as sorghum and peanuts; and breeding purchasing and/or fattening of cattle for sale to slaughterhouses and supermarkets. In addition it leases its farms to third parties for agriculture cattle breeding and seed production; and offers agricultural services. The company was incorporated in 1936 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Çimentas Izmir Çimento Fabrikasi Türk A.S.
Description: Çimentas Izmir Çimento Fabrikasi Türk A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production trading sale and transportation of bulk and bagged cement in Turkey. The company operates through four segments: Cement Aggregate Ready-mixed concrete and Waste management. It is involved in the sale of fuels; and fly ash production business. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey. Çimentas Izmir Çimento Fabrikasi Türk A.S. is a subsidiary of Aalborg Portland Espana SL.

Name: Theeb Rent A Car Company
Description: Theeb Rent A Car Company provides car rental and leasing services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Short Term Lease Long Term Lease and Car Sales segments. It also offers roadside assistance; and operates maintenance centers. In addition the company sells used vehicles. It offers its services through 48 branches distributed over the regions of the Kingdom international and regional airports with a fleet of more than 19000 vehicles. Theeb Rent A Car Company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Bank of Jordan
Description: Bank of Jordan provides financial and banking services in Jordan Palestine Syria Bahrain Iraq and Saudi Arabia. It operates through the Retail Banking Corporate Banking Treasury and Financial Brokerage Services segments. The company offers current salary and savings accounts; time deposits and certificates of deposits; loans comprising personal housing and auto loans; safe deposit boxes; and credit debit and prepaid cards as well as digital payments. It also provides dealing and treasury services purchase services portfolio brokerage custody of investments financial consultations custody service and management services for initial public offerings. Bank of Jordan was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Modern Mills Company
Description: Modern Mills Company engages in the manufacture and sale of flour and animal feed in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company also offers wheat and bran under the QAMHATI Modern Mills and QOOT & ROOT brands. In addition it offers livestock poultry and bran animal feeds under the Premier brand. Modern Mills Company was founded in 1982 and is based in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Electra Consumer Products (1970) Ltd
Description: Electra Consumer Products (1970) Ltd manufactures imports exports distributes sells and services for various consumer electrical products in Israel. It offers heating ventilation and air conditioning systems; and retails consumer electronics and cellular telephones and accessories. The company also retails food products and other consumables under the Carrefour brand; operates 7-Eleven chain; and develops and constructs commercial real estate properties. In addition it imports and wholesales equipment clothing footwears camping ski and snowboarding and outdoor sports and leisure products as well as operates franchise chain under the Adidas brand. Further the company engages in e-commerce business. Electra Consumer Products (1970) Ltd was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Rishon LeZion Israel.

Name: Katilimevim Tasarruf Finansman Anonim Sirketi
Description: Katilimevim Tasarruf Finansman Anonim Sirketi provides savings finance to buy houses and cars in Turkey. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Noor Financial Investment Company - KPSC
Description: Noor Financial Investment Company – KPSC together with its subsidiaries provides investment and financial services in Kuwait the GCC and internationally. It operates through Investments Real Estate IT Services and Hotel Operations. The company offers mutual funds; public placement and private placement advisory services; wealth management services; and transaction based advisory services including business valuations portfolio valuation purchase price allocation and goodwill impairment as well as strategic financial advisory such as merger and acquisition transactions restructurings business modeling change of control going private management buyout and public private partnerships. It also provides banking; investment advisory and portfolio solutions; and invests in local and international equities public and private equity markets and real estate opportunities as well as listed equities and financial products. In addition the company operates Amman International Airport Hotel a 4-stars hotel as well as provides hospitality services and management of third-party hospitality businesses; owns and manages residential and commercial properties; provides maintenance for residential and commercial complex entertainment centers hotels and tourist facilities; develops leases and operates real estate properties; and provides information technology solutions and services including Oracle Cloud ERP and Kiosk solutions CMS/DMS and archiving software development and integration manpower outsourcing and recruitment printers and copiers consumables and maintenance and training services. Further it engages in general trading and contracting activities; leasing of submarine internet transmission cables; and media and advertisement services. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Noor Financial Investment Company - KPSC is a subsidiary of National Industries Group Holding – KPSC.

Name: MAIR Group - P.J.S.C.
Description: Abu Dhabi Co-Operative Society a retail company primarily engages in the businesses of operating hypermarkets supermarkets shopping malls retail parks concept chain stores franchise operations retail property management real estate and investments. It offers produced packaged and branded consumer goods; electrical and household appliances electronics digital home entertainment solutions digital imaging solutions home computer solutions; and branded perfumes and cosmetics apparels and accessories home décor products DIY kits outdoor garden accessories and more. The company also engages in real estate operations and investments in Morocco Oman India China and far-eastern countries. In addition it manages retail properties. Abu Dhabi Co-Operative Society was founded in 1981 and is based in Abu Dhabi United Arab Emirates.

Name: Amlak Finance PJSC
Description: Amlak Finance PJSC together with its subsidiaries engages in real estate financing and investment activities in the Middle East. The company operates through three segments: Real Estate Finance Real Estate Investment and Corporate Finance Investments. It is involved in Islamic financing and investing activities based on various structures such as Ijara Murabaha Mudaraba Wakala and Musharaka. The company also provides Ijarah a home finance product; Edaara which includes landlord and property management services; Istithmari a buy-to-let property finance product; Tatweer including financing solutions for under-construction properties; private construction finance; and property portfolio services. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Baskent Dogalgaz Dagitim Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Baskent Dogalgaz Dagitim Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. provides natural gas distribution services in Ankara. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey. Baskent Dogalgaz Dagitim Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is a subsidiary of Torunlar Enerji Sanayi Ve Tic.A.S.

Name: Societe de Limonaderies et de Boissons Rafraichissantes d'Afrique
Description: Societe de Limonaderies et de Boissons Rafraichissantes d'Afrique engages in the manufacture and sale of beer soft drinks mineral water alcomixes and energy drink products. It operates malt houses breweries and lemonades; and manufactures preforms. The company was formerly known as Societe de Limonaderies et Brasseries d'Afrique SA and changed its name to Societe de Limonaderies et de Boissons Rafraichissantes d'Afrique in May 2023. The company was founded in 1955 and is based in Abidjan Ivory Coast.

Name: Vamos Locação de Caminhões Máquinas e Equipamentos S.A.
Description: Vamos Locação de Caminhões Máquinas e Equipamentos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the leasing reselling and selling of trucks machinery equipment and parts in Brazil. The company leases tractors forklift trucks agricultural machinery and implements buses and other vehicles; sells automobile parts and accessories; sells new and used tractors machines tires air tubes implements motor vehicles and buses; and provides automobile maintenance and repair and technical assistance and related services as well as engages in the logistics and road transportation of cargos. It also offers civil construction parts lubricants provision of vehicle repair and maintenance services and the like road transportation of cargo in general wholesale trade of machinery apparatus and equipment for agricultural use parts and pieces and intermediation and agency activities for services and business in general except real estate; commercial representatives and agents for the trade of motor vehicles. In addition the company sells fertilizers herbicides and seeds; and provides engineering services related to customization of trucks and buses as well as provision of agricultural activities. Further the company manufactures and sells truck trailers truck bodies road implements cabins and industrial machinery and equipment; and provides installation renovation repair and maintenance of equipment and vehicles; provision of logistics and road freight transportation services; information technology services; technical analysis on motor vehicles; forklift operator services; and outsourcing and managing of human resources. Vamos Locação de Caminhões Máquinas e Equipamentos S.A. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil. Vamos Locação de Caminhões Máquinas e Equipamentos S.A. is a subsidiary of SIMPAR S.A.

Name: Fawaz Abdulaziz Al Hokair & Company
Description: Fawaz Abdulaziz Al Hokair & Company operates as a franchise retailer of fashion products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Jordan Egypt the Republic of Kazakhstan the United States the Republic of Azerbaijan Georgia and Armenia. It operates through Fashion Retail Indoor Entertainment and Food and Beverage segments. The Fashion Retail segment sells apparel footwear and accessories through retail outlets. The Indoor Entertainment segment operates kids play centers. The Food and Beverage segment operates cafe and restaurant businesses. It is involved in the sale of womenswear menswear children and baby goods shoes and accessories food and beverage cosmetics sports and entertainment products through retail outlets and online channels. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Nice One Beauty Digital Marketing Company
Description: Nice One Beauty Digital Marketing Company provides beauty and personal products through e-commerce platform in Saudi Arabia. The company provides perfumes cosmetics soap and incense. It also engages in marketing activities. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Dor Alon Energy In Israel (1988) Ltd
Description: Dor Alon Energy In Israel (1988) Ltd develops constructs and operates fueling complexes and commercial centers in Israel. The company operates public gas stations under the Dor Alon brand; electric vehicle charging stations under the Ultra Speed and Speed brands; convenience stores under the Alonit Mini Super Alonit AM:PM the Moshav Alonit on the Kibbutz and Super Alonit brands; and a coffee shop chain under the Si brand. It also produces and markets fuel and oil under the ARAL and Texaco brands. In addition the company engages in the marketing of LPG and natural gas to institutional customers as well as jet fuel to foreign and domestic airlines. Further it offers Speed Wash which provides car wash services; SpeedCASH card for fuel payments; and Speedomat a computerized refueling system. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Yakum Israel. Dor Alon Energy In Israel (1988) Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Alon Blue Square Israel Ltd.

Name: Southern Sun Limited
Description: Southern Sun Limited owns leases and manages hotels in South Africa Mozambique the Seychelles Tanzania the United Arab Emirates and Zambia. The company operates through five segments: Manco Investment Properties Sandton Consortium SA Portfolio and Offshore. It operates hotels and resorts under the Southern Sun Hotels Southern Sun Resorts StayEasy Garden Court SUN1 SunSquare and Sandton Convention Centre brands as well as Arabella Hotel Golf & Spa Mount Grace Hotel & Spa Sandton Sun and Towers Beverly Hills 54 on Bath and Paradise Sun brands. The company was formerly known as Tsogo Sun Hotels Limited. Southern Sun Limited was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Kardemir Karabük Demir Çelik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Kardemir Karabük Demir Çelik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. produces and sells iron and steel products in Turkey. The company’s product portfolio includes railway rails and wheels profiles wire rods rebars billets granule blast furnace slag and products from its air separation plant. It offers GI sections for mine support as well as coke and by-products. The company also engages in casting and machining services energy business steel structure manufacturing and assembly insurance brokerage activities and urban and intercity freight transportation. Kardemir Karabük Demir Çelik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Karabük Turkey.

Name: Armah Sports Company
Description: Armah Sports Company operates chain of sports centers facilities. The company also retails sports apparel. In addition it offers food services for sport facilities salons and other sports activities as well as involved in fitness sports support activities. The company offers its products under BFIT and OPTIMO brands. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Jordan Kuwait Bank
Description: Jordan Kuwait Bank together with its subsidiaries provides banking products and services to personal private and corporate customers. It offers various accounts such as savings current basic bank and fixed deposit accounts as well as certificates of deposit; loans including personal car housing army and office and clinic loans as well as personal loans against mortgage and for medical doctors; credit debit and prepaid cards; life and general insurance services; and other services such as dividend disbursement western union money transfer safe store auto safe deposit boxes remittance and direct debit services. The company also provides direct loans and lines of credit including working capital and fixed asset financing discounted loans L/C financing export financing real estate financing project financing and overdraft facilities; bills for collection letters of guarantee import and export letters of credit and finance leasing; POS; loan guarantee programs CBJ financing programs EIB programs women loans and other programs such as markabati tourism loan and startup loan; craftsmen and professionals services; and energy efficiency renewable energy project financing and medical product services. In addition it offers brokerage Sharia compliant products ETFs mutual funds equity fixed income portfolio and asset management and wealth planning. Further the company provides treasury services including foreign exchange margin trading financial derivatives money market and capital market investment and financial institutions and international banking services as well as digital services. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Jordan Kuwait Bank operates as a subsidiary of Al Rawabi United Holding Company K.S.C.C. (Holding).

Name: Société des Boissons du Maroc S.A.
Description: Société des Boissons du Maroc S.A. engages in manufacturing and marketing beer in Morocco. The company produces and markets local wines and mineral water; and provides olive oil. Société des Boissons du Maroc S.A. offers its products under Casablanca Stork Gold Special Flag Original Special Flag Flag PILS Doppel Munich Lager Bonassia Comtesse de La Courtablaise Halana kasbah Larroque and Vigne d'azour brands. The company was founded in 1919 and is based in Casablanca Morocco. Société des Boissons du Maroc S.A. is a subsidiary of Ste Marocaine d'Investissements & de Sces - MDI.

Name: Econergy Renewable Energy Ltd
Description: Econergy Renewable Energy Ltd an independent power producing company develops owns and operates utility-scale renewable energy projects in Italy the United Kingdom Romania Spain Poland and Greece. It also operates solar wind and battery storage project plants. Econergy Renewable Energy Ltd was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Kfar Saba Israel.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Mercantil Servicios Financieros C.A.
Description: Mercantil Servicios Financieros C.A. through its subsidiaries offers banking insurance and asset management products and services in Latin America. It offers health and automobile insurances as well as property services; trust and custody administration services; investment portfolio management and banking services; and mutual funds. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Caracas Venezuela. Mercantil Servicios Financieros C.A. operates as a subsidiary of Mercantil Servicios Financieros Internacional S.A.

Name: Integratel Perú S.A.A.
Description: Integratel Perú S.A.A. operates as a telecommunications company in Peru. The company offers mobile telephony Internet and fixed telephony services; data transmission and information technology services; national and international long distance bearer services; and mobile satellite and pay television services. The company was formerly known as Telefónica del Perú S.A.A. and changed its name to Integratel Perú S.A.A. in June 2025. The company was founded in 1920 and is based in Surquillo Peru. As of April 13 2025 Telefónica del Perú S.A.A. operates as a subsidiary of Integra Tec International Inc.

Name: R.A.K. Ceramics P.J.S.C.
Description: R.A.K. Ceramics P.J.S.C. engages in manufacture and sale of various ceramic products in the Middle East Europe Asian countries and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Ceramics Products Faucets Other Industrial and Others. It manufactures and sells ceramic wall and floor tiles gres porcellanato and bath-ware and table ware; and taps and faucets. The company also manufactures and distributes power paints plastics mines and chemicals; and provides security material movement and real estate services. In addition it engages in manufacturing processing importing and exporting of industrial minerals; general trading activities; and manufacturing of pipes as well as provides utility services. Further the company undertakes construction projects and civil works; leases investment properties; trades in ceramic tiles sanitary ware and tableware; extracts trades in and exports clay and other minerals; and offers adhesive products. R.A.K. Ceramics P.J.S.C. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Ras al-Khaimah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Gulf Investment House - KPSC
Description: Gulf Investment House - KPSC together with its subsidiaries engages in the investment activities in Kuwait Gulf and the Middle East and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Investments Real Estate and Manufacturing. It provides financial and advisory services. The company also undertakes Islamic investments as well as engages in the real estate activities. Gulf Investment House - KPSC was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Gulf Investment House - KPSC operates as a subsidiary of GIH Financing Co.

Name: Hektas Ticaret T.A.S.
Description: Hektas Ticaret T.A.S. produces imports and markets agricultural and veterinary pesticides in Turkey. The company’s crop protection products include fungicides herbicides insecticides acaricides biological products fumigants and nemathists plant growth regulators winter struggle medicines and summer oils spreaders-adhesives pheromons and molluscicide and others. It offers smart base organically coated foliar and pure fertilizers; organominerals; drip irrigation; biological preparation; and other plant nutrition products. In addition the company provides tomato pepper cucumber eggplant wheat bean pea corn sunflower cotton and barley seeds. Further it provides ruminant and poultry products such as antibacterials vitamins and minerals and feed additive; and pet products including cat litter and pet care products as well as environmental health products. Additionally the company involves in development activities to establish greenhouses and specially equipped areas. Hektas Ticaret T.A.S. was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Gebze Turkey.

Name: Omnia Holdings Limited
Description: Omnia Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries research develops manufactures and supplies chemicals specialised services and solutions for the agriculture mining and chemicals application industries in South Africa rest of Africa and internationally. It operates through Agriculture RSA Agriculture Rest of Africa Agriculture International Mining RSA Mining International and Chemicals segments. The company manufactures and trades in granular liquid and specialty fertilizers; humates and other biostimulants; and fulvates kelp microbial products. It also offers trace elements and plant health products to enhance crop health yields and soil health; and value-added services and solutions as well as supplies raw materials and manufactured goods. In addition the company provides blasting agents bulk emulsion and blended bulk explosives; AXXIS electronic detonator system and software; mining chemicals; and manufactures and distributes specialty functional and effect chemicals and solutions as well as SHEQ-related services. It serves commercial and small-scale farmers co-operatives and other corporate clients; retail customers and government support programmes; and water agriculture industrial and life sciences sectors. Omnia Holdings Limited was founded in 1953 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Compagnie Marocaine de Goutte à goutte et de Pompage S.A.
Description: Compagnie Marocaine de Goutte à goutte et de Pompage S.A. engages in the distribution of irrigation and agricultural equipment in Morocco and West Africa. The company engage in the distribution of irrigation systems pumping equipment for water supply; and solar equipment. It is also involved engages in the production PVC and HDPE pipes for drinking water supply; liquid sanitation; and construction projects in the construction and telecommunications sectors. The company provides desalination and pumping treatment services. It also engages in the distribution of plant protection and nutrition products seeds and plastic films; and mixing and processing of fertilizers. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Meshulam Levinstein Contracting & Engineering Ltd.
Description: Meshulam Levinstein Contracting & Engineering Ltd. engages in engineering construction and real estate businesses in Israel and internationally. The company undertakes construction projects for residential office and commercial purposes. It also develops office buildings public buildings and structures designed for the hi-tech industry; housing units apartment buildings and residential neighborhoods; and shopping centers and commercial buildings. In addition the company is involved in the project development activities including land investments handling permits construction sales and rental activities. Further it undertakes infrastructure works bridge construction and building contracting activities. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Edita Food Industries Company (S.A.E)
Description: Edita Food Industries Company (S.A.E) engages in the production of snack food products in Egypt. The company operates through five segments: Cakes Croissants Rusks Wafer and Biscuits. It manufactures packs and sells food products such as juices jams readymade foods cakes pastry milk products meat vegetables fruits chocolate vegetarian products strudles brownies and packaged donut as well as candy jello cookies and frozen pastries. The company offers its products under the Molto HOHOs Twinkies TODO Bake Rolz Bake Stix Mimix Tiger Tail Oniro Molto Forni and Freska brands. It also distributes various brands of imported sweeteners olive oils and pasta. The company sells its products through distribution centers as well as wholesalers and retailers. The company also exports its products to approximately 17 markets across the Middle East and North Africa which include West Bank Iraq Libya and Morocco. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in 6th of October City Egypt.

Name: Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company
Description: Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company engages in the research development manufacture and marketing of generic medicines and pharmaceutical preparations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Private Public and Export. Its product portfolio includes dermatological respiratory cardiovascular alimentary and anti-infectives musculoskeletal genitourinary systems and CNS. The company also exports its products. Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company was formerly known as Middle East Chemical Products Factory Company and changed its name to Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company in January 2006. Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Nexa Resources Perú S.A.A.
Description: Nexa Resources Perú S.A.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the exploration exploitation production and commercialization of metals in Peru the United States Europe and Asia. It primarily explores for zinc copper lead concentrates gold and silver metals. The company holds interest in the Cerro Lindo Mining Unit located in Peru; the El Porvenir unit situated in Peru; and the Atacocha Mine located in Peru. The company was formerly known as Compañía Minera Milpo S.A.A. and changed its name to Nexa Resources Perú S.A.A. in September 2018. The company was incorporated in 1949 and is based in Santiago De Surco Peru. Nexa Resources Perú S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Nexa Resources - Cajamarquilla S.A.

Name: Standard Bank PLC
Description: Standard Bank PLC provides banking and other related services in Malawi. It operates through Corporate and Investment Banking Treasury and Capital Management Personal and Private Banking and Business and Commercial Clients segments. It offers current fixed deposit call SME and contract save accounts; fixed term home pay day revolving term business revolving credit business term commercial property medium term and working capital loans; business overdraft; and trade and vehicle and asset financing services. The company also provides debit cards; bancassurance products; investment products and advisory services; offshore banking services; and ATM Internet telephone and electronic banking services. In addition it offers corporate and investment banking products and services comprising foreign exchange services commodities debt securities and equities trading services; transactional banking trade finance and investor services; and equity investment advisory project finance structured finance structured trade finance corporate lending primary market acquisition and finance property finance and asset and wealth management services to larger corporates financial institutions and international counterparties. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Lilongwe Malawi. Standard Bank PLC operates as a subsidiary of Stanbic Africa Holdings Limited.

Name: JSE Limited
Description: JSE Limited operates as a multi-asset class stock exchange in South Africa. It offers listing services for securities and debt instruments; trading colocation and client support services across its markets; post-trade services such as risk management as well as clearing and settlement assurance for the exchange’s equity bonds and derivatives markets; transfer secretarial services including share register maintenance issuer communication the handling of corporate actions and share scheme management to issuers; and central securities depository service. The company provides market data products comprising live data for JSE-listed equities derivatives and bonds as well as a selection of historical data products to market professionals and data distributors; and Issuer Services including results presentations and investor engagements annual general meeting facilitation and training through the JSE Training Academy. In addition it operates a private placements platform to address the needs of companies that seek to raise capital. The company was founded in 1887 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Lydia Yesil Enerji Kaynaklari A.S.
Description: Lydia Yesil Enerji Kaynaklari A.S. engages in the production and sale of electricity and heat energy in Turkey. The company generates electricity through solar hydrogen wind etc. energy resources. It also engages in processing of fresh fruits and vegetables dry products and semi-finished products. The company was formerly known as Tetamat Gida Yatirimlari A.S. and changed its name to Lydia Yesil Enerji Kaynaklari A.S. in September 2024. Lydia Yesil Enerji Kaynaklari A.S. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Log-In Logística Intermodal S.A.
Description: Log-in Logística Intermodal S.A. engages in the provision of integrated logistics solutions for moving and transporting door-to-door containers and cargo in Brazil Austria and internationally. It operates through Integrated Logistics Solutions Port Terminal and Road Cargo Transport segments. The company offers cabotage services; coastal shipping and maritime services; warehousing separation and cross-dock services; and storage services for containers and general cargo as well as manages and operates container port terminals. It also provides road freight transport of cargo and parcels; administration transportation consultancy storage and customs clearance services; and river navigation agency and arm vessels cargo import and export and multimodal transport services. In addition the company is involved in the purchase sale rental administration construction and operation of real estate; distribution of material and equipment by air land sea or river; investment activities in securities; maritime trade; and deposit loading and unloading of goods. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil. Log-In Logística Intermodal S.A. is a subsidiary of SAS Shipping Agencies Services SÀRL.

Name: Agostini's Limited
Description: Agostini's Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in trading and distribution and manufacturing/packaging of certain food products in the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago Barbados and internationally. It operates through three segments: Pharmaceutical & Health Care; Consumer Products; and Energy Industrial and Holdings. The company offers convenience items food beverage personal care grocery and building products; engages in the wholesale distribution of pharmaceutical items and personal care products through pharmacies; and provides interior modelling oilfield and other construction related services. It also involved in the marketing of equipment and services to petroleum related companies; sale and service of medical equipment; and manufacture and supply of household related products. In addition the company engages in the management of real estate; and rental of properties and warehouse space for commercial use. Agostini's Limited was founded in 1925 and is based in Port of Spain Trinidad & Tobago. Agostini's Limited is a subsidiary of Victor E. Mouttet Limited.

Name: Capricorn Group Limited
Description: Capricorn Group Limited an investment holding company engages in the banking microlending and related businesses in Namibia Botswana and Zambia. The company’s products and services include savings investment loan credit and deposits. It also offers advisory asset management foreign exchange related finance and insurance products. In addition the company provides lending wealth management asset management and trust management services as well as offers property development and evaluation services and facilitates payments. Further it provides recapitalisations mergers acquisitions due diligence and restructuring services. The company was formerly known as Capricorn Investment Group Limited and changed its name to Capricorn Group Limited in May 2020. Capricorn Group Limited was founded in 1982 and is based in Windhoek Namibia.

Name: Consultatio S.A.
Description: Consultatio S.A. engages in the real estate development and investment business in Argentina and internationally. It is involved in the development of urbanizations; residential buildings for sale; and corporate towers. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Sok Marketler Ticaret A.S.
Description: Sok Marketler Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries operates in retail sector in Turkey. The company sells fast-moving consuming products. Its products portfolio includes dairy products such as milk butter cream cheese butter milk yogurt cocoa milk ice cream and milk puddings; fruit juices; spices comprising sumac carbonate red pepper flakes pepper coconut sesame cumin currants black cumin cinnamon eight oregano and pistachios; dry foods including bulgur rice lentils nohut wheat beans chickpeas and corn; pasta soups flour semolina starch cooking bases and bouillons and cooking aids; corn sunflower and canola oils; margarine kase; laundry conditioners washing powders general cleaning products and washing liquids; tea; olives and olive oils; canned foods gravies and sauces; chips and dryfruits; and cappuccino and coffee products. The company also provides shaving foams and related products; tissues napkins and toilet papers; wet towels soaps and colognes; fries potato coquettes mixed pizza peas meatballs ravioli puff pastry and sweet corn; and molasses and tahin and related products. In addition it offers wafers and cakes; pretzels stick crackers biscuits and creams; and soda and soft drinks as well as kitchenware cleaners paper products and clothing items. The company sells its products under the Mis Anadolu Mutfagi Piyale Evin Mintax Deren Lio Bizim Vatan AMIGO LEZZCAFE ADAM Beyaz Guvercin Ebru iNCi Taskale Peki Tempo Crown and Karmen brands. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Odine Solutions Teknoloji Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S.
Description: Odine Solutions Teknoloji Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. provides software solutions in Turkey. It also provides Odine Orion a voice management solution; Odine Nebula a voice cloud management platform and Odine Nebula+ a flexible hybrid voice platform; Odine Gatekeeper a voice fraud management solution; and Odine Pathfinder a centralized routing server solution. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Ferchem Misr for fertilizers and chemicals S.A.E
Description: Ferchem Misr for fertilizers and chemicals S.A.E produces and sells fertilizers. It offers super phosphate granulated and blended fertilizer products. The company was formerly known as Ferchem Misr Company for Fertilizers and Chemicals and changed its name to Ferchem Misr for fertilizers and chemicals S.A.E in August 2007. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Sadat City Egypt.

Name: Maharah for Human Resources Company
Description: Maharah for Human Resources Company provides manpower services to public and private sectors in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. It operates through three segments: Corporate Individual and Facilities Management. The company also offers temporary employment agency activities for domestic and foreign labor services. The company was formerly known as Maharah Recruitment Company and changed its name to Maharah for Human Resources Company in April 2017. Maharah for Human Resources Company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Tekfen Holding Anonim Sirketi
Description: Tekfen Holding Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in engineering and contracting agriculture and investment businesses in Turkey CIS the Middle Eastern countries and internationally. It operates through three segments: Engineering and Contracting Agricultural Industry and Investment. The company provides turnkey solutions for various facilities such as pipelines oil and gas terminals tank farms oil refineries offshore oil rigs pump and compressor stations power plants industrial plants petrochemical plants highway and metro projects sports complexes steel structures and superstructure and infrastructure projects. It also undertakes the production of agricultural inputs including seeds and saplings; and produces bread and durum wheat seeds table and seed potatoes banana fruits and banana saplings. In addition the company engages in the terminal management; ship agency business; free zone management; insurance; development leasing operation and management of properties; facility management services including general maintenance repair cleaning and security services as well as management of spaces such as parking facilities conference halls restaurants and fitness centers; management services; trading of fertilizers; manufacture of fruits; trading activities; and energy business. Tekfen Holding Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1956 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Yanbu Cement Company
Description: Yanbu Cement Company together with its subsidiaries engages in manufacturing producing and trading of cement and related products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company offers ordinary Portland Pozzolana Portland hydraulic and sulphate resistance cement products. It is also involved in the manufacturing and wholesale trading of cement paper; and sale of packed bulk cement and cement bags. Yanbu Cement Company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Qualitau Ltd
Description: Qualitau Ltd engages in the development manufacture and sale of test equipment and services for use in the semiconductor industry for European and Far-Eastern markets. The company provides reliability test systems including package and wafer-level multi-application testing package level pulse EM and BTS testing package and wafer-level TDDB and HC testing multi-site parallel wafer-level probing systems and semi- auto probers. It also offers fast parametric testers high voltage HTRB/H3TRB products and desktop micro-oven systems as well as test lab services. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ness Ziona Israel.

Name: Grindrod Limited
Description: Grindrod Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the logistics services business in North America the Middle East the United Kingdom Isle of Man rest of Europe Singapore Asia the Far East Australia South Africa and Rest of Africa. The company operates through Ports and Terminals; Logistics; Group; Private Equity and Property; and Marine Fuels segments. It engages in the bulk terminal activities include receiving stockpiling and loading of cargo onto vessels for onward transportation; container handling transport warehousing loading and offloading; selling and leasing containers; and logistics solutions for the transportation of cargo through road rail and sea. The company provides clearing and forwarding of imports and exports transportation of goods and ship husbandry services; and various ancillary services including training stevedoring and rentals. In addition it involves managing and handling port activities; freight services such as handling and storage of containers clearing and forwarding to road rail and seaborne freight; ships agency; and marine fuels lubricants bunkers and agricultural commodities. Further the company invests in private and property equity portfolios; and engages in the private equity investment business. The company was founded in 1910 and is based in Durban South Africa.

Name: Carasso Real Estate Ltd
Description: Carasso Real Estate Ltd engages in developing planning and constructing residential projects in Israel. It develops residential commercial office buildings and hi-tech facilities as well as retail centers. The company was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Saudi Steel Pipes Company
Description: Saudi Steel Pipes Company manufactures and distributes steel pipes in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company offers welded steel pipes by high frequency induction welding and galvanizing coating threading and bending of the pipes used in oil and gas water industrial and construction sectors. It also produces ERW/HFI galvanized and threaded steel pipes and seamless pipes; pipes with three-layer external coating by polyethylene and polypropylene and epoxy coating; and bended pipes in various diameters and space frame as well as submerged arc welded pipes. In addition the company is involved in wholesale of pipes tubes and hollow shapes from iron and steel ferrous and non-ferrous metal pipes and other metal accessories such as locks hinges and other hand tools as well as construction and metal materials. It exports its products. Saudi Steel Pipes Company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank - Egypt - S.A.E
Description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank - Egypt - S.A.E provides various banking products and services to individuals and corporates in Egypt and internationally. It operates through Large Medium and Small Enterprises; Investment; Retail; and Other Activities segments. The company offers personal banking solutions comprising current tiered monthly saving investment charitable and saving accounts; prepaid credit cash back business and debit cards; El Yosr finance small business finance and auto and used auto Murabaha solutions; lockers; custody services; real estate and personal finance; investment products; internet mobile and private banking services. It also provides small and medium enterprises solutions including cash management integrated financial and treasury services; business banking solutions comprising account payment services and cash management trade business card foreign currency internet banking and call center services; business finance services such as small business and doctors’ finance; and investment purchasing and financing of corporate restructuring and financial instruments. In addition the company offers corporate and trade finance and account and liquidity management services; factoring; and foreign exchange money market hedging and risk management and market analysis solutions. Further it provides financial leasing services and sale and lease back services that include funding of various assets such as buildings machinery and equipment passenger and commercial vehicles and others; and mergers and acquisitions and debt and equity capital market services. The company was formerly known as National Bank for Development (S.A.E) and changed its name to Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank - Egypt S.A.E in April 2012. Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank - Egypt S.A.E was founded in 1974 and is based in Cairo Egypt. Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank - Egypt - S.A.E is a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank PJSC.

Name: Brisa Bridgestone Sabanci Lastik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Brisa Bridgestone Sabanci Lastik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the manufacture marketing and sale of vehicle tires in Turkey and internationally. The company offers tires for radial passenger car truck minibus bus outer tires automobiles light commercial vehicles buses trucks and agricultural and construction machinery under the Bridgestone Lassa Dayton Firestone and Kinesis brand names; tire retreading services under the Bandag brand name; and vehicle maintenance services. It provides digital fleet services through Filofix road assistance mobile application and fleet services under the Probox Mobilfix and Propratik brands. The company offers its products and services through its stores and e-commerce platform under Lastik.com.tr website. The company was formerly known as Lassa Lastik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Brisa Bridgestone Sabanci Lastik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. in 1988. Brisa Bridgestone Sabanci Lastik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Yduqs Participações S.A.
Description: Yduqs Participações S.A. provides higher education services in Brazil. The company offers face-to-face semi-face-to-face and distance education. It also operates two edtechs to prepare the candidates for exams and competitions named HardWork Medicina and Grupo Q which offers Qconcursos solutions. It serves under Estácio Ibmec IDOMED Wyden and Damásio brand names. The company was formerly known as Estácio Participações S.A. Yduqs Participações S.A. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Arabi Group Holding Company K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Arabi Group Holding Company K.S.C. (Public) operates in the oil and gas retails investments and construction sectors in Kuwait Gulf Cooperation Council countries and internationally. It provides primary and secondary healthcare services through hospitals and primary healthcare centers. The company also offers water equipment such as water pumps filters and heaters as well as valves garage equipment and pipes/fittings; power tools landscape and irrigation systems misting systems window cleaning machines space frames and on line leak sealing services; garage and industrial equipment including specialized building equipment firefighting and HVAC pumps air condition equipment and construction chemicals materials; and cleaning and oil and gas equipment power tools and safety equipment welding accessories water and waste water treatment equipment access equipment personal safety welding equipment etc. In addition it undertakes EPC and maintenance contracts; landscaping and irrigation works; and construction and maintenance contracts in the heating ventilation and air-conditioning specialty. Further the company provides card solutions for exchange houses banks malls retail outlets restaurants and hotels and other point-based privilege schemes; SMS systems for financial institutions insurance companies hospitals telecommunication companies postal and courier services etc.; solutions for point-of-sale technology; remittance and money transfers ready and custom-made solutions; and other IT solutions and services. Additionally it offers outsourcing services such as customer interactions customer relationship management sales/telemarketing campaign technical IT support call center/helpdesk setup; maintenance for medical and analytical applications; and financial advisory services to businesses and high-net-worth individuals. Arabi Group Holding Company K.S.C. (Public) was founded in 1963 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: RIMAC Seguros y Reaseguros S.A.
Description: RIMAC Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. engages in the insurance business in Peru. It offers vehicle and SOAT health life house and travel workers and other insurance products; annuities; and insurance products for companies. The company was formerly known as Rimac - Internacional Compania de Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. and changed its name to RIMAC Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. in February 2012. The company was incorporated in 1896 and is headquartered in San Isidro Peru. RIMAC Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. is a subsidiary of Breca Seguros Y Salud S.A.C.

Name: Engie Energía Perú S.A.
Description: Engie Energía Perú S.A. engages in the electricity generation transmission and commercialization activities in Peru. The company generates electricity from various sources such as water natural gas and renewable energy. It has an installed capacity of 2496 MW from 8 power generation plants which include four thermoelectric plants two hydroelectric plants one solar plant. In addition the company distributes electrical power through transmission lines as well as offers customer services. Engie Energía Perú S.A. was formerly known as EnerSur S.A. and changed its name to Engie Energía Perú S.A. in March 2016. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Lima Peru. Engie Energía Perú S.A. operates as a subsidiary of International Power S.A.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Petroreconcavo S.A.
Description: Petroreconcavo S.A. engages in the exploration and production of oil and natural gas in Brazil. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Mata De Sao Joao Brazil.

Name: Volcan Compañía Minera S.A.A.
Description: Volcan Compañía Minera S.A.A. explores for and operates mining concessions in Peru Europe Asia and the United States. The company operates through six segments: Volcan Chungar Cerro investments energy and Others. It primarily explores for zinc copper lead and silver deposits. The company holds interests in Yauli Animon Alpamarca and Cerro mines located in the department of Cerro de Pasco and Junín and Lima. It also engages in electric power generation; real estate development; port and logistic activities; non-operating; and other activities. In addition the company operates and maintains electric transmission system generation plants. Volcan Compañía Minera S.A.A. was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Lima Peru. Volcan Compañía Minera S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Transition Metals AG.

Name: Juhayna Food Industries S.A.E.
Description: Juhayna Food Industries S.A.E. engages in producing manufacturing processing and packaging of dairy products juices and cooking products in Egypt. The company produces plain and flavored milk yogurt specialty drinks and cooking creams under the Juhayna brand as well as cheeses fruit juices and frozen materials; and operates dairy farms. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Nemak S. A. B. de C. V.
Description: Nemak S. A. B. de C. V. together with its subsidiaries develops manufactures and sells aluminum components for e-mobility structure and chassis and ICE powertrain applications to the automotive industry in North America Europe and internationally. The company offers ICE powertrain components such as cylinder heads engine blocks oil pans and transmission cases; and vehicle structures and chassis products including lift gates longitudinal members support brackets A-pillars cradles e-brackets shock towers and subframes. It also provides e-mobility components comprising e-motor and battery housings for hybrid and electric vehicles. The company was formerly known as Tenedora Nemak S. A. de C. V. and changed its name to Nemak S. A. B. de C. V. in June 2015. Nemak S. A. B. de C. V. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in García Mexico.

Name: SalfaCorp S.A.
Description: SalfaCorp S.A. engages in engineering construction and real estate businesses in Chile and internationally. The company offers construction and industrial assembly civil works construction industrial maintenance mining development marine works earthmoving and drilling and blasting services as well as undertakes engineering procurement and construction projects. It is also involved in real estate commercial and infrastructure activities; and development and rental of commercial and industrial projects. The company was founded in 1929 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Ampla Energia e Serviços S.A.
Description: Ampla Energia e Serviços S.A. is involved in the distribution of electricity in Brazil. The company was formerly known as Companhia de Eletricidade do Rio de Janeiro. The company was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil. Ampla Energia e Serviços S.A. is a subsidiary of Enel Brasil S.A.

Name: Mannai Corporation Q.P.S.C.
Description: Mannai Corporation Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries offers information technology services in Qatar other GCC countries and internationally. It operates through Information Technology and Networking Auto Group Jewellery Trading Energy and Industrial Markets Geotechnical Services Logistics Travel Engineering and Other segments. The company offers various IT services including application implementation bespoke application development systems integration mobility master data management enterprise content management data warehousing enterprise resource planning and customer relationship management; hardware software security networking compute and print solutions; digital business and technology services; IT infrastructure and office equipment solutions; distribution technology payment and other solutions; and healthcare research and scientific technology solutions. It sells small compacts passenger cars commercial vehicles and used cars; sells and markets heavy equipment and construction machinery to the construction and industrial sectors; retails jewellery; and offers car rental lease hire chauffeur and shuttle services. In addition the company offers equipment and services to the oil and gas construction infrastructure and utilities sectors; ground investigation borehole drilling laboratory and petroleum testing and environmental and food analysis; travel management and support services; air sea and road freight transportation; warehousing domestic transportation and customs clearance services; and engineering services. Further the company supplies home white goods and small kitchen appliances as well as electronics video and audio systems; and provides facilities maintenance and management services. The company was founded in 1951 and is based in Doha Qatar. Mannai Corporation Q.P.S.C. is a subsidiary of Qatar Investment & Projects Development Holding Co. W.L.L.

Name: Scope Metals Group Ltd.
Description: Scope Metals Group Ltd. stores processes and delivers metal and plastic worldwide. The company supplies aluminum stainless steel steel plastic materials copper bronze brass titanium zinc lead tungsten magnesium and other raw materials. Its products include actuators control and shut-off valves gate and globe valves pressure reducing valves positioners control instrumentation check valves and strainers measuring instruments steam traps and humidifiers expansion joints and vessels expansion joints sphere connectors plastic valves; fire sprinkler and protection systems firefighting monitors cabinets pumps nozzles suppression foam fire apparatus equipment pipework and fittings hydrants industrial firefighting systems and other accessories. In addition the company offers clean water vacuum industrial sanitary diaphragm and submersible pumps boosters mixers silukit macerator and mixing equipment; anchors screws nuts washers rings threaded rods pins rivets hose clamps and self-clinching fasteners. Further it provides welding electrodes and wires; submerged arc welding welding helmets and metal surface treatments; industrial flooring systems floor plates expanded meshes perforated sheets modular railings chains cables tensioners decorative aluminum sheets plastic sheets corrugated panels decorative stainless sheets and tiles; handles and hinges. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Bnei Ayish Israel.

Name: Mediterranean Towers Ltd.
Description: Mediterranean Towers Ltd. owns and operates residential homes for the elderly population in Israel. The company also owns land for construction. Mediterranean Towers Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Ganei Tikva Israel.

Name: Duniec Bros. Ltd
Description: Duniec Bros. Ltd operates as a public construction company primarily in Israel. The company engages in the planning developing construction marketing and selling of residential construction projects. Duniec Bros. Ltd was formerly known as Doniec Bros Company Ltd. and changed its name to Duniec Bros. Ltd in November 1992. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Rishon LeZion Israel.

Name: Societe Ivoirienne Des Tabacs S A
Description: Societe Ivoirienne Des Tabacs S A operates as a subsidiary of Imperial Tobacco Group plc.

Name: Beltone Holding S.A.E
Description: Beltone Holding S.A.E provides financial services in the Middle East and North America (MENA) region. It offers non-banking financial institution services including private equity and direct investments venture capital microfinance consumer finance leasing and factoring and mortgage finance. The company also provides investment banking advisory and capital raising services; brokerage services to individuals and institutional investors; and asset management and equity research services. In addition it offers a range of services including talent recruitment outsourcing strategic human resource (HR) and management consultations and training and development programs as well as HR services comprising paypro personnel services HR complete outsource services talent trove complete employee lifecycle solutions ascendplus benefits pro elite leadership discovery and organizational evolution solutions. Further the company provides financial educational services to individuals; and engages in data science and analytics and real estate brokerage and marketing activities. Additionally it offers services to small and medium enterprises (SMEs); and agriculture and management solutions. The company was formerly known as Beltone Financial Holding SAE and changed its name to Beltone Holding S.A.E in February 2024. Beltone Holding S.A.E was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in New Cairo Egypt.

Name: Airtel Networks Zambia Plc
Description: Airtel Networks Zambia Plc provides cellular radio telecommunication services for individual and business customers in Zambia. The company offers voice services 4G data home broadband and internet services SMS services MiFi’s and routers value added services and international calling and roaming services for individual customers. It also provides fixed voice bulk SMS closed user group postpaid hybrid roaming and toll-free services; dedicated internet data center international leased circuit co-location and National VPN services; and audio and video conferencing and virtual PABX services for businesses. The company was formerly known as Celtel Zambia Plc and changed its name to Airtel Networks Zambia Plc in April 2013. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Lusaka Zambia. Airtel Networks Zambia Plc is a subsidiary of Bharti Airtel Zambia Holdings BV.

Name: Union Properties Public Joint Stock Company
Description: Union Properties Public Joint Stock Company invests in and develops properties. The company operates through four segments: Real Estate Property Management Contracting Activities Investing Activities and Sales of Goods and Services. Its project portfolio includes master communities residential commercial hospitality and industrial projects. The company is involved in central air-conditioning requisites manufacturing and fire fighting equipment assembling; cold storage and warehousing; facilities management security mechanical electrical and plumbing works and energy management services; building management and consultancy for motor racing tracks; manufacturing and interior decoration; and owners association management.
