The company was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Kenya Electricity Generating Company PLC
Description: Kenya Electricity Generating Company PLC operates as an electric power generating company in Kenya. The company develops manages and operates geothermal hydro wind and thermal power generation plants with a combined installed capacity of 1726 megawatts. It also offers consultancy and drilling services. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Altshuler Shaham Finance Ltd
Description: Altshuler Shaham Finance Ltd engages in the provident and pension funds management activities in Israel. The company manages savings provident funds central severance pay provident funds central provident funds for budgetary pension participation as well as investment provident funds which include children savings plan and comprehensive pension funds and general pension funds. It is also involved in the management of alternative real estate investments. The company was formerly known as A.S. Matrat Hanpaka Ltd and changed its name to Altshuler Shaham Finance Ltd in March 2022. Altshuler Shaham Finance Ltd was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel. Altshuler Shaham Finance Ltd is a subsidiary of Altshuler Shaham Ltd.

Name: Dubai Refreshment (P.J.S.C.)
Description: Dubai Refreshment (P.J.S.C.) engages in bottling and selling Pepsi Cola International products in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company offers carbonated drinks under the Pepsi Mountain Dew Mirinda 7UP Sting ROCKSTAR Evervess Britvic and Shani brands; non-carbonated drinks under the Lipton Aquafina Mathieu Teisseire Ceres Robinsons London Essence and Gatorade brand names; and water under the Aquafina brand name as well as confectionary products under the Edita and Snack Time brands. It also exports its products. Dubai Refreshment (P.J.S.C.) was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Vodacom Tanzania Public Limited Company
Description: Vodacom Tanzania Public Limited Company offers telecommunication services to consumers and enterprises in Tanzania. The company offers mobile; mobile internet and fixed data; SMS and social media applications; value-added services including media and entertainment education and advertisement and health services; and customer care comprising call centre Vodacom shops service desks supplementary service data and customer alerts as well as customer support through social media and live chat on website and WhatsApp. It also provides deposits and withdrawals; person-to-person transfers; M-Pesa super-app; electronic payment solutions including virtual M-Pesa Visa card merchants consumer to business business to consumer and business to business; and financial services such as M-Pesa overdraft savings and loans group savings agent term loans insurance services and wealth management solutions. In addition the company offers mobility solutions such as voice small medium enterprises packages data internet of things reverse charge bulk messaging SIM manager and value-added services; fixed and wholesale solutions including internet inter-branch capacity hosting/co-location cloud session initiation protocol services digital solutions and M-Pesa for business solutions. It serves customers through various sales and distribution channels including wholesale distributors retailers franchise stores direct sales partners street vendors and informal resellers; and direct sales forces independent dealers and agents street vendors and informal resellers. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Ecogas Inversiones S.A.
Description: Ecogas Inversiones S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in the distribution of natural gas to residential and commercial customers in Argentina. It serves 1399777 customers through an infrastructure of 35842 km of networks and gas pipelines. The company was formerly known as Inversora de Gas del Centro S.A. Ecogas Inversiones S.A. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Issta Ltd
Description: Issta Ltd provides travel and tourism services to private and business customers groups and organizations in Israel and internationally. It offers outbound and domestic tourism services including scheduled flights charter flights vacation packages organized trips ski vacations sports music and cruises as well as complementary services such as hotels car rentals visas and student cards. The company offers its products through its branches in Israel as well as through call centers and online travel services. The company was formerly known as Issta Lines Ltd. Issta Ltd was founded in 1956 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: Nawi Group Ltd
Description: Nawi Group Ltd provides financial solutions based on financing and non-bank credit in Israel. The company offers import financing supplier financing real estate initiative financing equipment financing business financing supplementing equity funding against commercial checks and bridging loans. Its clients include individuals (licensed dealers) partnerships and corporations and businessmen operating in the construction infrastructure trade services factories and industry food agriculture and energy industries. The company was formerly known as Nawi Brothers Group Ltd and changed its name to Nawi Group Ltd in May 2024. Nawi Group Ltd was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Banque de Tunisie Société anonyme
Description: Banque de Tunisie Société anonyme provides various banking products and services to individuals professionals and public counterparties in Tunisia. The company offers demand deposits savings account term accounts and cash vouchers certificates of deposit and delivered pensions. It also provides furniture leasing services such as rolling stock office automation industrial equipment etc.; real estate leasing services including buildings factories stores etc.; and insurance products and servies. The company was founded in 1884 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: FMS Enterprises Migun Ltd
Description: FMS Enterprises Migun Ltd manufactures and sells ballistic protection raw materials and products worldwide. It offers uni-directional (UD) polyethylene and aramid fabrics; personal vehicle panel protection; and vehicle protection such as civilian military composite armor kits and boat armor. The company provides soft armor; hard armor including ceramic body armour plates against armour piercing threats groin protection plates neck protection plates and composite plates under the FAMOSTONE brands; and ballistic shields used by law enforcement personnel such as police or special forces. Its products are used for personal ballistic protection vehicle armoring ship armoring and aircraft armoring applications. FMS Enterprises Migun Ltd was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Byblos Bank S.A.L.
Description: Byblos Bank S.A.L. together with its subsidiaries provides various banking and insurance services for individuals and businesses in Lebanon Europe and internationally. It operates through Corporate and Commercial Banking Retail and Personal Banking and Treasury and Capital Markets segments. The company offers current savings and other deposit accounts; personal and consumer loans; overdrafts; retail and private banking; investment brokerage; project finance and syndication; and international trade finance. It also provides financing facilities comprising working capital and letters of credit and guarantee; and credit facilities for the trade and manufacturing and contracting and real estate industries. In addition the company offers debit and credit cards; retail payments; fixed income; equities; FX and precious metals; life fire general accident and medical coverage insurance products; investment banking services including business plans feasibility studies company valuation and restructuring and mergers and acquisitions; cash management; merchant solutions such as POS installation online payment gateway and smart ATMs; and corporate internet banking and mobile banking services. Byblos Bank S.A.L. was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Beirut Lebanon.

Name: More Provident Funds Ltd
Description: More Provident Funds Ltd. manages provident and pension funds in Israel. The company offers provident funds for rewards and compensations savings education training and investments as well as for saving plans for a child; and general and comprehensive pension funds. More Provident Funds Ltd. was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Description: Banco de la Producción S.A. Produbanco provides retail and corporate banking services for individual small and medium business and corporate customers in Ecuador. The company offers deposit products; savings virtual current and digital accounts; automotive mortgage vehicle closed credit lines and online credit as well as mortgage loans for housing; and certificates of deposit letters of credit bank and customs guarantees and documentary collections. Name: Computer Direct Group Ltd.

Name: Empreendimentos Pague Menos S.A.

It also provides personal care and beauty products including deodorant intimate care and oral hygiene as well as foot hair face and hand care products; dermo-cosmetics; and repellent diaper cloth and food products as well as other accessories for moms and babies. It sells its products through retail stores and online. Empreendimentos Pague Menos S.A. was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Fortaleza Brazil.

Name: Reunert Limited
Description: Reunert Limited operates in the fields of electrical engineering information communication technologies (ICT) and applied electronics in South Africa rest of Africa the United States Australia Asia and Europe. Its Electrical Engineering segment designs manufactures installs and maintains power cables; low-voltage distribution protection and control equipment as well as high and medium-voltage switchgears. The company’s ICT segment offers office equipment communication equipment automation products managed print software and solutions production printing devices routers PBX equipment switches and handsets as well as communication equipment and software that includes design implementation and support of converged networking communications and security solutions. Its Applied Electronics segment offers search and tracking radar systems and subsystems; radar sensor systems; ground and naval search and tracking radar systems; communication systems; cryptographic products and solutions; electronic components and printed circuit boards; remote controlled stabilized weapons platforms; and energy engineering and storage solutions. This segment also provides military and commercial products including technology solutions; and electronic manufacturing services. It serves municipalities parastatals utilities the mining and building industries corporate and retail customers small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) government and state-owned entities and defense forces. Reunert Limited was founded in 1888 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Auto Hall S.A.
Description: Auto Hall S.A. engages in the marketing and distribution of rolling stocks in Morocco and Japan. The company offers SUVs compact utility and city cars. It markets and distributes various branded products such as Ford Nissan Chery Mitsubishi DFSK Fuso Foton GAZ Opel Ford Trucks New Holland MASERATI Jeep Alfa Romeo FIAT FIAT Professional Case Belaz AutoCaz LEADER and VALVOLINE brands. Description: Lahav LR Real Estate Ltd. engages in the real estate and renewable green energy business in Israel and Germany. Overseas Investments Ltd. and changed its name to Lahav LR Real Estate Ltd. in January 2012. Lahav LR Real Estate Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Yakum Israel.

Name: Carreras Limited
Description: Carreras Limited markets and distributes cigarettes primarily in Jamaica. The company offers its products under the Craven A Matterhorn Dunhill Rothmans Pall Mall and Vuse brand names. Carreras Limited was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Carreras Limited is a subsidiary of Rothmans Holdings (CARICOM) Limited.

Name: City Cement Company
Description: City Cement Company together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company provides ordinary portland cement for construction and plastering works concrete pipe and block and tile industry; and concrete structure works. Description: Banestes S.A - Banco do Estado do Espírito Santo S.A. operates as a multiple-service bank in Brazil. The company operates through Financial and Insurance and Others segments. Description: Al Khaleej Training and Education Company together with its subsidiaries operates schools for primary and secondary education with an international curriculum in Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Other Gulf Cooperation Council countries and internationally. Name: Cydsa S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Cydsa S.A.B. de C.V. together its subsidiaries produces and markets salt chlorine caustic soda and refrigerant gases electricity and steam cogeneration and underground storage of hydrocarbons in Mexico the United States Canada Central and South America Asia and Europe. It operates through Salt Chlorine and Caustic Soda Refrigerant Gases Energy Processing and Logistics and Cydsa and Other segments. The company offers light salt salt substitute Kosher and halal grade salt salt with chile and lime and coarse sea salt for use in household and commercial human consumption food industry and industrial processes as well as salt pellets for swimming pools and water softening. It also provides liquid and gas chlorine solid caustic soda membrane grade and rayon grade liquid caustic soda chlorine in cylinders sodium hypochlorite caustic potash synthetic hydrochloric acid and muriatic acid for use in chemical petrochemical water treatment oil pulp paper pesticides bleach soaps detergents bottling mining-metallurgy plastics pigments and paints industries and others. In addition the company offers refrigerant propellant and blowing gases as well as gases for fluoropolymers and anesthetic-medical products for use in industrial commercial and domestic refrigeration medical automotive and domestic appliance industries. Further it involved in the electricity and steam cogeneration business; and hydrocarbons processing and underground storage business as well as provides liquid petroleum gas processing and storage services. The company offers its products under the La Fina Cisne Marfil Gallo Palomitos Bakara Elefante Klara Carmen Brisa de Occidente Fine Genetron Aquion and Eco Flush trademarks. Cydsa S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in San Pedro Garza García Mexico.

Name: RCL Foods Limited
Description: RCL Foods Limited operates as a food manufacturer in South Africa. The company operates through the Groceries Baking and Sugar segments. It is involved in culinary products including mayonnaise peanut butter and rusks; milling specialty and bakery products; breads buns rolls and pies; as well as pet food products and beverages and sugar and molasses-based feed operations. The company sells its products primarily under the Ouma Nola Yum Yum Nutso Bobtail Catmor Dogmor Ultra Dog Canine Cuisine Optimizer Feline Cuisine Mageu Number 1 Monati Mnandi Supreme Tafelberg Safari A1 5 Star Sunbake Piemans Sunshine and Selati brands. In addition it engages in treasury international investments farming marketing and food innovation and research activities. The company was formerly known as Rainbow Chicken Limited and changed its name to RCL Foods Limited in August 2013. RCL Foods Limited was founded in 1960 and is based in Durban South Africa.

Name: Saudi Paper Manufacturing Company
Description: Saudi Paper Manufacturing Company engages in the manufacture and sale of tissue papers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Gulf Cooperation Council countries and internationally. The company operates through Manufacturing and Trading and Others segments. It offers facial tissues napkins toilet paper pocket tissues kitchen towels industrial tissues and maxi rolls; and table napkins under pad and interfold towels under the Mouchoir Excellence City SPC Pro and Jumbo Roll brands. The company also buys manufactures and distributes pulps and papers; and collects sorts transports and presses waste papers. Saudi Paper Manufacturing Company was founded in 1989 and is based in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Molinos Rio de la Plata S.A.
Description: Molinos Rio de la Plata S.A. engages in the industrialization and commercialization of food and alcoholic beverages in Argentina and internationally. It operates through Foods and Wineries segments. The company offers edible oils pasta dried frozen fractionated flour grass rice wines and sparkling wines. Molinos Rio de la Plata S.A. was incorporated in 1931 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Tadiran Group Ltd
Description: Tadiran Group Ltd engages in the import marketing distribution and sale of air conditioners and air conditioning systems in Israel Europe and internationally. The company operates through the Consumer Goods Energy and Other segments. It offers air conditioners and air conditioning systems under the Tadiran Amcor SFERA Toshiba and Spectra brands; central cooling units under the Aermec brand; fan coil blowers; refrigerators washing machines dryers freezers ovens and microwaves under the Amcor and Crystal brands; and heat pumps. The company also provides after-sales warranty and maintenance services. In addition it is involved in the import distribution and trade of photovoltaic energy products; production of aluminum profiles for construction of solar energy systems; planning and execution of various types of building cladding projects; and provision of fire protection solutions and related products. The company was formerly known as Tadiran Holdings Ltd and changed its name to Tadiran Group Ltd in May 2021. Tadiran Group Ltd was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Medicare Group Q.P.S.C.
Description: Medicare Group Q.P.S.C. provides healthcare and treatment services in Qatar. The company operates hospitals medical clinic centers and outpatient clinics. The company was formerly known as Al Ahli Specialized Hospital Company Q.S.C. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Caribbean Cement Company Limited
Description: Caribbean Cement Company Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells cement and clinker in Jamaica Caribbean countries and North America. The company is also involved in mining and sale of gypsum shale and pozzolan. It operates a spa facility. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Caribbean Cement Company Limited is a subsidiary of Trinidad Cement Limited.

Name: Astral Foods Limited
Description: Astral Foods Limited operates as an integrated poultry producer in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through Poultry and Feed segments. It also engages in the marketing sale and distribution of fresh and frozen poultry products; and breeding and sale of day-old chicks and hatching eggs. The company also produces and sells feed products for farmed animal species; provides laboratory analytical services to the animal feed industry; and a range of value-added products comprising frozen reformed crumbed and ready-to-eat poultry products. It offers its products under the Goldi County Fair Festive Meadow Feeds National Chicks Ross CAL Tiger Chicks Tiger Animal Feeds Mountain Valley Earlybird and SupaStar brands. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Gauteng South Africa.

Name: Résidences Dar Saada S.A
Description: Résidences Dar Saada S.A engages in the real estate development business in the Kingdom of Morocco. Its projects include apartments villas land shops and duplexes. Résidences Dar Saada S.A was founded in 2001 and is based in Casablanca the Kingdom of Morocco.

Name: Sekerbank T.A.S.
Description: Sekerbank T.A.S. together with its subsidiaries provides agricultural business SME corporate and retail banking services in Turkey and internationally. It operates through Corporate/Commercial SME Retail Treasury/Investment and Other segments. The company accepts time demand savings commercial and other deposits as well as foreign currency deposits. It also offers small and medium enterprises loans; consumer loans comprising mortgage vehicle general purpose and other loans; corporate and commercial loans specialized loans; export and import loans; business loans; corporate and commercial loans; loans given to financial sector; retail loans; and individual and commercial credit cards. In addition the company provides transaction brokerage portfolio brokerage private portfolio management investment consulting and brokerage and underwriting of public offerings as well as general custody services; domestic and foreign factoring services; and financial leasing services. Further it operates a portfolio consisting of real estates real estate projects rights based on real estate capital market instruments and other assets and rights. The company was formerly known as Pancar Kooperatifleri Bankasi A.S. and changed its name to Sekerbank T.A.S. in 1956. Sekerbank T.A.S. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Akfen Yenilenebilir Enerji
Description: Akfen Yenilenebilir Enerji engages in the production of renewable energy in Turkey. It operates a portfolio of wind and hybrid solar power plants with a total installed capacity of 423.9 megawatts; hydroelectric plants with a capacity of 228.7; and solar power plants with an installed capacity of 121.4 megawatts. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Akfen Yenilenebilir Enerji operates as a subsidiary of Akfen Holding Anonim Sirketi.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Botswana Insurance Holdings Limited
Description: Botswana Insurance Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries provides financial solutions in Botswana. It operates through two segments Life Business and Asset Management. The company underwrites various classes of long-term insurances; administers deposit administration schemes and life and pension funds; and manages investments. It also provides life and short-term insurance; and microlending services. In addition the company is involved in the unit trust corporate social responsibility hospitality industry and corporate finance businesses. The company was founded in 1975 and is based in Gaborone Botswana. Botswana Insurance Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Sanlam Allianz Africa (Pty) Ltd.

Name: IC Enterra Yenilenebilir Enerji A.S.
Description: IC Enterra Yenilenebilir Enerji A.S. engages in the renewable energy production activities in Turkey. It operates hydroelectric and solar power plants. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Ankara Turkey.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Ashot Ashkelon Industries Ltd.
Description: Ashot Ashkelon Industries Ltd. manufactures and sells systems and components for aerospace and defense in Israel and internationally. The company offers aerospace products such as engine shafts and rotating parts; high lift system components including universal joints transmissions and gearboxes lever bearing arms and long and short shafts for rotary actuation; landing gears components for turbo prop and business jet aircraft; electro and mechanical assemblies for aerospace applications; gearboxes transmissions and gear-based products; and tungsten products which are installed in various aircrafts to balance weights in the wing fuselage vertical and horizontal stabilizers helicopter rotors propellers and aerospace instruments. It also provides land products comprising automated transmission products used in heavy-duty vehicles; final drive products; suspension systems which include rotary and linear shock absorbers road arms suspension springs and arms tension mechanism and road wheels tracks; and upgrade packages. It serves defense aerospace agriculture mining marine oil and gas printing construction industrial and commercial markets. Ashot Ashkelon Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Ashkelon Israel.

Name: Pan Jamaica Group Limited
Description: Pan Jamaica Group Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells food and drink products in Jamaica. It operates through Property and Infrastructure; Financial Services; Global Services; and Specialty Foods segments. The company engages in the processing distribution and retail of food and drink; agricultural services; property investment development rental and management; hotel operations and management; and capital infrastructure development. It also provides financial management; logistics transportation and port operations; business processing outsourcing and tourist attractions; captive insurance; cold storage; contract labour; and security services. Pan Jamaica Group Limited was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Moura Dubeux Engenharia S.A.
Description: Moura Dubeux Engenharia S.A. provides real estate development services in Brazil. The company develops flats hotels resorts and residential buildings as well as offers technical construction management and advisory services to the condominiums. It also engages in the purchase and sale of properties; rental and split of land allotment; real estate construction of properties; and management and administration of own- or third-party real properties as well as offers engineering services. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Recife Brazil.

Name: Guardian Holdings Limited
Description: Guardian Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries underwrites insurance products in Trinidad and Tobago Jamaica Barbados Dutch Caribbean Martinique Grenada curacao the Netherlands Aruba Cayman Islands Bermuda Bahamas and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Life health and pension; Property and casualty; Insurance brokerage; and Asset management. It offers short-term and long-term life and health insurance for both individuals and groups. In addition it provides critical illness property motor employers’ liability public marine accident engineering bonding fire commercial and crime insurance as well as short-term and long-term reinsurances. Further it offers traditional life and interest-sensitive without guarantee annuities-based and unit-linked life and interest-sensitive with guarantees insurance products. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in St Georges Grenada. Guardian Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of NCB Global Holdings Limited.

Name: Bosch Fren Sistemleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Bosch Fren Sistemleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of hydraulic brake systems for automotive and light commercial vehicles in Turkey and internationally. It offers servo brakes and brake master cylinders and support systems. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Bursa Turkey. Bosch Fren Sistemleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH.

Name: Oba Makarnacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Oba Makarnacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells pasta in Turkey and internationally. The company offers children pasta mac and cheese flour noodles and semolina products under the OBA Makarna OBA Mie Pasta Savana Omelia Vera Obalino Eva Rosa Linda OBA Gold Pasta Layla Nido Intervallo and Champion brand names. Oba Makarnacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Gaziantep Turkey. Oba Makarnacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Alpinvest Yatÿrÿm Gÿda Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Şirketi.

Name: Absa Bank Botswana Limited
Description: Absa Bank Botswana Limited provides various financial services in Botswana. It operates through three segments Corporate and Investment Banking; Retail Business Banking and Other; and Islamic Banking. The company offers current savings and call accounts; and term fixed interest and non-interest bearing and cheque account deposits. It also provides personal home life term foreign currency scheme and business loans; vehicle mortgage and production loans; commercial asset finance and overdraft services; trade finance products including letters of credit document collections performance bonds and bank guarantees and bills of exchange; and credit cards. In addition the company offers personal insurance products such as home owners household contents funeral motor and retrenchment insurance products; business insurance products covering buildings contents stock in trade motor vehicles electronic equipment workers compensation and other insurance products; treasury services comprising foreign exchange currency repo risk management and investment services; investment banking financing risk management and advisory solutions; customer loyalty programs and services; and cash management and merchant services. Further it provides Internet and ATM banking mobile app and e-statement services. The company offers its services to corporates financial institutions and government clients; and medium small businesses and retail customers. It operates through multiple branches ATMs and point-of-sale devices. The company was formerly known as Barclays Bank of Botswana Limited and changed its name to Absa Bank Botswana Limited in February 2020. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana. Absa Bank Botswana Limited is a subsidiary of Absa Group Limited.

Name: Al Yamamah Steel Industries Company
Description: Al Yamamah Steel Industries Company manufactures and sells steel products to construction electrical and telecommunication sectors in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Construction Electricity and Renewable Energy Sector segments. The company offers hot rolled hallow steel sections cold rolled hallow steel sections and steel sheets; space frames; and distribution poles including octagonal conical and special products. It also manufactures tubes pipes and hollow shapes from iron; metal structures and their parts for bridges and towers; and poles and their parts such as lighting cabins and traffic lights as well as manufacture and installs of prefabricated steel structures for industrial facilities. In addition the company is involved in producing reinforcing steel bars; and wholesale and retail trading of reinforcing steel bars. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Sociedad Anónima Importadora y Exportadora de la Patagonia
Description: Sociedad Anónima Importadora y Exportadora de la Patagonia operates a chain of supermarket in Argentina. Its supermarkets offer food personal care and children other products. The company was founded in 1908 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Bank of Jerusalem Ltd.
Description: Bank of Jerusalem Ltd. provides commercial banking services in Israel. The company offers deposit products such as saving and checking accounts; structured deposit products; personal loans such as new and used car loans and loans secured by deposits; mortgage loans; and foreign currency loans. It also provides independent trading services on the capital markets and investment advisory services as well as interactive brokerage services; housing credit and other retail credit and finance for housing construction; manages current accounts; and private banking services to non-residents. The company was formerly known as Bank of Jerusalem for Development and Mortgages Ltd. and changed its name to Bank of Jerusalem Ltd. in 1996. Bank of Jerusalem Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Airport City Israel. Bank of Jerusalem Ltd. is a subsidiary of Export Investment Co. Ltd.

Name: Alandalus Property Company
Description: Alandalus Property Company a real estate company engages in investment development and operation of commercial real estate properties in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It constructs owns and manages commercial and residential centers and complexes. The company also involved in the general contracting services for residential and commercial buildings educational recreational and healthcare buildings as well as roads dams water and sewage projects and electrical and mechanical works. In addition it provides maintenance and operation of real estate properties buildings and commercial facilities. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Export Development Bank of Egypt (S.A.E.)
Description: Export Development Bank of Egypt (S.A.E.) provides various banking products and services in Egypt. The company offers current savings export and time deposit accounts as well as certificates of deposit. It also provides loans for auto used car petroleum sector pharmacists university professors and scientific research centers doctors bankers loan-to-card buy out and financial institution employees; corporate and syndicated loans; and mortgage finance trade finance and export promotion services as well as financing for small and medium enterprises. In addition the company offers treasury services such as foreign exchange daily market report and money market services; and funded and unfunded risk participation bilateral loans and funding arrangements payments facilitation tailored/structured solutions and other products. Further it provides payroll financial inclusion transaction banking bancassurance online banking e-wallet and ATM services as well as debit prepaid and credit cards. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in New Cairo Egypt.

Name: Diagnósticos da América S.A.
Description: Diagnósticos da América S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides diagnostic and hospital services in Brazil and Argentina. It operates through Hospitals and Oncology; Diagnostics and Care Coordination; and International Diagnostics segments. The company offers outpatient doctors; medical and outpatient services; diagnostic support assistants for private patients or partner companies; care coordination remote monitoring population health management home medical and paramedical services; and medical consultations. It is also involved in the development and licensing of computer programs and predictive models using information technology and data science; and brokerage activities. The company was formerly known as Laboratório Clínico Delboni Auriemo S.A. and changed its name to Diagnósticos da América S.A. in August 2000. Diagnósticos da América S.A. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Barueri Brazil.

Name: Albaraka Türk Katilim Bankasi A.S.
Description: Albaraka Türk Katilim Bankasi A.S. provides various banking products and services in Turkey. The company provides participation current trend and gold accounts. It also offers personal housing real estate vehicle consumer dealer and jet financing services; cards including debit trend credit and digital debit cards; insurance and pensions such as private pensions vehicle housing health life and personal accident; investment comprising capital market and treasury products; payments and other banking services. In addition the company provides SME commercial and corporate cash and non-cash leasing credit guarantee fund and dealer financing; foreign trade payments financings treasury products electronic transfer notice form other transactions; cash management such as collections and payments e-services and accounting; merchant member and POS including merchant member services applications products and solutions; investment which includes capital market products treasury products and electronic product certificate; insurance and pension for employees liabilities assets and farmers; and SME and chargeback cards. Further it offers digital banking mobile banking; open banking; and internet branch services as well as provides ATM banking and services. Albaraka Türk Katilim Bankasi A.S. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Ümraniye Turkey.

Name: National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P.
Description: National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. engages in the provision of various upstream oilfield services in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Oil field and Non-oil field services segments. The company offers upstream oil services that include cementing down hole tool completion directional drilling well logging services hydraulic fracturing coiled tubing and well stimulation services; environmental and sustainability services such as environmental and safety services; quality health safety and environmental services. It also provides drilling and maintenance of oil wells and chemical waste management; petrochemical activities; and support activities for petroleum & natural gas mining incidental to onshore and offshore oil & gas extraction. In addition the company offers support services for well drilling repairing and preparation for production well maintenance-related services; importing and owning machines tools and materials; owning lands and real estate necessary for establishing facilities and equipment; and importing and exporting chemicals. National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Al Ahmadi Kuwait. National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P.

Name: Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc
Description: Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc produces and sells refined sugar to consumers and industrial markets in Nigeria. The company offers vitamin A fortified sugar for direct consumption baked foods sweetening of cereals and beverages applications; and non-fortified industrial sugar used by pharmaceuticals food and beverage other manufacturing companies. It sells its products under the Dangote Sugar brands. The company also exports its products. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc is a subsidiary of Dangote Industries Limited.

Name: Generation Capital Ltd
Description: Generation Capital Ltd is an infrastructure investment firm specializing in infrastructure and energy sector. The firm was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Herzliya Israel.

Name: Wisynco Group Limited
Description: Wisynco Group Limited engages in the bottling and distribution of water and beverages in Jamaica and internationally. The company offers bottled drinking water under the WATA brand; cranberry juice under the CranWATA brand; soft drinks under the BIGGA brand; and energy drinks under the BOOM brand. It also distributes and retails food products; and provides insurance services. In addition it imports grocery products under the General Mills Nestle and Kellogg’s brands; and distributes beverages juices and soft drinks under the Coca-Cola Tru-Juice Freshhh Juice Drinks Squeezz Drinks Wakefield Juices Calico Jack Rum Punch Fanta Sprite Schweppes Minute Maid and AdeS brands. Further it distributes green tea under the Ayataka brand; coffee and tea under the Costa Georgia Gold Peak and Honest Tea brands; water under the Dasani and smartwater brands; juices and nectars under the Del Valle and Simply brands; sports drinks under the Powerade brand; smoothies and juices; vitaminwater; and coconut water under the ZICO brand. Wisynco Group Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Spanish Town Jamaica. The company operates as a subsidiary of Wisynco Group (Caribbean) Limited.

Name: Alpha Data PJSC
Description: Alpha Data PJSC offers system integration services. The company provides IT infrastructure solutions including servers storage network infrastructure audio-visual infrastructure physical security infrastructure and backup and disaster recovery infrastructure. It offers tailored solutions by integrating advanced technologies such as cybersecurity cloud mobility AI big data digital transformation and software automation technology. In addition the company provides AWS services Microsoft solutions artificial intelligence mobility big data IoT cloud infrastructure end user software and ELV services. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi United Arab Emirates.

Name: PPC Ltd
Description: PPC Ltd together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of cement aggregates ready mix concrete and fly ash in South Africa Botswana and Zimbabwe. It also provides premixes stone sand road layer materials and special aggregate-related products. The company was formerly known as Pretoria Portland Cement Company Limited and changed its name to PPC Ltd in October 2012. PPC Ltd was incorporated in 1892 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Wema Bank PLC
Description: Wema Bank PLC provides banking and other financial services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria. The company offers current and saving accounts HNIs and term deposits; card services such as debit credit secure and prepaid cards; consumer and personal loans and revolving overdrafts; and collection services. It provides corporate banking services including overdraft term loan import and trade finance and financial lease facilities; and agricultural finance as well as export power oil and gas maritime and concessionary finance services. In addition the company offers small and medium scale enterprise financial advisory services; retail management and integrated revenue services; and cards and electronic and internet banking services. The company was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Brait PLC
Description: Brait PLC an investment holding company invests in privately owned business. Its primary investment portfolio includes Virgin Active Premier and New Look brands. The company invest in health clubs under Virgin Active brand in South Africa the United Kingdom Italy Australia Namibia Botswana Thailand and Singapore; Premier which manufactures baking and milling sugar confectionary and home and personal care products as well as wheat flour maize meal pasta biscuits animal feed and rice products in South Africa Eswatini Mozambique and Lesotho; and New Look an online fashion retailer that offers clothing and footwear in the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland. Brait PLC was founded in 2011 and is based in Moka Mauritius.

Name: Galatasaray Sportif Sinai ve Ticari Yatirimlar A.S.
Description: Galatasaray Sportif Sinai ve Ticari Yatirimlar A.S. engages in the commercial industrial and investment activities for various sports. The company also invests in and develops real estate properties. In addition it engages in the sale and merchandising of products with the GS logo; and communication activities. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Galatasaray Sportif Sinai ve Ticari Yatirimlar A.S. is a subsidiary of Galatasaray Spor Kulubu Derbegi.

Name: Sembcorp Salalah Power & Water Company SAOG
Description: Sembcorp Salalah Power & Water Company SAOG develops owns and operates an electricity generation and seawater desalination plant in the Salalah region. The company operates Salalah independent water and power plant that comprises 5 gas turbines and 2 steam turbines with a contracted power capacity of 445 megawatts as well as contracted water production capacity of 15 million imperial gallons per day. It also supplies power and water to the Oman Power and Water Procurement Company. Sembcorp Salalah Power & Water Company SAOG was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Salalah Oman.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Castro Model Ltd.
Description: Castro Model Ltd. engages in the retail sale of fashion products home fashion fashion accessories and cosmetics and care products in Israel. The company’s products portfolio includes knits and putters jeans jackets and coats shirts shoes dresses skirts swimwear accessories and bags underwear and socks cases and garden suits sunglasses and vision uniforms pants and tights and bodysuits. It provides storage and organization reusable picnic utensils textile serving/ hosting and holiday table products as well as cups plates and baking molds; pillows blankets and bedding sets; carpets and rugs fragrance and decoration products; bath rugs towels and bath accessories; and gift boxes. The company provides its products for women men boys girls and babies. Castro Model Ltd. was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Bat Yam Israel.

Name: Banco Hipotecario S.A.
Description: Banco Hipotecario S.A. provides wholesale and retail banking services in Argentina. The company offers savings current and investor accounts; mortgage loans; personal loans comprising destination short term and salary plan loans; home life personal accident ATM theft movable goods pets sustainable mobility senior health protected purchase and comprehensive health insurance products. It also provides investment products such as fixed term deposits mutual funds titles and shares mortgage certificates safe deposit box and market data solutions as well as corporate financial advisory and office banking services. In addition the company offers treasury management financing accounts and payment and collection solutions to corporates institutions and small and medium enterprises. Banco Hipotecario S.A. was founded in 1886 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Vinte Viviendas Integrales S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Vinte Viviendas Integrales S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the land acquisition design promotion construction urbanization and commercialization of housing projects for families in Mexico. Vinte Viviendas Integrales S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Amos Luzon Development and Energy Group Ltd
Description: Amos Luzon Development and Energy Group Ltd together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate development and construction business in Israel and internationally. It also involved in the energy infrastructure business. The company was formerly known as U. Dori Group Ltd and changed its name to Amos Luzon Development and Energy Group Ltd in May 2016. Amos Luzon Development and Energy Group Ltd was founded in 1961 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Bin Ulasim ve Akilli Sehir Teknolojileri A.S.
Description: Bin Ulasim ve Akilli Sehir Teknolojileri A.S. provides software solutions for micro-mobility transportation field in Turkey. It also designs and manufactures IoT device for vehicles; and purchases sells rents and operates electric non-electric bicycle motorcycle scooter etc. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Ümraniye Turkey. Bin Ulasim ve Akilli Sehir Teknolojileri A.S. operates as a subsidiary of 1000 Yatirimlar Holding Anonim Sirketi.

Name: Cohen Development Gas & Oil Ltd.
Description: Cohen Development Gas & Oil Ltd. engages in the exploration for development production and marketing of natural gas condensate and oil in Israel Cyprus and Morocco. The company was incorporated in 1958 and is based in Bnei Brak Israel.

Name: Kontrolmatik Teknoloji Enerji Ve Muhendislik Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kontrolmatik Teknoloji Enerji Ve Muhendislik Anonim Sirketi offers consulting feasibility studies project management engineering design construction management and procurement services in Turkey and internationally. The company also provides advanced process control computerized plant information systems software projects and support plant start-up and commissioning IoT and data analytics products and services. It serves oil and gas power generation power distribution and transmission process industry transportation mining agriculture and food and beverage sectors. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Companhia Energética do Ceará - COELCE
Description: Companhia Energética do Ceará – COELCE distributes electricity in Brazil. It operates in 184 municipalities in the state of Ceará in Brazil. Companhia Energética do Ceará is headquartered in Fortaleza Brazil. Companhia Energética do Ceará - COELCE is a subsidiary of Enel Brazil S.A.

Name: Inverfal Perú S.A.A.
Description: Inverfal Perú S.A.A. engages in investing in fixed or variable income securities. The company operates through Retail Financial and Real Estate and Other Services segments. It is involved in the marketing of hardware construction home and interior decoration accessories as well as engaged in hypermarket and supermarket activities; and real estate activities. In addition the company acts as an insurance broker; and provision of computer; and call attention services. Inverfal Perú S.A.A. was incorporated in 2019 and is based in San Isidro Peru. The company operates as a subsidiary of Falabella S.A.

Name: MIA Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi
Description: MIA Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi provides software development services to public and private organizations in Turkey. The company offers Pizzy an integrated facility management software; BIO-ID a biometric data management software; MIA-SOFT a multimodal biometric authentication and identification software; MBIS a multi biometric identification system; Surveillance an environmental surveillance and face recognition system; MIA-MED a hospital information management system software; traffic monitoring software; and ID-100B a multi biometric identification unit. It also provides identification and authentication environmental surveillance intelligent traffic inspection shared mobility renewable energy information technologies facility security and management city security health informatics technologies e-vehicle charging network cyber security critical facility security and management defense and immersive technologies sustainable and zero carbon and sustainable agriculture and food safety solutions. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Banco de Venezuela S.A. Banco Universal
Description: Banco de Venezuela S.A. Banco Universal provides personal business and private banking products and services in Venezuela. It offers currency digital key global and paid global accounts; financing services; credit and debit cards; payment and collection services; foreign exchange services; and mobile banking services. The company was incorporated in 1890 and is based in Caracas Venezuela. Banco de Venezuela S.A. Banco Universal operates as a subsidiary of Banco de Desarrollo Económico y Social de Venezuela.

Name: Ecobank Ghana PLC
Description: Ecobank Ghana PLC provides retail banking corporate and investment banking and other financial services in Ghana and internationally. The company operates through Consumer Banking Commercial Banking Corporate Banking and Treasury segments. It offers current savings and electronic accounts; personal auto and asset acquisition mortgage travel and cash backed loans as well as salary advance facility; microfinance products and services; term deposits; investor and securities services; and investment banking services. The company also provides funding for small and medium sized businesses and MidCaps; trade hub services; trade services and finance solutions; supply chain transaction banking cash and liquid management client channel access and integration rapid collect Omni Plus and asset and wealth management services; transfer and payment services; bancassurance products; fixed income currencies and commodities; business overdraft and revolving credit plan debtor finance distributor finance scheme and vehicle and asset finance services; e-commerce solutions; debit credit prepaid VISA Mastercard and PAC cards; and cashless payment ATM and internet and mobile banking services. It serves individuals small and medium-sized enterprises medium local corporates non-government public sector public sector multinational institutions financial institutions and international organizations. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Accra Ghana. Ecobank Ghana PLC is a subsidiary of Ecobank Transnational Incorporated.

Name: Seprod Limited
Description: Seprod Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and distributes food products in Jamaica. The company offers sports drinks condensed milk sardines tuna salmon and other seafood carbonated soft drink biscuits and snacks spreads carbonated beverage for kids real fruit flavour drinks pure juice with no additives or added sugar flour sauces jams seasoning oil various beans cheese mayonnaise creamer and dressings. It also offers canned foods milk punches nuts breakfast cereals cornmeal instant porridge mix crackers nutritional supplements liquid meal supplement powdered beverages energy drinks. The company offers its products under Altitude Betty Brunswick Busta Butterkist Chiffon Chubby Cool Fruit Delite Eve Gold Seal Goya Kraft Miracle Planters Post Pronto Ritz Serge Seven Seas Supligen Supligen Max Swizzzle Tang Turbo and Uncle Sam's brand names. In addition it engages in agriculture; manufacture and sale of oils and fats consumer pharmaceutical biscuit milk products juices corn and wheat; investments; investments in real estate; property development; dairy farming; and logistics activities. Further it exports its products to various countries. Seprod Limited was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Ipek Dogal Enerji Kaynaklari Arastirma ve Üretim A.S.
Description: Ipek Dogal Enerji Kaynaklari Arastirma ve Üretim A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the research development and production of oil natural gas and energy and energy resources in Turkey. It is involved in the construction; air transportation; tourism and hotel management; and food and livestock businesses. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Ipek Dogal Enerji Kaynaklari Arastirma ve Üretim A.S. is a subsidiary of Koza İpek Holding A.Ş.

Name: Rotshtein Realestate Ltd
Description: Rotshtein Realestate Ltd develops and executes residential projects in Israel. It undertakes large-scale residential projects and complex engineering jobs as well as government projects and public works projects. The company was formerly known as D. Rothstein Company and changed its name to Rotshtein Realestate Ltd in February 2013. Rotshtein Realestate Ltd was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel. Rotshtein Realestate Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Avnei Shoham Development Ltd.

Name: Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter société anonyme
Description: Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter société anonyme engages in the mining of silver deposits in Morocco. It holds interest in the Imiter mine covering an area of 375 ha located to the east of Ouarzazate in Morocco. The company was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter société anonyme operates as a subsidiary of Managem S.A.

Name: Holcim (Argentina) S.A.
Description: Holcim (Argentina) S.A. operates in the construction material industry in Argentina. It engages in the production of cement concrete stone aggregates liquid paints and membranes. The company also offers adhesives plasters additives repairers limes and hydraulic binders. It sells its products under the Dissents Geocycle Tector and Quimexur brand names. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Córdoba Argentina. Holcim (Argentina) S.A. is a subsidiary of Holcim Investments (Spain) SL.

Name: RP Optical Lab Ltd
Description: RP Optical Lab Ltd. engages in the development production and marketing of optical and electro-optical products in Israel. The company offers short mid and long waved infrared lenses special lenses video engine for cooled thermal imaging systems thermal imaging cameras multi-sensor systems. It serves to defense homeland security medical and commercial markets. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Curro Holdings Limited
Description: Curro Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries acquires develops and manages independent schools primarily in South Africa Namibia and Botswana. The company operates in Curro and Meridian segments. It offers independent education and ancillary services including Select schools Curro Academy Schools Curro Preschools Curro Assisted Learning Curro DigiEd Curro Private College and Curro Online for learners from the age of three months to Grade 12. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Bellville South Africa.

Name: Tegma Gestão Logística S.A.
Description: Tegma Gestão Logística S.A. provides logistics management transportation and storage services in Brazil. The company operates in two divisions Automotive Logistics and Integrated Logistics. The Automotive Logistics division engages in the transfer and distribution of new and used vehicles port transfers inventory and yard management vehicle assembly and vehicle preparation services. The Integrated Logistics division provides road transport general and bonded storage logistics management returnable packaging management inventory management operations parts and components management stock management vehicle preparation services tropicalization accessorization and reverse logistics. It serves chemicals home appliances consumer goods automotive and petrochemicals sectors. Tegma Gestão Logística S.A. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in São Bernardo do Campo Brazil.

Name: Oula Fuel Marketing Company - KSCP
Description: Oula Fuel Marketing Company - KSCP together with its subsidiaries engages in the acquisition establishment leasing operating and maintenance of petrol stations in Kuwait. It operates through two segments Fuel Marketing and Other Related Services; and Investments. The company also offers automobile services including oil change car wash maintenance workshop services and technical check-ups; prepaid fuel cards and related electronic services; various account cards for individual and corporate customers; and oulaE Tag a smart system for fuel payment and other services in the oula station. In addition it provides logistics marketing and consultancy services. Further the company is involved in the purchase renting owning and selling of lease lands and real estate; trade in petroleum products in bulk or retail; operation of central markets; and investment in financial and real estate portfolios. Oula Fuel Marketing Company - KSCP was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Afcon Holdings Ltd
Description: Afcon Holdings Ltd develops and executes construction projects in Israel and internationally. It provides electric charging solutions; generates electricity from wind energies; delivers hybrid systems and technological solutions for dealing with water and wastewater; and markets sells installs and maintains green technologies. The company conducts projects in the field of end-to-end communication solutions and security systems as well as in energy storage and renewable energies; multimedia and low-voltage installation; and develops and delivers communication services infrastructure and telecom solutions. In addition it plans and installs fire detection and extinguishing systems; provides technological solutions and products for very low voltage control and automation; conducts integrative security-related projects; technology-enhanced projects for electromechanical systems; and develops produces and installs peripheral electronic security and protection systems using advanced technologies. Further the company set up and maintain parking system projects; develops solutions in monitoring and control systems; radars for securing open-space facilities; deals with construction and civil engineering and electro-mechanical systems; provides electricity air conditioning plumbing cooling and low voltage electricity services; and manufactures electric boards for high voltage gas-insulated switchgears (GIS) and air-insulated switchgears (AIS) and for low voltage. Additionally it markets and distributes switching control communications and electrical installation as well as communication products; provides consultancy services and technical solutions; air conditioning and ventilation systems services; and develops and executes concession projects. The company was formerly known as Afcon Industries Group. The company was founded in 1945 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel. Afcon Holdings Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Shlomo Group.

Name: RAGHSA Sociedad Anonima
Description: RAGHSA Sociedad Anonima engages in the real estate development business. It is involved in the construction leasing and sale of properties for offices and/or homes; and financing of properties. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Marshall Boya Ve Vernik Sanayii A.S.
Description: Marshall Boya Ve Vernik Sanayii A.S. manufactures and sells paint coating and varnish products in Turkey. The company offers interior wall and exterior paint. Marshall Boya Ve Vernik Sanayii A.S. was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Dilovasi Turkey.

Name: Çan2 Termik A.S.
Description: Çan2 Termik A.S. engages in the generation and sell of electricity in Turkey. It operates thermal power plant with an installed capacity of 340 MWm/330 Mwe. The company is involved in renting of coal-based electrical energy production facilities. It also engages in the mining business. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Çan2 Termik A.S. is a subsidiary of Odas Elektrik Üretim Sanayi Ticaret A.S.

Name: Banco BMG S.A.
Description: Banco BMG S.A. provides commercial and credit financing and investment products and services primarily in Brazil. It operates in Retail Banking and Wholesale Banking segments. The company offers digital accounts; digital account credit card and consigned credit card; payroll and personal loan; insurance products including lender life family life and FGTS Protected insurance as well as Bmg Med and Bmg Consortium services. It also provides investment products such as bank deposit certificates agribusiness letter of credit and letters of real estate credit. In addition the company offers commercial banking; debentures; trade finance; and working capital; and derivatives such as non-deliverable forward SWAP options. The company was formerly known as BMG Financeira S.A.–Crédito Financiamento e Investimento and changed its name to Banco BMG S.A. in April 1989. Banco BMG S.A. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Telefónica Chile S.A.
Description: Telefónica Chile S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates as a telecommunication company in Chile. The company operates through Fixed Telephony Communications and Company Data Television Services and Others segments. It offers basic telephone services line connections and installations services dedicated lines international long-distance services marketing terminal equipment rental of circuit media of terminal equipment rental of means of circuits and others. The company also engages in the provision of business communication services; data transmission services; the sale and rental of communication equipment; telecommunications; and the sale and lease of networks. In addition it provides multimedia services such as the development installation maintenance marketing and operation of satellite television services; broadband; channel paid services; video on demand; and interactive or multimedia television services. Further the company offers logistics personnel and administration services. Additionally it provides broadcast live and play services as well as other related services in the fields of connectivity cloud security big data IoT and digital workplace. The company was formerly known as Compañía de Telecomunicaciones de Chile S.A. and changed its name to Telefónica Chile S.A. in April 2009. Telefónica Chile S.A. was founded in 1880 and is based in Santiago de Chile Chile. Telefónica Chile S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Telefonica Moviles Chile S.A.

Name: Egyptian Chemical Industries
Description: Egyptian Chemical Industries produces and sells nitrogenous fertilizers and chemical materials in Egypt. Its products include high density ammonium nitrate urea fertilizers liquid ammonia pporous prilled ammonium nitrate ferro silicon ammonium nitrate novo kima fort and liquid ammonium nitrate fertilizers. The company also provides nitrogen gas liquid and aqua ammonia nitric acid and hydrochloric acid for industrial purposes as well as oxygen gas for medical and industrial purposes; and silica fume that is used in concrete. The company was founded in 1956 and is based in Aswan Egypt. Egyptian Chemical Industries is a subsidiary of Chemical Industries Holding Company S.A.E.

Name: Délice Holding SA
Description: Délice Holding SA provides dairy products in Tunisia. The company produces and sells carbonated drinks and juice beverages; dairy products such as milk flavored milk milkshake fermented milk fresh cream butter and yoghurt; and melted triangle squared grated and fresh cheese products as well as packaged drinking water. It offers its products under the Délice Danone and other brands. The company also exports its products. Délice Holding SA was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Luzon Ronson N.V.
Description: Luzon Ronson N.V. engages in the real estate development and construction business in Israel and internationally. The company is based in Ra'anana Israel. Luzon Ronson N.V. is a subsidiary of Amos Luzon Development and Energy Group Ltd.

Name: Tanzania Cigarette Public Limited Company
Description: Tanzania Cigarette Public Limited Company manufactures distributes markets and sells cigarettes in the United Republic of Tanzania. The company offers its products under Embassy Crescent & Star Portsman Sweet Menthol Safari Club Camel and Winston Aspen Monte Carlo and LD brand names. It also exports its products to the Democratic Republic of Congo Southern Africa and Namibia and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Dar es Salaam the United Republic of Tanzania. Tanzania Cigarette Public Limited Company operates as a subsidiary of JT International Holding B.V.

Name: Diplomat Holdings Ltd
Description: Diplomat Holdings Ltd. operates as a sales and distribution company in the fast-moving consumer goods sector. The company offers logistics services including warehousing packaging and transportation; and third part logistics services. It also provides detergents knives shaving diapers cleaning personal grooming hygiene and health personal care laundry general house cleaning paper sweet food food and other food products as well as sweets and snacks canned food products and coffee; and electricity and batteries. The company serves food retail chains pharmacy chains minimarkets grocery stores containers wholesalers restaurants catering customers etc. It operates in Israel South Africa Georgia New Zealand and Cyprus. Diplomat Holdings Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Airport City Israel.

Name: Bank of Palestine Plc
Description: Bank of Palestine Plc provides banking and financial services in the Palestinian Authority. It operates through three segments: Retails; Corporate Institutions and Public Sector; and Treasury segments. The company offers current primary and saving account such as Baraem savings account; Labors program services; loan products including commercial mortgage loan programs personal personal housing student fishermen green and mortgage loans; overdrafts and microenterprise financing as well as loans for financing people with disabilities. It also provides card products and online banking services. In addition the company offers current accounts for corporate institutional customers and public sector; and trading and treasury services managing bank’s funds and investments. Bank of Palestine Plc was founded in 1960 and is based in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Integrated Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Integrated Holding Company K.S.C.P. operates a logistics company in Kuwait and internationally. The company offers equipment leasing and hiring services; heavy lifting services including specialized lifting and engineering and rigging services; heavy transport haulage services such as various trucks trailers and equipment; and alternative lift services comprising gantry system and jacking and skidding services. It also provides earth moving services including demolition and construction activities; industrial equipment services comprising air compressors welding machines tower lights man lifts and tele handlers; and rig move services such as drilling rig and super rig move work over casing and heavy haulage. In addition the company offers energy services for temporary project location including generators transformers fuel tanks load banks synchronizers and totals panels; shutdown management services; and tower cranes for residential and commercial civil construction high-rise building infrastructure bridges and flyovers and other construction projects. Further it provides port operations services such as handling of aggregates pet coke clinker gypsum rocks coal steel scrap direct reduced iron hot briquetted iron general cargo and jumbo bags; other services that include hopper system weigh bridge operation and port information management services; and general trading and contracting services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Nitratos de Chile S.A.
Description: Nitratos de Chile S.A. through its subsidiary Potasios de Chile S.A. invests in shares of Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile S.A. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Santiago Chile. Nitratos de Chile S.A. is a subsidiary of Norte Grande S.A.

Name: Cem Zeytin Anonim Sirketi
Description: Cem Zeytin Anonim Sirketi produces and sells olives in Turkey. The company offers pickled green and black olives; and engages in storage processing and packaging of olives. It offers its products under Cem Zeytin and Cem brands. Cem Zeytin Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Wilson Bayly Holmes-Ovcon Limited
Description: Wilson Bayly Holmes-Ovcon Limited operates as a construction company in South Africa rest of Africa and the United Kingdom. It undertakes construction of buildings including retail commercial offices residential healthcare hotels and entertainment warehousing and industrial and data centres; civil engineering and infrastructure for mining industrial and water and energy infrastructure; and roads and earthworks such as road and bridges bulk earthworks dams oil and gas and rail and pipeline infrastructure projects. The company also undertakes construction of airports toll roads renewable energy and serviced accommodation; and manufactures supplies and installs long-steel products. Wilson Bayly Holmes-Ovcon Limited was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Commercial Facilities Company S.A.K.P.
Description: Commercial Facilities Company S.A.K.P. together with its subsidiaries provides installment credit facilities to finance consumer products in Kuwait. The company offers cash auto housing educational marine furniture electrical commercial education and personal loans; guarantees; and short- medium- and long-term loans for the purchase of equipment home appliances land and properties. It also invests in real estate industrial agricultural and other economic sectors; and manages loans syndicated loans and investment portfolios. In addition the company is involved in the purchase and sale of financial securities such as shares and bonds; real estate activities; provision of collection services; and buying and selling of cars. Commercial Facilities Company S.A.K.P. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Beyout Holding Company (K.P.S.C)
Description: Beyout Holding Company (K.P.S.C) through its subsidiaries provides human resources and project lifecycle support services. It operates through Real Estate and Services segments. The company offers human capital and life support services such as HR and life support solutions; facilities management; engineering services; and KRH Academy a platform for training and professional growth. It also provides real estate services comprising real estate consulting property management solutions and development and project execution services as well as conducts feasibility studies and market research and analysis. In addition the company provides property leasing general trading housing entertainment human resources management logistic and support travel and tourism and contracting services. Beyout Holding Company (K.P.S.C) was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Hightech Payment Systems S.A.
Description: Hightech Payment Systems S.A. provides electronic payments and solutions in Morocco Europe the United States Africa Asia and the Middle East. The company is involved in the field of electronic banking software publishing consulting training auditing and electronic payment processing for third parties. It offers PowerCARD platform that covers the payment value chain and offers a range of solutions such as card issuing credit management merchant acquiring fraud monitoring retail payment payment analytics mobile payment and ATM and POS management. It also provides processing services for payment and switching activities; and testing services. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Axtel S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Axtel S.A.B. de C.V. an information and communications technology (ICT) company provides ICT solutions to companies corporations financial institutions and government entities in Mexico. It offers local and international long-distance calls to landlines and mobile phones; international traffics; voice over IP services; private lines accesses and dedicated internet; VPN and ethernet services; system integration and managed services; and digital transformation services including cloud cybersecurity managed application and collaboration services. The company also provides connectivity services such as last mile access long distance transport IP transit fiber spectrum and colocation services to fixed and mobile data center and tower operators. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in San Nicolás de los Garza Mexico. Axtel S.A.B. de C.V. is a subsidiary of Controladora Axtel S.A.B. de C.V.

Name: Hagag Group Real Estate Entrepreneurship Ltd
Description: Hagag Group Real Estate Entrepreneurship Ltd engages in the development management and marketing of real estate projects in Israel. It develops residential towers luxurious office towers and buildings private houses and apartments and commercial buildings as well as undertakes urban renewal projects. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: GraceKennedy Limited
Description: GraceKennedy Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in food trading and financial services businesses in Jamaica the United Kingdom the United States Canada rest of Caribbean countries other European countries Africa and internationally. It operates through four segments: Food Banking and Investments Insurance and Money Services. The Food segment engages in the merchandising of general goods and food products; processing and distribution of food products; and operation of a chain of supermarkets. The Banking and Investments segment provides commercial banking stock brokerage corporate finance advisory and lease financing services. The Insurance segment offers general health group and creditors life insurance products as well as insurance brokerage services. The Money Services segment provides money transfer and bill payment services as well as is involved in the cambio operations. The company engages in the data analytics media rights holding property rental and investment management activities. GraceKennedy Limited was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: GCB Bank Plc
Description: GCB Bank Plc engages in the retail and corporate banking consumer and commercial banking and treasury activities in Ghana. The company offers current savings salary student deposit call and foreign currency and exchange accounts; personal employee scheme and short- and medium-term loans; and overdrafts. It also provides bulk cash collection and payroll solutions; import and export finance; letters of credit; bills for collection; money transfer and remittance; business development and advisory services; insurance; bonds and guarantees; and electronic mobile and Internet banking services as well as bancassurance services. In addition the company offers debit cards; fee collection advance payment and investment banking services; and capital raising financial advisory and alternative/long-term assets services. Further it provides swift and telegraphic transfer travellers cheques finware networking cash management small business finance scheme money market foreign drafts trade and documentary collection services. GCB Bank Plc was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Accra Ghana.

Name: Al Kout Industrial Projects Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Al Kout Industrial Projects Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of chlor alkali products in Kuwait other in the Middle East and North Africa Asia South America North America and internationally. It operates through Chlor Alkali Petrochemical Products Trading Logistics and Transport Industrial Projects and Investments segments. The company offers caustic soda chlorine ferric chloride sodium hypochlorite purified food grade salt hydrochloric acid and hydrogen. It also provides logistic and transportation services; construction of chlorine dioxide plant for groundwater reservoirs; distribution of industrial materials; production and sale of petrochemical products; and investment activities. In addition the company is involved in the import storage and distribution of cement and other bulk materials; establishing operating and managing storage silos; and production of steel drums and other petrochemical products. It serves potable and waste water treatment plant power plant oil refinery petrochemical oil drilling industrial food and pharmaceutical industries. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Al Kout Industrial Projects Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Boubyan Petrochemical Company K.S.C.P.

Name: Kuwait Investment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait Investment Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries provides various investment and financial products and services in Kuwait Other GCC countries Other Middle East and North Africa Europe the United States and Asia. It operates through four segments: Asset Management Direct Investments and Corporate Finance Treasury and Other Operations. The company offers portfolio management services which include customized portfolio management; access to IPOs; and local regional and international fund management services.
