National Building and Marketing Co. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Even Construtora e Incorporadora S.A.
Description: Even Construtora e Incorporadora S.A. operates as a real estate developer and builder in Brazil. The company develops and sells residential and commercial projects under the Open and Even brands. It is also involved in land prospecting; real estate development and sale; broker portal operation; and project construction activities. The company was founded in 1974 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Marketing Home Group Company for Trading Company
Description: Marketing Home Group Company for Trading Company operates as a trading company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates the People’s Republic of China Kingdom of Spain and Arab Republic of Egypt. It engages in the construction of prefabricated buildings on-site; renovation of residential and non-residential buildings; wholesale of agarwood incense perfumes bricks blocks tiles stone marble ceramics porcelain sanitary ware and their extensions water heaters and tanks; retail sale of sanitary ware and extensions such as sinks chairs bathtubs sauna equipment electrical appliances and extensions marble natural and artificial stone ceramics porcelain chandeliers lighting goods and accessories; operation of storage facilities for all types of goods; marble cutting and sawing; manufacture of marble products such as kitchens sinks antiques basins statues sculptures and paintings; and manufacture of air conditioning ducts and duct accessories. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Heliopolis Co. for Housing & Development
Description: Heliopolis Co. for Housing & Development engages in the real estate development business in Egypt. The company develops residential and commercial properties. Heliopolis Co. for Housing & Development was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Heliopolis Egypt. Heliopolis Co. for Housing & Development is a subsidiary of Holding Company for Construction and Development.

Name: Hiper Global Ltd.
Description: Hiper Global Ltd. provides computing solutions to OEM customers. It offers network appliances embedded systems industrial servers embedded boards rack cabinets and storage systems. Hiper Global Ltd. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Rosh HaAyin Israel.

Name: Planigrupo LATAM S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Planigrupo LATAM S.A.B. de C.V. designs builds operates manages and leases shopping centers in Mexico. The company was founded in 1975 and is based in Mexico City Mexico. Planigrupo LATAM S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a subsidiary of Grupo México UPAS.

Name: Wataniya Palestine Mobile Telecommunication - Public Shareholding Company
Description: Wataniya Palestine Mobile Telecommunication - Public Shareholding Company offers manages and sells wireless telecommunication services for business and personal needs in Palestine. It provides 3G mobile services; and installs and operates communications stations and telephone networks. The company offers its products and services through a network of distributors agents and points of sale. Wataniya Palestine Mobile Telecommunication Public Shareholding Company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestine.

Name: Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries Company
Description: Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries Company manufactures and sells pharmaceutical ampoules in Egypt and internationally. The company offers analgesics and antipyretic; analgesics and anti-inflammatory; anti-infective; antihistamine; cardiovascular and metabolic; corticosteroids; gastrointestinal tract; nervous system; ophthalmic; respiratory; topical ointment and cream; vitamins; and miscellaneous products. It also exports its products. Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries Company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in 10th of Ramadan City Egypt.

Name: Clínica Las Condes S.A.
Description: Clínica Las Condes S.A. operates hospital centers in Chile. It provides services in the areas of anesthesia and pain adult bronchopulmonary cardiology adult surgery cardiovascular and endovascular surgery pediatric surgery plastic and reconstructive surgery dermatology gastroenterology gynecology and obstetrics maxillofacial physical medicine and rehabilitation internal medicine neurosurgery neurology adults child neurology nutrition dentistry ophthalmology otorhinolaryngology pediatrics adult psychiatry child and adolescent psychiatry traumatology CLC urgency urology. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Las Condes Chile. Clínica Las Condes S.A. is a subsidiary of Lucec Tres S.A.

Name: Solaer Renewable Energies Ltd
Description: Solaer Renewable Energies Ltd engages in the photovoltaic business in Israel Spain Italy Poland and Chile. It operates solar farms and wind turbines; storage and water desalination facilities; and provides rooftop systems and energy management and storage services. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Rehovot Israel.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Canada Global (T.R) Ltd
Description: Canada Global (T.R) Ltd engages in the development construction improvement leasing management and sale of real estate properties in the United States Serbia England and Germany. Its properties portfolio includes residential apartments and residential and commercial units. The company was formerly known as Aviv Arlon Ltd. and changed its name to Canada Global (T.R) Ltd in March 2023. Canada Global (T.R) Ltd was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Herzliya Israel.

Name: Real-Estate Trade Centers Company K.P.S.C
Description: Real-Estate Trade Centers Company K.P.S.C operates in the real estate business in Kuwait and Syrian Arab Republic. The company buys owns and sells real estate properties and lands; manages leases and markets third-party properties; owns and manages resorts hotels health and sports clubs private hospitals and tourist premises; and buys sells leases and rents land and buildings. It also conducts real estate studies and provides various kinds of related consultations; owns sells and purchases securities and debentures; constructs private and public buildings and projects; offers buildings and real estate maintenance works; organizes real estate exhibitions and auctions; and owns and manages commercial markets and residential complexes. In addition the company develops and manages real estate lands. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Promotora Ambiental S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Promotora Ambiental S.A.B. de C.V. provides environmental services in Mexico and Latin America. It offers waste management services including collection handling and final disposal of waste from industrial commercial and municipal levels. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Monterrey Mexico.

Name: Cairo Poultry Company S.A.E.
Description: Cairo Poultry Company S.A.E. operates as an integrated poultry company in Egypt. It operates through Food Poultry and Other segments. The company produces breeds and fattens chicks. It also involved in production of animal feed and fertilized eggs. In addition the company operates feed plants and poultry slaughterhouse. Further the company offers grandparents parents hatcheries broilers and processing poultry products. It sells its products primarily under the Koki and Koki Gold names. The company serves restaurants and five-star hotels as well as other users of feed live chicken chicken meat and other value-added chicken products. It also exports its products. Cairo Poultry Company S.A.E. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Mirgor Sociedad Anónima Comercial Industrial Financiera Inmobiliaria y Agropecuaria
Description: Mirgor Sociedad Anónima Comercial Industrial Financiera Inmobiliaria y Agropecuaria manufactures and sells air conditioning equipment for automotive and agricultural businesses. The company operates through Automotive Consumer Electronics and Telephony Retail Services Agricultural Steel Marketing and Other segments. It offers air conditioning equipment and car radios; televisions and cell phones; and other electronic products. The company is also involved in the metallurgy business; markets cereals and oilseeds to export destinations; production of agriculture breeding and farming activities; manufactures and markets steel; retails cellphone television and other electronic products; and provision of storage tire repair logistics technical service for repairing telephones and other services. It operates in the Argentine Republic the Eastern Republic of Uruguay the Republic of Chile Republic of Paraguay the Dominican Republic the Republic of Honduras the Republic of Colombia the Republic of Panama the Republic of Ecuador the Plurinational State of Bolivia and the United States of America. Mirgor Sociedad Anónima Comercial Industrial Financiera Inmobiliaria y Agropecuaria was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Mutandis SCA
Description: Mutandis SCA engages in the provision of various consumer goods in Morocco and Africa. It provides seafood and fruit juice products; detergents including powdered detergent multi-use detergent paste bleach surface cleaning liquids and dishwasher soap; and PET bottles and plastic bottle-caps for carbonated drinks mineral and table water table oil and fruit juice. The company also exports its products to Europe and the Middle East. Mutandis SCA was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc
Description: Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc provides various commercial banking products and services primarily to multinational companies financial institutions individuals small businesses partnerships and commercial entities in Nigeria. It operates through Retail Banking Commercial Banking Institutional Banking Corporate & Investment Banking Non-Interest Banking and Special Purpose Vehicle segments. The company offers savings and current accounts; investment products; personal loans; cards; e-channels; business accounts loan products business advisory and business digital solutions for SMEs; credit services to large scale enterprises; recurring discounted certificate fixed and call deposits; and importers financing invoice discount facility letter of credit and overdraft services. The company offers retail and consumer banking and trade services; corporate investment and non-interest banking services; and wholesale banking services comprising the granting of loans and advances letter of credit transactions money market operations electronic and mobile banking products and other banking activities as well as issues debt securities to borrow funds and solutions and guided by Islamic economics. It operates a network of branches and cash centers. Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Camanchaca S.A.
Description: Camanchaca S.A. engages in the industrial fishing business in Chile the United States Mexico Japan Europe and China. The company produces fishmeal frozen and canned jack mackerel langostino lobster and fish oil in northern and southern Chile; and engages in the salmon farming activities. It is also involved in the farming mussels abalones and shellfish as well as logistics operations. In addition the company export fishes and shellfish to approximately 50 countries. The company was formerly known as Compañía Pesquera Camanchaca S.A. Camanchaca S.A. was founded in 1965 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Eldan Transportation LTD
Description: Eldan Transportation LTD provides car sales  private leasing operational leasing for companies car rental in Israel car rental abroad road services and financing solutions for the purchase of a car and hotels in Jerusalem and Paris. It also offers services of rental and operational leasing of refrigerated vehicles as a solution for self-driving transportation of refrigerated and frozen products. The company’s online platform list vehicles for sale from its rental and leasing vehicle database. Additionally it also offers electric private and commercial vehicles from electric vehicle manufacturers and engages in the development rental and sale of real estate assets and land for investment. It provides services online from its website and through sales centers. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: Echeverría Izquierdo S.A.
Description: Echeverría Izquierdo S.A. engages in the engineering and construction activities in Chile. The company offers civil works electromechanical installation electrical installation and instrumentation installation of heavy structures piping prefabrication and installation and pre commissioning and industrial maintenance. It engages in construction of building and special foundations; and real estate development. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Las Condes Chile.

Name: Grupo Empresas Navieras S.A.
Description: Grupo Empresas Navieras S.A. an investment company engages in the maritime logistics and port businesses. The company provides maritime carriage services which include 9000 and 3100 TEUs full container vessels; tanker vessels for clean products; ferries for people vehicles and cargo; pilot launches; wellboats to support the salmon industry; and tugboats. It also operates port terminals and airports; provides agency services for coordinating pilotage services passengers service and tourism bunkering back office and other services; and logistics services. Grupo Empresas Navieras S.A. was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile.

Name: Kuwait Financial Centre - KPSC
Description: Kuwait Financial Centre - KPSC together with its subsidiaries provides asset management and investment banking services in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through three segments: Asset Management Investment Banking and Others. The company offers portfolio management services including discretionary non-discretionary and advisory services as well as equity real estate and fixed income portfolios; and market making services. It also provides wealth management services such as tailored portfolio across all asset classes investments advisory mandates private equity and venture capital private credit portfolio and iMarkaz; capital market and m&a advisory services; and industry capital markets regulatory economic policy infrastructure and periodic research services as well as consulting services comprising industry market assessment company valuation business plans white label reports due diligence/business evaluation c-suite support at CXO level databases access feasibility studies and directors intelligence support. In addition the company offers real estate services including fund management tailored portfolio management full property management RE development and advisory services. Further it is involved in funding import and export operation; undertake the job of brokers; dealing and trading in foreign currencies and precious metal markets; offering personal commercial and consumer loans; finance operation related to pledging investment portfolios and securities and finance brokerage; investment in industrial real estate agricultural services and other sectors; placement agent; and custodian services. Kuwait Financial Centre - KPSC was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Empresa Regional de Servicio Público de Electricidad Electro Norte Medio S.A.
Description: Empresa Regional de Servicio Público de Electricidad Electro Norte Medio S.A. distributes and markets electric energy in Peru. It also carries out sub-transmission and electricity generation activities; provides electrical meter contrast consulting services; and designs executes study or work related to electrical activities. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Trujillo Peru. Empresa Regional de Servicio Público de Electricidad Electro Norte Medio S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Fondo Nacional de Financiamiento de la Actividad Empresarial del Estado.

Name: Guinness Nigeria Plc
Description: Guinness Nigeria Plc engages in brewing packaging marketing and selling whisky vodka liqueur gin spirits beers non-alcoholic drinks and ready-to-drink products primarily in Nigeria. The company offers its products under Guinness Foreign Extra Stout Guinness Extra Smooth Malta Guinness Malta Guinness Herbs Lite Harp Lager Smirnoff Ice Satzenbrau Lager Dubic Malt Snapp Master’s Choice Orijin Spirit Mixed Drink Orijin Bitters Smirnoff Ice Double Black with Guarana Guinness Africa Special Orijin Zero Tappers and Royal Kingdom Lager brands. Guinness Nigeria Plc exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. As of September 30 2024 Guinness Nigeria Plc operates as a subsidiary of Tolaram Corporation Pte Ltd.

Name: Sönmez Filament Sentetik Iplik ve Elyaf Sanayi A.S.
Description: Sönmez Filament Sentetik Iplik ve Elyaf Sanayi A.S. manufactures and sells yarns and fibers in Turkey. It offers poy plain textured twisted and dyed yarns for the automotive industry as well as high flap yarns. The company also engages in leasing of real estates. Sönmez Filament Sentetik Iplik ve Elyaf Sanayi A.S. was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Bursa Turkey.

Name: Aksigorta A.S.
Description: Aksigorta A.S. provides various life and non-life insurance products and services to retail and corporate customers in Turkey. It operates through Fire Logistics Motor (Automobile Insurance) Motor Liability (Compulsory Traffic) Other Accident Engineering Agriculture Health and Life segments. The company offers car motor third party liability fire marine accident personal accident engineering and agriculture insurance products. It also provides traffic home compulsory earthquake building property foreign health health travel health and premium travel insurance as well as other insurance such as yacht bodycard security and credit card unemployment insurance products. The company sells its products through branches independent agencies brokers and contracted institutions. Aksigorta A.S. was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Armada Gida Ticaret Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Armada Gida Ticaret Sanayi Anonim Sirketi engages in processing selling importing and exporting pulses cereals bulgur organic products superfoods pulse flour rice gluten-free products packaged products and other products. The company offers its products under the DOYUM ARMADA FOODS POPIPOP and MEDITERRANEAN VILLAGE ORGANIC brands. It exports its products to 90 countries. The company is based in Toroslar Turkey.

Name: Empresas Gasco S.A.
Description: Empresas Gasco S.A. provides energy solutions based primarily based on gas in Chile and internationally. It operates through Chile Energy Solutions International Business Energy Solutions and Supply segments. The company distributes and commercializes liquefied gas and liquefied natural gas to residential commercial industrial and real estate customers; distributes natural gas under the concession regime; and develops and maintains photovoltaic solar energy and gas-fired power generation projects. Empresas Gasco S.A. was founded in 1856 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Arabian Shield Cooperative Insurance Company
Description: Arabian Shield Cooperative Insurance Company provides various insurance products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers motor property engineering marine travel personal accident extended visit visa and craftsman’s insurance; medical insurance such as health and medical malpractice insurance; and education marriage retirement ladies and investment protection and saving insurance. Arabian Shield Cooperative Insurance Company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Bank of Africa - Burkina Faso
Description: Bank of Africa - Burkina Faso provides commercial bank services for retail corporate and financial markets in Burkina Faso. The company offers savings checking current and currency accounts; term deposits; cards; and digital and online banking services as well as various loans such as house equipment collective car and motorcycle personal consumer vitamin holiday and payday advance loans. It also provides cash and overdraft facilities; discounted commercial papers; bridge spot and campaign credits; advances; cash vouchers; insurance advisory and money transfer services; foreign currency endorsements documentary discounts documentary credits and checks or foreign currency items; guarantee letters; and trade express and currency transfer services. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Ouagadougou Burkina Faso. Bank of Africa - Burkina Faso operates is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

Name: Distribuidora de Gas del Centro S.A.
Description: Distribuidora de Gas del Centro S.A. distributes natural gas in the provinces of Córdoba Catamarca and La Rioja Argentina. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Distribuidora de Gas del Centro S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Inversora de Gas del Centro S.A.

Name: National General Insurance Co. (P.J.S.C.)
Description: National General Insurance Co. (P.J.S.C.) engages in underwriting various classes of life and general insurance and reinsurance businesses in the United Arab Emirates. The company operates through two segments Insurance and Investments. It offers medical motor travel accident home life and yachts insurance products for individuals. The company also provides corporate insurance products including property insurance solutions such as fire allied and perils property all risks business interruption office multi cover and hotel comprehensive as well as terrorism sabotage and political violence; marine insurance products including cargo hull and machinery and yachts; and engineering insurance products comprising project installed machinery and consequential loss. In addition it offers general accident insurance products comprising money fidelity guarantee group personal accident bankers blanket bond and jewelers block; motor fleet; and onshore and offshore insurance products. Further the company provides general third-party cyber employers professional indemnity directors and officers and workmen’s compensation liability insurance; and group medical group life group travel credit computer crime and cancellation of events insurance products. National General Insurance Co. (P.J.S.C.) was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Al Obeikan Glass Company
Description: Al Obeikan Glass Company engages in wholesale and retail sale of chemicals and glass panels in Saudi Arabia and internationally. It operates through two segments Glass and Aluminum. The company also involved in the operation of quarries; and sand and gravel mines including crushers. In addition it manufactures and sells float and laminated glass products as well as insulating glass used in construction. It also provides consultation service. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Societe Generale Ghana PLC
Description: Societe Generale Ghana PLC engages in the provision of retail corporate and investment banking services in Ghana. It operates through three segments: Retail Banking Corporate Banking and Treasury. The company offers current and savings accounts; consumer appliance institutional auto home chat CAGD and cash covered loans as well as relief credit; treasury services overdrafts revolving advance factoring trade finance and working capital loans; term loans comprising asset financing finance leasing and project financing; safe deposit boxes; and insurance products comprising drive cash home eduflex and funeral insurance. It also provides cash management services including merchant/point-of-sale terminal acquiring bill/fees payment reporting account flow and liquidity management cash and electronic banking services as well as business cards; working capital finance that include project and infrastructure industrial project acquisition and structured corporate finance as well as syndicated loans and leverage buy outs; and trade finance services comprising letters of credit guarantees documentary collection standby letters of credit and avalised bills and bills discounting; and treasury services. In addition the company offers investment banking services as well as invests in liquid assets such as short-term placements and government debt securities. It serves individuals clients institutional clients and businesses. The company was formerly known as Societe Generale Ghana Limited and changed its name to Societe Generale Ghana PLC. Societe Generale Ghana PLC was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Accra Ghana. Societe Generale Ghana PLC operates as a subsidiary of SG Financial Services Holding SA.

Name: Turcas Petrol A.S.
Description: Turcas Petrol A.S. operates as a petrol and energy-focused investment company in Turkey. It operates through Petrol and Electricity segments. The company’s products include fuel lubricants and engine oil. It is also involved in the power generation activities. The company was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Turcas Petrol A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Aksoy Girisimcilik Enerji Ve Turizm A.S.

Name: Rapac Communication & Infrastructure Ltd
Description: Rapac Communication & Infrastructure Ltd engages in trade commerce electrical projects government and electricity production businesses in Israel. It provides consultancy representation and distribution; program management and system integration; business development; engineering/technical support; entrepreneurship; and other support services for the defense community as well as markets communication missile avionics navigation microwave and other defense systems. The company also offers solutions for power generation transmission and distribution as well as for domestic industrial and government sectors; finance for projects to produce electricity. In addition it implements energy electricity and air-conditioning projects for power plants renewable and solar energy various industry telecom high-tech commercial and public buildings military and defense facilities electrical and telecom infrastructure and street lighting; manufactures electrical switchboards; constructs power stations and substations; and operates as an EPC contractor for PV projects. The company was formerly known as RAPAC Electronics Ltd. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Netanya Israel.

Name: Dimed S.A. Distribuidora de Medicamentos
Description: Dimed S.A. Distribuidora de Medicamentos sells medicines perfumes personal hygiene and beauty products cosmetics and dermo-cosmetics in Brazil. It sells its products through stores under Panvel brand. The company is also involved in purchasing selling brokering subdividing leasing renting managing and administering its owned and third-party properties. Dimed S.A. Distribuidora de Medicamentos was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Eldorado do Sul Brazil.

Name: Effi Capital Nadlan Ltd
Description: Effi Capital Nadlan Ltd engages in the real estate business in Israel. The company is involved in initiating building and establishing residential construction projects. It undertakes housing and commercial space projects. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Bnei Brak Israel.

Name: Vestel Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Vestel Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries produces and sells brown and white goods in Turkey Europe and internationally. It operates in two segments Consumer and Mobility Electronic and Household Appliances. The company provides television headphones speakers and tablets; refrigerator deep freezer washing machines drying machines dishwashers freestanding ovens countertop hobs mini and microwave ovens aspirators water dispensers and wine coolers; household appliances including brooms coffee machines beverage preparation mix and go mixer and chopper electric cookers vacuum machines irons personal care and retro small appliances. It also offers air conditioners water heaters heaters and air purifiers. In addition it provides smart products such as smart watch smart scale smart light smart socket smart camera smart bulb smart doorbell and sleep tracking band. Further it provides electric vehicle charging stations and other products. It sells its products through online and stores. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Vestel Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Zorlu Holding A.S.

Name: Academy of Learning Company
Description: Academy of Learning Company operates education and training institutes in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company’s training program includes diploma in accounting and taxation hotel and resort management marketing and e-commerce supply chain management and logistics insurance and risk management business administration graphic design cyber security artificial intelligence occupational safety and health public relations and media event organization and management and human resources. It also engages in the wholesale of computers and accessories including printers and inks; and real estate investment activities. Academy of Learning Company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Zamp S.A.
Description: Zamp S.A. engages in the restaurant business in Brazil. It operates and franchises restaurants under the Burger King and Popeyes brands. The company was formerly known as BK Brasil Operação e Assessoria a Restaurantes S.A. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: APM Terminals Bahrain B.S.C.
Description: APM Terminals Bahrain B.S.C. owns and operates Khalifa Bin Salman Port in Bahrain. The company offers container terminal services; general cargo services that handles various vessel types comprising dhows five-star cruise vessels various bulk and break-bulk vessels RORO and livestock; and engages in landside operations including less-than container loads (LCL)/ full container loads (FCL) stations containerization of cargo vehicle storage and long/short term storage solutions. It also provides break bulk and project cargo services; operates roll-on roll-off (RoRo) terminal that handles tractors buses trucks oversized cargo loaded on special flatbed mafi and lowboy trailers as well as new or used vehicle import and export and related services; and provides cruise terminal services. In addition the company offers marine services such as activities relating to pilotage and towage FCL LCL livestock domestic export/import transshipment and mooring. Further it provides container repair reefer documentation gate/yard and data and application programming interface store services. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Muharraq Bahrain. APM Terminals Bahrain B.S.C. operates as a subsidiary of APM Terminals B.V.

Name: Raya Holding Company for Financial Investments (S.A.E)
Description: Raya Holding Company for Financial Investments (S.A.E) operates in information technology data center outsourcing contact center smart buildings consumer electronics food and beverage land transport E-payments and non-banking financial services fields in Egypt and internationally. The company offers business process and HR outsourcing contact center CX management digital solutions and call center seat leasing services; ATM and self-service data center site preparations low current enterprise network infrastructure and telecom solutions as well as voice and multimedia Internet of Things smart cities security enterprise management Oracle apps and tech and Microsoft solutions; and financial inclusion mobile wallets omni channel blockchain analytics and big data cyber security and customer experience (CX) solutions. It also provides mobile phones and accessories air conditioners desktops notebooks servers tablets computer accessories monitors printers printing consumables scanners software UPS cameras flat panel TVs white goods home appliances and IT products; frozen fruits and vegetables; and pasta tomato paste and fava beans. In addition the company offers auto; supply chain management; and sales and distribution merchandising export vessel discharging consumer finance microloans financing card recharging and donation payment services. Further it engages in the delivery of raw materials; trucking logistics and distribution activities; port and storage services; operates a fleet of trucks; operating and franchising of restaurants; developing commercial and office complexes; and assembling of light transport vehicles. The company was formerly known as Raya Holding Company for Technology and Communication (S.A.E) and changed its name to Raya Holding Company for Financial Investments (S.A.E) in October 2016. Raya Holding Company for Financial Investments (S.A.E) was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Abdullah Saad Mohammed Abo Moati for Bookstores Company
Description: Abdullah Saad Mohammed Abo Moati for Bookstores Company engages in the retail and wholesale trading of stationery computers and other accessories in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company is involved in the wholesale trading of office supplies leather products and travel accessories made of leather or leather substitutes bags home furniture and furniture office stationery wooden cork and plastic products children's toys computers and their accessories and office furniture. Further it engages in the sale of printers and inks as well as the leasing of buildings for commercial and residential purposes. Abdullah Saad Mohammed Abo Moati for Bookstores Company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: National Industries Company - KPSC
Description: National Industries Company - KPSC engages in the manufacturing and marketing of building and constructing materials and infrastructure products in Kuwait the GCC and the Middle East. It operates through four segments: Building Materials and Contracting Services Oil Sector Real Estate and Investments. The company offers interlock yard tiles kerbstone garden benches and flower pots; cement cladding and limestone bricks; cladding bricks and materials; and mansory blocks. It also provides PPR fittings cPVC and uPVC pressure fittings uPVC sewerage and drainage systems uPVC conduit pipes and accessories and uPVC cable ducts. National Industries Company - KPSC was founded in 1960 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Arkaan Real Estate P.L.C
Description: Arkaan Real Estate P.L.C engages in the real estate development and investment activities in Palestine. The company develops and sells real estate properties such as housing tourism commercial and mixed-use lands. It also involved in the financial investment activities. The company was formerly known as Asas Al-Ard Company for Investments and Real Estate Development and changed its name to Arkaan Real Estate P.L.C in May 2022. Arkaan Real Estate P.L.C was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Rawabi Palestinian Authority.

Name: Hospital Mater Dei S.A.
Description: Hospital Mater Dei S.A. operates hospitals in Brazil. The company provides healthcare services such as hospitalizations surgeries oncology medical consultations exams and other services. It also engages in data and artificial intelligence business. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Belo Horizonte Brazil. Hospital Mater Dei S.A. is a subsidiary of JSS Empreendimentos e Administração LTDA.

Name: Bulls Girisim Sermayesi Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Bulls Girisim Sermayesi Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi engages in investment business in Turkey. Bulls Girisim Sermayesi Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is a subsidiary of Bulls Yatirim Holding A.S.

Name: Export Investment Co. Ltd.
Description: Export Investment Co. Ltd. operates as the holding company for Bank of Jerusalem that provides various banking products and services in Israel. The company accepts various deposits such as long-term or short-term deposits savings plans and saving and checking accounts. Its loan products include personal loans foreign currency loans and mortgages. It also offers capital market services comprising trading investment advisory and broker services. Export Investment Co. Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Jaffa Israel.

Name: Banque Nationale Agricole Société anonyme
Description: Banque Nationale Agricole Société anonyme provides various banking products and services in Tunisia. The company offers savings foreign currency and convertible dinar accounts as well as personal business agricultural and professional financing. It also provides investment products remote banking bancassurance TPE affiliation AVA business travel allowance and MoneyGram services as well as international services and credit cards. The company was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Misr National Steel - Ataqa
Description: Misr National Steel - Ataqa manufactures and sells steel rebars in Egypt. The company serves its products to government projects real estate developers national infrastructure engineering projects tunnels and other projects. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt. Misr National Steel - Ataqa is a subsidiary of Al Wehda Industrial Development.

Name: Altin Yunus Çesme Turistik Tesisler A.S.
Description: Altin Yunus Çesme Turistik Tesisler A.S. operates a hotel in Turkey. It provides various facilities that covers wedding and banquet meeting and conference spa and catering as well as events. The company was founded in 1972 and is based in Izmir Turkey. Altin Yunus Çesme Turistik Tesisler A.S. is a subsidiary of Yasar Holding A.S.

Name: Access Bank (Ghana) Plc
Description: Access Bank (Ghana) Plc provides various banking products and services primarily in Ghana. The company offers current savings and call accounts; fixed deposits; vehicle and personal loans term loan and overdrafts; investment advisory services; mobile and internet banking; money transfer; bancassurance; and dormant account reactivation as well as debit prepaid and credit cards. It also provides financing supply chain finance trade finance project and structured finance global trade cash management treasury and bonds and guarantees; payment and advisory services; and invoice discounting services. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Accra Ghana. Access Bank (Ghana) Plc is a subsidiary of Access Bank Plc.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Côte d'Ivoire S.A.
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Côte d'Ivoire S.A. supplies and markets petroleum products in Ivory Coast. The company offers fuel liquified petroleum gas lubricant and renewable energy though network of service stations. It also provides solar lamps. In addition the company serves food aviation automotive construction chemicals energy metallurgy steel paper wood and textile industries. The company was formerly known as Total Cote d'Ivoire S.A. and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Côte d'Ivoire S.A. in June 2021. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Abidjan Ivory Coast. TotalEnergies Marketing Côte d'Ivoire S.A. operates as a subsidiary of TotalEnergies SE.

Name: Compagnie Ivoirienne d'Électricité (CIE) S.A.
Description: Compagnie Ivoirienne d'Électricité (CIE) S.A. engages in the production transmission and distribution of electricity in West Africa. The company also engages in the production of drinking water. In addition it provides management of public services. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Abidjan Ivory Coast.

Name: Sociedad Eléctrica del Sur Oeste S.A.
Description: Sociedad Eléctrica del Sur Oeste S.A. engages distribution of electricity in Peru. The company was formerly known as Electroperú S.A. and changed its name to Sociedad Eléctrica del Sur Oeste S.A. Sociedad Eléctrica del Sur Oeste S.A. was incorporated in 1905 and is based in Arequipa Peru.

Name: Trisul S.A.
Description: Trisul S.A. engages in the construction and development of real estate properties in Brazil. The company is involved in the subdivision of plots of land; and purchase and sale of properties. It also develops real estate projects with ownership interest of third parties. Trisul S.A. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Wiz Co Participações e Corretagem de Seguros S.A.
Description: Wiz Co Participações e Corretagem de Seguros S.A. operates as an insurance broker in Brazil. The company offers financial and insurance products including individual and corporate insurance consortia capitalization and private pension plans. It is involved in prospecting activation support insurance and financial products through car dealership networks and training for the sale of credit and credit-related insurance products. The company was formerly known as Wiz Soluções e Corretagem de Seguros S.A. Wiz Co Participações e Corretagem de Seguros S.A. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Brasília Brazil.

Name: Adgar Investments and Development Ltd
Description: Adgar Investments and Development Ltd engages in the real estate business in Israel Canada Poland and Belgium. The company invests in office space. It also develops income-producing office assets through land purchases and utilization of land reserves associated to various property holdings. Adgar Investments and Development Ltd was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel. Adgar Investments and Development Ltd is a subsidiary of Direct I.D.I. Holdings Ltd.

Name: Kingston Wharves Limited
Description: Kingston Wharves Limited provides multi-purpose port terminal and logistics services in Jamaica. It operates through Terminal Operations and Logistics Services segments. The company operates public wharves and stevedoring of vessels as well as warehousing and logistics facilities. It also involved in the provision of port security services; rents of ambient warehouses and cold storage facilities; and rents properties. In addition the company offers verified gross mass services for full container load shipment; logistics services including inventory management order fulfilment product assembling and labelling order picking and packaging customized freight transportation and distribution services warehousing and returns immediate short-term and long-term lease and postponement services; and contract labor services. Kingston Wharves Limited was incorporated in 1945 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Ser Educacional S.A.
Description: Ser Educacional S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates on-campus and distance-learning undergraduate graduate and professional training courses and other education-related areas in Brazil. It offers undergraduate post graduate on-campus and digital learning and vocational courses. The company operates under the UNINASSAU – Centro Universitário Maurício de Nassau UNINABUCO – Centro Universitário Nabuco UNG – Universidade Guarulhos UNAMA – Universidade da Amazônia UNIVERITAS – Centro Universitário Universus Veritas UNINORTE - Centro Universitário do Norte Centro Universitário de Ciências Biomédicas de Cacoal – UNIFACIMED UNIJUAZEIRO - Centro Universitário de Juazeiro do Norte Sociedade Educacional de Rondônia – UNESC Centro Universitário São Francisco de Barreiras – UNIFASB Centro Universitário FAEL CDMV – Centro de Desenvolvimento da Medicina Veterinária Faculdades UNINASSAU Faculdades UNINABUCO e Escolas Técnicas Joaquim Nabuco e Maurício de Nassau Centro Universitário 7 de Setembro – UNI7 GOKURSOS BEDUKA DELÍNEA PROVA FÁCIL and Peixe 30 CDO CDM DOK and PLANTÃO VETERINÁRIO brands.
