Name: Electreon Wireless Ltd
Description: Electreon Wireless Ltd engages in the research development and implementation of the wireless electric road system in Israel. The company offers static dynamic and semi-dynamic charging solutions for electric vehicles. Its wireless electric road system is a shared invisible platform that wirelessly charges commercial and passenger electric vehicles while driving. The company offers its solution for governments cities and fleet operators. Electreon Wireless Ltd was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Beit Yanai Israel.

Name: Grupo Gicsa S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Gicsa S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the real estate and residential properties development activities in Mexico. It is involved in the investment acquisition construction leasing marketing and sale of shopping centers corporate offices hotels and mixed-use properties. The company also engages in the real estate properties administration operation and maintenance activities; and brokerage and stock holding services. Grupo Gicsa S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1989 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Jacob Finance and Investments Ltd
Description: Jacob Finance and Investments Ltd provides non-banking credit services. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Meitav Trade Investments Ltd
Description: Meitav Trade Investments Ltd provides financial investment services. The company was incorporated in 2023 is based in Bnei Brak Israel.

Name: Automatic Bank Services Limited
Description: Automatic Bank Services Limited operates payment systems for international debit cards in Israel. It serves as an infrastructure for credit card clearing; works with various credit companies as clearers and issuers; and works with distributors and manufacturers as well as provides service to businesses; and activates the confirmation switch on the ATM devices. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Holon Israel.

Name: Banco Popular S.A.
Description: Banco Popular S.A. provides banking products and services in Colombia. The company offers debit and credit cards; savings and current accounts; CDT term deposits; investment and voluntary pension funds; housing and investment credits; protection and insurance; tax payment; and customer service and payment channels; cash management; working capital; development credits; commercial consumer mortgage and microcredit loans; financial leasing; and money table products and services as well as digital wallet. It also provides overdraft real estate and machinery and equipment leasing; collection with barcode PSE payment to suppliers payment of payroll and tax and national referenced collection; and foreign trade services including import and export credit portfolio guarantees and warranties and import and export financing. Banco Popular S.A. was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Bogotá Colombia. Banco Popular S.A. is a subsidiary of Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A.

Name: Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A.
Description: Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A. captures produces bottles and markets still and carbonated natural mineral waters in Morocco. It is involved in the manufacture and sale of preforms as well as bottling and marketing of table water. The company offers its products under the Sidi Ali Oulmès Aïn Atlas Vitalya Bahia Purifya Glass' Orangina Fifa of Sainte Luce and DIAM brands. Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Navarino S.A.
Description: Navarino S.A. through its subsidiaries manufactures and sells steel parts for mining and grinding balls in Chile and internationally. It is also involved in the glass packaging business. Navarino S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Mega Metal Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Mega Metal Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells electrolytic copper wires in Turkey. It offers single and bunched copper wires wire rods multi wires and braiding wires as well as silver and tin plated and bare copper wires. The company serves energy generation and distribution electricity electronics communication renewable energy electrical appliances white goods special industrial applications aviation and automotive sectors. It also exports its products to approximately 30 countries worldwide. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Brisanet Serviços de Telecomunicações S.A.
Description: Brisanet Serviços de Telecomunicações S.A. provides broadband internet services in Brazil. It offers fiber optic internet pay TV music streaming and fixed and mobile telephony services. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Pereiro Brazil. Brisanet Serviços de Telecomunicações S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Brisanet Participações S.A.

Name: Ânima Holding S.A.
Description: Ânima Holding S.A. operates as an education organization in Brazil. It operates in two segments Inspirali Medical Education and Ânima Core. The company provides undergraduate courses in medicine; educational services in higher education and professional training courses; and professional development services in postgraduate courses. It also offers consultancy services in technological innovation technical support and maintenance; and develops computer programs. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: ASAS Makeen Real Estate Development and Investment Company
Description: ASAS Makeen Real Estate Development and Investment Company engages in the real estate development activities. It develops villas townhouses residential apartments commercial and hotel compounds and apartments. The company also rents villas townhouses residential apartments and apartments. ASAS Makeen Real Estate Development and Investment Company was founded in 2010 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Zvi Sarfati & Sons Investments & Constructions Ltd.
Description: Zvi Sarfati & Sons Investments & Constructions Ltd. through its subsidiaries constructs and sells residential projects apartments and commercial spaces and offices in Israel. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Rishon LeZion Israel.

Name: Taaleem Management Services Company S.A.E.
Description: Taaleem Management Services Company provides private higher education and skills-based learning services in Egypt. It operates Nahda University Badya University and Memphis University. The company was formerly known as Bisco Investment Company and changed its name to Taaleem Management Services Company S.A.E. in July 2016. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: The Egyptian Satellite Company Nilesat
Description: The Egyptian Satellite Company Nilesat provides direct-to-home (DTH) broadcasting satellite broadband and other communication services in Egypt the Middle East and North Africa. It operates fleet of satellites including Nilesat 201 and Nilesat 301; and geostationary satellites that delivers a range of television channels radio stations and data and internet connectivity solutions to households businesses and governmental organizations. The company also offers satellite services including KA-BAND broadband services and KU-BAND and EXT. KU-BAND broadcasting services. In addition it provides teleport services such as OTT and video streaming satellite uplink and downlink services DTH playout and backhauling solutions and occasional TV solutions. Further the company offers gateway operations and consultancy services; broadcasting services including free-to-air and encrypted television channels radio stations and interactive services; satellite-based broadband and data services to support internet connectivity in underserved areas; and serves as a primary distribution platform for various Arabic-language broadcasters which includes content in various genres such as news sports entertainment and educational programming. The Egyptian Satellite Company Nilesat was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in 6th of October City Egypt.

Name: Paz Corp S.A.
Description: Paz Corp S.A. a real estate company engages in housing projects development business in Chile and Peru. The company develops apartments and houses as well as office and other real estate projects like offices shops strip centers malls etc. Paz Corp S.A. was founded in 1982 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: The Gold Bond Group Ltd.
Description: The Gold Bond Group Ltd. engages in the storage conveyance and logistical solutions for cargoes and containers. It provides terminal services such as container and cargo terminal customs supervision storage and unload containers train transport and storage and transport hazardous cargo; and advanced logistics services including temperature and climate warehouse wash TK and tankers storage RF containers and e-commerce warehouse as well as rents heavy forklifts. It serves importers and exporters delivery companies customs brokers and maritime companies. The company was formerly known as H.M.N Paper Products Factory Ltd. and changed its name to The Gold Bond Group Ltd. in February 1994. The Gold Bond Group Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Ashdod Israel.

Name: Munshaat Real Estate Projects Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Munshaat Real Estate Projects Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the ownership development sale and purchase of real estate properties in Kuwait and internationally. The company also owns operates manages rents and invests in hotels clubs motels entertainment houses rest places gardens parks exhibitions restaurants cafes commercial complex residential compounds touristic and health spas entertainment and sports facilities stores and appended facilities as well as offers real estate consultancy services. In addition it is involved in the maintenance works for buildings and real estate properties such as civil mechanical and electrical and elevator and air conditioning works; and organizing exhibitions related to the real estate projects and auctions as well as develops and manages real estate investment funds. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Limited
Description: Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Limited together with its subsidiaries provides banking and other related services in Kenya Tanzania Uganda and Burundi. The company offers current savings salary accounts and fixed deposits; mortgage and term loans; and overdrafts hire purchase credit guarantee scheme insurance premium financing leasing and trade finance as well as debit and credit cards. It also provides Diaspora banking money transfer POS acquiring agency banking Agri Biz Loans mobile banking internet banking treasury automated teller machines and payment solutions; and bancassurance general insurance and medical insurance products. The company was formerly known as Diamond Trust of Kenya and changed its name to Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Limited in 1997. Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Limited was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Gelecek Varlik Yönetimi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Gelecek Varlik Yönetimi AS operates as a financial institution in Turkey. It provides banking savings deposits insurance fund loans other financial institution and consultancy and intermediary services. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Gelecek Varlik Yönetimi Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Fiba Holding Anonim Sirketi.

Name: Emirates Reem Investments Company P.J.S.C
Description: Emirates Reem Investments Company P.J.S.C together with its subsidiaries engages in the bottling distribution and trading of mineral water carbonated drinks soft drinks juices and evaporated milk in the United Arab Emirates rest of the Middle East and Africa. It operates through Land and Building Leasing Corporate and Operations segments. The company also manufactures plastic bottles cups and containers; and engages in the leasing of investment property warehouses. It markets and sells its products under the Jeema and AL REEM brand names. Emirates Reem Investments Company P.J.S.C was formerly known as Emirates Refreshments (P.S.C.) and changed its name to Emirates Reem Investments Company P.J.S.C in August 2023. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S.
Description: Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S. manufactures and sells vehicle tires and related products in North America South America Europe the Middle East Africa and Asia. It is involved in the manufacturing of industrial cloths transmission belts v-belts rubber hoses and rubber and plastic products; industrial single cord with industrial fabrics in the structure of the material; heavy denier fiber and connection fabrics; and the processing and marketing of guide cloths and other rubber reinforcement materials. The company also provides rubber cord and mechanical rubber good fabrics. In addition it offers advanced composites to the civil aviation sector and offers nylon 6 nylon 6.6 and polyethylene terephthalate high modulus low shrinkage polyester as well as rayon heavy decitex yarns for use in tires and mechanical rubber goods. The company was formerly known as Kordsa Endüstriyel Iplik ve Kord Bezi Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi and changed its name to Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S. in March 2017. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Izmit Turkey. Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S. is a subsidiary of Haci Ömer Sabanci Holding A.S.

Name: Metalfrio Solutions S.A.
Description: Metalfrio Solutions S.A. together with its subsidiaries manufactures imports and sells domestic and commercial refrigerators and freezers in Brazil Turkey Mexico the United States and internationally. The company offers horizontal and vertical freezers and refrigerators conservators inverters storage units ice cream freezers beverage displays coolers breweries display and glass doors beer max and all black equipment under the Metalfrio Klimasan Derby and Caravell brands. It also provides maintenance and technical assistance; sells spare parts; offers logistic services; leases related goods and services; and refurbishment services. The company exports its products. Metalfrio Solutions S.A. was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Drake and Scull International P.J.S.C.
Description: Drake and Scull International P.J.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in construction activities in the United Arab Emirates Saudi Arabia Kuwait Egypt Oman Germany Algeria India Iraq Jordan and internationally. It operates through three segments: wastewater treatment and water sludge Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) and Corporate. The company offers infrastructure water treatment plants district cooling plants and power plants. It also provides engineering procurement and construction solutions for water and infrastructure projects; wastewater sludge water and industrial wastewater treatment; and contracting works related to mechanical electrical and sanitary engineering. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Dubai United Arab Emirates.

Name: Terminal X Online Ltd.
Description: Terminal X Online Ltd. offers clothing footwear fashion accessories cosmetics and beauty products for men women and teenager under various brands through online. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Bnei Brak Israel. Terminal X Online Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Fox-Wizel Ltd.

Name: Compañía Industrial El Volcán S.A.
Description: Compañía Industrial El Volcán S.A. produces and sells construction materials in Chile and internationally. The company offers thermal insulation and acoustic absorptions; asphalt shingles accessories and fixing and moisture barriers; vapor barrier manhole covers valcanoboarding and volcanoes; volcoglasses; invisible seam cornerbacks septum repair partition plasters putties volcastic and façade installation tools; and passive fire protection products as well as pastes compounds and joint treatment tapes. It offers its products to housing health hospitality education industrial commercial and work space sectors. The company was founded in 1916 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: P.C.B. Technologies Ltd
Description: P.C.B. Technologies Ltd engages in the production sale marketing and repair of printed circuit boards (PCB) and beddings in Israel and internationally. The company provides electronics manufacturing services. It offers design fabrication supply chain management assembly and test and inspection services for PCB; and production floor services as well as miniaturization of electronic systems. It also provides assembly services such as integration and ICT J-TAG and final testing of PCB complete systems and products as well as acrylic coating potting ultrasonic soldering and DfM services. In addition it provides electronic packaging of printed circuit boards and substrates; and BGA and QFN components. Further the company offers full system integration services including sub-assembly BTO CTO testing loading software fulfillment final product packaging and other services. It offers its products for UAV interception systems sensors antenna in package optical instruments radars global positioning systems microelectromechanical systems industry 4.0 power devices Ew-electronic warfare base stations space modules microelectronics phased array antennas substrates micro assemblies biosensors detecting and analyzing biomarkers and chip on board applications. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Migdal Haemek Israel.

Name: Zona Franca de Iquique S.A.
Description: Zona Franca de Iquique S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates premises for wholesale and retail business centers in the duty-free zones of South America. It operates distribution center for domestic and international goods; logistics center; and mall commercial area and industrial parks. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Iquique Chile.

Name: Blume Metal Kimya Anonim Sirketi
Description: Blume Metal Kimya Anonim Şirketi operates a holiday village in Bodrum Gümbet Turkey. The company is involved in the construction and sale of Fugayaz Gündoğan houses; and generation and sale of electricity through solar power plants. The company was formerly known as Metemtur Yatirim Enerji Turizm ve Insaat Anonim Sirketi and changed its name to Blume Metal Kimya Anonim Şirketi in September 2025. Blume Metal Kimya Anonim Şirketi was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Saudi Cable Company
Description: Saudi Cable Company manufactures and sells power telecommunications and fiber optic cables in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the Middle East and North Africa. The company's product portfolio includes a wide range of cables such as high and low voltage power cables medium voltage power cables instrumentation cables and control cables for applications in various industries including energy infrastructure telecommunications and transportation; specialty instrumentation and industrial cables including fire retardant and halogen acid gas-free cables for oil and gas applications in the petrochemical industry and use in renewable power generation as well as use in the mining railway transit automotive military and industrial sectors. It also offers bare and insulated copper cables for residential commercial and institutional construction projects; fibre-optic and copper conductor communication cables for government agencies and private and public companies; and high voltage and extra-high voltage power transmission cables including foundation fieldbus thermocouple fire resistant and lead sheathed cables. In addition the company offers copper rods plastics wooden reels and related products; engineering and project management services; aluminum and aluminum alloys rods wires and conductors; contracts trades in distributes and supplies cables electronic products information technology products and related supplies; and undertakes engineering construction and turnkey projects. Further it buys and sells electrical cables and related products; provides electrical power distribution and communications services; and manufactures and supplies electronic tools and goods. The company also exports its products to approximately 40 countries worldwide. Saudi Cable Company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Armac Locação Logística e Serviços S.A.
Description: Armac Locação Logística e Serviços S.A. engages in leasing machines equipment and services in Brazil. The company offers trucks forklifts excavators telescopic handlers skid steer loader mini excavators motor graders wheel loaders backhoes road rollers crawler tractors wheel tractors and pavers. Armac Locação Logística e Serviços S.A. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Barueri Brazil.

Name: Tabuk Cement Company
Description: Tabuk Cement Company manufactures and sells cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers ordinary Portland cement blended hydraulic cement and sulphate resisting cements. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Tabuk the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Garanti Faktoring A.S.
Description: Garanti Faktoring A.S. provides factoring services to industrial and commercial firms. The company offers financing guarantee and collection services in selling goods/services; and supplier financing services in buying goods/services. It serves SMEs import and export companies and corporations through supplier and dealer networks in Turkey. The company was formerly known as Garanti Faktoring Hizmetleri A.S and changed its name to Garanti Faktoring A.S. in April 2014. Garanti Faktoring A.S. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Garanti Faktoring A.S. is a subsidiary of Türkiye Garanti Bankasi A.S.

Name: Pie Siam Ltd
Description: Pie Siam Ltd engages in the operation and management of hotels in Israel. It also invests and rents in real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Vakif Finansal Kiralama A.S.
Description: Vakif Finansal Kiralama A.S. engages in the provision of financial leasing services in Turkey. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Vakif Finansal Kiralama A.S. is a subsidiary of Türkiye Vakiflar Bankasi Türk Anonim Ortakligi.

Name: CIM Financial Services Ltd
Description: CIM Financial Services Ltd a non-banking financial institution provides financial solutions to individual consumers SMEs and large corporates in Mauritius and internationally. The company operates in Finance and Investments segments. The Finance segment provides consumer credit leasing card acquiring and issuing insurance and factoring services. The Investments segment offers strategy monitoring performance monitoring and statutory reporting services; and supports SBUs. It also engages in insurance agency business; offers secretarial and management services; and acts as corporate trustee. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Port Louis Mauritius. CIM Financial Services Ltd is a subsidiary of Cim Holdings Ltd.

Name: Casa Grande S.A.A.
Description: Casa Grande S.A.A. engages in the cultivation industrialization and marketing of sugar cane in Peru. It operates through Sugar and Derivatives; and Grape and Blueberry segments. The company offers products derived from cane such as brown sugar refined white sugar ethyl alcohol molasses and sugarcane bagasse. It is also involved in the cultivation packaging conservation transformation and industrialization of grapes blueberries and other agricultural products. The company was formerly known as Empresa Agroindustrial Casa Grande and changed its name to Casa Grande S.A.A. in April 2008. The company was founded in 1970 and is based in Chocope Peru. Casa Grande S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Corporación Azucarera del Perú S.A.

Name: Ege Gübre Sanayii A.S.
Description: Ege Gübre Sanayii A.S. primarily provides port services in Türkiye. The company operates through Chemical Fertilizers Port Services and Tank Farm segments. It offers various port services including cargo handling storage container loading and unloading container stuffing/unstuffing container repair/cleaning field stacking and off dock external field services; tank terminal management; and scaffolding services. The company also provides nitrogenous compounds and fertilizers and organic solvents. In addition it sells petroleum products. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Izmir Türkiye.

Name: Ibnsina Pharma
Description: Ibnsina Pharma operates as a pharmaceutical distributor in Egypt. The company offers pharmaceutical and cosmetics products to private and public-sector customers including retail chains independent pharmacies wholesalers hospitals and healthcare institutions. It also provides warehousing and logistic services for its suppliers; marketing solutions; importation and packaging services; and market research and analysis services as well as value added services. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in El Obour City Egypt.

Name: Trabzonspor Sportif Yatirim ve Futbol Isletmeciligi Ticaret A.S.
Description: Trabzonspor Sportif Yatirim ve Futbol Isletmeciligi Ticaret A.S. operates Trabzonspor Professional Football Team. It engages in activities related to its sports teams including broadcasting contracts sponsorship contracts and advertising agreements; and publishes an electronic sports magazine. The company was formerly known as Trabzonspor Sportif Yatirim ve Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Trabzonspor Sportif Yatirim ve Futbol Isletmeciligi Ticaret A.S. in May 2011. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Trabzon Turkey. Trabzonspor Sportif Yatirim ve Futbol Isletmeciligi Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Trabzonspor Futbol Isletmeciligi Tic. A.S.

Name: Cartavio S.A.A.
Description: Cartavio S.A.A. engages in the cultivation processing and industrialization of sugarcane in Peru. It produces refined white and brown sugar; rectified and industrial ethyl alcohol; and other products such as molasses and bagasse. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Cartavio Peru. Cartavio S.A.A. operates as a subsidiary of Corporación Azucarera del Perú S.A.

Name: Gulf Hotels Group B.S.C.
Description: Gulf Hotels Group B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries owns operates and manages hotels and restaurants. The company operates in three segments: Hotel Room Operations Food and Beverages and Investments and Other Activities. It owns and operates the Gulf Hotel Gulf Hotel Bahrain Convention and Spa Gulf Executive Offices Gulf Executive Residence Gulf Brands International Gulf Hotel Laundry Services Gulf Executive Residence Juffair Asdal Gulf Inn Boutique Hotel Novotel Bahrain Al Dana Resort Gulf Convention Centre Ocean Paradise Resort Zanzibar Gulf Court Hotel Business Bay Crowne Plaza Bahrain GHG Colombo and Bahrain Airport Hotel. The company also provides management services to Asdal Gulf-inn Seef in the Kingdom of Bahrain; laundry services; group support services; imports and sells alcohol beverages; interior and building design of catering facilities and landscape and recreational design services; computer and telephone system selection and layout; marketing advertising and promotion; supervision of building repair and maintenance; staff recruitment orientation and training services; and energy saving and security systems. In addition it engages in the construction supervision and liaison; production of brochures folders and menus; materials purchasing; marketing surveys; development of operating plan and budget as well as collateral materials; recruitment management; set-up of financial accounting and control systems; negotiation of leases licenses and concessions with third parties; provision of family entertainment; and coordination and execution of hotel opening. Further the company is involved in the rental and management of executive apartments and offices; retail sale of food and beverages; and executive apartments. Gulf Hotels Group B.S.C. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Alwasail Industrial Company
Description: Alwasail Industrial Company manufactures and sells polyethylene pipes and fittings in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Egypt Oman and the United Arab Emirates. The company offers irrigation portable water gas industrial and wastewater drainage pipes as well as telecom pipes and ducts; and barbed compression electrofusion and low-cost fittings. Its products are used in irrigation water telecom electrical industrial oil and gas wastewater and building sanitation sectors. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Alwasail Agricultural Company and changed its name to Alwasail Industrial Company in 1990. Alwasail Industrial Company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Buraydah Saudi Arabia.

Name: Nampak Limited
Description: Nampak Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of packaging products in South Africa and rest of Africa. The company offers beverage food and aerosol cans; and other metal packaging products. It also provides date/batch small character ink jet and large character ink jet coding; laser coding technologies; thermal transfer overprinting; thermal inkjet printing; marking addressing barcoding and labelling solutions; metal detection; X-ray inspection; package integrity inspection/pressure or vacuum loss detection; and fume extraction systems. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Ouro Fino Saúde Animal Participações S.A.
Description: Ouro Fino Saúde Animal Participações S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the development production and sale of veterinary drugs vaccines and other products for production and companion animals primarily in Brazil. The company operates through three segments: Production Animals; Companion Animals; and International Operations. It manufactures and trades in medicines including anti-inflammatories antibiotics anticoccidials antimastitics ectoparasiticides endectocides endoparasiticides hemoparasiticides inoculants therapeutics products for animal reproduction and vaccines; and performance-enhancing additives probiotics and other veterinary products for cattle swine poultry sheep horses and goats as well as manufacturing services. The company also manufactures veterinary solutions for dogs and cats such as anesthetics sedatives anti-inflammatory antibiotic antimicrobial dermatological ectoparasiticide endoparasiticide dermocosmetic and otological products. In addition it offers vaccines and other veterinary products for production and companion animals. The company was formerly known as A.H.N.S.P.E. Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. Ouro Fino Saúde Animal Participações S.A. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Cravinhos Brazil.

Name: Emilia Development (O.F.G) Ltd.
Description: Emilia Development (O.F.G) Ltd. manages a portfolio of investments in field of distribution logistics and industry services in Israel. The company provides hazardous industrial and medical waste treatment as well as environmental protection services; sampling and analysis services to the food agriculture pharma cosmetics and environmental industries; and logistic services as well as distributes chemicals and raw materials to the food and beverage agriculture plastics construction paint detergent cosmetics pharma and energy industries; operates lab for occupational and environmental monitoring; and accompanies consults and monitors the food and agricultural sectors. It is also involved in the production import market and distribution of pipes valves and fittings for the construction plumbing sanitation infrastructure firefighting HVAC and special metals industries; importing processing marketing and distributing of metals and steels; technical and engineering composites for liquid transportation water desalination and the chip processing industries; and sanitary devices faucets tubs shower stalls and wet room complementary products. In addition the company manufactures polyethylene pipes; and provides ground transport services for containers and cargoes. Emilia Development (O.F.G) Ltd. was incorporated in 1945 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Megiddo Y.K. Ltd
Description: Megiddo Y.K. Ltd engages in initiating planning and developing residential real estate projects. It also engages in development and construction large-scale commercial and employment projects. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Ramat Gan Israel. Megiddo Y.K. Ltd is a subsidiary of Aura Investments Ltd.

Name: One Tech Holding S.A.
Description: One Tech Holding S.A. operates in cable mechatronics and ICT sectors in Tunisia and internationally. It offers printed circuits boards plastic parts cables wire harness electronic manufacturing services and box build and product design and engineering services. The company serves automotive energy and industry sectors. One Tech Holding S.A. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Imagesat International (I.S.I) Ltd
Description: Imagesat International (I.S.I) Ltd together with its subsidiaries provides space-based intelligence satellite imagery and data analytics solutions for homeland defense markets and civilian markets worldwide. The company provides satellites services including EROS NG an intelligence collection asset; and Global Eye a multi-sensor high revisit satellite constellation. It offers satellite infrastructure such as RUNNER KNIGHT and SPRINTER space platforms; ClearSky a multi-satellite command and control system for end-to-end operation of various earth observation satellite constellations in real time; Direct Access which enables access to the EROS NG constellation; and AI and data analytics comprising ClearSky Analytics KingFisher intelligence as a service geospatial solutions and analysts training. The company was formerly known as Imagesat Israel Ltd. and changed its name to Imagesat International (I.S.I) Ltd in September 2021. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Or Yehuda Israel.

Name: Stokvis Nord Afrique S.A.
Description: Stokvis Nord Afrique S.A. engages in the import and distribution of technical equipment in Morocco. The company is involved in the importation and distribution of new construction equipment such as compact or hydraulic excavators loaders backhoe loaders compactors graders and crawler bulldozers as well as spare parts; and distributes equipment for other sectors such as dumpers used in mines and quarries forklifts and crushers. It engages in the rental of industrial equipment. The company was founded in 1953 and is based in Bouskoura Morocco.

Name: Oron Group Investments & Holdings Ltd
Description: Oron Group Investments & Holdings Ltd together with its subsidiaries engages in the civil engineering infrastructure and construction businesses in Israel. The company engages in the construction of residential condominiums including detached houses; and construction and paving building residential projects building bridges geotechnical works tunneling execution of prefabricated buildings and paving roads activities. It is also involved in the development and execution of real estate projects; and manufacture and marketing of quarry materials as well as production of asphalt mixtures ready-mix concrete cement mortar kurkar clay white clay and other products. In addition the company offers bulk transportation services for transporting quarry and raw materials. Oron Group Investments & Holdings Ltd was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Beersheba Israel.

Name: Reeder Teknoloji Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Reeder Teknoloji Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces and sells e-book readers smart mobile phones smart watches and tablets in Turkey. The company also offers robot vacuum cleaners and smart televisions. In addition it sells its products through online. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Samsun Turkey.

Name: Controladora Axtel S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Controladora Axtel S.A.B. de C.V. through its subsidiaries provides information and communications technology solutions in Mexico. It operates through Enterprise Government and Wholesale segments. The company offers various solutions for managed networks collaboration and information technology such as systems integration cloud services cybersecurity and others; and connectivity solutions including last-mile access IP transit spectrum fiber to the tower and data center. It also and leases telecommunication and equipment infrastructure equipment; provides telecommunication and training and development services. Controladora Axtel S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2022 and is based in San Nicolás de los Garza Mexico.

Name: CGE Transmisión S.A.
Description: CGE Transmisión S.A. operates in the electric power transmission sector primarily in the zonal transmission and dedicated transmission segments. The company has 3639 kilometers of zonal transmission lines and transformer substations totaling 8932 MVA of installed power. It also designs builds and operates dedicated transmission solution to meet the needs of its customers. The company is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Salam International Investment Limited Q.P.S.C.
Description: Salam International Investment Limited Q.P.S.C. establishes incorporates acquires and owns enterprises in contracting energy and industry consumer and luxury products technology real estate and development sectors in Qatar and internationally. The company offers information technology (IT) IT consulting electronic system installation and maintenance and mechanical services; and building and facilities management investment and oil and gas services. It also engages in civil contracting and furniture trading activities; trading and maintenance of refrigerators water coolers and air conditioners; consulting and managerial studies; and manufacturing of switchgears. In addition the company involved in trading of chemical materials water equipment IT equipment and computer networks; maintenance of oil equipment; steel and aluminum works; aluminum and powder coating services; managing of restaurants and bakeries; real estate; interior design; and furniture and interior manufacturing businesses. Further the company engages in the retail and wholesale of luxury consumer products; marketing and offices facility; construction and supply of landscaping related materials; manufacture of bowls and boxes of cardboards; installation operation and maintenance of cameras and security surveillance systems; and investment in securities. Salam International Investment Limited Q.P.S.C. was founded in 1952 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Balady Poultry Company
Description: Balady Poultry Company together with its subsidiaries produces poultry products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia other GCC countries and internationally. The company offers whole and marinated chicken; and chicken parts including gizzards hearts breasts thighs whole chicken feet wings mix chicken pieces liver feet and legs as well as chicken fillet. It also engages in the rearing and production of laying boiler breeders and operation of its hatcheries; operation of slaughterhouses for the slaughter and preparation of poultry rabbit and bird meat; land transportation of refrigerated and frozen goods; wholesale of feed and non-pharmaceutical feed additives; and production of chilled and frozen meat poultry rabbits and birds as well as poultry feed. In addition the company is involved in the production of fertilizers from organic materials and potassium fertilizers; construction and renovation of residential and non-residential buildings such as schools hospitals and hotels; pharmaceutical sales agency; and construction of government buildings. The company was formerly known as Balady Poultry Trading Company. Balady Poultry Company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Khamis Mushait the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Israel Land Development - Urban Renewal Ltd
Description: Israel Land Development - Urban Renewal Ltd engages in urban renewal activities. The company was formerly known as Israel Land Development Alpha Ltd and changed its name to Israel Land Development - Urban Renewal Ltd. in February 2019. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Bnei Brak Israel. Israel Land Development - Urban Renewal Ltd is a subsidiary of The Israel land Development Company Ltd.

Name: Hat-San Gemi Insaa Bakim Onarim Deniz Nakliyat Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Hat-San Gemi Insaa Bakim Onarim Deniz Nakliyat Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages building and constructing vessels and steel for marine and land. The company also offers ship repair and maintenance services including sand blasting and painting services; rudder shaft and propeller repair services; cargo and ballast tank treatment services; bow thruster maintenance services; main and auxiliary engine maintenance services; boiler heat exchanger and pump maintenance and repair services; turbocharger and governor overhauling services; electrical works; mechanical works; navigational equipment services; fire and safety system services; BWTS installation services; scrubber system installation services; steel and piping works; and laid up services as well as ship conversion services. In addition it builds and sells floating docks. Hat-San Gemi Insaa Bakim Onarim Deniz Nakliyat Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was founded in 2006 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Hat-San Gemi Insaa Bakim Onarim Deniz Nakliyat Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim  operates as a subsidiary of Pekar Grup Insaat A.S.

Name: Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. engages in the real estate investment and development activities in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates and Egypt. The company operates through Real Estate Hotels and Investment segments. It is involved in commercial real estate activities such as purchase and sale of lands and properties. The company also involved in the establishment acquisition and management of hotels; and tourism activities. In addition it invests in shares and share capital of the companies. Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Damaan Islamic Insurance Company "Beema" (Q.P.S.C.)
Description: Damaan Islamic Insurance Company Beema" (Q.P.S.C.) provides a range of insurance products and services in Qatar. It operates through five business segments: Marine and Aviation; Motor Insurance; Fire & General Accidents; Takaful and Medical insurance; and Investments. The company offers retail insurance products such as motor travel home domestic help accident individual life marine and caravan insurance. It also provides corporate insurance products including group health group life aviation marine hull miscellaneous engineering liability workmen’s compensation and property insurance. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Lusail Qatar."

Name: Bell Equipment Limited
Description: Bell Equipment Limited designs manufactures exports distributes and supports a range of heavy equipment for the mining and quarrying construction forestry agriculture and industry sectors in South Africa Rest of Africa and Europe. It operates through Manufacturing Assembly Logistics and Dealer Sales Operations – South Africa; Manufacturing Assembly Logistics and Dealer Sales Operations – Europe; Direct Sales Operations – South Africa; and Direct Sales Operations – Rest of Africa segments. The company offers articulated dump trucks (ADT) water tankers motor graders tracked carriers and articulated haulers; backhoe skid steer and wheel loaders; compaction; excavators telehandlers and rough terrain forklifts; and crushers screeners and conveyors for the mining and construction industries. It also provides forklifts and versalifts haulage tractors loggers and cane loaders logpro and canepro skoggers slew loaders and timber trucks; telecopic wheel loaders and loadalls; and attachments comprising cross-cut grapples felling and harvesting heads pickaroons and stem and timber grapples for the forestry and agriculture industries. It sells its products under the BELL JCB KOBELCO and FINLAY brands through a network of customer service centers and independent dealers. The company was founded in 1954 and is based in Richards Bay South Africa. Bell Equipment Limited is a subsidiary of I A Bell and Company (Pty) Limited.

Name: Saudi Arabian Refineries Company
Description: Saudi Arabian Refineries Company together with its subsidiary engages in the extraction of crude oil in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company is involved in the construction of refineries and petrochemical plants; buying and selling of lands and real estate; and management and leasing of owned or rented non-residential real estate properties as well as dealing in securities. It also invests in local companies. Saudi Arabian Refineries Company was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: G Collado S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: G Collado S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the manufacture transformation processing purchase sale and distribution of steel products in Mexico. The company provides blueprint products comprising corrugated cast-anti slip claw anti-slip galvanized and painted hot and cold rolled and steel plates as well as black and galvanized boards; and meshes and derivatives such as fence accessories polished and galvanized wire lattices concertinas gabion perforating sheet cyclonic mesh expanded metal structural expanded metal ceiling and gutter and steel grates. It offers pipeline products including galvanized steel conduit square industrial oval industrial rectangular industrial industrial round and standard X pipes as well as structural tube schedules; and construction products such as annealed wires prefabricated castles standard headed nail ladders welded mesh and rods. In addition the company offers commercial profiles including commercial angles channels mon-ten channels squares hollow structural galvanized and painted tubular rectangular tubular round soleras IPR and IPS beam zeta and tee; and damping economizer system. The company was founded in 1949 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Escar Filo Kiralama Hizmetleri A.S.
Description: Escar Filo Kiralama Hizmetleri A.S. provides motor vehicle rental services in Turkey. It offers various services including vehicle delivery financing support roadside assistance tire management backup vehicle door-to-door online fleet reporting and related consulting services as well as insurance brokerage services. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Rainbow Chicken Limited
Description: Rainbow Chicken Limited operates as an integrated chicken/broiler producer in the Republic of South Africa. It processes distributes and markets a range of frozen fresh and further-processed added-value chicken products under the Rainbow Rainbow Ready2Go Rainbow Simply Chicken Rainbow FlavourBurst and Farmer Brown brand names. The company also produces a range of grain-based animal feed products under the Epol and Driehoek Feeds brands. In addition it processes wastewater from chicken processing plants and poultry manure from chicken farms to generate electricity heat and recycled water as well as converts wastewater from the chicken processing plant into biogas. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Irene the Republic of South Africa.

Name: Gipta Ofis Kirtasiye ve Promosyon Ürünleri Imalat Sanayi A.S.
Description: Gipta Ofis Kirtasiye ve Promosyon Ürünleri Imalat Sanayi A.Ş. manufactures and sells notebooks school stationery products office products and promotional products in Turkey and internationally. The company also offers gift boxes and bags. In addition it exports its products primarily to Europe the Balkans and the Middle East. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: ER Group Limited
Description: ER Group Limited operates in agribusiness real estate hospitality and travel logistics finance commerce and manufacturing and technology and energy sectors. It grows sugar cane tea and food crops; and propagate exotic and endemic plants as well as engage in poultry cattle and deer farming activities. The company also offers landscaping services and agro-inputs. In addition it plans develops owns and manages territories malls workplaces and homes in Moka Savannah and Bel Ombre. Further the company owns and operates resort brands; curates leisure guest experiences; and manages aviation and travel services. Additionally it offers courier transport and customs services; and credit fiduciary and leasing services. In addition the company operates car dealerships; and involved in eyewear production retail and building materials activities. Further it operates fibre optic networks IT infrastructure AI cloud solutions and cybersecurity as well as in solar energy systems and energy management business; and support innovation and entrepreneurship through business incubation foresight analysis and investment in venture capital. The company was formerly known as NewENLRogers Limited and changed its name to ER Group Limited in September 2025. ER Group Limited was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Moka Mauritius. ER Group Limited operates as a subsidiary of La Sablonnière Holding Limited.

Name: Grupo Industrial Saltillo S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Industrial Saltillo S.A.B. de C.V. through its subsidiaries engages in the design manufacture sale and marketing of auto parts and housewares in Mexico Europe Asia Spain the Czech Republic Poland Italy and China. It operates through Auto Parts and Home segments. The company offers gray and ductile iron and aluminum components for automotive systems including brakes engines and chassis. It also provides kitchen and tableware items such as vitrified steel and aluminum as well as ceramic tableware for domestic and institutional use. The company sells its products under the Draxton and Cinsa brands. Grupo Industrial Saltillo S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1928 and is based in Saltillo Mexico.

Name: Kuwait Portland Cement Co. K.P.S.C.
Description: Kuwait Portland Cement Co. K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiary National Company for Aggregate Import & Sale W.L.L trades in construction materials in Kuwait. It operates through Cement Steel Aggregate and Ready Mix; and Investments segments. The company is involved in the import and sale of aggregates; transportation of liquids liquid gases chemicals and solid and liquid waste; extraction reprocessing and packaging of sand; processing of construction waste; processing and disposal of non-hazardous wastes; warehousing and storage; chemical storage; retail sale of construction materials and scraps; and gravel crusher activities. It also distributes ready-mixed concrete cement gypsum bricks tiles ceramics marbles building materials metallic construction materials plumbing and heating supplies sand gravel steel blacksmithing supplies and related materials and equipment; and holds properties and movable assets. Kuwait Portland Cement Co. K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Fitaihi Holding Group
Description: Fitaihi Holding Group provides gold jewelry and luxury products primarily in Saudi Arabia. The company offers gifts crystal and silverware products antiques household utensils chinaware textiles leather goods watches chocolates bed-linen toilet sets and accessories as well as men’s women’s and children’s wear products as well as handicraft bags blankets sheets bedspreads sweets carpets rugs handicrafts cutting tools and ceramics. In addition the company engages in the cleaning and operation of factories companies buildings and shops; and offers air conditioner machinery equipment vehicle and device maintenance; and commercial services as well as export and marketing services. Name: QLM Life & Medical Insurance Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: QLM Life & Medical Insurance Company Q.P.S.C. operates as a life and medical insurance company in Qatar. It operates through two segments: Medical and Life. The company offers group and individual and group medical insurance; retirement and child insurance plans; and senior citizens and visitors mandatory health insurance. It also underwrites reinsurance products in the GCC region and internationally. QLM Life & Medical Insurance Company Q.P.S.C. was founded in 2011 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Cairo For Investment And Real Estate Developments-CIRA Education
Description: Cairo For Investment And Real Estate Developments-CIRA Education together with its subsidiaries operates as an integrated provider of educational services in Egypt. It operates through School and Higher Education segments. The company offers K-12 and higher education services. It owns and operates K-12 schools under the Mavericks BCCIS Saxony International School Regent International School Futures Futures Language Schools and Rising Stars brands; and nurseries under the KidzGround STEAMulation and Discovery Campus brands. The company also provides transport services to students. Cairo For Investment And Real Estate Developments-CIRA Education was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Societe d'Equipement Domestique et Menager (EQDOM) S.A
Description: Societe d'Equipement Domestique et Menager (EQDOM) S.A provides financing solutions in Morocco. It offers financing solutions for personal automobile journey and life events. Name: Holmes Place International Ltd
Description: Holmes Place International Ltd manages and operates health and fitness clubs under the Holmes Place brands. The company also operates wellness spa and nutritionists related services. The company was founded in 1979 and is based in Or Akiva Israel.

Name: Ilex Medical Ltd

Its Logistics division offers solutions for the handling conservation marketing and distribution of merchandise; merchandise collection delivery and selection; and inventory control packaging and labeling crossing platform and other services. Accel S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Phoenix Beverages Limited
Description: Phoenix Beverages Limited an investment holding company engages in production and sale of alcoholic and non-alcoholic products in Mauritius and internationally. It offers beers wines and spirits carbonated soft drinks energy health drinks ready to drinks bottled water table water and other beverages. The company also operates as the authorized bottler of the products of The Coca-Cola Company in Mauritius such as Coca-Cola Fanta Sprite Schweppes Dasani and Crystal table water. In addition it manufactures and sells glass-made products. Further the company engages in the property holding; and distribution of beverages and other commodities. It distributes its products to retail and wholesale customers. Phoenix Beverages Limited was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Phoenix Mauritius.ius.

Name: Emtel Limited
Description: Emtel Limited provides information and communications technology services in Mauritius. The company operates through the Telecommunication Business Fintech Digital Solution Space Economy Business And Media Business segments. It offers mobile telephony fixed telephone broadband and enterprise solutions; subscription television services through satellite and internet platforms; fintech mobile payment applications; prepaid and postpaid recharge roaming voice and SMS packs and bill payment services; value-added services; other services including eSIM VoLTE international calling and retrieve services; and mobile data 5G devices as well as data centers and cloud services business communication and network and security services. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Ebene Mauritius. Emtel Limited is a subsidiary of Currimjee Jeewanjee & Co. Ltd.

Name: Neto M.E Holdings Ltd
Description: Neto M.E Holdings Ltd. produces processes imports markets and distributes a range of food products in Israel. The company offers frozen refrigerated fresh and processed meat including chicken and turkey; grilled meat products such as hamburgers kebabs steaks sausages skewers and others; ground meat products comprising beef lamb and veal; and meat products for cooking such as calf goulash roasted veal faux-filet kishke and roast beef as well as instant meals including shawarma readymade schnitzel chicken rings and others under the Tibon Veal brand.
