Further the company operates grill restaurant chain under the El Gaucho brand name. Neto M.E Holdings Ltd. was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Kiryat Malakhi Israel.

Name: The Saudi Arabian Amiantit Company
Description: The Saudi Arabian Amiantit Company together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells various pipes and related products in Saudi Arabia. The company offers ductile iron pipes and fitting products and pipe fittings; glass reinforced plastic glass reinforced vinyl ester and glass reinforced epoxy products pipes tanks manholes spools and fittings for water chemical and wastewater applications; and licenses related technologies. It also provides ductile iron valve products gate butterfly air control check and hydraulic valves; high density polyethylene products solid pipes and corrugated pipes; and rubber products such as rubber rings and seals ariflix tank track pads rubber spiders and o- rings as well as customized rubber solutions for construction HVAC and defense sectors. In addition the company offers design engineering and implementation services comprising full scale system installation; testing and commissioning services for installed systems; site consulting support and supervision services; supply usage and training on specialized equipment; electro-mechanical design and project execution including pipeline and tank design stress analysis and life assessments; and fiberglass piping installations for industries such as power desalination petrochemicals and infrastructure. Further the company provides water management services including related consultancy engineering and operations. It serves water infrastructure oil and gas industries. The Saudi Arabian Amiantit Company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Dammam Saudi Arabia.

Name: Izmir Demir Çelik Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Izmir Demir Çelik Sanayi Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in the production marketing and sale of iron and steel in Turkey and internationally. It is also involved in the energy production and trading; and ship production and operation activities as well as provision of port and harbor services. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Izmir Turkey. Izmir Demir Çelik Sanayi Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Sahin Koc Celik Sanayi A.S.

Name: Besler Gida Ve Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Besler Gida Ve Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces and trades in frozen and canned products in Turkey. The company operates through Frozen and Canned and Edible Oil segments. The company offers bakery products frozen vegetables and fruit potatoes and croquettes meat products and canned; consumer margarine; oils for pastry catering and industrial products; and cooking fats and spread cheese. It offers its products primarily under Superfresh brand and other brands. The company also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Kerevitas Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Besler Gida Ve Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi in May 2025. The company was founded in 1970 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Besler Gida Ve Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Yildiz Holding A.S.

Name: Consorcio ARA S. A. B. de C. V.
Description: Consorcio ARA S. A. B. de C. V. together with its subsidiaries engages in designing promoting building and selling housing developments in Mexico. The company builds urban infrastructure and facilities for its housing developments including streets parks water supply systems power plants schools and commercial areas. It is involved in building and leasing shopping centers single centers and mini shopping centers as well as operating real estate projects. Consorcio ARA S. A. B. de C. V. was founded in 1977 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Bahrain Islamic Bank B.S.C.
Description: Bahrain Islamic Bank B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides various banking products and services in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates in three segments: Corporate Retail and Investment. The company offers current salary cheque savings call vevo RERA escrow and investment accounts; investment deposits; financing products such as personal property Ministry of Housing programs auto working capital capital expenditure enterprise export Bahrain special project and short and long-term financing as well as specialized trade financing instruments. It also provides debit and credit cards; remittances and foreign exchange transactions drafts and managerial cheques cash management and trade finance services; interbank tools and investment and hedging instruments; and payroll wealth management investment banking and custody services. In addition the company offers online and mobile banking automated and interactive teller machine services and bulk cash deposit machines; and money market trading and treasury services as well as handles debt and equity investments; and invests in real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain. Bahrain Islamic Bank B.S.C. is a subsidiary of The National Bank of Bahrain B.S.C.

Name: Saudi Industrial Development Co.
Description: Saudi Industrial Development Co. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells sanitary wares and sponge products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Arab Republic of Egypt. It operates through Mattresses and Sponges; Sanitary Ware; Transportation; Financial Investments; and Other segments. The company offers various pressures and structures of mattresses and beds and its accessories; sanitary ware comprising wash basins showers toilets etc.; wall tiles ceramic flooring and acrylic bathtubs; furniture products from wood; upholstery furniture products; and sist and sponge mattresses. It also engages in the wholesale and retail sale of home furniture and other furniture products; blankets sheets linens and bedspreads; heaters and water tanks; and chairs sinks and devices for saunas. In addition the company acts as a sales agent for furniture and household goods; and rents and manages owned or leased residential and non-residential real estate properties. Further. it is involved in the road transportation of goods and equipment. Saudi Industrial Development Co. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Tourism Enterprise Company (Shams)
Description: Tourism Enterprise Company (Shams) engages in managing of tourism projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company manages hotels furnished residential units chalets tourist inns resorts wedding halls and events. It also manages camps restaurants coffee shops cafeterias and tourist accommodation facilities. In addition the company operates entertainment centers and facilities amusement parks and other recreational activities as well as rents bicycles. Further it owns and operates the Palm Beach Resort. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Industrias del Cobre Sociedad Anónima
Description: Industrias del Cobre Sociedad Anónima engages in the manufacture and sale of wires and electrical and telecommunication cables and conductors in Peru and internationally. The company offers low voltage conductors cords fire safety cables and bare copper conductors; and low voltage aerial distribution cables medium voltage low fire hazard sheathed cables medium voltage PVC sheathed cables medium voltage PE sheathed cables and bare conductors. It also provides mining cables such as medium voltage cables for fixed installations and low voltage infrastructure cables; and cables for solar farms and rooftops. The company was incorporated in 1952 and is based in Lima Peru. Industrias del Cobre Sociedad Anónima operates as a subsidiary of Invercable S.A.

Name: SHUAA Capital PSC
Description: SHUAA Capital PSC together with its subsidiaries provides various investment and financial services in the United Arab Emirates and the Gulf Cooperation Council markets. It operates in three segments: Asset Management Investment banking and Corporate. The Asset Management segment manages real estate funds and projects; and investment portfolios and funds in regional equities fixed income and credit markets. This segment offers investment solutions to clients. Its Investment Banking segment provides corporate finance and mergers and acquisitions advisory services; transaction services; private placements; public offerings of equity and debt securities; structured investments; and other products as well as creates market liquidity OTC fixed income products. The Corporate segment manages principal investments non-core assets corporate developments treasury and other shared services. It offers investment advisory and management project management financial securities trading consultancy and development management services; and is involved in commercial and real estate investment activities and establishment and management of enterprises. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Mopas Marketcilik Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Mopas Marketcilik Gida Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi sells various consumer products through physical and online stores. It offers fruits and vegetables; red/white meat; milk cheese butter margarine olive bakery products cream sauce yogurt egg milk dessert ice cream and breakfast products; detergent and cleaning products; and legumes pasta salt spice biscuits and snacks gums and candy frozen food oil chocolate and wafer coup and bouillon ready meals canned foods tomato paste and healthy living products. The company also provides fizz daily drink mineral water tea and coffee and still drinks; paper products wax depilatory oral care shaving facial care perfume and deodorant health hair care shower bathroom and body hand care products as well as makeup materials accessories; kitchenware utensils electrical electronics personal interest entertainment and pet products; baby care ready meal food diaper and toys; organic foods; and soups cuisine snacks and rice pasta. It also sells its products through website mopas.com.tr and the mobile application MOPAS. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: United Capital Plc
Description: United Capital Plc together with its subsidiaries provides investment banking portfolio management securities trading and trusteeship services in Nigeria. It operates through Investment Banking Asset Management Wealth Management Trustees Securities Trading Consumer Finance and UCEE MFB segments. The company offers issuing house corporate investment advisory project finance debt restructuring mergers and acquisitions asset management wealth management and debt capital market services. It also provides trust services such as debenture trust; bond trusteeship to corporate and sub-sovereign issuers of public debt instruments; trustees to collective investment schemes; and private and security trusts. In addition the company offers pay day loans and consumer lending; stockbroking; and securities trading services including receiving agents to new issues stockbrokers to primary issues and advisers to SMEs as well as equity portfolio management and securities dealing services. It serves governments; micro small and medium scale enterprises; institutions; high net worth individuals; and other individuals. The company was formerly known as UBA Capital PLC and changed its name to United Capital Plc in December 2014. United Capital Plc was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Kafrit Industries (1993) Ltd
Description: Kafrit Industries (1993) Ltd offers customized masterbatches and compounds in Israel China Germany Canada and internationally. The company provides masterbatches and compounds for agricultural films polycarbonate and PMMA sheets antioxidants BOPE and BOPP films injection molding and extrusion-blow molding fibers and nonwoven products and pipes and sheets. It offers masterbatches for polyethylene films such as bubble films electronic packaging films injection- and extrusion-blow molding foamed films films for food packaging greenhouse films film packaging industrial films and industrial packaging films; a range of peel compounds under the CONSTAB name; and Ecocell a combination of additives in a pelletized polymer base. Kafrit Industries (1993) Ltd was founded in 1973 and is based in Sha’ar Hanegev Israel.

Name: Canal Shipping Agencies Company
Description: Canal Shipping Agencies Company provides various shipping services to the international commercial fleet in Egypt. It offers shipping services on Suez Canal transit Port Said Ports Red Sea Al-Arish and Damietta. The company also provides services including canal tourism freight forwarding sailors and parcel cargo handling and spare parts as well as legal services comprising marine insurance settlement of marine general average and collision and other related legal services. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Port Said Egypt. Canal Shipping Agencies Company is a subsidiary of The Holding Company for Maritime and Land Transport.

Name: Al Imtiaz Investment Group Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Al Imtiaz Investment Group Company - K.S.C. (Public) an investment holding company manages a portfolio of investments across various sectors in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Financial Services (Real Estate) Pharma Education Food and Beverage IT Solutions and Oil and Construction segments. The company invests in real estate industrial agriculture and other sectors; buys and sells in shares sukuk and other securities; develops the infrastructure of residential commercial and industrial areas; and manages real estate facilities by built operate and transfer system. It also invests in financial real estate and investment portfolios; and provides lending and guarantee services. In addition the company deals and trades in the foreign exchange and precious metals market. Further it owns property rights patents trademarks or industrial models franchising rights and other intangible rights. Additionally the company engages in real estate media general trading investment and educational catering services; and provision of IT professional audio visual and enterprise software solutions to public and private sectors as well as specialized graduate studies. It also offers grinding and packaging of spices grains and herbs; provides oil and construction services; and branded generic pharmaceuticals. The company was formerly known as Al Imtiaz Investment Company - K.S.C. (Public). Al Imtiaz Investment Group Company - K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: KAP Limited
Description: KAP Limited engages in industrial chemical and logistics businesses in South Africa rest of Africa the Americas Europe the Middle East and Australasia. It operates through six segments: PG Bison Safripol Unitrans Feltex Sleep Group and Optix. It manufactures and sells polyethylene terephthalate high-density polyethylene and polypropylene products. In addition the company offers foam sprung fabric and industrial foams and mattresses as well as provides technology-enabled driver behaviour management solutions. The company also operates timber plantations a sawmill a pole plant and production facilities for wood-based decorative panel products. It serves automotive components consumer agriculture petrochemical mining and passenger transport sectors. KAP Limited was formerly known as KAP Industrial Holdings Limited and changed its name to KAP Limited in April 2023. KAP Limited is headquartered in Stellenbosch South Africa.

Name: Khaleeji Bank B.S.C.
Description: Khaleeji Bank B.S.C. provides various banking products and services to retail customers corporate clients high net worth individuals and financial institutions in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates through two segments Banking and Investments. The company offers various corporate and retail banking products and services that include Mudharaba deposits savings current term deposits and salary accounts; and fund transfer and bill payment services as well as money market and treasury services. It also provides personal home auto real estate and consumer finance products; letters of credit; wealth management services; structured investment products; project financing; debit and credit cards; doctors financing scheme; SIO finance; insurance products; SME financing; and online and mobile banking services. In addition the company offers investment banking products and services such as deals structuring raising of funds through private placement and fund administration services; and carries out strategic investments in the form of equity contribution as well as engages in the construction and selling of properties and issuing additional tier 1 certificates. It provides its products and services through branches located in Bahrain Financial Harbor Hidd Sanad and Riffa. The company was formerly known as Khaleeji Commercial Bank BSC and changed its name to Khaleeji Bank B.S.C. in June 2023. Khaleeji Bank B.S.C. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain. Khaleeji Bank B.S.C. is a subsidiary of GFH Financial Group BSC.

Name: Voltamp Energy SAOG
Description: Voltamp Energy SAOG together with its subsidiaries manufactures distributes and sells transformers medium and low voltage switchgears and panels in the Sultanate of Oman. It offers power transformers; corrugated type special duty hermetically sealed type solar inverter duty and earthing transformers; motor duty booster isolation and furnace transformers; solar power green energy and wind transformers as well as solar skid solutions; and dry type distribution transformers. The company also provides package sub-station solutions; reactors; and MV and LV switchgears as well as repair overhauling and maintenance services of transformers and switchgears for utilities oil and gas companies power plants industrial and government sectors etc. It offers its products for various applications including power generation and distribution power transmission infrastructure renewable offshore and railway. The company also exports its products. Voltamp Energy SAOG was founded in 1987 and is based in Rusayl the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Libra Insurance Company Ltd
Description: Libra Insurance Company Ltd engages in the general insurance business in Israel. The company offers c compulsory motor and property motor insurance; and apartments businesses pet travel insurance products; and life insurance products. Libra Insurance Company Ltd was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Holon Israel.

Name: Irbid District Electricity Co. Ltd.
Description: Irbid District Electricity Co. Ltd. engages in the distribution of electric power in Jordan. It serves retail consumers. The company was founded in 1957 and is based in Irbid Jordan. Irbid District Electricity Co. Ltd. is a subsidiary of Electricity Distribution Company.

Name: Siniora Food Industries Company
Description: Siniora Food Industries Company engages in the canning packaging distribution and trading of chilled meat in Jordan. The company is involved in the retail of cold cuts frozen products canned products and plant-based products as well as Horeca cold cuts and frozen products; peppers spices olives pistachios and vegetables; chicken and turkey; and luncheon meat salami and sausages under the Siniora UNIUM Polanez Almasa and BADEEL brand names. It exports its products to Palestine Syria Lebanon Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates Kuwait Qatar Oman Yemen and Bahrain. The company was founded in 1920 and is based in Sahab Jordan. Siniora Food Industries Company is a subsidiary of Arab Palestinian Investment Company.

Name: Companhia CELG de Participações S/A
Description: Companhia CELG de Participações S/A engages in the generation of electricity. It generates electricity from hydro power plants. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Goiânia Brazil.

Name: Banan Real Estate Company
Description: Banan Real Estate Company owns and leases residential and non-residential properties in Saudi Arabia. It operates and manages hotel apartments; manages real estate on commission basis; and provides real estate registration services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Watt's S.A.
Description: Watt's S.A. manufactures and sells food products in Chile Argentina Peru and Internationally. It operates in Food Business and Wine Business segments. The company offers liquid and powdered milk dairy beverages oils jams preserves creams manjar juices and nectars yogurt cheese butter fruit pulp tomato sauce frozen vegetables and fruits fruit-based beverages and dairy-based beverages. It also owns and operates wine-producing valleys. The company sells its products under the Calo Sureña Loncoleche Danone Activia Danone Light & Free Oikos San Rafael Las Parcelas de Valdivia Calan Crucina Astra and Watt's Frugo Yogu Yogu Shake a Shake Danone Griego FRUTOS DEL MAIPO La Reina SANTA CAROLINA Dampezzo Frito Master Plus Gastonomico Pamperita Mazola Los Lagos Regimel Chef Belmont Cristal and Wasil brands. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in San Bernardo Chile. Watt's S.A. is a subsidiary of Chacabuco S.A.

Name: Sonol Real Estate And Investments Ltd
Description: Sonol Real Estate And Investments Ltd engages in leasing acquisition initiation management development and enhancement of handline assets in Israel. Its assets include retail and trade logistics complexes and storage and fuel distribution; and fueling complexes including gas stations and convenience stores as well as associated uses such as car wash car and catering services. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Netanya Israel. Sonol Real Estate And Investments Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Sonol Israel Ltd.

Name: National Finance Company SAOG
Description: National Finance Company SAOG offers financial products and services to individuals small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and corporate entities in the Sultanate of Oman. The company provides corporate deposits; and new and used vehicles used vehicles consumer durables equipment and warehouse financing services as well as working capital debt factoring guarantee and sale and lease back services as well as green finance service. It operates through its branches in the Sultanate of Oman. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: S.R. Accord Ltd.
Description: S.R. Accord Ltd. provides credit and non-bank financing services in Israel. The company offers cashing check real estate financing bridging loans and line of credit; financing for infrastructure projects renewal and growth and public companies; guarantees for project execution; and currency services; as well as business financial support services. It serves corporations licensed dealers partnerships and businessmen. The company was formerly known as Shrem Fudim Group Ltd. and changed its name to S.R. Accord Ltd. in December 2010. S.R. Accord Ltd. was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Ramla Israel.

Name: alBaraka Bank Egypt S.A.E.
Description: alBaraka Bank Egypt S.A.E. provides corporate and retail banking and investments services in Egypt and internationally. The company offers savings and current accounts certificate of deposits and time deposits; debit and credit cards; and personal mortgage auto education and other financing products. It also provides corporate banking products such as financing channels structured finance and syndication investment and securities custody and clearing corporate service desk global transactional banking; financing of small medium enterprise; and commercial activities medical program and Izdehar. In addition the company offers banking services such as payroll exchange rates investment funds investment trustees custodian services financial inclusion international limit Tharaa and schedule of charge. Further it provides internet banking mobile banking and ATMs network services. The company was formerly known as Egyptian Saudi Finance Bank and changed its name to alBaraka Bank Egypt S.A.E. in April 2009. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in New Cairo Egypt. alBaraka Bank Egypt S.A.E. is a subsidiary of Al Baraka Group B.S.C.

Name: Al Eid Food Company K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Al Eid Food Company K.S.C. (Public) engages in the import distribution and trade of food products in Kuwait. It supplies bee honey; and offers food stuff real-made meals and vegetable products. The company was formerly known as ALEid Company for General Trading and Contracting WLL. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Al Eid Food Company K.S.C. (Public) is a subsidiary of Dalqan Holding Company K.S.C. (Holding).

Name: São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações S.A.
Description: São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. operates as a real estate investment and management company in Brazil. The company is involved in management of own or third-party real estate developments including shopping malls centers; purchase and sale of ready-made or under-construction residential and commercial properties; leasing of real estate; and operation of rotating parking. Its portfolio includes office buildings and convenience centers. São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Autopistas Del Sol SA
Description: Autopistas Del Sol SA is involved in the construction expansion remodeling preservation improvement operation and administration of highways. It operates the North Access a 95-kilometer highway that connects the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires with the suburbs in the north and nearby coastal areas; and the General Paz Beltway highway a 24-kilometer toll-free section of the primary ring road that surrounds the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: JTC Logistics Transportation & Stevedoring Co. K.S.C.P.
Description: JTC Logistics Transportation & Stevedoring Co. K.S.C.P. provides ports management warehousing contract logistics equipment leasing and power rental services in Kuwait and rest of GCC. The company offers container handling RORO heavy lift break bulk vessels and aggregate cargo handling; handling of container terminal and general cargo; transportation; reefer plugging facility; and value added services including weighbridge general transportation and project logistics and advanced ERP management system. It also provides bulk transportation and customs clearance support services and turnkey solutions; temperature controlled warehouses client warehouse management system and inventory management; equipment leasing services including cranes heavy lift material handling equipment portable welding machines screw compressors tower lights man lifts excavators and wheel loaders; and power rental services such as diesel generators transformers fuel tanks power accessories as well as value added services comprising engineering design and consulting installation and commissioning project management and maintenance and support services. In addition the company is involved in buys sells rents hires and imports trucks vehicles and equipment and machinery; clearance shipping and stevedoring operations for imported and issued goods and packaging goods; and ground support services for passengers as well as airport management services for aircraft and aviation-related goods. The company was formerly known as Jassim Transport & Stevedoring Company K.S.C.P. and changed its name to JTC Logistics Transportation & Stevedoring Co. K.S.C.P. in November 2024. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: INMAR Company
Description: INMAR Company engages in establishing and owning real estate properties in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It manages and leases owned or leased residential and non-residential properties. The company also undertakes real estate management activities. INMAR Company was formerly known as Enma Al Rawabi Company and changed its name to INMAR Company in September 2025. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya PLC
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya PLC markets and sells of petroleum products and energy solutions in Kenya and internationally. The company offers excellium fuels and kerosene; and petrol diesel lubricants and car care products. It also provides liquefied petroleum gas and solar lanterns through service stations and authorized distributor outlets. In addition the company offers logistics and facilities services; and car wash and care services. Further it operates a convenience shop under the Bonjour brand name that provides various products and services including banks ATMs chemists dry cleaners barber shops florists and restaurants in collaboration with other third-party partners; and coffee shops under the café bonjour Java on the go Java Express Art Caffe’ to Go and Mugg & Bean names as well as service bay stations with trained mechanics under the Quartz Auto service name and TotalEnergies Card a fleet management solution for fleet managers. It also exports its products. TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya PLC was formerly known as Total Kenya Plc and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya PLC in July 2021. The company was founded in 1955 and is based in Nairobi Kenya. TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya PLC operates as a subsidiary of TotalEnergies Marketing Afrique SAS.

Name: Central Costanera S.A.
Description: Central Costanera S.A. generates transports trades and distributes electrical energy in Argentina. It owns and operates four conventional turbo steam units with an installed capacity of 661 MW; two cycles energy plant with an installed capacity of 851 MW; a gas turbine; and a BTH steam turbine with an installed capacity of 277 MW. The company provides engineering consultancy and management services for operation of electrical power plants. The company was formerly known as Enel Generación Costanera S.A. and changed its name to Central Costanera S.A. in March 2023. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. The company operates as a subsidiary of Enel Argentina S.A.

Name: Misr Hotels Company
Description: Misr Hotels Company engages in the tourism and hotel business in Egypt. The company constructs buys and sells hotels resorts casinos and restaurants. It operates the Nile Ritz Carlton Hotel in Cairo; and the Safir Dahab Resort Hotel in Dahab. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc
Description: The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc engages in the transmission distribution and retail of electricity in Kenya. It purchases electricity generated from geothermal hydro thermal solar cogeneration and wind sources. The company was formerly known as East Africa Power & Lighting Limited and changed its name to The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc in October 1983. The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc was incorporated in 1922 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Ofis Yem Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Ofis Yem Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells feeds for the livestock sector in Turkey. It offers ovine calf fattening milk and poultry feeds under the Ofis Yem brand. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Oncoclínicas do Brasil Serviços Médicos S.A.
Description: Oncoclínicas do Brasil Serviços Médicos S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides oncology hematology radiotherapy and genomics healthcare services in Latin America. The company offers treatment services including radiotherapy hormone therapy immunotherapy port-a-cath palliative care target therapy breast cancer hormone therapy bone marrow transplant non-oncological infusions chemotherapy oral chemotherapy and prostate cancer hormone therapy; and surgery procedures such as breast head and neck lung prostate cancer stomach bladder cancer oncological kidney cancer gynecological and testicular cancer. It also provides diagnostics services comprising pathological analysis genetic testing molecular journey personalized medicine and individualized treatment myelogram-bone marrow biopsy and ONCO test-PDO. In addition the company offers treatment support services which include veinviewer cryotherapy integrative medicine and DeLife as well as hilotherapy laser therapy OC care line OC precision medicine OncoACCESS survivorship and telemedicine services. Oncoclínicas do Brasil Serviços Médicos S.A. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Socovesa S.A.
Description: Socovesa S.A. engages in the real estate development and construction businesses under the Almagro Socovesa Pilares and Desarrollos Comerciales brands in Chile. The company constructs various projects such as houses buildings bridges roads dams irrigation works tunnels ports airports and earthworks. It also develops high-rise housing projects. Socovesa S.A. was founded in 1965 and is based in Providencia Chile.

Name: Karsan Otomotiv Sanayii ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Karsan Otomotiv Sanayii ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of automotives and related vehicles and spare parts in Turkey and internationally. The company provides passenger cars trucks minivans autonomous bus and electric and diesel busses. It also offers after-sales marketing and financial leasing services. The company sells its products under the JEST ATAK and STAR brand names. Karsan Otomotiv Sanayii ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Bursa Turkey. The company operates as a subsidiary of Kıraça Holding A.Ş.

Name: Easy Lease Motor Cycle Rental P.S.C.
Description: Easy Lease Motor Cycle Rental P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the trading rental and repairing of motorcycles in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. It operates through five segments: Motorcycle Business; Delivery Services; Marine Sports Club; Event Management; Logistics and Freight Forwarding; and Mobility and Others. The Motorcycle Business segment offers motorcycle leasing solutions and related items including delivery boxes. The Delivery Services segment provides turnkey logistic solutions through bike messengers and delivery squads. The Marine Sports Club segment engages in managing marine sports club and wholesale trade of ships and boats. The Event Management segment organizes exhibitions fashion shows conferences and seminars and auctions and ripe market events. The Logistics and Freight Forwarding segment provides transportation cargo handling warehousing freight clearing marine and air shipment and specialized oil and gas field services. The Mobility and Others segment offers limousine services bus on demand vehicle rental recovery services electric vehicles charging car parking IT services railway infrastructure and train spare parts and security system trading. The company is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Bonei Hatichon Civil Engineering & Infrastructures Ltd.
Description: Bonei Hatichon Civil Engineering & Infrastructures Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Israel. It develops markets and manages residential commercial and luxury buildings. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Bnei Brak Israel.

Name: Manazel PJSC
Description: Manazel PJSC together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate business in the United Arab Emirates. It invests in develops constructs manages and sells residential commercial retail. The company is involved in purchase and development of properties for resale or lease; properties management and brokerage; facility management services; district cooling; management services; public security guarding services; express delivery services and parcels documents and instruments delivery and letter-post dispatches delivery; and buildings maintenance. It is also engages in entertainment enterprises investment institution and management buildings cleaning services central air-conditioners maintenance electrical fittings and fixtures services and landscape and gardening services; land and real estate purchase and sale real estate lease and management services; commercial complex; building projects contracting; management of medical facilities; architectural engineering consultancy; cinema; cold and hot beverages and snack selling; sports academy; real estate enterprises investment development institution and management; and recreational services and hospitality services. The company was formerly known as Manazel Real Estate PJSC and changed its name to Manazel PJSC in July 2019. Manazel PJSC was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: National Environmental Recycling Company
Description: National Environmental Recycling Company recycles electronic and electrical equipment in Asia Middle East Japan and Europe. It engages in the in the wholesale of waste scrap and materials for recycling including collection classification segregation stripping storage and delivery. The company is also involved in the import export wholesale and retail trade of scrap copper aluminum plastic spare parts tires glass and iron. The company was founded in 2015 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Aljazira Takaful Taawuni Company
Description: Aljazira Takaful Taawuni Company provides various insurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through three segments: Non- Life Individual Life and Group Life. The company offers medical care to the members of organizations and their dependents on a group basis and individuals in a wide network of hospitals and medical centers; third-party liability vehicle insurance products which covers the amounts payable to third parties by the insured; and vehicle comprehensive insurance product which covers all losses or damages incurred to the vehicle including third party liability; and fire and property marine engineering other liability insurance contracts and other insurance products. It also provides life insurance products which include unit-linked investment-oriented products to individual basis; and life protection programs to the members of organizations on a group basis as well as credit protection benefits in respect of personal loan given by financing organization. In addition the company offers protection benefits in respect of various credit facilities other than personal loans extended by the financing organizations to its customers. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Hermes Transportes Blindados S.A.
Description: Hermes Transportes Blindados S.A. provides money and securities transfer custody and processing and document transfer services in Peru. The company offers sending and collecting banknotes coins precious metals jewelry and other high-value items to and/or from the requested destination; prepare and transfer the banknotes to supply the indicated ATM; administration of premises and agencies; vault management; and specialized services for mining sector. It also provides Hermeticase a device that allows receiving validating accounting for deposits made viewing movements online and generating reports for accounting closings. In addition the company offers corporate messaging services including transport of documents and national packages local distribution internal messaging and custody of documents and back ups; business processing services such as digitization and digitalization of documents verification and validation attention to commercial requirements accounting registration and analysis of invoices and card insertion services. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Chorrillos Peru. Hermes Transportes Blindados S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Maiz Jersey Limited.

Name: Bikurey Hasade Group Ltd
Description: Bikurey Hasade (Holdings) Ltd. engages in growing marketing and distributing fresh vegetables and fruits in Israel and internationally. The company also provides various shipping and collection solutions for agricultural produce from the growers at a controlled temperature; multi-purpose plastic packaging and pallet services; and accounting services for the agricultural field personal treatment and close accompaniment. Bikurey Hasade (Holdings) Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Kiryat Malakhi Israel.

Name: Telekom Networks Malawi plc
Description: Telekom Networks Malawi plc provides telecommunication services to enterprises and individual customers in Malawi. It operates in two segments Telecommunications and Mobile Money. The company provides a range of communication products and services including voice internet access bundles international dialing and roaming and value-added services as well as prepaid tariff plans. It also offers prepaid data international incoming messaging enterprise business postpaid and roaming services. In addition the company provides internet and virtual private network; session initiation protocol and PBX; home broadband; hosting; managed cloud; mobile phone contracts; mobile advertising; and 5G solutions as well as communications solutions to small and medium enterprises. Further it offers a range of mobile money services including money transfers cash withdrawals bill payments cash deposits and merchant payments. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Blantyre Malawi.

Name: Shemen Yielding Real Estate Ltd
Description: Shemen Yielding Real Estate Ltd engages in leasing real estate properties to various tenants in Israel. The company was formerly known as Shemen Industries Ltd and changed its name to Shemen Yielding Real Estate Ltd in May 2023. Shemen Yielding Real Estate Ltd was incorporated in 1945 and is based in Haifa Israel.

Name: Kuwait Business Town Real Estate Company - KPSC
Description: Kuwait Business Town Real Estate Company - KPSC engages in real estate business in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates the United States and Europe. The company operates through Investment and Real Estate segments. It develops owns purchase and sale real estate and lands; and shares and bonds of real estate entities. The company also offers maintenance works execution of civil mechanical electrical elevators and air conditioning works to ensure protection and safety of buildings as well as consultancy services. In addition it manages operates invests in rents and leases hotels clubs motels guest houses parks gardens showrooms restaurants cafeterias housing complexes touristic and health resorts recreational and athletic projects and stores with auxiliary services accompanying facilities and other services; and commercial malls and residential complexes. In addition the company establishes and manages real estate funds; invests surplus fund available with company by investing in financial and real estate portfolios; contributes to the development of infrastructure of areas and residential commercial and industrial projects using build-operate-transfer system and manages through it; and holds real estate auctions. Kuwait Business Town Real Estate Company - KPSC was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Carthage Cement SA
Description: Carthage Cement SA manufactures and markets hydraulic binders in Tunisia. The company offers Portland cement Portland high sulfate resistance cement clinker and artificial hydraulic lime. It is also involved in the exploitation production and marketing of aggregates including gravel run material ballast and cement blocks source rock and sharp sand; and production and marketing of ready-mixed concrete. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Jordan Commercial Bank
Description: Jordan Commercial Bank provides banking and financial products and services to corporate retail and investment clients in Jordan and internationally. The company offers deposit products such as fixed deposit certificate of deposit and current accounts; personal housing and auto loans; debit credit and pre-paid cards; electronic payment services; and safe deposit boxes fast cash salary advance Tejari express and autosave services. It also provides financing for restaurants; fixed assets and working capital; renewable energy educational industrial IT architectural and entrepreneurs start-up projects; and point of sale financing as well as business loans. In addition the company offers overdraft revolving loans discounted bills term loans letters of credit letter of guarantee bills for collection and export loans; and liabilities and cash management services. Further it offers investment services such as cash dealing margin trading custody services investment management financial consultancy issue management trust services and safekeeping services; and spot and forward foreign currency trading services. The company operates through its branches and ATMs. Jordan Commercial Bank was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Société Tunisienne de Banque Société anonyme
Description: Société Tunisienne de Banque Société anonyme provides financial services to individuals professionals and enterprises in Tunisia and internationally. The company offers checking savings and current accounts; certificates of deposit; and direct credit savings and auto loans housing credit and home savings loans computer loans study savings loans investment credit and real estate credit financing services as well as financing services for professional projects and an operating cycle. It also provides online and mobile banking phone recharge cards commercial papers and treasury as well as bancassurance services. In addition the company offers documentary credits import/export import/export documentary discount credit for the mobilization of credit issues abroad extended change SWAP allowance for business travel professional currency accounts domiciliation of a foreign trade and export prefinancing services. Société Tunisienne de Banque Société anonyme was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Pesquera Exalmar S.A.A.
Description: Pesquera Exalmar S.A.A. operates in the fishery sector in Peru and internationally. The company offers frozen giant squid jack mackerel mackerel and anchovy for direct human consumption. It also provides indirect human consumption products such as fishmeal that is used for animal breeding in livestock sheep and porcine industry as well as in aquaculture; and fish oil which is used in the aquaculture industry as well as for human consumption as health supplement capsules. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Lima Peru. Pesquera Exalmar S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Caleta de Oro Holding del Perú S.A.C.

Name: Jordanian Duty Free Shops
Description: Jordanian Duty Free Shops invests in operates and manages duty-free shops. Its shops provide a range of products which include fragrances cosmetics accessories confectionary liquors cigarettes and tobacco products for diplomats non-residential foreigners tourists businessmen and pilgrims. Jordanian Duty Free Shops was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A.
Description: Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. provides stock over the counter markets services for equity fixed income derivative and foreign exchange services in Colombia. The company offers listing services to issuer and issues; trading services through electronic trading and recording platforms; post trading services which consist of settlement clearing collateral management custody and securities management services; market information and price procurement services; and core banking and securities market system implementation services as well as digital solutions. The company was formerly known as Servicios Integrados Bursátiles S.A. and changed its name to Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. in June 2001. Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Bogota Colombia. Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. is a subsidiary of Holding Bursátil Regional S.A.

Name: Ajial Real Estate Entertainment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Ajial Real Estate Entertainment Company K.S.C.P. operates as a real estate company in Kuwait. The company operates through three segments: Real Estate Activities Entertainment Activities and Equities and Other Investing Activities. The Real Estate Activities segment invests and trades in real estate; constructs or develops real estate properties; and offers other related real estate services. The Entertainment Activities segment owns and operates cinemas; and leases cinemas to governmental and private entities. The Equities and Other Investing Activities segment participates in financial and real estate funds. The company also buys rents leases and sells real estate properties inside and outside of Kuwait; establishes and maintains buildings and real estate projects including residential complexes; establishes commercial markets entertainment centers touristic facilities and building accommodations; engages in contracting works; and trades in building materials. Ajial Real Estate Entertainment Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: A1 Capital Yatirim Menkul Degerler A.S.
Description: A1 Capital Yatirim Menkul Degerler A.S. operates as a brokerage company. It engages in fund management activities including portfolio management and join ventures; investment consultancy; transaction brokerage; and public offering brokerage activities. The company also provides trading platforms comprising the A1 Capital mobile application; A1 WEB platform; TradingView a charting and trading platform; Fintables mobile; Matrix data terminal Matrix e-broker and Matrix mobile; FXPlus and Forex mobile application that provides data from money markets; and iDeal data terminal which provides data and news broadcasts of financial markets. A1 Capital Yatirim Menkul Degerler A.S. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Bossa Ticaret ve Sanayi Isletmeleri T.A.S.
Description: Bossa Ticaret ve Sanayi Isletmeleri T.A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacturing marketing and sale of textile products in Turkey. It also offers various denim products. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Adana Turkey.

Name: Kimteks Poliüretan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Kimteks Poliüretan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of polyurethane system. It offers polyurethane unit sole polyurethane slipper system polyurethane safety shoe sole polyurethane boot polyurethane insole polyester polyol and polymeric polyester polyol systems; release agents; and liquid color master batch systems. The company provides sandwich panel polyurethane pipe insulation polyurethane spray foam polyurethane polyurea systems polyurethane rubber binder system and shutter and sectional doors polyurethane systems; elastomers; polyester polyols; integral foam filter foam and sound insulation systems; and office furniture foam wood imitation viscoelastic integral foam polyester polyol systems. In addition it offers commercial and domestic refrigerator polyurethane cold storage room refrigerator container polyurethane and boiler and solar panel systems; EVA compounds thermoplastic polyurethane polyurethane gels and stress ball systems; and polyols for rigid polyurethane and foam and CASE Applications. It serves footwear building and insulation automotive furniture and foam and heating and cooling industries. Kimteks Poliüretan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Inversora Juramento S.A.
Description: Inversora Juramento S.A. operates as an agricultural and livestock company in the northwestern region of Argentina. The company engages in the production industrialization marketing and sale of meat and agricultural products. Its agricultural products include soybeans sorghum alfalfa pastures and corn. The company has approximately 89504 hectares of land located in the province of Salta. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Salta Argentina.

Name: Palmci S.A.
Description: Palmci S.A. engages in the management of oil palm plantations in Ivory Coast. The company produces and sells olein crude palm and palm kernel oil. It also engages in the production of natural rubber cane sugar and biomass. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Abidjan Ivory Coast.

Name: JMMB Group Limited
Description: JMMB Group Limited provides a range of financial services for individual business corporate and institutional clients in Jamaica North America Trinidad and Tobago Barbados the Dominican Republic and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Financial and Related Services Banking and Related Services and Other. The Financial and Related Services segment offers securities brokering stock brokering portfolio planning funds management and investment advisory services. The Banking and Related Services segment is involved in accepting deposits; granting of loans and other credit facilities; foreign currency trading; and provision of remittance and related services. The Other segment provides insurance brokering investment and real estate holding services. The company also offers savings and loans commercial and merchant banking; consumer financing; mutual fund administration; and pension funds administration services. JMMB Group Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Cemento Polpaico S.A.
Description: Cemento Polpaico S.A. produces and sells cement in Chile. It also offers concrete; and aggregates including sand and gravel. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is based in Santiago Chile. Cemento Polpaico S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones Caburga Limitada.

Name: Bastas Baskent Cimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Bastas Baskent Cimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces cement clinker aggregate lime ready-mixed concrete and waste processing products in Turkey. The company was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Bastas Baskent Cimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Parficim S.A.

Name: Al Buhaira National Insurance Company P.S.C.
Description: Al Buhaira National Insurance Company P.S.C. operates as an insurance company in the United Arab Emirates. It operates through three segments: General Insurance Life Assurance and Investments. The company offers personal insurance products including motor travel medical home yacht and jet ski; and business insurance products such as property engineering group medical group life credit life marine aviation motor fleet liability energy and miscellaneous insurance products. It also invests in equity securities investment properties and statutory deposits. Al Buhaira National Insurance Company P.S.C. was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Sharjah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Ashdod Refinery Ltd
Description: Ashdod Refinery Ltd engages in the oil refining business in Israel and internationally. The company refines exports and imports crude oil and intermediate materials for petroleum distillates; and produces and sells electricity. It also provides fuel storage and dispensing services; and light gases LPG gasoline and naphtha diesel fuel kerosene fuel oil and other products. The company was formerly known as Paz Ashdod Refinery Ltd. and changed its name to Ashdod Refinery Ltd in September 2023. Ashdod Refinery Ltd was founded in 1973 and is based in Ashdod Israel.

Name: Invicta Holdings Limited
Description: Invicta Holdings Limited an investment holding company engages in the distribution of engineering components and consumables in South Africa the Rest of Africa Europe and Asia. It operates in Replacement Parts for Industrial Equipment; Replacement Parts for Auto and Agri; Capital Equipment and Related Services; and Replacement Parts for Earthmoving Equipment. The company offers technical services including on-site installation maintenance work breakdown repair condition monitoring failure analysis design engineering and manufacturing services; engineering consumables such as bearings seals and gaskets power transmissions light and heavy materials handling fasteners geared and electric drives and motors; and fluid technology products and solutions comprising hydraulic pneumatic valves pumps filtration hose fittings and lubrication. It also supplies tools and equipment cutting welding lifting personal protective equipment locks and machine tools; imported and local vibrator motors tensioning and suspension systems; and vibrating equipment and material handling solutions. In addition the company manufactures and supplies heavy-duty belting components and imported conveyer belting to the industry. Further it supplies automotive and agricultural after-market replacement parts and kits; forklifts off-road dump trucks and related spare parts; earthmoving and materials-handling equipment; after-market replacement spare parts ground engaging tools and undercarriage parts for earthmoving equipment; aftermarket heavy-duty diesel engine parts for industrial and agricultural machinery; and heavy machinery parts and diesel engine components used for excavators bulldozers wheel loaders motor graders trucks trailers power generation sets and marine engines. Additionally it provides technical support and value-added assembly services. Invicta Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Koza Polyester Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Koza Polyester Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces and sells polyester fibers polyester chips and plasticizers in Türkiye and internationally. It offers textile and nonwoven type fibers; semi-dull chips; and phthalate-free plasticizers. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Gaziantep Türkiye.

Name: Mutakamela Insurance Company
Description: Mutakamela Insurance Company provides insurance products and solution in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Motor Health care Property and Casualty and Protection and Saving segments. The company offers accident fire or theft and third-party liability motor insurance; medical cover to policyholders; group retirement products; and protection and saving products to individuals and corporate institutions. It also provides engineering insurance for builders’ risks construction mechanical electrical electronic machinery breakdown and other; property accidental physical loss or damage fire and allied perils and related losses; and marine credit fidelity guarantee and liability insurance products as well as burglary and money insurance solutions. The company was formerly known as Allianz Saudi Fransi Cooperative Insurance Company and changed its name to Mutakamela Insurance Company in November 2024. Mutakamela Insurance Company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Mutakamela Insurance Company is a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi National Insurance Company PJSC.

Name: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG
Description: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries engages in milling wheat and other cereals in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates in four segments: Flour Mill Feed Mill Bakery and Others. The company offers bread baking health special grain and premix products under the Dahabi and Atyab brands; and cattle and poultry feed products including general ruminant calf rearer sheep cubes camel and horse feed and breeder and pigeon feed under the Barakat brand. It also manufactures sells and distributes fresh and frozen bakery products; sells and distributes confectionery items and other flour related products; and manufactures imports and exports wheat and flour. In addition the company provides laboratory services for testing of materials and chemicals; and consultancy services. Further it engages in investment activities. Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG was founded in 1976 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Hayat Communications Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Hayat Communications Company K.S.C.P. provides construction and communication services. The company engages in the trading and installation of telecommunications and related equipment; electrical communication tools and contracting; maintenance of telecommunication tools; trading of telecommunication materials and systems; information transfer infrastructure and contracting; trade installation management operation and maintenance of telephones and communication devices and tools; trading of communication lines and cards; marketing and leasing of electronic communication devices and internal communication networks; establishment and contracting of information centers and infrastructure; trade installation management operation and maintenance of communication devices and networks security and safety and monitoring devices; preparation of various studies and provision of technical consultation in the field of communications information systems and security services; owning establishing leasing and renting telecommunications networks; and investment business. It also offers mobile phone services paging systems and other telecommunications services as well as computer consultancy services. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Morabaha Marina Financing Company
Description: Morabaha Marina Financing Company provides financing to individual and small and medium enterprises in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Retail SMEs and Digital Payments segments. It offers finance leasing; and consumer financing as well as electronic commerce payments and wallet services. Morabaha Marina Financing Company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Izmir Firça Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Izmir Firça Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces and sells various cleaning materials and painting brushes in Turkey and internationally. It offers brush such as white wash paint and oil based paint brushes; steel including spatula trowel and putty knifes and stuff scratch brush; min size big and special rollers; tapes drop sheets and nylon canvas and auxiliary products; and cleaning products comprises window and floor squeegee brush broom mop handle and bucket as well as hobby directing hardware and thinner products. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Peña Verde S.A.B.
Description: Peña Verde S.A.B. offers insurance and reinsurance services in Mexico Latin America the Caribbean and internationally. It offers life personal accident health civil liability and professional risks maritime and transportation fire automobiles credit agricultural and animal earthquake and other catastrophic risks insurance products. The company was formerly known as Minera Peña Verde SA and changed its name to Peña Verde S.A.B. in 1978. The company was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Ebebek Magazacilik Anonim Sirketi
Description: Ebebek Magazacilik Anonim Sirketi engages in the retail of mother-baby products in Turkey and internationally. The company offers clothing and textile baby room bath and care diapers and wipes and toys and books for mothers and babies. It sells its products through its ebebek brand name through retail and e-commerce channels. Ebebek Magazacilik Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: International Company for Agricultural Crops
Description: International Company for Agricultural Crops engages in the agricultural activities in Egypt. The company is also involved in trading and import of agricultural pesticides and fertilizers; and mixing and filling of liquid fertilizers; production of agricultural crops seeds; and trading ginning and export of cotton. It also engages in trading and import of fertilizers and agricultural fertilizers; trading of agricultural crops and seeds; and seed screening. In addition the company offers rice wheat maize legumes beans etc. as well as NPK mixture fertilizers. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Mansoura Egypt.

Name: Peninsula Group Ltd
Description: Peninsula Group Ltd provides credit solutions in Israel. The company offers long term medium term import supplier equipment and asset-based financing services. It provides bridge loans; line of credit; and diamond exchange services. Peninsula Group Ltd was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: Zanlakol Ltd
Description: Zanlakol Ltd engages in the development production marketing and sale vegetable products in Israel. It provides corn peas chickpeas beans and other legumes. The company also offers hummus and dips; cooking sauces including pasta pizza lasagna Bolognese and omelet sauces; tomato products such as crushed tomatoes tomato pastes and concentrates diced tomatoes tomato omelet sauce and spicy pepper salsa; and canned vegetable products comprising apple purees beans potatoes mixed vegetables corn kernels carrots chickpeas and lupines. In addition it provides vinegar preserved lemon sauce and syrups; and customized products. It sells its products to food chains independent retailers hospitals catering services companies restaurants the ministry of defense and various manufacturing companies. The company also exports its products to the United States Europe and internationally. Zanlakol Ltd was incorporated in 1940 and is based in Afula Israel.

Name: Zur Shamir Holdings Ltd
Description: Zur Shamir Holdings Ltd through its subsidiaries operates in the insurance consumer credit and real estate markets in Israel. The company provides insurance products such as compulsory car property car property general medical expenses and hospitalization personal disability critical illness travel abroad life insurance and savings and other health insurance as well as savings products. It is also involved in the direct financing activity; and provision of loans for purchase of vehicles products and services as well as investment in real estate assets. The company was formerly known as Zur and changed to its name to Zur Shamir Holdings Ltd in February 1997. The company was founded in 1957 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Basic Chemical Industries Company
Description: Basic Chemical Industries Company together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells various chemicals in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Chemicals Polymers and Adhesives and Other Materials segments. The company offers industrial chemicals such as hydrochloric acid ferric chloride sulfuric acid caustic soda chlorine sodium hypochlorite etc. for use in various industries; rigid and semi-rigid polyurethane systems for manufacture of various density foams; and hot and cold melt adhesives for use in various industries. It also provides water treatment chemicals including boiler cooling water waste treatment plant domestic water reverse osmosis and desalination plant cleaning and hydrotest chemicals as well as provides contract manufacturing services. In addition the company offers caustic soda flakes sodium sulphate and industrial chemicals and solvents. Further it purchases formulates processes exports imports markets distributes and acts as an agent for the sale of chemicals. The company serves paints and coatings; oil gas and petrochemicals; steel galvanizing; beverage manufacturers dairy operators and farmers; and commercial laundry sectors. Basic Chemical Industries Company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Obour Land for Food Industries S.A.E.
Description: Obour Land for Food Industries S.A.E. manufactures and distributes dairy products in Egypt. The company engages in the packing and pasteurization of liquid dairies cream and natural butter as well as white dry and cooked cheese; and yogurt ice creams biscuits and natural fruit juices. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in El Obour City Egypt.

Name: Bank of Baroda (Uganda) Limited
Description: Bank of Baroda (Uganda) Limited provides commercial banking services in Uganda. It offers various deposit products including savings accounts current accounts festival flexible recurring deposits monthly and quarterly income plan for fixed deposit and fixed/short-term deposit accounts. The company also provides loans/advances such as salary multi-purpose housing loans against bank's deposits education traders business and short-term loans; financing against warehouse/storage receipts sales invoice financing suppliers bill discounting and asset finance products as well as loans against future rent receivables and bank deposits. In addition it offers non-fund based services/products comprising letter of credit and bank guarantee services; funds transfer services; foreign exchange services; and lockers Internet banking ATM cards and tax collection services as well as invests in government securities such as treasury bills and treasury bonds. Further the company provides equity brokering services; and investment advisory securities trading securities exchanges listing sponsoring services and remittance services as well as other digital channels comprising mobile banking cash recyclers agent banking SMS alerts automated account statement website and call center services. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Kampala Uganda. Bank of Baroda (Uganda) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Bank of Baroda Limited.

Name: Karel Elektronik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Karel Elektronik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. designs develops produces and sells communication systems in Türkiye. It offers communication products such as PBX phone systems for small medium and large-scale businesses; IP based call center systems for public and private institutions; and IP analog wall hotel and feature phones as well as direct station select modules and operator phone headsets. The company also provides convergence and integration products including conference products GSM terminals wireless (DECT) systems auto-attendant and voicemail modules call traffic control systems VoIP and network products call recording systems nurse call systems and other products as well as vehicle tracking systems. In addition it offers visual communication and security systems comprising security cameras intruder alarm and intercoms; cloud solutions with Internet applications that facilitate the business processes and provide economy and productivity for corporate users; and electronics manufacturing services as well as undertakes telecommunication projects for fixed and mobile operators and state institutions and organizations. Further the company offers defense industry solutions such as military tactical switches; alarm and announcement system for small boats and navy ships phone and intercom PABX system military gateway and communications switching systems; electronic mirror; military computers; and inertial navigation systems. It provides its communication solutions for hotels public institutions medical institutions educational institutions production facilities retail business finance institutions and transportation institutions. The company also exports its products and technologies to approximately 30 countries. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Istanbul Türkiye.

Name: Globrands Ltd.
Description: Globrands Ltd. distributes consumer goods in Israel. The company operates through the Smoking Products Sector the Sweet and Snacks Sector and the Quality of Life Products Sector segments. It is involved in the importation sale and distribution of tobacco products and smoking products including cigarettes rolling tobacco lighters and papers to roll; the distribution sale and marketing of sweets and snacks. In addition the company offers over-the-counter pharmaceutical products protein bars medical cannabis and other consumer products. It serves its products to retail customers and multinational corporations under the Natural American Spirit Camel Winston Kent Pall Mall Vogue Rothmans and Golden Virginia brands. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Herzliya Israel.

Name: Kirac Galvaniz Telekominikasyon Metal Makine Insaat Elektrik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kirac Galvaniz Telekominikasyon Metal Makine Insaat Elektrik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a guardrail supplier company in Turkey. The company provides steel guardrail systems noise barrier systems solar energy systems and motorcyclist protection systems as well as hot dip galvanizing services. It also offers other products such as traffic sign and boards steel constructions and informative signs omega profiles traffic sign trailers pedestrian guardrails crash cushions and pedestrian overpass construction systems. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Bursa Turkey.

Name: Electro Cable Egypt
Description: Electro Cable Egypt manufactures and sells power and telecommunication cables in Egypt. It offers enameled copper wires; low medium and high voltage wires and cables; overhead transmission conductors; building wires; and telephone cables. The company also exports its products to Africa Europe and the Arab countries. Electro Cable Egypt was founded in 1954 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et L'Industrie Société anonyme
Description: Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et L'Industrie Société anonyme provides various banking products and services to individuals professionals and corporate and institutional clients in Tunisia. The company accepts various accounts and packages; and offers credit savings and investments fundings and collections services. It also provides growth financing operating cycle and flow management international trade and hedging of exchange rate risk services. In addition the company offers remote banking; cash management market activities investment banking international trade financial engineering and leasing and factoring; project financing bancassurance and wealth management; and electronic and mobile payment services. Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et L'Industrie Société anonyme was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Raoom trading Company
Description: Raoom trading Company engages in the manufacture trade and installation of glass mirrors and aluminum decorations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers polycarbonate clear flat glass stained glass reflective glass glass path crystal and fused glass products as well as accessories doors and fronts. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Buraydah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Hareket Proje Tasimaciligi Ve Yuk Muhendisligi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Hareket Proje Tasimaciligi Ve Yuk Muhendisligi Anonim Sirketi provides heavy lifting and transportation services with engineering solutions in Turkey Europe Asia the Middle East and Africa. It offers load out services equipment rental and renewable energy solutions as well as rigging engineering and transport survey consultancy. The company also provides project planning route surveys lift engineering project management and installation services. It serves petrochemical renewable energy and power industries as well as offshore projects. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Kardan Israel Ltd
Description: Kardan Israel Ltd. through its subsidiaries engages in the real estate business in Israel and the United States. It locates initiates and develops residential buildings in Israel for sale; demolishes and rebuilds properties for urban renewal; develops sells and rents office buildings and commercial areas; and invests in real estate properties. The company also provides contractor services for the construction of residential buildings commercial buildings public buildings etc. In addition it is involved in the development sale and rental of logistics real estate complexes such as server farm commerce office and cold storage buildings. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: El-Mor Electric Installation & Services (1986) Ltd.
Description: El-Mor Electric Installation & Services (1986) Ltd. operates in the energy infrastructure and communications business in Israel. It undertakes the construction and implementation of energy electricity and air-conditioning projects in various fields such as power plants renewable and solar energy industry telecom high-tech commercial and public buildings military and defense facilities electrical and telecom infrastructure and street lighting. The company also constructs substations; contracts photovoltaic solar plants; manufactures and assembles power electrical boards distribution switchboards and automation and MCC boards; and operates energy electrical and electro-mechanical projects. In addition it engages in transforming organic waste into energy using pyrolysis and gasification solutions. El-Mor Electric Installation & Services (1986) Ltd. was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Ashkelon Israel.

Name: Kuzey Boru Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kuzey Boru Anonim Sirketi produces and sells plastic pipes and fittings in Turkey and internationally. Its clean water pipes include high-density polyethylene (HDPE) PVC low-density polyethylene (LDPE) polypropylene random copolymer (PPRC) and glass reinforced thermosetting pipes; and drainage pipes comprise corrugated drainage steel reinforced corrugated perforated drainage and geotextile covered drainage pipes. The company offers pre-insulated geothermal pipes; fish farming aquaculture polyethylene and PVC pipes and cages; HDPE cable PVC cable casing and corrugated cable casing ducts as well as telecommunication pipes; dredging and marine pipes and sea dredger pipes and floaters; and hydropower spiral corrugated HDPE cooling water and gas pipes. It also provides HDPE electro fusion and spigot fittings corrugated and PP-R fittings HDPE coupling fittings valves fire hydrants and pipe welding machines. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Aksaray Turkey.

Name: Türk Prysmian Kablo ve Sistemleri Anonim Sirketi
Description: Türk Prysmian Kablo ve Sistemleri Anonim Sirketi produces imports exports and trades in cables conductors machinery apparatuses tools and equipment and spare parts and accessories worldwide. It offers energy cables communication cables with copper conductors and fiber optic cables; cable for utilities and power grids; telecom; transportation and mobility; and asset monitoring systems and electronics. The company provides medium and low voltage fire performance and building wire cables for trade and installers; cables for industries including renewables water treatment oil and gas oems nuclear mining military and defence marine and crane.
