Description: Naba Al Saha Medical Services Company operates private and governmental hospitals and health facilities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It owns operates and manages Al-Zahraa Hospital Manarat Al-Haramain Pharmacy and Nabea Al-Sahha branch. The company provides outpatient inpatient and operation services as well as maintenance and cleaning services; and building operation services. It is involved in construction and maintenance of medical facilities; provision of strategic consulting; training of medical and administrative personnel; development of therapeutic programs and medical services; quality management; and pharmacy operation. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Qatif the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P. engages in managing real estate projects in Kuwait. It operates in Hotel Operations Real Estate and Investment segments. The company invest develop and trades real estate properties as well as manages real estate investment commercial projects investment funds and portfolios. Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Allpark Empreendimentos Participações e Serviços S.A.
Description: Allpark Empreendimentos Participações e Serviços S.A. engages in the provision of parking services in Brazil. It operates through Leased and Managed Locations Owned Locations Public concessions (Otf-Stíeet) Public concessions (On-Street) Long-term Private Contracts Digital and Other segments. The company operates parking lots in commercial buildings shopping malls hospitals educational institutions banks and land; and outside public roads including airports and underground garages. It is also involved in the investments in parking meters infrastructure signage and initial concessions in the municipalities; and provision of AppZul+ services as well as technical administration advisory and planning services related to vehicle parking. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Beta Glass Plc
Description: Beta Glass Plc manufactures distributes and sells glass bottles and containers in Nigeria and internationally. The company also offers crowns and crates. Its products are used by soft drinks breweries wine and spirits pharmaceutical food and cosmetics companies. The company also exports its products to Ghana Burkina Faso Benin Republic Cameroon Gabon Republic of Congo Angola Mauritius South Africa Côte d’Ivoire Sierra Leone Guinea and Liberia. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Beta Glass Plc is a subsidiary of Frigoglass Industries Nigeria Limited.

Name: Solrom Holdings Ltd
Description: Solrom Holdings Ltd engages in the research and development of printhead laser for 3D printers in Israel. It offers 3D printers. The company was formerly known as 3DM Digital Manufacturing Ltd. and changed its name to Solrom Holdings Ltd in September 2024. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Rosh Haayin Israel.

Name: Sociedad Anónima Viña Santa Rita
Description: Sociedad Anónima Viña Santa Rita produces and sells wines in Chile America Europe Asia Africa and Oceania. The company offers wine products under the Casa Real Reserva Especial Bougainville Pewën de Apalta Triple C Floresta Medalla Real Gran Researva Medalla Real Gold Medal SR Secret Reserve 120 Reserva Especial 120 Early Harvest and 3 Medallas brands. It exports its products to Ireland Brazil the United States of America Canada Mexico the United Kingdom China Japan Denmark Colombia Scandinavia Korea and the Netherlands. The company was founded in 1880 and is based in Las Condes Chile. Sociedad Anónima Viña Santa Rita is a subsidiary of Cristalerías de Chile S.A.

Name: Aenza S.A.A.
Description: Aenza S.A.A. together with its subsidiaries provides specialized management consulting services and leasing of corporation in Peru Chile and Colombia. It operates through Infrastructure Energy Engineering and Construction and Real Estate segments. The company’s Infrastructure segment offers long-term concessions or similar contractual arrangements in Peru for toll roads transportation and water treatment as well as operation and maintenance services for infrastructure assets. Its Engineering and Construction segment provides traditional engineering services such as architectural planning structural civil and design engineering for advanced specialties comprising process design simulation and environmental services. This segment also provides services related to civil works which include construction of hydroelectric power stations and other large infrastructure facilities; electromechanic construction such as power plant concentrator plants oil and natural gas pipelines and transmission lines; and office and residential buildings hotels accessible housing projects shopping centers and industrial facilities. Its Energy segment engages in exploration production treatment marketing services of natural gas and its derivatives in the gas processing plant and gas processing as well as the construction and assembly of oil facilities and the storage and dispatch of fuel and oil by products. Its Real Estate segment develops and sells house  offices and commercial spaces. The company was formerly known as Graña y Montero S.A.A. and changed its name to Aenza S.A.A. in November 2020. Aenza S.A.A. was founded in 1933 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Merafe Resources Limited
Description: Merafe Resources Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the mining and beneficiation of chrome ore into ferrochrome and associated minerals. The company operates ferrochrome smelters ferrochrome furnaces chrome ore mines UG2 plants and PGM processing plants located in the Northwest Limpopo and Mpumalanga provinces of South Africa. It operates in South Africa Brazil the United States China India Japan South Korea Taiwan Singapore Australia England Finland Italy Luxembourg the Netherlands Slovenia and Spain. Merafe Resources Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Bryanston South Africa.

Name: Renaissance Services SAOG
Description: Renaissance Services SAOG together with its subsidiaries operates as an accommodation services solutions and integrated facilities management company in the Sultanate of Oman and rest of the Middle East. The company offers turnkey and other contract services including accommodation solutions facilities management and establishment contract catering operations and maintenance training cleaning and waste management services. It is also involved in the ownership building and operation of permanent accommodation for contractors; and investment in companies and properties as well as general trading and related activities. The company serves healthcare energy defense education utilities and other sectors. Renaissance Services SAOG was founded in 1996 and is based in Muttrah the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Abra Information Technologies Ltd.
Description: Abra Information Technologies Ltd. provides information technology solutions in Israel. The company provides managed research and development services; customer relationship management system solutions such as system specification cross-organizational implantation process automation instruction and training and ongoing support solutions; UX and UI designing studio; enterprise resource planning system solutions including project management training and instruction data migration and support and service center as well as consultancy application and implementation solutions; business intelligence solution; strategy realization such as project management and agile transformation solutions as well as implementing PPM Jira and Atlassian tools; cloud solutions; e-commerce and marketing automation comprising development of e-commerce websites and systems technological specifications and UI/UX and IoT direct sales solutions; cyber consulting solutions including information and cyber security management technological consultancy and test and supply chain security solutions; and operates training center as well as provides courses. It serves health security fintech hi-tech government and commerce and retail industries. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Raanana Israel.

Name: Willy-Food Investments Ltd
Description: Willy-Food Investments Ltd imports exports markets and distributes food products in Israel and internationally. It offers rice canned fruits canned vegetables canned fish roasted vegetables noodles mushrooms coconut milk rice vermicelli egg noodles chilly and soy sauce pasta lemon juice balsamic vinegar pomegranate sauce cereals and snacks tortillas toasts crackers corn flour and grain products. The company also provides oil cookies and sweets coffee creamer tea and condensed sweet milk characol milk alternative drinks yogurts whipped cream mascarpone twarog cheese margarine and butter Italian products gluten free and frozen soy beans and fruits. It offers its products under Willi Food Valio Wyke Kolios Euro Happy Nuts DAAWAT El Pastor Sera Zanetti and Completa’s coffee whiteners brands. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Yavne Israel.

Name: Rotem Shani Entrepreneurship and Investment Ltd.
Description: Rotem Shani Entrepreneurship and Investment Ltd. together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate business in Israel. The company initiates develops establishes manages markets and sells as well as constructs of entrepreneurial projects for residential commercial employment storage and others. The company was formerly known as Delta Eshbol Entrepreneurship Ltd. and changed its name to Rotem Shani Entrepreneurship and Investment Ltd. in May 1996. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Finance House P.J.S.C.
Description: Finance House P.J.S.C. provides investment consumer and commercial financing and related services primarily in the United Arab Emirates. It operates through three segments: Commercial and Retail Financing Investment and Insurance. The Commercial and Retail Financing segment offers loans and other credit facilities for institutional and individual customers. The Investment segment is involved in the management of investment portfolio and treasury activities. The Insurance segment offers non-life insurance products including motor medical and property and casualty products. The company also offers home business commercial payday and corporate finance products; financing solutions to SMEs; and credit cards guarantees multi-year fixed deposit and trade finance solutions as well as flexi products. In addition it is involved in the provision of share registrar dividend distribution general assembly management and IPO administration and issuer services; mobile and online securities trading activities; and investment banking brokerage and asset management activities. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Monteiro Aranha S.A.
Description: Monteiro Aranha S.A. through its subsidiaries operates in the telecommunications the pulp and paper sector petrochemicals and real estate sectors in Brazil. The company distributes timber pulp packaging paper paper bags and corrugated cardboard boxes; liquefied petroleum gas and fuel; and fuel and LPG as well as produces ethylene oxide and its derivatives. It is also involved in producing ethylene oxide and its derivatives; and developing and investment in residential and commercial real estate projects as well as offers storage services for liquid bulk. Monteiro Aranha S.A. was founded in 1921 and is based in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Shoval Engineering and Construction Ltd
Description: Shoval Engineering and Construction Ltd a construction company engages in the planning and execution of logistics centers public buildings commercial centers industrial buildings and offices in Israel. The company is based in Nesher Israel.

Name: Agricultural Development Bank Plc
Description: Agricultural Development Bank Plc provides corporate investment and retail banking products and services in Ghana. It offers corporate banking services comprising business bank accounts; business overdraft business invoice factoring import and export documentary credit import and export bills trade and supply chain protection foreign exchange risk management foreign exchange foreign currency account guarantees and export invoice finance services; payments and cash management services; funding solutions; and asset finance services. In addition the company provides retail banking services including current savings deposit salary student save and Mmofra accounts; and electronic banking services. Further it offers risk management services such as market/financial and operational risks and compliance units; treasury management services including foreign exchange fixed deposit call account rediscounting of bill primary dealer and secondary market activities repurchase contract and custody services; agribusiness products and services; executive banking; and commercial/SME short and medium term loans inventory financing facilities working capital lending contractor financing import and export financing and bridge and LPO financing. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Accra Ghana.

Name: Ennakl Automobiles S.A.
Description: Ennakl Automobiles S.A. operates as an importer and distributor of vehicles in Tunisia. The company offers vehicle brands such as Volkswagen Volkswagen Utilities Audi Porsche SKODA SEAT CUPRA DasWeltAuto and Renault Trucks. It also sells used vehicles. In addition the company provides spare parts and after sales services. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia. Ennakl Automobiles S.A. operates as a subsidiary of PGI-Holding.

Name: National Gypsum Company
Description: National Gypsum Company produces and trades in gypsum and its derivatives in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It primarily offers plasterboard products. The company was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: National Enterprises Limited
Description: National Enterprises Limited an investment holding company engages in natural gas and energy-based manufacturing telecommunications power generation and basic foods manufacturing and marketing businesses in the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago. It offers dry mixes pet food livestock feed packaged rice bottled cooking oil coconut milk instant yeast and ginger tea as well as flour such as all purpose flour baker’s flour whole wheat flour cake flour self-rising flour breading flour wheat germ wheat bran wheat cereal and cracked wheat flour. The company also provides mobile fixed-line broadband pay TV security and other related services; and generates and distributes power for supply in bulk form to industrial commercial and residential customers. National Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Port of Spain Trinidad & Tobago.

Name: Arab Tunisian Bank
Description: Arab Tunisian Bank provides various banking products and services for individuals and companies primarily in Tunisia. The company offers savings accounts; term deposits; bank cards; money transfer services; financing services; and internet and mobile banking services. It also provides abroad transfer foreign exchange transaction placement and portfolio management services. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia. Arab Tunisian Bank is a subsidiary of Arab Bank PLC.

Name: Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company B.S.C.
Description: Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company B.S.C. provides general insurance takaful and related products and services in the Kingdom of Bahrain and internationally. It operates through Marine and General Motor Medical and Life segments. The company offers fire general accident engineering group life marine cargo marine hull and aviation special contingency motor third party motor comprehensive and extended warranty medical education protection and savings insurance products. It also provides travel home and life insurance products. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain. Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company B.S.C. is a subsidiary of Gulf Insurance Group K.S.C.P.

Name: Sun Limited
Description: Sun Limited operates in the tourism sector. It operates and manages seven properties including Shangri-La’s Le Touessrok Resort & Spa Four Seasons Resort Mauritius at Anahita Long Beach Sugar Beach La Pirogue Ambre and Ile aux cerfs in Mauritius. The company engages in operation golf and restaurant logistics retail training laundry tour operator marketing and procurement activities. The company was formerly known as Sun Resorts Limited and changed its name to Sun Limited in September 2015. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Ebene the Republic of Mauritius. Sun Limited is a subsidiary of CIEL Limited.

Name: Link Bilgisayar Sistemleri Yazilimi ve Donanimi Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Link Bilgisayar Sistemleri Yazilimi ve Donanimi Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. operates as a software development company in Turkey. The company offers e-document e-ledger; bank integration software; marketplace integration software; enterprise resource planning software; new generation software for tracking and managing accounting stock current account invoice bill check personnel fixed assets and other processes; techno human resources use for managing and monitoring of human resources and personnel payroll management needs; food production software; and campus software. It also provides organized industry invoicing e-reconciliation e-purchase invoice transfer payment recording device e-export passenger together invoice mandatory bes transactions management güneş warehouse management contractual invoicing e-prescription solution link-POS and link new generation payroll. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Letshego Holdings (Namibia) Limited
Description: Letshego Holdings (Namibia) Limited provides banking and other financial services to residents in Namibia. It offers banking services including account management; overdraft facilities and services; and micro-lending services. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Windhoek Namibia. Letshego Holdings (Namibia) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Letshego Holdings Limited.

Name: Nama Chemicals Company
Description: NAMA Chemicals Company together with its subsidiaries owns operates and manages industrial projects in the petrochemical and chemical sectors in Saudi Arabia the Gulf countries Asia Africa Europe and other territories. It operates through Epoxy Resin Products Chlor Alkali Products and Others segments. The company provides epoxy resins anhydrous caustic soda epichlorohydrin and calcium chloride. In addition it engages in real estate operations. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Jubail the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Umm Al Qaiwain General Investments Company P.S.C.
Description: Umm Al Qaiwain General Investments Company P.S.C. engages in the development establishment and management of real estate enterprises in the United Arab Emirates and the Gulf Cooperation Council countries. It is also involved in funds stocks and bonds investments as well as investment establishment and institution in commercial enterprises entertainment agriculture tourism industrial infrastructure educational services health and energy sectors; and owns and invests in classes and units in the buildings of the investment areas. The company was formerly known as Umm Al Qaiwain Cement Industries Company and changed its name to Umm Al Qaiwain General Investments Company P.S.C. in March 2016. Umm Al Qaiwain General Investments Company P.S.C. was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Umm Al Qaiwain the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Arabian United Float Glass Company
Description: Arabian United Float Glass Company manufactures and sells glass products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers float and pattern glass products and mirrors. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Yanbu the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: New Mauritius Hotels Limited
Description: New Mauritius Hotels Limited together with its subsidiaries operates hotels in Mauritius Europe Morocco and internationally. It operates through Hotel Operations; Tour Operating; Catering; and Property and Other segments. The Hotel Operations segment is involved in the operation of hotels comprising provision of room services food and beverages and other services such as spa laundry and boutique sales in Mauritius and Morocco. Its Tour Operating segment engages in the operation of a fleet of contract hiring vehicles the organization of sightseeing tours and rental of cars in Mauritius France the United Kingdom Italy and South Africa. The Catering segment offers flight and inland catering services for airline companies in Mauritius. Its Property and Others segment engages in the rental of hotel properties in Seychelles. The company also provides hotel training real estate and plant nursery services. New Mauritius Hotels Limited was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Curepipe Mauritius.

Name: Sönmez Pamuklu Sanayii A.S.
Description: Sönmez Pamuklu Sanayii A.S. engages in the manufacturing dyeing and sale of various yarns and fibers in Turkey. The company produces viscose tencel modal micromodal microtencel acrylic wool silk linen elastane bamboo and polyester fibers. It is also involved in real estate leasing activities. Sönmez Pamuklu Sanayii A.S. was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Bursa Turkey.

Name: Eléctrica Puntilla S.A.
Description: Eléctrica Puntilla S.A. generates and sells of electrical energy and power in Chile. It operates various hydroelectric plants. The company was founded in 1906 and is based in Santiago Chile. Eléctrica Puntilla S.A. is a subsidiary of Sociedad del Canal del Maipo S.A.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Tigbur - Temporary Professional Personnel Ltd.
Description: Tigbur - Temporary Professional Personnel Ltd. provides personnel and nursing services for business public and private customers in Israel. The company’s services include manpower in the technical office industrial construction and hotels fields; guarding security cleaning and other services; and accessibility services including the provision of hearing aids to private customers accessibility consulting technology installation of accessibility accessories training and implementation of accessibility to public places development production and international distribution of technologies designed to make the physical space accessible to people with visual impairments. It is involved in the locating recruiting staffing and placing professional and skilled employees in various fields including in the field of office work banking marketing and sales nursing accounting and senior management as well as provides mediation handling and treatment of foreign workers. In addition the company provides personal care services comprising assistance with bathing dressing feeding etc. help with household maintenance arrangements outside the home such as shopping purchasing medical equipment and medicines accompanying medical examinations and other required arrangements. Further it sells and installs of peripheral security equipment. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Wafrah for Industry and Development Company
Description: Wafrah for Industry and Development Company produces markets manufactures and sells of food products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Pastery Sector Vegetable Sector Breakfast Cereals Sector and Meat Product Sector segments. It provides breakfast cereal products including spices salted peanuts corn flakes and peanut products; meat products such as frozen and chilled meat minced chicken chicken franks burgers and cooked meat; pasta products including macaroni; and French fries. The company is also involved in the manufacturing drying packing and sale of dates; and wholesale of food and beverages as well feed production activities. It markets its products under the Wafrah Macolate Caprini Saudi Garden and Aghsan brands. The company was formerly known as Food Products Company and changed its name to Wafrah for Industry and Development Company in 2014. Wafrah for Industry and Development Company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: MOBI Industry Co.
Description: MOBI Industry Co. manufactures and sells fertilizers and nitrogen compounds in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also offers phosphate and potash fertilizers; plastics; household insect and rodenticides; floor glass and furniture polishes and scouring powders; and preparations for perfuming rooms and removing odors. The company also provides soaps and shampoos; industrial detergents and washing and cleaning materials as well as preparations under the Mobi and Shot brand names. In addition it is involved in plastic bottles manufacturing. The company was formerly known as National Fertilizer Company Ltd. and changed its name to MOBI Industry Co. in November 2022. MOBI Industry Co. was founded in 1981 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Sea Harvest Group Limited
Description: Sea Harvest Group Limited engages in the fishing and fast-moving consumer goods business in South Africa Europe Australia Asia and internationally. It operates through four segments: South African Fishing Sea Harvest Australia Sea Harvest Aquaculture and Cape Harvest Foods. The company is involved catching processing and marketing cape hake horse mackerel pelagic fish anchovy pilchard Spanish mackerel fish trawl prawns scallops crabs and abalone. It also engages in the production distribution marketing and sale of cheese butter powder and convenience food products in retail and bulk forms to the South African retail foodservice co-packing and food product development markets; and manufacture and distribution of chilled and frozen food products. The company was formerly known as Sea Harvest Holdings Proprietary Limited and changed its name to Sea Harvest Group Limited in February 2017. Sea Harvest Group Limited was founded in 1964 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Saudi Printing and Packaging Co.
Description: Saudi Printing and Packaging Co. provides printing services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Printing Packaging and Other segments. It also engages in printing newspapers magazines and books; and printing on plastics and commercial labels. In addition the company manufactures and sells paper and plastic cups; bottles and closures; and plastic products and packaging materials. Saudi Printing and Packaging Co. was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Darb Saudi Investment Company
Description: Darb Saudi Investment Company together with its subsidiaries manages and leases residential and non-residential real estates in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is also involved in the management and leasing of warehouses; brokerage of real estate; management of properties; and real estate investment and development. In addition the company engages in the construction of buildings; financial service activities; wholesale and retail trade; support functions; residence food and beverage service activities; creative activities arts and entertainment; and usage activities. The company was formerly known as Al-Baha Investment and Development Company and changed its name to Darb Saudi Investment Company in June 2025. Darb Saudi Investment Company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: HF Group Plc
Description: HF Group Plc through its subsidiaries engages in the mortgage lending banking property development and bancassurance businesses in Kenya. The company operates through Retail Banking Corporate Banking Property Development Bancassurance and Others segments. It accepts deposits from retail customers; and provides micro and personal loans as well as sources residential mortgages for individual owner occupiers. The company also accepts deposits from corporate organizations; and provides loans to property developers for construction of residential houses office blocks schools hospitals and other related infrastructure. In addition it engages in the development and sale of housing projects; and provision of insurance agency services. It serves individual and corporate customers. The company was formerly known as HF Group Limited and changed its name to HF Group Plc in July 2017. HF Group Plc was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Custodian Investment Plc
Description: Custodian Investment Plc through its subsidiaries provides insurance products and services in Nigeria. It operates through Non-Life Business Life Business Pension Administration Property Development and Management and Trustees and Others segments. The Non-Life Business segment offers engineering aviation marine and motor liability oil and energy fire and property insurance for individual and corporate customers. The Life Business segment provides a range of life insurance products for individual and group including annuity endowment and investment-oriented products and insurance products with discretionary participatory features (DPF). The Pension Administration segment is involved in the administration and management of the retirement benefits of members. The Property Development and Management segment engages in the acquisition development sale and management of various commercial residential hospitality and retail property assets. The Trustees and Others segment includes trustee management corporate services investment and property management. The company offers general insurance products such as auto travel home event personal accident and other insurance products; and life insurance products including savings and investment endowment protection annuity and other products as well as group life and group credit life insurance products. The company was formerly known as Custodian and Allied Insurance Limited. Custodian Investment Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Sudatel Telecom Group Limited
Description: Sudatel Telecom Group Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the provision of installation maintenance and infrastructure development services and operation of telecommunication services in the Republic of Sudan Senegal Mauritania and the United Arab Emirates. It operates through Voice Data and Wholesale segments. The company offers voice services; data services comprising leased data transmission circuits DSL and internet; and transmission services to other operators and corporate organizations as well as wire and wireless telecommunication services. It also manages its international operations. The company was formerly known as Sudan Telecommunication Company Limited. Sudatel Telecom Group Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Khartoum Sudan.

Name: Big Medya Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi
Description: Big Medya Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi publishes magazines in Turkey. It publishes magazines in computer and technology decoration youth travel and exploration human business and economy corporate life and style fashion and women special interest and health and fitness categories in printed and digital formats. Big Medya Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi was formerly known as Dogan Burda Dergi Yayincilik Ve Pazarlama A.S. and changed its name to Big Medya Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi in October 2025. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Biomm S.A.
Description: Biomm S.A. operates as a biotechnology company in Brazil. The company offers insulin products for the treatment of diabetes including AFREZZA a Human insulin powder for inhalation; GLARGILIN a glargine insulin; WOSULIN N and WOSULIN R; and Lifepen G a reusable insulin injection pen. It also provides Bevyx for the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer; HERZUMA for the treatment of early-stage and metastatic breast cancer and metastatic gastric cancer with HER2-positive tumors; GHEMAXAN an anticoagulant for the prophylaxis and treatment of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism unstable angina and in cases of acute myocardial infarction; and RANIVISIO for the treatment of vision problems related to abnormal blood vessel growth or fluid buildup in the retina. Biomm S.A. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Nova Lima Brazil.

Name: Bahrain National Holding Company B.S.C.
Description: Bahrain National Holding Company B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides insurance and investment products in the Kingdom of Bahrain other GCC countries and internationally. It operates through Motor Insurance Property & General Insurance Medical Insurance and Life Insurance segments. The Motor Insurance segment offers motor comprehensive insurance third party insurance and other services related to motor insurance. The Property & General segment provides property general accident engineering marine and aviation insurance products. The Medical Insurance segment offers medical insurance products. The Life Assurance segment provides group life insurance group credit life insurance term assurance and saving scheme plans. The company also offers automobile smash repairs roadside assistance and automobile services. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Birzeit Pharmaceuticals Company
Description: Birzeit Pharmaceuticals Company manufactures and trades in various medicines in the Palestinian Authority. The company offers its products in various therapeutic fields comprising alimentary system cardio-vascular system muscolo-skeletal system endocrines central nervous system genito-urinary system obstetrics and gynecology infections dermatological preparations ophthalmic drugs respiratory system and nutrition and metabolism as well as ear nose and oropharynx. It also provides OTC products such as multivitamins and minerals and supplements; and skin/topical care allergy and cold eye care mouth and nose care pain and fever and digestion and gastrointestinal products. In addition the company offers its products in various dosage forms including ampoules capsules tablets and caplets syrups suspensions and granules ophthalmic semi-solids powder vials suppositories and powders. Further it manufactures and trades in cosmetics products; and provides printing and publishing services. The company serves the Ministry of Health as well as health care organizations and programs; and end users through pharmacies and physicians. It also exports its products primarily to Algeria and East Europe. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Gimat Magazacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Gimat Magazacilik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. operates in the retailing and wholesale business in Turkey. It operates an online store for food; red and white meat fish and aquaculture; milk and breakfast products; cleaning products which include general cleaning washing washing dishes and cleaning supplies; personal care; baby products including diapers detergents foods and toys; fruits and vegetables; non-food and bakery products as well as beverages comprising tea coffee and drinks. The company is also involved in retailing of fast-moving consumer products. Gimat Magazacilik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V. develops operates and manages hotels in Mexico Costa Rica Colombia and Chile. The company operates hotels under the City Junior by Marriott City Express Suites by Marriott City Express by Marriott City Express Plus by Marriott and City Centro by Marriott brands. It also provides marketing technical and administrative; real estate development; restaurant operation and catering; and IT server maintenance update and equipment rental services as well as software platforms and applications; and dashboards for hotel managers and operating teams. In addition the company develops Front2Go a property management system; hires personnel or third parties for the development of civil works; and invests in hospitality industry projects. It serves business travelers. The company was formerly known as Hoteles City Express S.A.B. de C.V. and changed its name to Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V. in April 2024. Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Combined Motor Holdings Limited
Description: Combined Motor Holdings Limited an investment holding company engages in the motor retail and distribution business in South Africa. It offers new and used vehicles including parts and accessories; and fleet solutions. The company also provides car rental services. In addition it offers insurance products that includes death disability dread disease and retrenchment of customers and vehicle and component warranties as well as vehicle financing. Further the company is involved in supply and installation of workshop lifting lubrication and diagnostic equipment waterless car wash systems and office consumables services. Combined Motor Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Durban South Africa.

Name: Alexandria New Medical Center
Description: Alexandria New Medical Center engages in the operation of a hospital in Egypt. The company’s hospital provides range of medical specialization services including gynecology general surgery pediatrics and other as well as medical diagnostic and treatment services in various medical fields. It also operates children’s neurology sugar liver chest cardiology internal oncology dental nose and ear women’s ophthalmology nutrition dermatology blood disease and rheumatology clinics; specialized units and centers; and dormitories. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Julius Berger Nigeria Plc
Description: Julius Berger Nigeria Plc a construction company engages in the planning and construction of various civil engineering works in Nigeria and Europe. The company operates through Civil Works Building Works Services and Diversification segments. The Civil Works segment provides professional services in the areas of engineering construction and maintenance of various infrastructures including construction of traffic networks turnkey harbors wharfs jetties loading installations and warehouses; refurbishment and construction of airports; design and construction of auxiliary buildings for factories oil and gas installations and power plants in the oil gas and energy sectors. The Building Works segment designs and constructs buildings hotels hospitals sports facilities and residential districts as well as administration commercial and industrial buildings. The Services segment produces and supplies furniture and interior fittings; and offers stevedoring port management and medical as well as design engineering and procurement services. The Diversification segment engages in the purchase and processing of raw cashew nuts; and sale of cashew kernels and other cashew products. The company also manufacturers and deals in aluminum steel iron or other structural products; provides logistical and technical support services; and port management and warehousing services. In addition it operates medical service institutions; and offers medical and health care services as well as acts as a cargo superintendents and proprietors of warehouses. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Abuja Nigeria.

Name: BMMI B.S.C.
Description: BMMI B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the wholesale and retail of food beverages and other consumable items. It operates through five segments: Retail Operations; Wholesale Operations; Contract Services and Supply; Hospitality; and Investments Shipping and Other Activities. The company is involved in the distribution wholesale and retail of beverages through its BMMI shops to hotels restaurants clubs and other licensed outlets; and production of ready-made food products including sandwiches packaged fruits baked goods sushi and sashimi fully cooked meals and European and Arabic and fusion style salads. It also operates Downtown Rotana a five-star hotel; and provides remote site and facilities management services camps and temporary structures rations supply technical sourcing and supply and contract logistics and services. In addition the company offers supply chain warehousing and distribution services; provides shipping services such as marine cargo relocation liner surveying and government services; and owns and operates Alosra supermarket as well as operates restaurants and cafes. Further it provides catering and housekeeping services. It operates in the Kingdom of Bahrain the United Arab Emirates the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Iraq the United States Djibouti South Sudan Sudan and Kenya. The company was founded in 1883 and is headquartered in Seef the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Al Khaleej Investment P.J.S.C.
Description: Al Khaleej Investment P.J.S.C. operates as a real estate and investment company in the United Arab Emirates. The company engages in the private fund investment commercial enterprises investment institution and management buildings maintenance and detection services for real estate. It is also involved in the real estate enterprises investment development institution and management. The company was formerly known as Livestock Co. (Gulf) PJSC and changed its name to Al Khaleej Investment PSC in November 2014. Al Khaleej Investment PSC was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Ras al-Khaimah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Hagag Europe Development Z.F. Ltd
Description: Hagag Europe Development Z.F. Ltd engages in the investment and development of real estate properties in Romania. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Northern Cement Company
Description: Northern Cement Company produces and sells cement in Jordan. The company offers ordinary Portland Pozzolanic Portland Pozzolanic sulphate resistant Portland low alkali Portland oil well and white Portland cements. It engages in the carbon gypsum and pozzolan griding; investment in other companies; importing white clinker and all kinds; manufacturing and griding of clinker; and importing grinding and crushing of all types of materials for cement and concrete industry. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Northern Cement Company operates as a subsidiary of Northern Region Cement Company.

Name: The Kuwait Company for Process Plant Construction and Contracting K.S.C.P.
Description: The Kuwait Company for Process Plant Construction and Contracting K.S.C.P. executes turnkey projects for building civil engineering and infrastructure projects in Kuwait. The company provides civil engineering services including project and construction management design engineering construction and commissioning services for residential buildings commercial and industrial buildings shopping centers and hotel projects; and flooring systems water/fire proofing and roofing systems rehabilitation and concrete repair structures electro chemical treatments of structures and corrosion services and solutions to various specialized industries. It offers road and infrastructure services such as road and highway construction projects as well as related services comprising storm water drainage sewer systems water networks telephone networks and road marking and signs; drainage pipeline maintenance services; and electrical related products and supporting services. In addition the company provides engineering products including asphalt polymer based bitumen and ready mix concrete as well as scaffolding services and equipment rental; and constructs installs and maintains water facilities such as treatment plants for drinking water for homes and large buildings swimming pools water features and spa facilities. Further it supplies and installs passenger and freight elevators escalators moving walks dumbwaiters and elevators for the physically challenged; and distributes marble and natural stone products and services. The company was founded in 1979 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Bahrain Duty Free Shop Complex BSC
Description: Bahrain Duty Free Shop Complex BSC operates the duty-free business in the new Bahrain international airport in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Muharraq the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Saudi Fisheries Company
Description: Saudi Fisheries Company engages in fishing fish-farming and other activities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company engages in processing and preservation of shrimps and aquatic organisms; and in online sale of sea food and related products. It operates shrimps and seafood grilling shops; and operates seafood restaurants. Saudi Fisheries Company was founded in 1980 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A.
Description: Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A. provides diagnostic imaging and medicine services in Brazil. The company offers diagnostic imaging clinical analysis nuclear medicine genetic testing and vaccination services as well as corporate remote and in-person solutions for hospitals and diagnostic centers in the private and public sectors. It provides clinical analysis services such as blood count cholesterol triglycerides urinalysis 1 stool test detection of sexually transmitted diseases and anatomical pathology; and diagnostic imaging services such as magnetic resonance computed tomography ultrasound x-rays bone densitometry mammography scintigraphy and PET-CT (positron emission tomography – computed tomography). It also offers graphic methods examinations including electrocardiogram cardiotocography Holter ergometric tests and cardiopulmonary tests. Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A. was formerly known as Centro de Imagem Diagnósticos S.A. and changed its name to Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A. in April 2023. Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A. was founded in 1992 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Tomer Energy Royalties (2012) Ltd
Description: Tomer Energy Royalties (2012) Ltd a special-purpose yield company holds the right to receive overriding royalties in respect of oil and/or gas and/or other valuable materials derived from the shares of various oil and gas companies and entities in Israel. It also holds rights to receive royalties from the Tamar Reservoir project. The company was formerly known as Delek Royalties (2012) Ltd and changed its name to Tomer Energy Royalties (2012) Ltd in June 2021. Tomer Energy Royalties (2012) Ltd was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Arab International Company for Education and Investment
Description: Arab International Company for Education and Investment engages in the establishment of private universities in Jordan. The company is involved in the preparation of students as specialists in the technological fields. Arab International Company for Education and Investment operates its educational activities through the Applied Science University. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Europap Tezol Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Europap Tezol Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells semi-finished cleaning papers in Turkey. It offers jumbo rolls napkins toilet papers and kitchen towels under the Softy Mare Ritmo Ecco Y.D Dolce and Unico brands as well as private label brands. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Colorado S.A.
Description: Colorado S.A. manufactures and distributes various paints in Morocco and internationally. It offers building and automotive refinish paints; and industrial ecological and functional paints. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Colorado S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Colbert Finances Sa.

Name: Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A.
Description: Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A. engages in the sale of cars and spare parts in Tunisia. It also manufactures electronic equipment comprising filters for the automotive and real estate development industries. The company was formerly known as Renault Tunisie. Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A. was founded in 1947 and is based in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Dorsel Holdings Ltd
Description: Dorsel Holdings Ltd engages in the construction development and rental of real estate properties in Israel and internationally. It also owns industrial commercial and logistics office buildings. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Yokneam Israel.

Name: Cashbuild Limited
Description: Cashbuild Limited engages in the retailing of building materials and associated products in South Africa Botswana Eswatini Lesotho Namibia Zambia and Malawi. It operates through Cashbuild P&L Hardware Cashbuild Common Monetary Operations and Cashbuild Non-Common Monetary Operations segments. The company offers builder hand and garden tools; safety equipment and workwear tanks field toilets drain covers and wheel barrows; and aggregates plastic sheeting and steel products. It also provides brickwork; concrete; cement; electrical and bathroom and kitchen products; doors putty and windows; roofing and ceiling products; tools and hardware; inverters petrol generators lighting and gas solutions; soft drinks and snacks; and outdoor and decorative products. It serves contractors homebuilders and improvers farmers traders and other customers. The company operates through the Cashbuild model and P&L Hardware stores. Cashbuild Limited was founded in 1978 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: BH Bank Société anonyme
Description: BH Bank Société anonyme a financial institution provides various products and services to public customers in Tunisia. It offers bank deposits credit granting foreign exchange and payment services. The company provides wealth advisory and management financial management and financial engineering services as well as facilitates the creation development and restructuring of companies and takes stakes in the capital of existing or newly created companies. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Payton Industries Ltd
Description: Payton Industries Ltd develops produces trades markets and sells various types of transformers for communications electronics automotive and industrial equipment industries in Israel Europe the United States and Asia. It offers planar/flat transformers. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Nes Ziona Israel.

Name: Naseej International Trading Company
Description: Naseej International Trading Company together with subsidiaries engages in the manufacture import export wholesale and retailing of carpets and rugs in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company’s products also include flooring furniture and furnishings antiques office furniture blankets kitchens bed sheets curtain fabrics and accessories tuft and yarns. In addition it provides maintenance services for factories governmental and private institutions. The company was formerly known as Al Sorayai Trading And Industrial Group Company. Naseej International Trading Company was founded in 1953 and is based in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Tihama for Advertising Public Relations and Marketing Company
Description: Tihama for Advertising Public Relations and Marketing Company together with its subsidiaries engages in the commercial advertising public relations marketing publishing and distribution businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers road advertising services; and stationeries and books. It is also involved in production trading and retail activities; media and research businesses; and invests in properties. Tihama for Advertising Public Relations and Marketing Company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc markets and distributes refined petroleum products in Nigeria. It operates through Network General Trade and Aviation segments. The company offers premium motor spirit (PMS) automotive gasoline oil (AGO) and aviation turbine kerosene (ATK) as well as kerosene for use in lamps cooking stoves etc. It also provides range of lubricants such as automotive lubricants and industrial lubricants; engine oils for cars motorcycles tricycles and heavy-duty engines; transmission oils and brake fluids; marine oils and greases; and automotive and industrial greases under the TotalEnergies and ELF brand names. In addition the company jet fuels and aviation gasolines for the aviation industry; bitumen; and solar lamps and solar home and industrial solutions. Further it operates service stations and lubricants blending plants; provides food snacks and coffee products through Café Bonjour; and offers TotalEnergies Card for individuals and professionals as well as offers TouchPoint services to facilitate the management of mobile money services and other digital services. The company was formerly known as Total Nigeria Plc and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc in September 2021. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of TotalEnergies Marketing & Services.

Name: Wataniya Insurance Company
Description: Wataniya Insurance Company provides a range of insurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Marine Property Motor Comprehensive Motor Third Party Liability Engineering Accident & Liability and Life Insurance segments. The company offers insurance against losses and liability related to marine vessels and marine cargo; fire and other insurance; insurance against damages to vehicles due to storm tempest flood fire theft and personal accident; insurance against liability to third parties arising through accidents; and insurance for builder's risks construction mechanical electrical electronic and machinery breakdown as well as life insurance. It also provides money insurance fidelity guarantee business all risk business travel and exhibition insurance; and general third-party liability product liability worker’s compensation/employer’s liability and damages to motor vehicles after the manufacturer warranty expires as well as professional indemnity cover protecting the insured’s legal liability arising out of acts of negligence during their business operations. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Arabia Insurance Cooperative Company
Description: Arabia Insurance Cooperative Company provides insurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through six segments: Medical Insurance Motor Insurance Fire Engineering Marine and Other. The company offers medical insurance which covers medical costs medicines and other medical services and supplies; motor insurance; fire insurance; engineering insurance which provides coverage for builder’s risks construction mechanical electrical electronic work and machinery disruption; marine insurance which provides coverage for goods in transit and the vehicles of transportation on main roads; and other insurances. Arabia Insurance Cooperative Company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Medine Limited
Description: Medine Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the planting of sugar cane in Mauritius. It operates in five segments: Agro Casela Sports and Hospitality Property and Education. The company is involved in the planting and milling of sugar cane for the production of sugar and by-products of sugar cane including molasses and bagasses; engages in the landscaping and nursery business that include cultivation of aromatics indoor plants and orchids; production of fruits and vegetables such as potatoes onions and carrots; and ready to eat products including seasonal fruits dried herbs and chips and snacks under the Jardins de Medine and Epices Et Herbes Aromatiques brand names. It also provides nursery pre-primary primary school secondary school and higher education programs; and executive education services that include coaching consulting and industry-specific short courses. In addition the company engages in land promoting and residential and commercial property development activities; asset property and facilities management services; rental of residential educational office and commercial buildings; construction and sale of villas; hotel resort operation; and other land transactions. Further it operates Casela nature and leisure park nature escapade Tamarina golf and spa boutique hotel SPARC sports and leisure center and restaurants; and offers deer farming nature escapade forestry management consultancy event management and travel and tourism services as well as provides renewable energy services. The company was formerly known as The Medine Sugar Estates Company Limited and changed its name to Medine Limited in September 2009. Medine Limited was founded in 1911 and is based in Beau Bassin Mauritius.

Name: SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C
Description: SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C engages in the real estate business in Kuwait and internationally. It engages in the purchase sale investment management leasing and renting of real estate properties; and purchase and sale of shares bonds and securities of real estate companies. The company also provides consulting services for real estate; organizes exhibitions for real estate projects; and develops infrastructure projects in the areas of residential commercial and industrial construction as well as projects under the build operation and transfer system. The company was formerly known as Sanam Real Estate Company K.S.C.(Public) and changed its name to SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C in May 2025. SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Indeks Bilgisayar Sistemleri Mühendislik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Indeks Bilgisayar Sistemleri Mühendislik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi distributes IT products in Turkey. The company’s products portfolio includes computers/tablets smartphones printers consumer electronics software peripherals wearable technologies data storage products smart home products and accessories. It purchases and sells spare parts and home electronics as well as provides logistics and rental services. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Albaad Massuot Yitzhak Ltd
Description: Albaad Massuot Yitzhak Ltd manufactures and sells wet wipes and feminine hygiene products worldwide. The company offers baby and toddler wipes; facial and cosmetic wipes including refreshing cosmetic exfoliating and make-up remover wipes; household cleaning wipes such as disinfecting and floor wipes; flushable moist toilet paper; and feminine hygiene products comprising G2 plastic and cardboard applicator compact and G4 3-piece plastic applicator and G3 sport plastic applicator as well as digital/compact digital products. It also provides professional wipes consisting of cow udder cleaning wipes pet wipes car wipes restaurant wipes sachets and screen wipes as well as plastic free wipes under the Hydrofine name. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Ashkelon Israel.

Name: Shatirah House Restaurant Co.
Description: Shatirah House Restaurant Co. operates quick service restaurants under the Burgerizzr brand in Saudi Arabia. Its restaurants offer beef and chicken burgers. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Zahrat Al Waha For Trading Company
Description: Zahrat Al Waha For Trading Company engages in the manufacturing and sale of PET preforms and caps in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It manufactures and sells semi-finished products from plastics; cans and boxes from plastics; and bottles of various forms from plastics as well as offers plastic products using roto mold method. The company also offers packaging solutions; and produces polyethylene packaging products for commercial industrial and household use. It exports its products to Yemen Qatar Oman Bahrain Sudan Emirates Kuwait Jordan and Lebanon. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Jalles Machado S/A
Description: Jalles Machado S/A produces markets and exports sugar ethanol and other by-products from sugarcane. The company offers crystal and organic sugar; hydrated anhydrous industrial and organic ethanol; sanitizing products; and yeast. It also produces clean and renewable energy from cane bagasse and straw. In addition the company engages in industrial automation 4G project agro-industrial control tower and research and development activiries. Jalles Machado S/A was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Goianésia Brazil.

Name: Terra Santa Propriedades Agrícolas S.A.
Description: Terra Santa Propriedades Agrícolas S.A. operates as a rural real estate company in Brazil. The company engages in leasing of farms for agricultural production located in various municipalities in Mato Grosso. Terra Santa Propriedades Agrícolas S.A. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: A'Saffa Foods SAOG
Description: A'Saffa Foods SAOG manufactures and distributes poultry meat in the Sultanate of Oman. It offers fresh frozen and processed chicken. The company was formerly known as ASaffa Poultry Farms SAOG and changed its name to A'Saffa Foods SAOG in April 2010. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Twareat Medical Care Company
Description: Twareat Medical Care Company provides medical care services in remote and industrial areas in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers medical care and occupational medicine services that consists of assessing the need for medical services at work sites; provision of specialized medical staff medical equipment medical supplies and medicines specialized medical ambulance and other services; service evaluations; training for staff; reviewing of applicable medical orders and legislation; annual and pre-employment examinations; routine visits to assess quality and readiness; medical transportation and disaster response services to industrial companies and public facilities and companies. The company also provides medical operation services comprising provision of doctors and nurses; consultants in emergency pediatric internal medicine family and community departments; and operation of medical centers within residential complexes. In addition it owns Twareat Medical Center which provides emergency medical care radiology laboratory testing home care medical transport pediatrics otolaryngology occupational medicine internal medicine ear nose and throat obstetrics and gynecology and general medicine services. Twareat Medical Care Company was founded in 2010 and is based in Al Khobar the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Norstar Holdings Inc
Description: Norstar Holdings Inc together with its subsidiaries develops rents and manages real estate properties in Northern Europe Central and Eastern Europe Israel Brazil and the United States. It develops commerce residential and office properties. The company was formerly known as Gazit Inc. and changed its name to Norstar Holdings Inc in May 2011. Norstar Holdings Inc was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Panama City Panama.

Name: iOCO Limited
Description: iOCO Limited provides information and communications technology services in Africa the United Kingdom Europe and the Middle East. It offers advisory; agile; artificial intelligence; automation; cloud and cyber security; data; enterprise resource planning; financial performance management; managed services; software testing; security and building management; and software and development services. The company also provides ExposeIT app that helps for root out corruption and wrongdoing in the organizations. It serves mining financial manufacturing public sector and telecommunication industries. The company was formerly known as EOH Holdings Limited and changed its name to iOCO Limited in December 2024. iOCO Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Midrand South Africa.

Name: Kartonsan Karton Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Kartonsan Karton Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and trades in coated cardboards in Turkey. It offers normprint exprint and luxtriplex multi-coated cardboards from recycled paper. The company’s products are used for the packaging of food pharmaceuticals detergents matches perfumery textiles stationary glassware small white goods book and notebook containers and corrugated lamination. It also exports its products to approximately 20 countries including Bulgaria Greece Spain Portugal Romania Georgia Israel and Egypt. The company was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Palestine Islamic Bank
Description: Palestine Islamic Bank provides various banking products and services to personal and business customers in Palestinian and internationally. The company offers current current salary savings financial inclusions corporate and fixed deposit accounts; term and investment deposits; education healthcare auto cars insurance commodity property and pensioners financing services; and Istisna’a’ services. It also provides direct financing products; and indirect financing products such as letters of credit and bills of collection and guarantees. In addition the company offers transfer safe deposit box money exchange and international bank account number services; personal and corporate cards; and electronic banking services that include online mobile SMS ATM electronic top-up and payment and cash deposit services. Palestine Islamic Bank was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestinian Authority.

Name: CI Systems (Israel) Ltd.
Description: CI Systems (Israel) Ltd. develops manufactures and markets electro-optical precision test and measurement equipment worldwide. The company offers various electro-optical test systems including SWIR cameras FLIR cameras day cameras detector testing systems laser testing systems and boresight testing systems; missile warning system testers; optical alignment testers; and integrating sphere systems. It also provides blackbody radiation sources such as extended area and cavity black bodies RAD motorized target wheels and accessories; and aperture collimators and wide field of view collimators. In addition the company manufactures and sells infrared radiometric products comprising multi-channel multi-spectral dual-band fast and solar-blind imaging radiometers for remote sensing applications. Further it offers optical gas imaging solutions; temperature screening cameras atmospheric transmission measurement systems spectroradiometers and circular variable filters; and optical monitoring equipment including noncontact temperature monitors and liquid monitoring systems for wafers and photovoltaic solar cell manufacturing. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Migdal Haemek Israel. CI Systems (Israel) Ltd. is a subsidiary of CI Technologies Inc.

Name: United Mining Industries Company
Description: United Mining Industries Company manufactures and sells a range of gypsum products for residential and commercial development in Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through Gypsum Board & Powder Cement Board and Others segments. It offers gypsum and performance boards; fiber cement boards; gypsum and fiber cement board ceiling tiles; metal profiles and accessories for walls and ceilings; T-grid ceiling systems; and gypsum powder. United Mining Industries Company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Libstar Holdings Limited
Description: Libstar Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures distributes and markets branded and private label consumer packaged goods in South Africa and internationally. It operates through three segments: Perishable Products Ambient Products and Household and Personal Care Products. The company offers refrigerated or frozen products including dairy convenience meals value-added meats and fresh mushrooms; wet and dry condiments meal ingredients baking and snacking and spreads; and household cleaning products as well as personal care products. It also provides baby food products; and beverages. The company sells its products under the Lancewood Millennium Foods Finlar Fine Foods Denny Mushrooms Umatie Rialto Cape Herb & Spice Khoisan Gourmet Cape Foods Montagu Foods Cecil Vinegar Dickon Hall Foods Cape Coastal Honey Chamonix Amaro Foods Cani Ambassador Foods Contactim and retailer brands to retail and wholesale food service industrial contract manufacturing and export channels. Libstar Holdings Limited was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Plattekloof South Africa.

Name: Melon S.A.
Description: Melon S.A. through its subsidiaries produces markets and supplies cement ready-mix concrete and aggregates in Chile. It operates through two segments Cement and Aggregates. The company’s products are used in high-rise buildings civil and industrial works mining and port works and household. It serves construction material distributors; construction companies; and the real estate infrastructure civil works and mining sectors. The company was formerly known as Lafarge Chile SA and changed its name to Melon S.A. in October 2009. Melon S.A. was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile. Melon S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Inversiones Cordillera del Sur II Spa.

Name: National Metal Manufacturing and Casting Co.
Description: National Metal Manufacturing and Casting Co. manufactures and sells metal engineering products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through Transformation Industries Engineering and metal forming industries and Industrial Valves segments. It offers high carbon steel wire products and PC strands for construction and infrastructure projects. The company also provides axles for heavy transport vehicles; and various spare parts for the automotive industry. In addition it offers metal castings including machined castings to the automotive agri and water crushing and mining cement plant oil and gas engineering and general manufacturing industries; and technical and engineering services to the oil and gas petrochemical and general engineering industries. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Jubail the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Delta Sugar Company
Description: Delta Sugar Company engages in the manufacture and sale of sugar beets in Egypt. It offers white and sugar cubes; beetroot pulp; and molasses for use in animal feed industry and to produce alcohol carbon dioxide converted honey vinasse and various types of baker's yeast. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt. Delta Sugar Company is a subsidiary of Egyptian Sugar and Integrated Industries Company SAE.

Name: Melnick Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A.
Description: Melnick Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A. operates as a real estate development company in Brazil. The company undertakes development of residential commercial condominium land and hotel projects; and provides reversible leasing programs. Melnick Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Porto Alegre Brazil.

Name: Suwen Tekstil Sanayi Pazarlama A.S.
Description: Suwen Tekstil Sanayi Pazarlama A.S. operates in women's underwear home wear and beach wear sector in Turkey. It provides a range of products comprising of home dressing beach and pregnant/puertomacy as well as socks; products for male such as athlete briefs athlete pyjamas and socks. The company sells its products in retail stores with its own brand and on its own e-commerce website. Suwen Tekstil Sanayi Pazarlama A.S. was founded in 2003 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Jamaica Producers Group Limited
Description: Jamaica Producers Group Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the property management businesses in Europe the Caribbean and North America. It operates through four segments: property and infrastructure; specialty foods global services; and financial services segments. The company is involved in the agriculture processing distribution and/or retail of food and drinks. It also engages in logistics transportation port terminal operations shipping land management and investment activities. Its products include fruit juices smoothies and flavored waters natural juices purified ice and water tropical snacks and rum cakes under the Hoogesteger St Mary’s Tortuga CoBeverage Lab Monte Cristi JP Tropical Snacks and Grupo Empresarial Alaska brands. The company also provides land and property management and treasury investments services. The company was formerly known as Jamaica Banana Producers Association Ltd. and changed its name to Jamaica Producers Group Limited in 1992. Jamaica Producers Group Limited was founded in 1925 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: British American Tobacco (Zambia) Plc
Description: British American Tobacco (Zambia) Plc engages in the manufacturing sales and distribution of cigarettes and nicotine products in Zambia. The company offers vapour tobacco heating products modern and traditional oral and combustible tobacco products. It sells its products under the Vuse Glo Velo Grizzly Dunhill Kent Lucky Strike Pall Mall Rothmans Camel Natural American Spirit Newport Vogue Viceroy Kool Peter Stuyvesant Craven A and State Express 555 brand names. British American Tobacco (Zambia) Plc was founded in 1963 and is based in Lusaka Zambia. British American Tobacco (Zambia) Plc is a subsidiary of British American Tobacco p.l.c.

Name: Inversiones Centenario S.A.A.
Description: Inversiones Centenario S.A.A. together with its subsidiaries operates as a real estate company in Peru. The company operates through Urban Development and Real Estate Rental segments. It owns a portfolio of urban development industrial development and offices. The company also develops and markets residential and industrial lots. In addition it operates hotels; and invests in housing. Inversiones Centenario S.A.A. was founded in 1929 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe S.A.B. de C.V. acquires develops and operates beach and urban hotels in Mexico. It operates in three segments: Urban Services Resort Services and Operator and Holding. The company operates a portfolio of 27 hotels under the Krystal Grand Krystal Hotels & Resorts Krystal Beach and Krystal Urban brands as well as under licensed brands such as Hilton Hilton Resorts Hilton Garden Inn and Hampton Inn & Suites. It also operates third-party hotels. Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries operates a chain of restaurants under the BigChefs NumNum and Buselik brands in Turkey and internationally. It also franchises its restaurants. Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Colombina S.A.
Description: Colombina S.A. produces and sells food products in Colombia and internationally. The company operates through Sweets Chocolate Cookies Preserves Ice Cream and Represented segments. It offers sweets chewing gum gums marshmallows chocolates snacks sweet cookies cakes sauces and preserves ice cream cream for cones popsicles ice cream cookies canned fish tuna and sardines coffee drinks olive oil alcohol and other imported products. The company was founded in 1918 and is based in Cali Colombia.

Name: AFMA S.A.
Description: AFMA S.A. provides insurance brokerage services for private and corporate clients in Morocco and internationally. The company offers insurance products for businesses such as civil liabilities operating loss business motor automobile transport damage and credit insurance as well as insurance related to construction; and personal and cyber risk insurance products. It also provides individual insurance solutions comprising car multi-risk home death retirement capitalization individual accident and health insurance products. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Warba Insurance and Reinsurance Company (K.S.C.P.)
Description: Warba Insurance and Reinsurance Company (K.S.C.P.) provides life and non-life insurance products and services for individuals and companies in Kuwait. The company operates through General Risk Insurance Life and Medical Insurance and Investment segments. It offers insurance against the risks related to goods transportation and various marine and aviation vessels; insurance against risks of contractors machine and computer damages and cessation of works; insurance for cash fidelity bonds professional risks work accidents civil responsibility and cars; insurance against fire for buildings stores industrial risks and oil and gas industries; and insurance against accidents for motor vehicles. The company also provides life and health insurance products; and reinsurance services. Warba Insurance and Reinsurance Company (K.S.C.P.) was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Ingevec S.A.
Description: Ingevec S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the engineering and construction business in Chile. The company operates through Engineering and Construction; Real Estate; and Investment and Income segments. It is involved in the study promotion administration and execution of real estate projects and developments which includes homes buildings civil and other related works as well as offers architecture and engineering services; and provision of professional and consultancy services. The company also invests in hotel and office projects located in Chile and Peru. Ingevec S.A. was founded in 1983 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc
Description: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc provides aircraft and cargo handling passenger handling passenger profiling and crew transportation services in Nigeria. It operates through Ground Handling Cargo Handling and Other segments. The company engages in ramp services and baggage handling. It also provides cargo documentation services for airlines import and export facilitation through customs bonded warehouses across the network.
