In addition the company involved in energy and power distribution and leasing of ground handling equipment. Further the company offers aircraft handling disinfection cleaning and aircraft movement control load control baggage/cargo off and onloading GSE supply and utilization unit load device management and baggage reconciliation services. Additionally it provides cargo handling services including warehousing import cargo bulk breaking cargo delivery and customs control-services; and crew transportation as well as aviation training services. Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Seef Properties B.S.C.
Description: Seef Properties B.S.C. primarily engages in real estate activities in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates through four segments: Malls and Properties Serviced Apartments Leisure and Entertainment and Other. The Malls and Properties segment manages real estate properties including the Seef Mall Isa Town Mall and Muharraq Seef Mall as well as other properties in Hamad Town Isa Town Saar and Um-Al Hassam. The Serviced Apartments segment leases Fraser Suites Seef furnished serviced apartments and tourist restaurants. The Leisure and Entertainment segment owns and operates leisure and recreational games facilities in various commercial malls under the Magic Island brand name. The company also manages hotels and amusement parks and theme parks. Seef Properties B.S.C. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Agma SA
Description: Agma SA engages in the insurance and reinsurance advisory and brokerage business in Morocco. The company offers automobile multi-risk home death accident travel/assistance pension savings insurance products for individuals. It also provides automotive insurance that covers public liability defense and appeal vehicle damage flight fire broken glass collision damage and passenger protection; industrial multi-risk fire/explosions breakage of machinery water damage flight and glass breakage and signs insurance products; construction assembly all risks and civil liability insurance products; and operating losses transported goods credit and cyber security insurance products. The company was formerly known as Agma Lahlou-Tazi S.A. and changed its name to Agma SA in May 2018. Agma SA was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Waja Company
Description: Waja Company engages in the construction business. The company undertakes general construction works for residential and non-residential buildings such as schools hospitals hotels and other projects. It is also involved in the construction and repair of water distribution stations and main pipelines; and design and programming of proprietary software. In addition the company manufactures furniture and wood-based furniture; and offers system analysis artificial intelligence technologies advertising agency and interior decoration design services. Waja Company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Salalah Port Services Company SAOG
Description: Salalah Port Services Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries engages in the leasing equipping operating and managing of container terminal and general cargo terminal facilities in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates in two segments Container Terminal and General Cargo Terminal. The company provides marine services; value-added services such as trucking real estate leasing CFS roro customs clearance bulk dhow operations warehousing sea air cargo cruise flex hubs oasis villas and clubs and break-bulk services; and property-related activities within the Port of Salalah premises. In addition it operates a liquid bulk terminal at the port of Salalah. Salalah Port Services Company SAOG was founded in 1998 and is based in Salalah the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Financiera Independencia S.A.B. de C.V. SOFOM E.N.R.
Description: Financiera Independencia S.A.B. de C.V. SOFOM E.N.R. a non-bank entity offers micro-lending services in Mexico and the United States. The company provides unsecured loans to individuals with low income and minimum wage informal sector and mothers as well as individuals with proven income as employees self-employed or independent contractors. It also offers consumer credit granting; administrative; and call center promotion marketing and other services. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Quds Bank Ltd.
Description: Quds Bank Ltd. provides banking and investment services and commercial solutions to corporate and individual customers. It offers current accounts; personal loans auto financing and real estate financing; credit cards and ATM cards; and e-services money transfer and safe boxes services. The company also provides banking services including treasury and FX services and remittances; financing services such as loans overdraft fixed assets financing project financing purchase and receivable financing discounting bills/cheques and customs financing; international trade services comprising bills for collection letters of credit and letters of guarantees; and mobile and online banking services. It operates through a network of multiple branches and offices in the Palestinian Authority as well as representative office in Jordan. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Takween Advanced Industries
Description: Takween Advanced Industries produces and sells plastic packaging products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Arab Republic of Egypt. The company offers polyethylene terephthalate (PET) pre-forms and bottles for water juices and other beverages and home and personal care products; HDPE bottles and containers; and flexible packaging products including plastic films and sheets. It also provides caps and closures for the mineral water soft drink juices dairy and food industries; disposable white semitransparent and transparent polystyrene cups and lids for the beverage industry; and industrial crates pallets pails buckets plastic plates cups utensils tables and chairs and others as well as drums. In addition the company offers non-woven fabrics comprising polypropylene spunbonded and spunmelt nonwoven products for use in consumer medical or industrial applications; the construction automotive home furnishings and packaging sectors; and babies’ products feminine care etc. as well as gowns drapes and sterile wraps for medical applications. Further it engages manufacture wholesale and retail trading of plastic containers and polyethylene cups rolls and bags; and management and operation of industrial centers. Additionally the company owns land; establishes industrial institutes and provides and coordinates training courses related to the development of plastic products; and establishes manages operates and maintains various industrial projects as well as engages in the import and export wholesale and retail of plastic products. The company was formerly known as Al-Othman Plastic Products. Takween Advanced Industries was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Al Khobar the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Cagdas Cam Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Cagdas Cam Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells insulated glass products in Turkey and internationally. The company offers oven and refrigerator glasses; energy saving glass solutions for commercial coolers; and AR coated PV module and greenhouse glasses. It also trades in glass products. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Aydin Turkey.

Name: Romi S.A.
Description: Romi S.A. develops manufactures and sells machine tools plastic processing machines and cast parts. The company provides machine tools such as machining and turning centers vertical turning centers CNC lathes and vertical CNC lathes CNC borings engine lathes and heavy and extra-heavy-duty CNC lathes; plastic processing machines including plastic injection blowing and molding machines; and casting and machined parts. It also provides presales and aftersales engineering services technical assistance and spare parts; and exports its products internationally. Its products and services are used by various industries such as automotive components manufacturing consumer goods agricultural machinery and implements education and industrial machinery and equipment. The company was formerly known as Indústrias Romi S.A. Romi S.A. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Santa Bárbara d'Oeste Brazil.

Name: City Lodge Hotels Limited
Description: City Lodge Hotels Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the operation of hotels for business and leisure travelers in South Africa Botswana Mozambique and Namibia. It owns operates and manages hotels under the Courtyard City Lodge Town Lodge and Road Lodge brands. City Lodge Hotels Limited was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Master Drilling Group Limited
Description: Master Drilling Group Limited an investment holding company provides specialized drilling services to blue chip major and mid-tier companies in the mining civil engineering construction and hydroelectric power sectors. It provides rock boring services including horizontal and vertical raise and box hole boring; slot hole reverse circulation piling and directional drilling; shotcreting; paste holes; and LIDAR scanning for mining civil and energy sectors. The company also offers industrial products. In addition it provides exploration drilling services such as blast hole core mud and air rotary percussion sonic diamond slim and reverse circulation drilling services; de-watering; and geotechnical services as well as mining services. The company also developed new technologies for tunneling shaft sinking and production boring. It operates in Africa Central and North America South Africa South America and internationally. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Fochville South Africa.

Name: Arabian Food Industries Company (DOMTY) - S.A.E
Description: Arabian Food Industries Company (DOMTY) - S.A.E together with its subsidiary El Tatweer Food Industries Company (S.A.E.) manufactures markets and distributes dairy cheese juice and bakery products in Egypt. It operates in three segments: Dairy Products Juice Products and Bakery Products. The company offers white and processed cheeses; mozzarella; juices; bakery products comprising sandwiches bread and croissants; and full and half cream and skimmed milk products. It sells its products under the Domty Bravo and Slim brands. The company also exports its products to approximately 35 countries with presence in the Middle East Europe North America and Africa. The company was formerly known as Domty Company for Food Industries S.A.E and changed its name to Arabian Food Industries Company (DOMTY) - S.A.E in August 2006. Arabian Food Industries Company (DOMTY) - S.A.E was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Gan Shmuel Foods Ltd.
Description: Gan Shmuel Foods Ltd. produces markets and sells citrus fruit tomato and other non-citrus fruit products in Israel. It also provides natural juices nectars and soft drinks as well as various types of sauces and spreads. The company serves food and beverage industries. It also exports its products to approximately 50 countries worldwide. The company was formerly known as Gan Shmuel Foods Industries (1993) Ltd. and changed its name to Gan Shmuel Foods Ltd. in August 1993. The company was founded in 1941 and is based in Gan Shmuel Israel.

Name: Supergas Power (2019) Ltd
Description: Supergas Power (2019) Ltd markets sells and distributes liquefied petroleum gas natural gas electricity and thermal energy in Israel. Its products are used to operate burners and boilers ovens in bakeries and restaurants for heating institutions and chicken coops in agriculture; and operation of small power stations. The company was formerly known as Electra Power (2019) Ltd and changed its name to Supergas Power (2019) Ltd in October 2025. Supergas Power (2019) Ltd founded in 1953 and is based in Netanya Israel. Supergas Power (2019) Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Elco Ltd.

Name: Al Gassim Investment Holding Company
Description: Al Gassim Investment Holding Company engages in the leasing of investment properties plants and equipment in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company invests in stocks and other securities and general contracting and real estate as well as in the industrial field; and the commercial import and export education healthcare transportation and agricultural sectors. It owns exploits and leases industrial property rights such as patents industrial trademarks franchise rights and other moral rights; establishes refrigeration and refrigerated transport units for the company and others; manages its subsidiaries; and engages in manufacture packaging and marketing of agricultural and food products. The company was formerly known as Qassim Agriculture Company and changed its name to Al Gassim Investment Holding Company in January 2017. Al Gassim Investment Holding Company was founded in 1984 and is based in Buraydah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Société Maghrébine de Crédit-bail
Description: Société Maghrébine de Crédit-bail provides various financial services in Morocco. The company offers equipment leasing and real estate leasing services. It serves professionals traders SMEs SMIs large groups and multinationals. Société Maghrébine de Crédit-bail was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Société Maghrébine de Crédit-bail operates as a subsidiary of Bank of Africa.

Name: Syn Prop & Tech S.A.
Description: We are SYN and we have a deep understanding of the Brazilian commercial real estate market. Our business is to make our clients' lives easier so they can focus on their own businesses. We serve various market segments including shopping malls commercial buildings and warehouses. Our services encompass leasing management as well as buying and selling commercial properties. Our team consists of experts in management projects engineering security technology and business with experience autonomy and a lot of talent for innovation to deliver the best solutions. Every day we wake up and dedicate ourselves to ensuring that companies and retailers feel at ease achieve their goals and thrive. We work behind the scenes taking care of people's experiences in SYN spaces while they work shop and have fun.

Name: Jaiz Bank Plc
Description: Jaiz Bank Plc provides non-interest banking services in Nigeria. It offers savings current domiciliary investment and term deposit accounts. The company also provides auto household appliances consumer home working capital project/construction lease to own equity-based import and export financing services as well as school fee hospital and medical bill rent and other financing services. In addition it offers various cards; investment products; letters of credit bonds guarantees acceptances and trade related contingencies that include documentary credits; point of sale; and automated teller machine services as well as online mobile and SMS banking services. Jaiz Bank Plc was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Abuja Nigeria.

Name: Vitro S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Vitro S.A.B. de C.V. through its subsidiaries produces processes distributes and markets inorganic chemical products worldwide. The company provides sodium carbonate and bicarbonate calcium chloride and sodium chloride. It serves automotive glass detergent water treatment pharmaceutical food oil road deicing and livestock sectors. Vitro S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1909 and is based in San Pedro Garza García Mexico.

Name: Gulf Union Alahlia Cooperative Insurance Company
Description: Gulf Union Alahlia Cooperative Insurance Company provides various insurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Riyadh Jeddah and Al Khobar. It offers motor out-patient clinic treatment charges property marine cargo engineering burglary comprehensive general liability employers’ liability fidelity guarantee money public and products liability workmen’s compensation and group life and accident insurance products as well as reinsurance products. Gulf Union Alahlia Cooperative Insurance Company was formerly known as Gulf Union Cooperative Insurance Co. and changed its name to Gulf Union Alahlia Cooperative Insurance Company in December 2020. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Dammam Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Arabia.

Name: Penta Teknoloji Urunleri Dagitim Ticaret A.S.
Description: Penta Teknoloji Urunleri Dagitim Ticaret A.S. distributes computer hardware and software goods in Turkey. The company offers Bazinet V3 a B2B e-commerce platform; and Bayinet mobile application for product review and warranty-failure tracking. It offers services including Penta technology center which provides demos PoCs hardware and software presentations and end-to-end business solutions; printing technology center that offers printing solutions and digital printing machines; printing solutions management a printing management model that measures consumables and printer usage of the users; and Penta subscription management which enables to display and manage subscriptions; Penta Mywarehouse for physical storage and online management; Penta Integration a system for storage logistics sales and marketing services; Penta OnAir a communication platform to reach resellers and customers; and 10 to 10 delivery service. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Kuwait Foundry Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait Foundry Company K.S.C.P. engages in the manufacturing of iron and other metal products in Kuwait. It operates through two segments: Manufacturing and Investment. The company offers manhole covers gratings and frames and pressure fittings. It is also involved in the investment in securities. Kuwait Foundry Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 1973 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Al Argan International Real Estate Company - K.S.C.P.
Description: Al Argan International Real Estate Company - K.S.C.P. operates as a real estate development company in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Real Estate Investment Contracting and Hotels and Resorts segments. The company engages in owning buying managing and selling of real estates and lands; conducting real estate studies and consulting activities; performing maintenance work related to buildings and real estates including maintenance work execution of civil mechanical electrical elevators work and air conditioning; organizing real estate exhibitions; and import and export activities. It also establishes real estate auctions; owns and manages commercial shops and housing complexes; trades in construction materials and equipment; constructs civil mechanical electrical sanitary elevators air conditioning aluminum and carpentry contracting projects; imports construction equipment; and owns buys and sells real estate companies' shares and bonds. In addition the company invests owns operates manages and leases hotels clubs motels hospitality houses rest houses parks gardens exhibitions restaurants cafeterias touristic and health resorts entertainment and sports projects; and manages restaurants. Further it establishes and manages investment funds; undertakes infrastructure projects for areas housing commercial and industrial projects; manages real estate facilities under BOT system; invests in portfolios managed by specialized entities; engages in agricultural activities; and offers medical services and heavy equipment as well as project management educational assets management advertising and entertainment services; and operates swimming pools. Al Argan International Real Estate Company - K.S.C.P. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: CSU Digital S.A.
Description: CSU Digital S.A. a technology company for financial services provides digital solutions for payments embedded finance customer experience and loyalty and incentive programs in Brazil. The company operates through two segments: CSU Pays and CSU DX. The CSU Pays segment encompasses solutions in digital payments loyalty and incentives and embedded finance including card processing for issuers and acquirers in the credit debit digital and virtual modalities; the offer of digital wallets instant payments and cryptocurrencies; and others. The CSU DX segment focuses on the development of digital experience solutions with technological and digital density directing efforts to projects with added value and complexity. The company also provides development and operational management relationship and customer acquisition programs; electronic transaction services for companies; information technology outsourcing services; and banking correspondent services to financial institutions. In addition it manages and operates telemarketing and telesales contact centers and credit analysis; captures electronic transactions as means of payment; and develops credit card administration and issuance activities as well as payment account management solutions and activities. The company was formerly known as CSU CardSystem S.A. and changed its name to CSU Digital S.A. in August 2022. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Barueri Brazil. CSU Digital S.A. is a subsidiary of Greeneville Delaware LLC.

Name: Konya Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Konya Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of paper products in Turkey. It offers paper rolls; writing papers white woodfree offset paper rolls and sheets; copy ivory and other colored papers; cardboard and offset printed laminated cardboard box packaging products; and spiraled and single-centered wire- stitched school notebooks spiral cardboard and plastic spiral PP cover notebooks separator notebooks calligraphy notebooks drawing notebooks and papers parchment papers cube blocks A4/A5 notepads and railroad board papers. The company also exports its products to Afghanistan Germany the United States the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Albania Azerbaijan Belarus Belgium Bosnia and Herzegovina Bulgaria Algeria the Czech Republic Armenia Ethiopia Palestine France South Africa Guinea Georgia Holland Iraq the Great Britain Iran the Republic of Ireland Spain Israel Switzerland Kazakhstan Kyrgyzstan North Cyprus Republic of the Congo Kosovo Libya Lebanon Macedonia Moldova Nigeria Uzbekistan Portugal Romania Russia Slovenia Somalia Sudan Syria Turkmenistan Ukraine Jordan and Greece. Konya Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Konya Turkey.

Name: Productive Business Solutions Limited
Description: Productive Business Solutions Limited engages in the distribution of printing equipment business machines handsets and related accessories. The company offers automated teller machines security checkpoints system integration cloud services data analytics communication solutions e-transaction solutions and development of software and other technology solutions. It also provides professional advanced networking and communications and information technology services; and printing security systems and payment methods. It has operations in Barbados Costa Rica Dominican Republic El Salvador Guatemala Honduras Nicaragua Panama the United States Antilles Jamaica Trinidad Guyana Cayman Antigua Colombia Suriname and internationally. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in St Michael Barbados. Productive Business Solutions Limited is a subsidiary of Facey Group Limited.

Name: Constructora Conconcreto S.A.
Description: Constructora Conconcreto S.A. operates as a construction company in Colombia and internationally. It offers construction services including consulting services such as pre-construction project management technical management conceptualization and auditing services for project conceptualization; construction design services which include architectural interior structural network geotechnical geometric and bioclimatic designs as well as integration of designs under BIM methodology; services for infrastructure housing buildings prefabricated components triboard panels and aggregates; and asset management services including specialized and public service management maintenance and multiservices and renovation and building adaptation services. The company also develops and sells housing and commercial units; and concessions and real investment projects. In addition it develops builds designs and manages infrastructure building and housing projects such as airport facilities logistic facilities commercial facilities institutions hotelier health facilities industrial corporate and transport. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Medellín Colombia.

Name: Egypt Gas Company SAE
Description: Egypt Gas Company SAE operates EPC-based natural gas distribution projects in Egypt. The company offers natural gas services including land survey P and A survey and design of natural gas projects; constructs high pressure transmission pipelines in different materials such as carbon steel and HDPE; and constructs pressure reduction stations and pressure reduction units as well as distribution networks. It also provides internal and external installations of gas meters for residential and commercial units; fabricates and installs the flues required for the system; operates and maintains projects; designs fabricates and installs accessories for natural gas project installations; and performs technical control and inspections on steel pipelines. In addition the company offers services for the design engineering procurement and construction of oil and gas projects; undertakes civil works; and mechanical works comprising supply and installation of pipeline projects storage tanks construction and maintenance installation works fire proofing works electromechanical works abrasive blasting and protective coating works scaffolding works and offshore platforms maintenance and rehabilitation. It serves residential commercial and industrial customers. The company was formerly known as natural gas projects company – SAE and changed its name to Egypt Gas Company SAE in August 2008. Egypt Gas Company SAE was founded in 1983 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Kenya Reinsurance Corporation Limited
Description: Kenya Reinsurance Corporation Limited engages in the underwriting of various classes of reinsurance and investments activities in Africa the Middle East and Asia. The company offers life and health reinsurance plans; property and casualty insurance policies for the fire marine hull engineering aviation motor and agriculture industries; and Retakaful support services. It also provides training services in the field of insurance and reinsurance industry. Kenya Reinsurance Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Ras Al Khaimah Co. for White Cement & Construction Materials P.S.C.
Description: Ras Al Khaimah Co. for White Cement & Construction Materials P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and supplies lime and cement products in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company operates through Manufacturing and Investments segments. It also offers concrete blocks and interlock tiles; and white cement clinker and Portland cement hydraulic cement and Kerbstone products. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Ras al-Khaimah the United Arab Emirates. Ras Al Khaimah Co. for White Cement & Construction Materials P.S.C. is a subsidiary of Ultratech Cement Middle East Investments Limited.

Name: Lux Island Resorts Ltd
Description: Lux Island Resorts Ltd invests in and operates hotels and resorts in Mauritius Reunion Island and Maldives. The company operates resorts and hotels under the LUX Grand Baie LUX Le Morne LUX Grand Gaube LUX Belle Mare LUX Saint Gilles LUX South Ari Atoll in the Indian Ocean; LUX Chongzuo and LUX TeaHorse Road in Asia Pacific; LUX Marijani in Africa; and Tamassa Bel Ombre and Ile des Deux Cocos brand names. It also operates a restaurant under the Emba Filao brand. The company was formerly known as Naïade Resorts Ltd and changed its name to Lux Island Resorts Ltd in December 2011. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Floreal Mauritius. Lux Island Resorts Ltd is a subsidiary of IBL Ltd.

Name: Israir Group Ltd
Description: Israir Group Ltd operates as an international tourism and aviation company in Israel. The company operates through four segments:  International tourism and aviation Domestic tourism and aviation Inbound tourism services and Maintenance. It leases aircraft and purchases seats as well as operates scheduled domestic and charter flights. The company is based in Givatayim Israel.

Name: Osoul Investment Company - K.S.C.P
Description: Osoul Investment Company - K.S.C.P an asset management company engages in the financing and investment activities in Kuwait and Gulf Co-operation council. The company operates through three segments: Finance Investment and Real Estate. It invests in real estate industrial agricultural and economic sectors; acts as an investment portfolio manager; purchases and sells securities and bonds; deals and trades in the foreign exchange market and precious metals market; and owns industrial property rights patents commercial and industrial trademarks commercial designs and literary and intellectual property rights related to programs and writings. The company also invests in Murabaha v and deposit in financial institutions; and offers wealth fund client portfolio and real estate management services. In addition it conducts studies and specializes in analytical research; and engages in the general trading activities. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Quara Finance Company
Description: Quara Finance Company provides financing services in Saudi Arabia. It operates through Retail and SME Financing segments. The Retail segment provides cash loan and microfinance services. The SME Financing segment offers term loans to small and medium enterprises. It also provides lease consumer and small and medium enterprise finance services. The company was formerly known as Maalem Financing Company and changed its name to Quara Finance Company in January 2021. Quara Finance Company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Baran Group Ltd
Description: Baran Group Ltd an engineering company provides engineering solutions for projects in Israel and internationally. The company offers feasibility studies engineering and design permitting and regulation management and supervision EHS commissioning process procurement and legal schedule and budget control operation and maintenance EPCM BOT/PPP project financing and related services. It also provides project execution and projects funding services. It serves various industries such as national infrastructures structures industry production water and agriculture gas and energy and technology and innovation. Baran Group Ltd was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Kfar Saba Israel.

Name: Abu Dhabi National Company for Building Materials PJSC
Description: Abu Dhabi National Company for Building Materials PJSC through its subsidiaries provides steel and cement products in the United Arab Emirates. The company offers wall and ceiling concrete blocks and interlocking tiles; concrete paving products for sidewalks car parks public parks etc.; reinforcing steel services such as steel cut and bend for various sizes and shapes wire mesh products and steel rebar threading and couplers; autoclaved aerated concrete products for the construction of buildings such as residential homes commercial and industrial buildings schools hospitals hotels and other applications; and paving blocks. It also involved in the manufacturing of construction precast concrete and bricks artificial stone articles and hot-rolled steel bars and rods; trading of oilfield and natural gas equipment and spare parts; bricks manufacturing; general trading; and operation of commercial agencies. Abu Dhabi National Company for Building Materials PJSC was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Arabian International Healthcare Holding Company
Description: Arabian International Healthcare Holding Company engages in distribution and maintenance of medical devices imaging equipment prosthetics dental and veterinary equipment and cosmetic products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through three segments: Medical Devices Medical Supplies and Clinical & Pharmaceutical. It offers various products for cardiology intensive care oncology rehab infection prevention technologies hospital infrastructure gene sequencing laboratory anesthesia machines hospital beds and medical furniture lab furniture solution biobanking solution hospital information technology surgical rooms solutions laboratories and ventilation system. The company also provides its products for orthopedics management delivery solutions catheters and syringes and vein thrombosis prevention. In addition it offers medical services at clinics; and sells health and beauty related medicines. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Tenth of Ramadan for Pharmaceutical Industries and Diagnostic Reagents (Rameda) (S.A.E)
Description: Tenth of Ramadan for Pharmaceutical Industries and Diagnostic Reagents (Rameda) (S.A.E) together with its subsidiaries produces and sells a range of branded generic pharmaceuticals food supplements veterinary products and nutraceuticals in Egypt. The company manufactures markets sells and stores pharmaceutical reagents for human and veterinary use and diagnostic reagents for individuals laboratories and hospitals; imports pharmaceutical reagents and raw materials; and produces food supplements for human use. It offers a portfolio of products in various therapeutic areas such as anti-biotics cardiovascular diseases and gastro-intestinal tract disorders anti-infectives alimentary tract and metabolism genito-urinary system nervous system blood forming organs weight management and sex hormones. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in 6th of October City Egypt.

Name: Loterie Nationale du Bénin Société Anonyme
Description: Loterie Nationale du Bénin Société Anonyme a gaming and lottery company. It offers mobilize national savings to finance investments of a social cultural and sporting nature. The Company was founded in 1967 and is based in Cotonou Benin.

Name: Sharjah Cement and Industrial Development Co. (PJSC)
Description: Sharjah Cement and Industrial Development Co. (PJSC) together with its subsidiary manufactures and supplies cement dry mortar paper sacks and plastic ropes in the United Arab Emirates other countries in the Middle East Africa and Asia. It operates in two segments Manufacturing and Investment. The company offers Portland cement sulfate-resisting Portland cement moderate sulfate-resisting Portland cement blast furnace cement oil well cement and ground granulated blast furnace slag. It also invests in investment securities public and private equities and funds and properties. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Sharjah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Bonyan for Development and Trade
Description: Bonyan for Development and Trade a real estate investment company acquires operates and leases commercial real estate assets in east and west Cairo. The company is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Sadr Logistics Company
Description: Sadr Logistics Company manufactures and supplies storage warehousing handling pallets and office solutions in Saudi Arabia. The company operates through four segments: Steel Wood Logistics and Other. It offers storage solutions such as pallet racking systems cantilevers radio shuttle racks shelves clading racks and mezzanine as well as accessories. The company also provides forklifts hand pallets roll containers and conveyors; office solutions comprising mobile shelves carrousel and lockers; wooden plastic and steel pallets; and warehousing services including dock levelers fixed elevators mobile ramps firefighting equipment and epoxy flooring systems. In addition it manufactures prefabricated steel structure units and furniture; forges presses casts and rolls finished and semi-finished metal products; and offers warehousing automation solutions. The company was formerly known as Al Samaani Factory For Metal Industries Company. Sadr Logistics Company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Maytronics Ltd.
Description: Maytronics Ltd. together with its subsidiaries engages in the development production marketing distribution and technical support of swimming pool equipment in Israel North America Europe Oceania and internationally. The company operates through The Private Pool Robotic Cleaner The Public Pool Robotic Cleaner and Safety Products and Related Pool Products segments. It offers robotic cleaners for private and public pools automatic swimming pool covers alarms and drowning detection systems and other supplementary products for monitoring control and treatment of swimming pool water pumps filters water heaters chemicals to clean the water and other related products. The company offers its robotic pool cleaners under the Dolphin name; and pool alarms under the Aqualarm Premium and Espio names. It sells its products through distributors and e-commerce platforms. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Jezreel Valley Israel. Maytronics Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Kibbutz Yizre'el Holdings 2004 ACS Ltd.

Name: The West Indian Tobacco Company Limited
Description: The West Indian Tobacco Company Limited manufactures and sells nicotine products primarily in Trinidad and Tobago and Caricom markets. It sells its products primarily under the Dunhill Lucky Strike Ruthmans and DuMaurier brand names. The company was founded in 1904 and is based in San Juan Trinidad & Tobago. The West Indian Tobacco Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of British American Tobacco (Investments) Limited.

Name: Caracol Televisión S.A.
Description: Caracol Televisión S.A. engages in the radio broadcasting and television businesses in Columbia and internationally. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Boyacá Colombia. Caracol Televisión S.A. is a subsidiary of Valorem S.A.

Name: Al-Mazaya Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Al-Mazaya Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public) together with its subsidiaries operates as a real estate development company in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Oman and Bahrain. It develops villas and residential buildings; commercial spaces comprising office and retail buildings; and health projects such as medical centers and hospitality projects. The company is involved in the marketing and sales management services; project management services; property management services; portfolio management services; medical services; and real estate brokerage and research services. In addition it purchases owns and sells lands; and operates manages invests in leases and rents hotels health clubs recreational parks gardens exhibition grounds restaurants residential and commercial complexes and tourist and health resorts. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Jazan Development and Investment Company
Description: Jazan Development and Investment Company together with its subsidiaries engages in the aquaculture agricultural manufacturing and real estate businesses in Saudi Arabia and Egypt. It operates through Agricultural Commercial Shrimp Farming and Investment Properties segments. The company is involved in the cultivation of mangoes and fruit seedling; marine shrimp farming; preservation of fish and fish products; cooling and freezing of fruits; production and bottling and distributing of pure filtered water; cutting packing and wrapping fruits and vegetables; operation of hotels and heritage; and animal feed and food storage as well as engages in the road transportation and refrigerated store activities. It also engages in the purchase sale and rental of land and real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Jazan Energy and Development Company. Jazan Development and Investment Company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Jazan Saudi Arabia.

Name: Kervan Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Kervan Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells candies in Turkey. The company provides soft and hard candy chewing gum degree chocolate jelly licorice and marshmallow products as well as surprise eggs and toy products. It also exports its products under the Bebeto and Cosby brand name. Kervan Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1994 is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Bor Seker A.S.
Description: Bor Seker A.S. manufactures and sells sugar products in Turkey. It offers granulated sugar sugar cubes stick sugar wet beet pulp bagged beet pulp and molasses. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Intema Insaat ve Tesisat Malzemeleri Yatirim ve Pazarlama A.S.
Description: Intema Insaat ve Tesisat Malzemeleri Yatirim ve Pazarlama A.S. markets and sells building products in Turkey. It provides ceramic sanitary ware armatures bathtubs shower trays built-in reservoirs bathroom furniture ceramic coating products construction chemicals kitchen furniture counters and accessories kitchen appliances and small household appliances under the VitrA Bathroom VitrA Karo Artema Villeroy & Boch and Intema brands. as well as Norm Selena and Punto brand names. The company provides its products through its retail stores as well as through wholesale channels. Intema Insaat ve Tesisat Malzemeleri Yatirim ve Pazarlama A.S. was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Priner Serviços Industriais S.A.
Description: Priner Serviços Industriais S.A. provides industrial infrastructure integrity engineering and inspection services in the petrochemical pulp and paper steel offshore naval mining and infrastructure sectors in Brazil. The company provides access solutions including scaffolding UpPriner LinkDeck Rope access and Web PrinerDeck; mechanical testing chemical analysis metallographic analysis corrosion testing field solutions procedure and welder qualification and failure analysis; execution of injected piles micro-anchoring anchored retaining walls soil nailing shotcrete soil treatment and load testing; pressurized habitat solutions; non-destructive testing inspection of equipment and facilities welding engineering advanced engineering materials engineering and laboratory services training and consulting inspection software and tank inspection services. It also offers Vivax Insertion camera Rovver X and Camera manhole zoom STV-3; conventional removable and reusable PFP hot and cold insulation and thermoplastic coating; industrial park; inspection and RBI finite element analysis engine thermal jackets computational fluid dynamics and fracture mechanics. In addition the company provides CIPP Point repair Steam curing process pressurized networks and UV Line curing process; and resin injection gallery plugging structural repair and reinforcement waterproofing hydrodemolition and priner soil inspection. Priner Serviços Industriais S.A. was formerly known as Mills SI Serviços Industriais S/A and changed its name to Priner Serviços Industriais S.A. in 2016. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Arab Sea Information Systems Company
Description: Arab Sea Information Systems Company together with its subsidiaries engages in the production of software for small medium and large businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers Saudi Administration and Accounting System a management accounting program; SCRIBES System an enterprise resource planning system for medium and large enterprises; 3S POS System a solution for companies with various points of sale such as supermarkets clothing companies footwear pharmacies drug stores and spare parts; and GIC – E-Government solutions a warehouse management system. It also provides consulting and planning installation training and customization service; management and monitoring services for communications and information networks; and cybersecurity services. In addition the company is involved in the repairing and maintaining of engines systems and fixed and portable information storage devices; and retail sale of computers and accessories including printers and inks. Further the company offers information systems and solutions for the government institutions and IT sectors. Arab Sea Information Systems Company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Société Nationale d'Electrolyse et de Pétrochimie S.A.
Description: Société Nationale d'Electrolyse et de Pétrochimie S.A. produces and sells vinyl and electrolysis products. The company offers liquid chlorine for use in bacteriological treatment; caustic soda used in food textile mining detergent and other industries; bleach for disinfection and detergent; and hydrochloric acid for galvanizing and surface treatment. It also provides PVC resin and PVC compound used for buildings irrigation drinking water supply sanitation energy transfer clothing etc. The company was founded in 1973 and is based in Casablanca Morocco. Société Nationale d'Electrolyse et de Pétrochimie S.A. is a subsidiary of YNNA Holding SA.

Name: Amir Marketing and Investments in Agriculture Ltd
Description: Amir Marketing and Investments in Agriculture Ltd supplies and markets agricultural inputs in Israel. It is involved in the marketing and distribution of inputs for the agricultural sector including plant protection and nutrition materials such as pesticides and fertilizer; industrial and agricultural packaging products that include cartons plastic containers and corrugated cardboards; irrigation and infrastructure solutions; technical equipment including gardening tools home tools synthetic grass clothing and footwear and others; greenhouse and cover solutions comprising polyethylene and nets; and markets seeds and seedlings. The company also operates animal feed production institute and real estate properties as well as markets agricultural tractors. Amir Marketing and Investments in Agriculture Ltd was founded in 1942 and is based in Hefer Valley Israel. Amir Marketing and Investments in Agriculture Ltd is a subsidiary of Amir Supply Ltd.

Name: Çates Elektrik Üretim Anonim Sirketi
Description: Çates Elektrik Üretim Anonim Sirketi engages in the production and sale of electricity through its thermal power plant. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Mugla Turkey.

Name: Al-Etihad Cooperative Insurance Company
Description: Al-Etihad Cooperative Insurance Company provides insurance services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers property motor marine medical and health general accident engineering and construction visit and tourism travel medical malpractice and other general insurance products and services. Al-Etihad Cooperative Insurance Company was founded in 2008 and is based in Al Khobar the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Al Dhafra Insurance Company P.S.C.
Description: Al Dhafra Insurance Company P.S.C. engages in the insurance and reinsurance business in the United Arab Emirates other GCC countries and internationally. It operates in two segments Underwriting of General Insurance Business and Investments. The company provides fire and general accident contract works and contractor’s plant & equipment electronic equipment machinery breakdown workmen’s compensation employer’s liability public liability medical malpractice professional indemnity risks marine cargo marine hull pleasure craft oil & gas on and offshore operations personal accident medical and life and motor products as well as visit visa and house maid policies. It also invests in marketable equity securities and investment funds development bonds term deposits with banks properties and other securities; and provides claim settlement services. In addition the company offers online insurance services. Al Dhafra Insurance Company P.S.C. was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Abu Dhabi United Arab Emirates.

Name: Benso Oil Palm Plantation PLC
Description: Benso Oil Palm Plantation PLC engages in the production of palm oil primarily in Ghana. It produces palm oil and palm kernel oil. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Takoradi Ghana. Benso Oil Palm Plantation PLC is a subsidiary of Wilmar Africa Limited.

Name: M.L.R.N Projects and Trade Ltd.
Description: M.L.R.N Projects and Trade Ltd. provides credit to small and medium-sized businesses in Israel. It offers business loans check discounting leasing to finance the purchase of equipment and tools and financing for the purchase of real estate as well as line of credit services. M.L.R.N Projects and Trade Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: Liva Insurance Company
Description: Liva Insurance Company engages in the insurance and reinsurance businesses primarily in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through six segments: Property Motor Engineering Medical Marine Group Life and Others. It offers car travel home and personal accident insurance products; and small and medium business package solutions motor fleet property marine engineering life workmen’s compensation liability and general accident insurance products. The company was formerly known as Al Alamiya for Cooperative Insurance Company and changed its name to Liva Insurance Company in November 2023. Liva Insurance Company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia. Liva Insurance Company is a subsidiary of Liva Insurance B.S.C.

Name: Prime Energy P.E. Ltd
Description: Prime Energy P.E. Ltd together with its subsidiaries engages in the initiating planning developing financing constructing managing licensing and operating of solar energy projects in Israel and internationally. As of December 31 2023 it had an operating portfolio of 36 commercially operated facilities with a total capacity of approximately 30 megawatts. Prime Energy P.E. Ltd was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Rishon LeZion Israel.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Horoz Lojistik Kargo Hizmetleri ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Horoz Lojistik Kargo Hizmetleri Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates in the logistics industry in Turkey and internationally. The company offers transportation services including international road transport and air freight national-international rail freight international sea freight intermodal transport domestic full track load transportation domestic distribution furniture distribution and project cargo transportation; and storage services such as conventional dealer shared e-commerce and furniture warehouses. It also provides e-services comprising e-export e-commerce logistics horoz wallet and alibaba membership; and other services consisting of furniture assembly and SSH project management and consulting and customs and insurance services. The company was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Klil Industries Ltd
Description: Klil Industries Ltd designs develops manufactures paints and markets aluminum systems for the construction and industrial sectors in Israel and internationally. It offers windows doors shutters curtain walls blinds and shading solutions and accessories as well as shutter boxes made of aluminum cans. The company was founded in 1950 and is based in Karmiel Israel.

Name: Zeda Limited
Description: Zeda Limited provides mobility solutions in South Africa and other countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. It operates through Car Rental Business and Leasing Business segments. The Car Rental Business segment provides short term rental and subscription solutions for individuals business travel corporates and government entities under the Avis and Budget brand name. It provides replacement vehicles for its partner insurance companies as well as other complementary products that include the hire of child car seats GPS and bike racks and specialized insurance products. The Leasing Business segment offers services that comprise the leasing of vehicles such as motorcycles and heavy commercial vehicles for corporates small businesses and government entities. It also provides complementary products such as telematics intelligent fuel and accident management roadside assistance insurance and managed maintenance services as well as maintenance plans. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Kempton Park South Africa.

Name: Alkim Alkali Kimya A.S.
Description: Alkim Alkali Kimya A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of paper products in Turkey. The company operates through three segments: Chemical Products Paper and Other Operations. It offers paper pulp coated paper and photocopy paper; ivory glass paper wet strength label paper soap paper and special paper for religious books; and label papers soap packaging papers envelope papers and blueprint papers white kraft papers and cup papers. The company also provides sodium sulphate potassium sulphate salt and magnesium chloride liquid. In addition it offers Insurance intermediary services. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A.
Description: Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A. operates as a multi-solution company in Brazil. The company offers private healthcare plans markets and manages other insurance or complementary services and provides services for the capture routing authorization and billing of medical and hospital services. It also offers medical audit services processing of medical bills call center operations claims and hospital network management system licensing and other outsourced healthcare support services. Additionally it engages in mass insurance brokerage through retail channels such as life insurance capitalization home insurance extended warranty financial protection insurance and others. The company facilitates client access to accredited networks of service providers and offers specialized care management services. It provides private collective healthcare plans to members of contracting legal entities offers technical support supports the human resources area in managing plan benefits outsources administrative services manages registration movements checks invoices and provides billing services to beneficiaries by delegation. It also offers consulting services and suggests plan design and management models. In addition the company identifies the target market defines the marketing strategy and distribution model and offers membership plans to potential clients through its own distribution channel or a network of accredited insurance brokers. It serves monitors and reviews client portfolios. The company was formerly known as Qualicorp S.A. and changed its name to Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A. in June 2018. It was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Dari Couspate SA
Description: Dari Couspate SA produces and sells couscous and pasta products in Morocco. It also exports its products to approximately 45 countries. In addition the company distributes its products to retail chains and outlets. Dari Couspate SA was founded in 1995 and is based in Salé Morocco.

Name: Compañía Minera Santa Luisa S.A.
Description: Compañía Minera Santa Luisa S.A. engages in the development exploration exploitation production and metallurgical treatment and marketing of mining in Peru. The company produces and sells zinc lead and copper concentrates. It also owns mining rights in the Huanzalá and Pallca mines located in the Ancash Region Peru. Compañía Minera Santa Luisa S.A. was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Lima Peru. Compañía Minera Santa Luisa S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Mitsui Mining & Smelting Co. Ltd.

Name: Société Multinationale de Bitumes Société Anonyme
Description: Société Multinationale de Bitumes Société Anonyme processes heavy bitumen crude in Africa. The company offers bitumen and distillates. It exports bitumen to Nigeria Ghana Gabon Senegal Cameroon Mauritania Angola Guinea Conakry Togo Benim and DRC. Société Multinationale de Bitumes Société Anonyme is based in Abidjan Ivory Coast.

Name: Envases Venezolanos S.A.
Description: Envases Venezolanos S.A. engages in the manufacturing and sale of metal and glass containers for various containers for use in industrial and domestic applications in Venezuela. The company provides tin containers for canned fish food and industrial products; lids; and tin crown caps and plastic caps as well as undertakes lithography works. Envases Venezolanos S.A. was founded in 1952 and is based in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: Grupo Bvl S.A.A.
Description: Grupo Bvl S.A.A. provides stock market services in Peru. It offers stock market trading clearing and settlement digital and price provisioning services. The company also facilitates the trading of duly registered securities through stock exchange; offers registration transfer and custody services for securities; provides transaction clearing and settlement services; offers platform services for the issuance signature management and custody of electronic documents linked to commercial transactions; and provides consulting services in various areas related to the financial and securities markets. In addition it offers educational services for promoting the development of the securities market as well as invests in financial assets. The company was formerly known as Bolsa de Valores de Lima S.A.A. and changed its name to Grupo Bvl S.A.A. in June 2021. The company was founded in 1860 and is based in San Isidro Peru. Grupo Bvl S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Holding Bursátil Regional S.A.

Name: Mohandes Insurance Company
Description: Mohandes Insurance Company provides life and general insurance products in Egypt. It offers fire and burglary; and engineering insurance products including all-risk installation contractors all-risk machinery malfunction document contractors machinery and equipment electronic equipment document and corruption document contents insurance. The company also provides transport and ship hull insurance; group medical treatment insurance; and compulsory and supplementary cars insurance. In addition it offers miscellaneous accident insurance products comprising personal accident employers liability travel risk document professional liability family protection and housing glass breakage cash transportation and civil liability for elevator and construction work as well as insurance against breach of trust of embezzlement insurance policies. Mohandes Insurance Company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Çemtas Çelik Makina Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Çemtas Çelik Makina Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and selss of steel products in Turkey. The company offers specialty steel products including spring steel flat peeled round and hot rolled round bars in various steel qualities consisting of spring carbon quench and tempering micro alloy boron case hardening free cutting stainless carbon toll and bearing and structural steel. It provides stabilizer bars. The company serves automotive supply wind energy machine manufacturing and defence industries. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Bursa Turkey. Çemtas Çelik Makina Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Bursa Cimento Fabrikasi A.S.

Name: Oncosem Onkolojik Sistemler Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Oncosem Onkolojik Sistemler Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi manufactures and sells chemotherapy drug preparation kits medical devices and test kits in Turkey. The company offers OncoCare Monolitik an automated chemotherapy drug preparation device; OncoCare Plus a chemotherapy drug guide; OncoWaste and M-Waste a hazardous waste sealing system chemotherapy drugs cephalosporins penicillins infectious waste and toxic laboratory waste; OncoCare Set a chemotherapy preparation and administration consumables; and Oncocare Infusion Pump. It also provides Oncosem components such as pinch clamps roller clamps 3/4 way connectors vial adapters drip chambers hydrophobic caps male and rotating luer locks spikes taxol filters check valves and covers. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Barem Ambalaj Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Barem Ambalaj Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi provides packaging solutions in Turkey. It offers corrugated cardboard sheet box paper and offset printed box products. The company serves food electronics hygiene toys textile cosmetics agriculture automotive and other sectors. It also exports its products to 17 countries. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the retail sale of technology products in Turkey. It sells its products through its stores; air conditioners and refrigerators through its dealer network; and solar energy systems. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Haci Ömer Sabanci Holding A.S.

Name: Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG
Description: Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries markets and distributes petroleum products primarily in the Sultanate of Oman. It offers one-stop-shop service stations that provides on- the-go shopping food and beverages; commercial fuels; fuel cards and lubricants; and digital transformation solutions. The company also provides marine fuel and solutions advertisement and property rental services. In addition it operates retail convenience store car care centers and coffee franchise. Further the company markets and distributes petroleum products and bunker petroleum products. The company was formerly known as BP Oman SAOG and changed its name to Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG in October 2003. Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG was founded in 1998 and is based in Muscat Oman.

Name: Avgol Industries 1953 Ltd
Description: Avgol Industries 1953 Ltd together with its subsidiaries manufactures and markets high-performance spun melt nonwoven materials worldwide. Its products have applications in the adult hygiene baby care construction feminine hygiene filtration industrial medical and transportation sectors. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel. Avgol Industries 1953 Ltd is a subsidiary of Indorama Ventures Spain S.L.

Name: Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the production and marketing of manganese minerals and ferroalloys in Mexico and internationally. It is also involved in the electricity generation and mining of precious metals. The company offers ferroalloy and manganese products including high medium and low carbon ferromanganese; silicomanganese; nitrided medium carbon ferromanganese; manganese nodules and carbonates; and other specialty ferroalloys as well as manganese derivatives such as battery-grade natural manganese dioxide ceramic-grade natural manganese dioxide and manganous oxide products. In addition the company generates electricity through hydroelectric plant; and produces electrolytic manganese dioxides. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in San Pedro Garza García Mexico. Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a subsidiary of Autlán Holding SAPI de CV.

Name: Al Mahhar Holding Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Al Mahhar Holding Company Q.P.S.C. engages in the energy and infrastructure business in Qatar and internationally. The company engages in the marketing and sale of products and services related to oil and gas industry; trading and rental of industrial construction equipment; and undertaking water contractor works. It also provides engineering services for geological mining and underground and surface water; and sewage and water draining services. Al Mahhar Holding Company Q.P.S.C. was founded in 1989 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Egeyapi Avrupa Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Egeyapi Avrupa Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. operates as a real estate development company in Turkey. It undertakes housing office hotel shopping mall and educational institution projects. The company was founded in 2015 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Birlesim Grup Enerji Yatirimlari A.S.
Description: Birlesim Grup Enerji Yatirimlari A.S. engages in investment production and sale of renewable energy. It generates energy from solar wind hydroelectric biomass and geothermal heat resources. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: YeboYethu (RF) Limited
Description: YeboYethu (RF) Limited acquires and holds shares in Vodacom Group. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Midrand South Africa.

Name: Al Ain Ahlia Insurance Company P.S.C.
Description: Al Ain Ahlia Insurance Company P.S.C. provides insurance and reinsurance services in the United Arab Emirates. It operates through two segments Underwriting of General Insurance and Investments. The Underwriting of General Insurance segment offers fire marine motor medical general accident and miscellaneous insurance. The Investments segment provides investments in marketable equity securities and investment funds development bonds term deposits investment properties and other securities. The company also offers home travel and boat insurance as well as school and family care package services. In addition it provides group medical group life and personal accident property liability financial line aviation oil and gas onshore and offshore engineering and construction and motor fleet insurance products as well as miscellaneous insurance including professional indemnity directors’ and officers’ liability fidelity guarantee fire and allied perils sabotage terrorism money/cash in transit public and products liability and workmen’s compensation insurance products. Additionally the company is involved in the investment management and hotel apartment rentals business. Al Ain Ahlia Insurance Company P.S.C. was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Al Kathiri Holding Company
Description: Al Kathiri Holding Company together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells ready-mix concrete products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company also supplies transports distributes and sells cement and construction materials such as gravel and washed sand. In addition the company offers three-dimensional concrete panels; real estate contracting and development; telecommunications; construction; yachts and boats; and logistical services and support for the transportation sector. Al Kathiri Holding Company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Keir International Co.
Description: Keir International Co. provides a range of service solutions. It operates through Telecom Power and Software segments. The company engages in laying of pipes for electricity communications etc.; installation and maintenance of security devices; repair and maintenance of telecommunications and radar stations and towers; development of residential real estate; network extensions; and extension of electrical and communication wires. It also offers implementation execution operation maintenance and trading and supply products for the IT and communications sector as well as for public utility industries such as power and electricity generation water gas and petroleum sectors. In addition the company provides CCTV security and core network solutions electrical and infrastructural works information and communications technology works and low current systems; and software products and services such as eMORSALAT eMAKTAB payment gateway SADAD adapter RASED adapter crowdfunding digital wallet and open banking outsourcing and insourcing business intelligence low code platform custom development fintech products and solutions and networking. Further it offers telecom engineering planning design and inventory electrical engineering planning design and inventory gas engineering planning design and inventory and water engineering planning design and inventory; construction of structure solid wall system bathroom pods and remote production units; and fiber optic cables IoT M2M solution and sim cards fiber-to-the-home connectivity materials and networking products. Additionally it is involved in supply and installation of solar and renewable energy system. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Ash-Sharqiyah Development Co.
Description: Ash-Sharqiyah Development Co. produces and markets agricultural greenfeed in Saudi Arabia. It operates through Al-Sharqiya (Holding Company) Sadu Al Arab and Al Waseet Al Barri Logistics Company (A subsidiary of Sadu Al Arab Trading Company) segments. It is also in involved in agriculture forestry fishing and construction activities; wholesale and retail trade; repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles; operation of storage facilities; accommodation and food service activities; real estate activities; art entertainment and leisure activities; and other service activities including growing vegetables in greenhouses and growing uncovered variegated vegetables. In addition the company engages in food security and logistics; and refrigerated and frozen goods land transportation activities. Ash-Sharqiyah Development Co. was founded in 1986 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Rimoni Industries Ltd.
Description: Rimoni Industries Ltd. engages in the design engineering and manufacture of molds and precise injection molding and assemblies for the medical automotive agricultural high-tech and consumer industries in Israel. The company offers hardened steel molds including multi-cavity molds molds with hot runner systems prototype molds for complex and intricate products molds for micro-precision parts over-moldings and others. It also provides plastic parts by thermoplastic injection molding; and assembly services for injection molding products. Rimoni Industries Ltd. was founded in 1954 and is based in Modi'in-Maccabim-Re'ut Israel.

Name: Aspen Group Ltd.
Description: Aspen Group Ltd. engages in the purchase initiation improvement management and rental of real estate properties in Israel and the Netherlands. Its property portfolio includes office hotel services trade industrial and logistics buildings. The company was formerly known as Aspen Construction and Development Ltd. and changed its name to Aspen Group Ltd. in July 2009. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: Egyptian Gulf Bank (S.A.E)
Description: Egyptian Gulf Bank (S.A.E) provides various corporate retail and investment banking services in Egypt. It offers savings current interest bearing and investment accounts; certificates of deposit; and time deposits. The company provides secured personal auto used cars auto durable goods education syndicated and mortgage loans; revolving overdrafts; loans for small and medium sized businesses; working capital and trade financing; project finance; loans for doctors; and pharmacists lending services. In addition it offers Islamic banking cash management foreign exchange treasury bills and bonds payroll fund margin lending e-statement and online banking services as well as debit credit and internet cards. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Carmel Corp Ltd.
Description: Carmel Corp Ltd. engages in the production and marketing of various soft drinks and mineral water in Israel. It sells soft drinks under the Tafuzina Spring RC Spring Tea Cola Schweppes Crystal Schweppes Fun Waer Ein Gedi and Fruit & Veg brand names. The company is also involved in recycling of plastic bottles; processing development production marketing and sale of wine and alcohol products under the Carmel Wineries Brand name; and buying marketing and distribution of finished products such as beers wines cognac vodka and arak. The company was formerly known as Clal Industries and Beverages Ltd and changed its name to Carmel Corp Ltd. in September 2022. Carmel Corp Ltd. was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Shoham Israel.

Name: Fujairah Building Industries P.J.S.C.
Description: Fujairah Building Industries P.J.S.C. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells concrete products in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company operates through Manufacturing and Quarrying segments. The Manufacturing segment manufactures and supplies blocks interlocks kerbstones ceramic tiles rockwool insulation materials and marble and terrazzo tiles. The segment also provides contracting for supply and installation of marbles and terrazzo tiles. The Quarrying segment mines and sells quarry products. Fujairah Building Industries P.J.S.C. was founded in 1978 and is based in Fujairah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Bait Vegag Real Estate Development Ltd
Description: Bait Vegag Real Estate Development Ltd engages in the construction evacuation and urban renewal activities in Israel. The company was formerly known as BAIT VEGAG GL LTD and changed its name to Bait Vegag Real Estate Development Ltd in April 2022. The company is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Abu Dhabi National Takaful Company PSC
Description: Abu Dhabi National Takaful Company PSC provides takaful insurance solutions in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company operates in two segments: Underwriting and Investments. It offers personal insurance such as female and male critical illness care; health; home; jetski; motor; personal accident; and school fee protection insurance. The company also provides aviation casualty energy engineering general accident group life group medical marine cargo motor fleet political violence property and protect Plus corporate insurance. Abu Dhabi National Takaful Company PSC was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Onur Yuksek Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi
Description: Onur Yuksek Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi designs manufactures and installs communication systems for civil and military sectors in Turkey. The company offers voice communication and recording systems including military civilian and integrated voice communication systems; voice communication for transport applications; and other command and control systems. It also provides integrated data communications solutions for mobile platforms and unmanned systems; and integration of aviation systems including mobile air traffic control towers and navigation and air traffic control systems as well as solar and wind power plants for renewable energy systems. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: KFIC Invest Company K.S.C. (Public)
Description: KFIC Invest Company K.S.C. (Public) together with its subsidiaries provides consumer and commercial lending services in Kuwait. It operates through four segments: Finance Asset Management Investment and Corporate Finance and Financial Brokerage and Online Trading. The Finance segment provides consumer and commercial loans to individuals and corporate entities. The Asset Management segment offers portfolio management and custody services; and manages mutual funds. The Investment and Corporate Finance segment provides investment banking and financial consultancy services; and monitors direct investments. The Financial Brokerage and Online Trading segment offers brokerage and online trading services. The company also leases buys and sells vehicles; provides collection services; manages funds and portfolios on behalf of its clients; and invests in securities and real estate. In addition it offers investment management alternative investment and consulting and advisory services. The company was formerly known as Kuwait Finance and Investment Company K.S.C and changed its name to KFIC Invest Company K.S.C. (Public) in November 2022. (Public). KFIC Invest Company K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Prestige Holdings Limited
Description: Prestige Holdings Limited operates as a restaurant management company in the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago Jamaica and internationally. It operates a chain of casual dining and quick service restaurants under the KFC Pizza Hut Subway Starbucks and TGI Fridays brand names. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Port of Spain Trinidad and Tobago. Prestige Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Victor E. Mouttet Limited.

Name: Quality Chemical Industries Limited
Description: Quality Chemical Industries Limited manufactures and sells pharmaceutical drugs in Uganda. The company offers lamivudine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate dolutegravir efavirenz and zidovudine tablets for the treatment of HIV infection. It also provides lumartem/lumet tablets for the treatment of malaria; texavir and zentair for the treatment of Hepatitis B; and isoniazid/pyridoxine hydrochloride /sulfamethoxazole trimethoprim tablets for the treatment of tuberculosis. In addition the company offers emeset for the treatment of nausea and vomiting; ciplox and azicip anti-infectives to prevent and treat infections; amlopres to treat hypertension; and erecto for the treatment of reproductive disorders such as erectile dysfunction. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Cipla Quality Chemical Industries Limited and changed its name to Quality Chemical Industries Limited in February 2024. Quality Chemical Industries Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Kampala Uganda. Quality Chemical Industries Limited is a subsidiary of Cipla Limited.

Name: E & M Computing Ltd.
Description: E & M Computing Ltd. provides technological solutions in Israel. The company provides software development enterprise applications digital cloud computing on-premises infrastructure business continuity managed services data integration management and analytics security solutions AI and high-performance computing and professional services. It also offers a range of services which include professional services data big-data and analytics hyperscale cloud business continuity cyber security software hosted IT rack-scale systems and data center technologies solutions as well as networking OEM and outsourcing solutions. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Companhia de Participações Aliança da Bahia
Description: Companhia de Participações Aliança da Bahia through its subsidiaries engages in breeding rearing selecting fattening buying and selling of cattle and other species in Brazil.
